chapters.title: Chapter 751: The Yan Clan
paragraphs: Since there was no room left in the Yin-Yang Space to place Ma Mingxin there, Zhang Fei [5] freed Mo Xuanxing from the dream prison and woke her up.
After she opened her eyes, Mo Xuanxing immediately realized her situation, especially after she saw Ma Mingxin. "Are you going to release me from this place now, Master?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] first chained Ma Mingxin and imprisoned her subconscious. He then spoke to Mo Xuanxing. "Even though you were originally my enemy, your Yin Qi has helped me a lot. However, you should already know that I never wanted you by my side, so I will let you go. I will remove my slave mark on your soul, and I will change a little of your memories so you will not remember me or this place. Since you are a human with a demon bloodline, you can choose between the human realm or the demon realm, and I will send you to one of them."

Mo Xuanxing had long realized that, but she still felt disappointed with Zhang Fei [5]'s decision to abandon her. "Can you not change my memories, Master? I don't mind living as your slave for the rest of my life, but I don't want to lose my memories of everything."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow slightly. "Are you sure about that?"

"Yes." Mo Xuanxing replied with a firm nod. "Even though I have a demon bloodline, I don't want to become a complete demon, so I want to go to a human realm. If you don't mind, I hope you are willing to send me to the middle or upper realms, Master."

Hearing that, Zhang Fei [5] pondered as he stared at Mo Xuanxing, and he used his demon eyes to inspect her soul before making a decision about her. "I don't know many realms in the middle or upper realms yet, but I have a safe place for you, so I will send you there now."
"Thank you, master." Mo Xuanxing responded with a sense of relief.

Zhang Fei [5] contacted Hong Xinxin first before he sent Mo Xuanxing to the Hong clan. After that, he returned to the Nine Stars Realm and went to Duan Zhao's residence, where he began to try forging an earth-grade weapon under his guidance.

In the Hong Clan, Hong Xinxin led Mo Xuanxing to leave her clan and took her to a place a little far from her clan. "Why did you choose to live like this? Zhang Fei is not usually forgiving of his enemies, and he gave you a chance to live freely, but you refused it."

"I no longer have a family because my master sent my husband to the realm of the heavenly foxes, and I killed my own son due to my body being controlled by that female demon. Besides, the cultivators in the Sky Jade Realm had already slaughtered all the heretics, and there was no one left there." Hong Xinxin was not surprised to hear Mo Xuanxing's answer because Zhang Fei had already told her about all the events in that realm. "I've been his slave for a long time, and I'm used to my situation, but he doesn't want me because many men have touched my body when that female demon controlled me before. Since I'm his slave, I want to help him in other things, especially in his organization. Unfortunately, my cultivation is too weak, so I asked him to send me to this realm, and I will focus on improving my strength here."

Hong Xinxin felt quite sorry toward Mo Xuanxing, but she did not want to go against Zhang Fei's decision. Before long, they arrived at a small garden with a cave at the end, and she led her into it. "Honestly, I wanted to let you stay in my Hong clan, but your demon bloodline and nature are quite troublesome, so I brought you here. You don't need to worry about anything, and no one will bother you here, so you can focus on your cultivation. I will send someone to send you some food every day, and I will ask her to leave it on the garden table."
"Thank you."

Hong Xinxin then gave Mo Xuanxing a storage ring. "There are quite a lot of cultivation resources inside, and they can help you speed up your cultivation. I don't know when Zhang Fei will move to this realm yet, but I'm sure it won't be too long. Therefore, you must fully focus on your cultivation if you really want to help him, and I will continue to help you with that."

"I will focus on my cultivation, and I will be useful to my master in the future." After Hong Xinxin left, Mo Xuanxing immediately sat in the middle of the cave, checked the contents of the storage ring, and took out several items. "All these resources are too precious for cultivators in the lower realms, and the quality of Qi in this realm is too powerful for cultivators at my level. I'm sure my cultivation will skyrocket if I use them to cultivate, so I'll start now."
"Who was the woman just now, Xin'er?" Yan Yizhen inquired as soon as Hong Xinxin returned.

Hong Xinxin immediately explained to her mother and grandmother about Mo Xuanxing's identity. "Zhang Fei wanted to free her, but she refused because she had no family left, and she was used to living as his slave. She insisted on helping him, so I brought her to my private cave. I will also support her with a lot of cultivation resources, so she will be useful to him in the future."

Cai Yinzhi and Yan Yizhen also felt sorry for Mo Xuanxing, but the world of cultivation was always cruel and knew no mercy, let alone her former family were heretic cultivators. However, they were surprised that Zhang Fei intended to release her and not kill her, which was quite contrary to his character.

Cai Yinzhi then spoke to her granddaughter. "Since that woman wants to help Zhang Fei, you can use any method to help her. After all, her cultivation is still in the ten mortal realms, and she will be useless if her cultivation continues to be at that level. Even if she succeeds in breaking through to the Seven Divine Realms, it is still not enough because there are too many high-level cultivators in these upper realms, and she has to work harder."
"Yes, Grandmother." Hong Xinxin then told her mother. "Mother, Zhang Fei has agreed to meet your family, and he will come once they get here."
Yan Yizhen nodded in satisfaction with that. "What made Zhang Fei agree to meet them?"

"Hehe." Hong Xinxin giggled. "Naturally, Zhang Fei agreed because they are my family, and he is also curious about your clan's speed techniques. Some of his wives, such as Qing Yi and Zhao Ziqin, are speed cultivators. Therefore, he wants them to learn from my grandpa to further hone their speed."
"Are their speeds also as fast as Zhang Lin's?" Cai Yinzhi asked.

"I've watched them fight before, so I can say that Qing Yi and Zhang Lin's speed is equal." Hong Xinxin smiled when she heard Yan Yizhen's sigh. "Zhao Ziqin's speed is a bit faster than both of theirs, even if she doesn't use her wind element. If she uses her wind element, her speed will surpass yours, Mother."

Yan Yizhen could only nod in response. "I don't know if your grandfather will be willing to teach them because our speed techniques are a family heritage and have never been taught to outsiders, so we'll have to wait for the results when they meet later."

In the Cloud Mansion, Zhang Yue had calmed down, but her mind was still filled with the power of Zhang Fei's killing intent, especially since it could make a cultivator of Feng Jinqiu's level terrified. "Is the only way for me to increase my killing intent by killing, Fei'er?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded at her. "The more you kill and the more your hands are soaked in blood, the stronger your killing intent will be. If you want to increase your killing intent, I can take you to the Netherworld Realm. There are countless evil demons there, and they are far more vicious than humans, so you don't have to regret killing them."
"How many have you killed? Have your victims reached one million?" Zhang Yue curiously asked.

"Honestly, I've killed too many since I became a cultivator, so I can't count my casualties anymore." Zhang Yue took a deep breath at Zhang Fei's response. "However, most of my victims were demons or demon beasts because I focused more on my demon form at the beginning of my cultivation, and I spent more time in the Netherworld Realm and the Diyu Realm."
Zhang Yu nodded in understanding. "Unfortunately, I am not a demon like you, and I do not want to turn into a demon, so I cannot possibly stay in the Netherworld Realm for too long."

"Well, that's true." Zhang Fei replied with a nod. "If you want to train in the Netherworld Realm, you have to train with me or Elmyra, especially since our light elements can protect you from the demon aura there."

"I don't want you to waste your time accompanying me to train, and you must reach the Heaven Realm as soon as possible." Zhang Yue thought for a moment before continuing. "Fei'er, please call Senior Elmyra here, and I will ask her to accompany me to train in the Netherworld Realm."
"All right." A few minutes later, Elmyra arrived in the room, and Zhang Fei immediately explained to her about Zhang Yue's wishes. "Is it okay if you accompany her to train in the Netherworld Realm?"

"I have no objections to that." Elmyra immediately agreed. "However, you should send several of them there at once, especially those who are still lacking in combat experience. That way, we won't have to waste too much time, and they can improve their abilities together."

Zhang Fei immediately called Qing Yi, Zhang Lin, Tang Ziyu, Zhong Yan, Ru Xue, Lillea, and Janette. Since the seven women had the least fighting experience among his wives, he wanted them to train there. He wanted to send Jiang Yinghua, Meng Tianshi, and Daniella there as well. Unfortunately, the cultivation of the three winged races was still too low, so they were not ready to fight against demons or demon beasts in the Netherworld Realm.

Once the seven women arrived, Zhang Fei explained to them his purpose in calling them. To his surprise, none of them objected and were looking forward to it, especially after their fight with the winged races. Moreover, they did not need to dual cultivate with him directly, and they could cultivate using his Yang Qi.

Even so, Zhang Fei would not possibly let them focus on their training and neglect their cultivation, and he told them that he would bring them back to the training space to dual cultivate with him every night.

After they agreed, Zhang Fei took the nine women to the Netherworld Realm, and he looked for a location that best suited their strengths. After he found it, he left them there, and Elmyra protected them with her light element so the demon aura would not affect them.

After returning to the Cloud Mansion, Zhang Fei immediately went to see Jiang Yinghua, Meng Tianshi, and Daniella. He was eager to eat them, but their cultivation was still too low for him, and their virgin Yin Qi would be wasted, so he kept holding himself back.
Since Jiang Yinghua and Meng Tianshi still didn't want to be intimate with him, Zhang Fei didn't force them. Instead, he was intimate with Daniella, and they did it in front of the two women.

After they finished, Zhang Fei did not immediately go to his other wives, but instead, he trained using the suppression feature, especially since he felt that his mental strength was still too weak compared to Hong Xinxin and Murong Qianying. If he didn't have his lust demon abilities that could barely be resisted by anyone, except for Feng Yao and Jiang Yinghua, then he would never be able to subdue them.

Quickly, another week had passed, and a new group of people had just arrived at the Hong Clan. Hong Quan and the others immediately welcomed them warmly, especially since they were a group from the Yan Clan, who came from the Shandian Realm.
"Grandpa!" Hong Xinxin immediately greeted the old man who was standing at the front. "It's been a long time since I saw you."

"Hahaha!" The old man, Yan Liebao, laughed and pulled Hong Xinxin into his arms. "The older you get, the more beautiful you become, Xin'er. Even your mother is less beautiful than you now, and I can barely recognize you."
"Father." Yan Yizhen called out with a soft sigh.

Yan Liebao smiled playfully as he looked at his daughter, but then he asked Hong Xinxin. "Where is your lover? Your mother told me that you have found a new lover, and his speed is also amazing, so I can't wait to meet him."
"He—"

"Sorry, I'm late." Yan Liebao and the people from the Yan Clan immediately turned to Zhang Fei, who had just arrived with Qing Yi and Zhao Ziqin in surprise, especially since they were unable to sense his aura earlier.
Yan Liebao suddenly released Hong Xinxin from his embrace and charged straight at Zhang Fei, but he immediately disappeared, shocking the old man and his family.

"Hmm?" Yan Liebao looked up at Zhang Fei, who had appeared on a tree some distance away from them. "At first, I didn't believe it when my daughter told me about your speed, but I have to admit that your speed is remarkable, kid. Only a few people could dodge my surprise attack, but you were the youngest of them."
"Let me try his speed, Father." A middle-aged man suddenly spoke, and he was Yan Dashan, the big brother of Yan Yizhen.
Yan Liebao shook his head at him. "You're no match for him, Dashan. He hasn't used anything yet, but he managed to dodge my attack, so his speed is several levels above yours."
"You flatter my speed too much, Senior Yan." Zhang Fei said casually. "How about we have a speed race now?"

Yan Liebao gave a faint smirk before disappearing from their sight, but Zhang Fei also immediately disappeared from his spot. Yan Dashan and the people from the Yan Clan became serious as they tried to follow the two's movements, but they could not see them clearly, which meant that their speed had already surpassed theirs.

Unlike the people from the Yan Clan, Qing Yi and Zhou Ziqin smiled as their eyes followed Zhang Fei and Yan Liebao's movements. Although they moved so fast, the two women could still follow their movements, and they could see that the old man's speed was still below their husband's.

However, Yan Liebao's wind element suddenly enveloped his body, increasing his speed by several levels. Unfortunately, it was still not enough to catch up to Zhang Fei, who also instantly increased his speed.

Unlike Yan Liebao, Zhang Fei still had not used his wind element, but he had no difficulty in avoiding the old man's pursuit, which greatly shocked him. 'Unbelievable! A young man at 20 years old managed to beat me in terms of speed, and he only relied on his raw speed!'
Hong Quan suddenly spoke to Qing Yi and Zhao Ziqin. "Little girls, I want you two to chase after old man Liebao."
"Eh?" Qing Yi and Zhao Ziqin turned to Hong Quan in surprise.
"Do you think they can catch up to my father, Uncle Hong?" Yan Dashan doubtfully asked.
"Hahaha." Hong Quan laughed in response. "Go! Chase that old man, little girls."
"Yes, Senior." The disappearance of Qing Yi and Zhao Ziqin shocked Yan Dashan and the people of the Yan Clan once more. "Shit! Where did these three young monsters come from?"

No one answered Yan Dashan, and Hong Quan noticed Yan Liebao's shocked expression once Qing Ying and Zhao Ziqin had caught up to him. He still hadn't managed to catch up to Zhang Fei, but his two wives had caught up to him instead.

chapters.title: Chapter 752: Two Techniques
paragraphs: Yan Liebao stood there in a daze as he watched the three people in front of him with a serious look. No matter how hard he tried to chase Zhang Fei, he never managed to catch up to him. Worse still, he could never escape Qing Yi and Zhao Ziqin's pursuit, and the two women could keep up with him without having to use their wind elements.

Yan Dashan and the Yan Clan members were deeply shocked when Yan Liebao conceded defeat in a speed race against three people from the younger generation, particularly considering that their cultivation was still in the Earth Realm. If they can catch up to their leader while weak, no one will be able to catch them once they reach their level.

Even though the people from the Yan Clan weren't the fastest in the upper realms, their speed was still one of the best there, yet three young cultivators from the middle realms could defeat them in terms of speed.
After some time, Yan Liebao released a heavy sigh and asked Zhang Fei. "Your previous speed wasn't your maximum speed, right, kid?"
"Not yet." Zhang Fei replied with a shake of his head. "Honestly, my previous speed was still half of my actual speed, Senior Yan."
"Are you kidding us? Was your previous speed really only half of your actual speed?" Yan Dashan asked with an incredulous look.

The people of the Yan Clan also thought Zhang Fei was bragging, especially since his previous speed was already too fast. If he could move even faster than that, it would mean that he was the fastest cultivator in the upper realms.

"Hmm?" Yan Liebao and the others were shocked as soon as Zhang Fei used his teleportation ability, and he moved from one place to another in an instant until their eyes couldn't follow him. 'This brat isn't bragging! His speed is truly incredible!'
Zhang Fei immediately returned to his spot again. "What do you all think, seniors?"

"Marvelous!" Yang Dashan and the others nodded in agreement with Yan Liebao. "Why don't you teach your two wives your movement techniques? If they learn them, their speed will be on par with yours, and you won't have to worry about finding other techniques for them, right?"

"You're right about that, Senior Yan." Zhang Fei replied with a nod. "Unfortunately, I can't teach them my previous technique because it comes from my bloodline, so I'm the only one who can use it, and my other techniques require a greater physique. Qing Yi and Zhao Ziqin are indeed body cultivators like me, but their physical strength is not even half of mine, and they still need a long time to learn my techniques. Therefore, I want to find speed techniques that suit their current physical strength, and Grandpa Hong told me that your Yan Clan is one of the best in speed, so I hope to get some techniques for them."

Yan Liebao nodded in understanding. "In speed, my Yan Clan is only the third fastest in the upper realms, and the other two clans are much faster than us. The Ying Clan is the second fastest, and Ying Niao is their fastest cultivator. Meanwhile, the fastest clan is the Lei Clan because one of them can combine the wind and lightning elements at once, and their fastest cultivator is Lei Xuanfeng."
"Combining the wind and lightning elements, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered to himself.
Yan Liebao nodded. "Wind is fast, but a lightning strike is much faster, right?"

"According to some people, lightning can travel about 185 miles per second, and wind can also reach hundreds of miles, but it takes several hours." Everyone present seemed confused by Zhang Fei's muttering. "But in reality, the fastest element is the light element, and lightning's speed can never match it."
"Light?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed awkwardly at their confused expressions. "I don't know how to explain it to you, but the people in my home realm use devices similar to those in the Xianjin Realm to measure the speed of each element. According to them, lightning is not as fast as sound, but sound is still far behind light, so light is the fastest."

Yan Liebao looked at Zhang Fei as he stroked his beard. "The world of cultivation is too mysterious, and the Xianjin Realm is the most advanced realm in this universe. I don't know how the people in your home realm could have devices similar to theirs, but they might be right about the elements. However, I have never met a light cultivator who has such high speed before, and it is usually only used for healing."

"Well, that's true." Zhang Fei fell into contemplation after that, and he became increasingly impatient about retrieving the lower-grade lightning elemental speed from the Cyanwood Mountain. "Can you teach your speed techniques to my two wives, Senior Yan?"

"Usually, only our clan members are eligible to learn our speed techniques, but my granddaughter has chosen you as her future husband, which means you will be part of our clan soon. Since these two little girls are your wives, I will give them each one of the techniques that suits them best." Yan Liebao immediately walked in front of them and touched both women's foreheads, imparting to each of them one technique. "The Nine Windstride and the Gale Phantom Steps are both celestial-grade techniques, but their characteristics are different. One utilizes the surrounding air to accelerate our speed, and the other requires us to generate wind currents around our bodies, making movements swift and elusive. Based on my previous observations, the Nine Windstride is more suitable for Zhao Ziqin, and the Gale Phantom Steps is for Qing Yi."
"Thank you, Senior Yan." Zhao Ziqin and Qing Yi expressed their gratitude to Yan Liebao by cupping their hands.
Yan Liebao smiled and rubbed their heads. "You two have to study them seriously, and I want to see the results at our next meeting."
"Yes, Senior Yan."

Yan Liebao then looked at Zhang Fei. "If you want to learn both, you can ask these two little girls to share them with you. However, I doubt that they will be of any use to you, especially since your movement techniques are better than both of them."

"There's no harm if I learn more techniques, right, Senior Yan?" Yan Liebao nodded to Zhang Fei. "In that case, I'll send them to my training ground so they can start learning both techniques right away."
"Oh?" Yan Liebao was surprised when Zhang Fei opened the portal to the training space. However, he also felt strange about it, especially since he didn't have space or void elements.
After Zhao Ziqin and Qing Yi disappeared, Zhang Fei asked them. "Shall we talk inside?"

Hong Quan immediately led them all to the main hall of the Hong Clan, but Yang Dashan of the people of the Yan Clan kept his eyes on Zhang Fei. They were not only curious about his abilities, but they were also curious about how he could win Hong Xinxin's heart due to their huge age difference.
After they talked for a few hours, Zhang Fei decided to return to the training space, as he was impatient to reach the Heaven Realm.

Once Zhang Fei left, Yan Leibao immediately asked his granddaughter to accompany him on a walk together, especially since he still had many questions about Zhang Fei. "How did you meet such a young monster, Xin'er? He's only 20 years old, but he's already that strong and fast, and he'll probably surpass the Nameless One after he cultivates for hundreds or even thousands of years."

"Grandpa, I don't think it will take him that long to surpass the Nameless One, and I'm sure he will succeed in doing it much faster than everyone's expectations." Yan Leibao was amazed by Hong Xinxin's confidence in Zhang Fei. "In fact, he cultivated for less than a year, Grandpa."
"Are you serious about that?" Yan Liebao asked with wide eyes.

"Yes." Hong Xinxin nodded at him. "Zhang Fei is a dual cultivator, and the number of women by his side cannot be compared to anyone else in this universe, so his cultivation speed is extremely frightening. However, he does not only focus on his cultivation, and he also continues to improve himself in various aspects."

"Tell me everything." Hong Xinxin immediately told Yan Liebao about Zhang Fei as a body cultivator, soul cultivator, alchemist, blacksmith, array master, and more. "As expected, that kid is truly a monster, and he's the only cultivator I know who can learn all of that at once, so it's not surprising that Hun Di is willing to accept him as his disciple. Does he love you, Xin'er?"

"Yes." Hong Xinxin answered confidently. "At first, I had no interest in him, and our relationship occurred due to unexpected circumstances. In fact, I was angry with him because he lied to me, especially since he initially disguised himself as a 10-year-old kid. Not only did he fool me, but he also fooled Sister Qianying and so many other people. The first person to know his true identity was Murong Mengying because of her eye techniques, and Senior Hun Di found out after her."

"What was his reason for doing that?" Hong Xinxin immediately explained to Yan Leibao about Zhang Fei, Shang Huaqiang, the Sky Jade Realm, and the Netherworld Realm. "So he disguised himself as a 10-year-old kid to destroy the Shang Clan, right?"

"That's right, Grandpa." Hong Xinxin replied with a nod. "I was hesitant to accept Zhang Fei at first, but I've met his family and talked to them, especially his grandmother. Zhang Chen is much younger than us, but I can tell she is a wise woman, and she is wiser than many senior cultivators. She told me a lot about him, from him being an ordinary human to him becoming a cultivator, and she also told me about his relationships with all his women. Even though he had so many women, he wholeheartedly loved them. Shang Huaqiang caused some of his to suffer, so he decided to disguise himself as a kid and infiltrate the Shang clan by himself. Therefore, I decided to accept him, and I believe I will never regret my decision."

"If someone else were to infiltrate the Shang Clan alone with his or her cultivation still in the ten mortal realms, I would consider that person an idiot, and his or her stupidity knows no bounds." Hong Xinxin laughed hearing that from her grandfather. "I still don't know Zhang Fei well, but I can see that he is not stupid, and your story about him fooling everyone in the Wasteland Realm is one of the proofs. His expression does show arrogance, but he has the abilities to support his arrogance. Moreover, I can still feel his killing intent and bloodlust even though he has suppressed both of them; both of them are truly powerful, so I am sure that he has killed countless people."

"Grandpa, I watched him kill hundreds of thousands of people in one battle, and he already killed too many before that." Yan Liebai turned to Hong Xinxin, who immediately shared her memories of when she followed Zhang Fei to the Tian Realm. "Watch them first, and you will understand his horror."

For several minutes, Yan Liebai watched all the events in the Tian Realm from the first floor to the top. "You're right, that kid is too scary. His expression didn't change, even though he killed so many people in one go. Although all his wives are still less experienced when compared to him, I can see that they are starting to follow in his footsteps, and they might become as scary as him. How can he have darkness and light elements at the same time?"

"Grandpa, I want to tell you the truth about Zhang Fei's true identity, but I think it's better if I keep it to myself because his identity is too complicated, and people will definitely hunt him down if his identity is leaked to the public." Yan Liebao narrowed his eyes at Hong Xinxin, but she had no intention of telling him the truth. "The most important thing is that he is not a heretic cultivator, and he only kills people who threaten the safety of him and those closest to him."

Yan Liebai let out a heavy sigh. "I hope you're right, Xin'er. However, you should often remind Zhang Fei not to kill too often, especially when it's not necessary. Heretic cultivators are born not only because of their rotten hearts, but some of them become heretics because of their habit of killing. Killing is too addictive for many people, and they cannot stop killing others because of their addiction, which eventually turns them into heretics. Moreover, killing will accumulate our bad karma, and Zhang Fei will face powerful lightning tribulations if he continues to increase his bad karma, so you must remind him of that often.
"I understand, Grandpa. I will definitely remind Zhang Fei often."
Yan Liebai nodded. "Let's go back; I want to talk to Old Hong about some important matters."

Imperceptibly, another week passed, and Yan Liebao took the members of his Yan Clan to leave the Hong Clan. Hong Quan and his clan members were gathered in the main hall, discussing something serious with his family. "I just got information that Xi Hongyan has successfully united the western region, so she and her Xi Clan are their leaders now."
"Xi Hongyan's action was so fast, and she managed to do it in just a month. Did they destroy the Xing and Fang clans?"

"No." Hong Quan shook his head at his wife. "At first, Xi Hongyan only sent Xi Zhenyang and Xi Xiuling to subdue them, but both of them repeatedly failed to subdue the two clans. Therefore, he personally intervened and forced them to submit, which they could not refuse."
Hong Chong then spoke. "This way, there are four groups in our realm now: our group, the Shang Clan's group, Xi Hongyan's group, and the Huo Clan's group."

"No one dares to disturb the Huo and Niu clans, especially since they have the support of Tian Shuixiang and Lin Jingxia. The Shang and Xi clans also won't dare to openly attack us, and we don't need to start trouble with them first." Hong Quan then asked Hong Xinxin. "What about Zhang Fei? When will you bring him to meet Jin Ruyue? If we can get the support of the Jin Clan, our group will be more solid."

"Zhang Fei is in the process of breaking through to the 6-Star Earth Realm, but he still has other matters to attend to, so I will bring him to see Jin Ruyue after his matters are finished." Hong Quan and the others looked at Hong Xinxin with questioning gazes. "Sister Qianying just told me that Shang Chongyun and the others are almost at the Netherworld Realm, and I have already told her about it, so she will go there first after her breakthrough is complete."
"What is Zhang Fei's plan for Shang Chongyun and the others?"
Hong Xinxin shook her head at them. "Zhang Fei has already prepared some people in that realm, but I still don't know his true plan for them, so we can only wait for him to finish breaking through."
[Congratulations! Your cultivation broke through to the 6-Star Earth Realm.]
As usual, Lei Que, the thunderbird, accompanied Zhang Fei [5] in his breakthrough process, and the two of them immediately entered the black sky above them.
Meanwhile, Duan Zhao and his four disciples stood below with solemn expressions, especially since Zhang Fei [5]'s lightning tribulations continued to grow stronger.
"Do you think he will succeed, master?" Gang Zhishou asked with a worried expression.

Duan Zhao nodded in response. "Zhang Fei [5] has undergone several lightning tribulations, and his expression is so calm even though his lightning tribulation is so powerful, so I am sure he will succeed."

chapters.title: Chapter 753: Arrival of Four People
paragraphs: Three hours after Zhang Fei initiated his lightning tribulations, a flying artifact entered the Netherworld Realm. It was protected by white light, preventing the demon aura from affecting its passengers.
The passengers on the flying artifact were four people from the Shang Clan: Shang Chongyun, Shang Chenguang, Shang Tinglong, and Ran Keqing.
As the four stood in front, Shang Chongyun posed a question. "What should we do now? You're the only one who has been to this realm before, Chengguang."

"Over there." Shang Chenguang pointed to the far north. "The demon palace is over there, so we should go there now. However, the strong demons from this realm seem to have taken over the palace, so we have to do something about them first."
"Since they aren't demon cultivators, it shouldn't be difficult for us to get rid of them, right?" Shang Tinglong said this as he looked toward the northernmost area.

Shang Chenguang nodded at him. "Those demons are too weak to fight us, but some of them have special abilities, so we can't underestimate them. Back then, our patriarch controlled a demon from another realm to control them, and he used a lot of resources to strengthen him. Unfortunately, the demon disappeared after Princess Feng Yao foiled his plan, and he couldn't track his whereabouts."

"Let's go there, and we'll install the teleportation portal after we get rid of them." Shang Chongyun and the others immediately frowned as soon as countless black crows appeared around their flying artifact, and they right away charged toward them. "What the hell with these crows? Why do they attack us without caring about their lives?"

"These crows are not living beings, but a demon created them to bother us." The three men turned to Ran Keqing. "Just look at them; they don't bleed when they die, so I'm sure they're not really real."

The three men only realized it after Ran Keqing mentioned it, but a large ball of lava suddenly shot toward them from afar. However, it was too weak to take them down, and the shield on their flying artifact instantly destroyed it.

"Somehow I feel that the demons in this realm already know about our arrival." Shang Chongyun spoke as he looked at the surrounding area, but he couldn't sense the presence of any demons near them. However, he suddenly noticed something in the distance and pointed towards it. "Hey, guys! Isn't that a light element? How can there be a light element in this realm?"

Shang Chenguang and Shang Tinglong immediately directed their senses towards it, and they found dozens of women practicing in that area protected by a pure light element. "Who are those human women? How did they come to this realm?"
"Their cultivation is in the ten mortal realms, but their fighting abilities and speeds are extremely astonishing, and those demons are not their opponents at all." Shang Tinglong spoke in awe.
Ran Keqing asked them. "How about we check them out first?"
"Let's go there, and we'll check them out." Shang Chongyun immediately flew their flying artifact towards that area.
Morgana and Oz the First suddenly appear at the previous location of the Shang Clan members. "Are you sure we don't need to stop them, wife?"

"No need." Morgana answered with a shake of her head. "They are Zhang Fei's official and unofficial women, and he would not allow them to train in this realm without protection, so we don't need to worry about them. Moreover, they are not as weak as you imagine, and they have slaughtered thousands of demons and demon beasts since they started training here two weeks ago. "Husband, these women seem to be deliberately training to increase their killing intent." Ran Keqing spoke to Shang Tinglong.

Shang Tinglong nodded in agreement with that. "The demons and demon beasts that fought them were high-rank demons, but they were controlled by their cruel nature, and they attacked them with the intention of killing them."

"I am really curious about their identities, especially since they are clearly cultivators from the lower or middle realms. However, their fighting abilities are too good, and their speed seems to be much better than ours." Shang Chongyun then pointed at Zhang Yue. "She is the most terrifying among her sisters, and her ice will instantly freeze everything around her before shattering them into pieces. Even though we are quite far from them, I can still feel the coldness of her ice element."
Shang Chenguang then spoke. "That little girl's ice element is definitely not an ordinary ice element, and as far as I remember, there is only one living creature with such a powerful ice element."
"Who?"
"The ice phoenix."
"Are you saying that little girl has something to do with the ice phoenix?" Shang Chongyun asked.

"That little girl is an ordinary human, but she probably has the ice phoenix bloodline, or else her ice element wouldn't be that cold and deadly." An ice phoenix silhouette suddenly appeared behind Zhang Yue, and her body became ice, which proved their guess. In an instant, the entire area around her froze along with dozens of demons and demon beasts surrounding her. "As expected! She really has the ice phoenix bloodline in her body!"
"What if we capture that little girl? If we can help her become stronger, she will be very useful for us against Shang Huaqiang."

"Are you crazy, Tinglong?" Shang Chenguang asked with a frown. "Since that little girl has the ice phoenix bloodline, I'm sure the phoenix race already knows about her, and they might have already sent someone to protect her from behind. Not even our patriarch dares to fight them, let alone us."

"They are people from the Shang Clan, Big Sis." Liu Hua said as she looked at the flying artifact.

Liu Qingyu nodded. "Fei'er seems to have not finished with his breakthrough yet, so we will wait for him to arrive. Since our cultivation has just broken through, we have plenty of time to increase our killing intent, so we will focus on fighting these demons and demon beasts."

"I agree with you." Shen Xueyi then turned her gaze to their other sisters. "The demons and demon beasts in this realm are no longer suitable for us, but they are still useful to Zhang Lin and the others. Moreover, only Elmyra can protect us from the demon aura, so we cannot train separately."
"Can your light element protect us from the demon aura, Yue?" Shen Yue asked the female moon fox.

On the other hand, people will immediately notice our demon scent if we turn into demons, and we won't be able to live as freely as him."
"Why are you thinking about becoming a demon, Sister Lian?" Zhao Ziqin asked.

Therefore, I thought about becoming a demon so I could help him with that. However, I still want to live freely, and I won't be able to live freely if I become a demon, so I don't dare to make a decision about that yet."

Liu Qingyu and the others had actually thought about it, but it had never crossed their minds to become demons. Although they had no problem with Zhang Fei's demon identity and living with other demons, they still thought becoming demons was the worst thing in their lives, and they didn't want that to happen to them.

"Forget it, let's not think about it too much and focus on our training, or we will never be ready to accompany our husband to fight our enemies." After that, they continued their practice again, but Ye Lian's previous words kept ringing in their minds.

"You know that my big brother will never agree, right?" Zhang Lin replied with a soft sigh. "That's why I don't want to discuss this matter with him, and I will turn myself into a demon to help him."

Boitata immediately snatched the demon beast meat from Zhang Lin's hand and crushed it directly. "Regardless of whether he agrees or not, he is our husband, so you should discuss this matter with him first. If he agrees, he will help you find the best demon beast, and you can become one after that."
"But—"

"Don't argue, okay?" Boitata interrupted Zhang Lin. "You have known our husband since childhood, so you should be familiar with his character. If you turn yourself into a demon without his consent, he might be disappointed with you, so you should discuss this matter with him first."
Zhang Lin helplessly nodded. "All right, I will discuss this matter with my big brother first, and I hope he will agree with my idea so I can help him more."

"That's good." Boitata immediately lifted Zhang Lin to his feet. "Let's go! We can't waste time, so we should continue our training now. Your big sister is already far ahead of us, and she is too enthusiastic about killing demons or demon beasts, so we can't lag behind her."

"You're right." Boitata responded with a note. "All mythical beasts are arrogant by nature, and her bloodline continues to influence her, making her character closer to the ice phoenix. If she continues to train like this, she might become as terrifying as him, and she will be the strongest among us."
"If you evolve into a mythical beast, you will be able to match her, right?"

"I'm not sure about that." Boitata answered with a shake of her head. "Zhang Yue has not yet achieved her true strength, and she still has to go to the Frozen Lotus Basin in the phoenix realm to undergo the tests of the Ice Phoenix. If she successfully passes those tests, she will reach her peak strength, so we can only wait for the time to find out the results."

Although she had obtained the water dragon bloodline from Long Huang, Zhang Lin felt that her strength was still lacking compared to Zhang Yue, and Boitata's words made her even more determined to become a demon. 'I'll talk to my big brother after this, and I'm sure I'll be stronger than big sis if I become a demon with a water dragon bloodline.'

"If my demon power wasn't sealed, I would definitely go there to help them get rid of the human invaders." Azaroth let out a heavy sigh as he spoke.

"Haha." Oz the Second laughed in response. "You don't need to worry about them because my predecessor is not weak, and his wife is much stronger than him, so I'm sure they both can fight those humans."

"Even if the two of them can't fight them, we still have Zhang Fei." Zygoz also speaks to Azaroth. "That kid even dared to infiltrate their clan alone, and he must have prepared some plans to deal with them, so we can leave their affairs to him."
"They have landed in front of the demon palace."

As Arbeola said, Shang Chongyun and the others had arrived in front of the demon palace in Demon Emperor City. However, they were confused because the demons who were previously in the palace suddenly vanished.
Shang Chongyun then led them to the throne room, and they found Oz the First sitting on the throne in the form of Azaroth.

Shang Chenguang immediately recognized him and informed the others. "He is the demon controlled by our patriarch before. I am not sure how he managed to return to this realm, but I will not mistake him."

"You are right; your patriarch controlled my husband back then, but he is a free demon now that Princess Feng Yao has freed him." Shang Chenguang and the others looked at Morgana, who suddenly appeared beside Oz the First. "The Phoenix Princess knew that Shang Huaqiang would send the other subordinates to this realm again, so she brought us back here to protect it."

chapters.title: Chapter 754: Face The Four
paragraphs: "Do you think we'll be afraid if you mention the Phoenix Princess?" Shang Tinglong asked with a frown. The Phoenix Race may be stronger, but we won't be afraid as long as they're not here."
Morgana waved her hand, and a curtain of darkness immediately opened in their eyes. Dozens of demon kings and queens were already standing behind her and Oz the First, including Demon King Oxgorth.

Shang Chenguang and the others immediately went on alert after their sudden appearance. Morgana smiled at their reactions. "These demon kings and queens are not demon cultivators like me or my husband, but their strength and abilities are not bad. If Shang Huaqiang came here himself, we would never win against him, but he is not here now."

"Haha." Shang Chenguang chuckled and took out a device. "Our patriarch is not here, but we can still summon his avatar to descend into this realm. You all witnessed his avatar a few months ago, so you should still remember the horror of his power, right? Back then, you were all lucky that Princess Feng Yao helped you, but she is also not here now. Therefore, you guys should surrender and submit to us, or you will suffer the consequences."

Shang Chenguang smiled mockingly as he saw the ugly expressions of the demons, especially since they were still horrified every time they remembered the power of Shang Huaqiang's avatar. However, his smile disappeared because the device in his hand suddenly disappeared, and he circled around his spot to look for the thief.
Shang Chongyun and the other three naturally noticed this, and they took out their respective devices, but all of them immediately disappeared from their grasp. "Who? Come out!"
*Swoosh.*

"Ugh!" Shang Chongyun and the other three staggered backward as soon as a powerful killing intent pressed down on them. Their bodies visibly trembled as sweat started to drip down their bodies. 'Fuck! Who owns this killing intent? This killing intent even surpasses Shang Huaqiang's.'
Unlike Oz the First and Morgana, who remained calm, the demon kings and queens behind them looked confused by the reactions of the four humans in front of them.
*Crack... Crack... Crack...*

Upon hearing the shattering sound, all of them looked up, and Zhang Fei was already standing there in his lust demon lord form. When he got the news about the arrival of Shang Chongyun and the other three, his lightning tribulations had just finished, and he immediately rushed to the Netherworld Realm.

'Another demon cultivator? His cultivation is only at 6-Star Earth Realm, yet his killing intent is much stronger than senior cultivators like us.' Shang Chongyun and the others uttered these words in shock within their hearts.
Zhang Fei then threw the broken devices in front of them. "Shang Chongyun, I know the teleportation device is in your hands, so hand it over to me now."
"Hmm?" Shang Chongyun and the others were shocked by that. "How do you know my name?"

"You are Murong Qianying's husband, and you two have three children: Shang Yumei, Shang Guangming, and Shang Yaolin." Zhang Fei ignored their shocked reactions and turned to the other three. "Two of your children came to this realm together with Shang Chenguang a few months ago, but their plan failed miserably, and Shang Huaqiang sentenced them to labor in the Wasteland Realm for a hundred years. The other two are Shang Tinglong and Ran Keqing, and you two are the parents of that idiot Shang Xiaojuan."

All of that made the four people realize that Zhang Fei had connections with people from the Wasteland Realm and the Red Sun Realm. "Who the hell are you? How can you know our identities in such detail?"

"I don't need to explain my identity to you." Zhang Fei summoned the demon extermination sword before pointing it at them. "Hand over the teleportation device to me now, or you won't like it if I have to force you."
"Do you think you can defeat the four of us just with your killing intent? We— Guah!" Before Shang Tinglong could complete his sentence, Zhang Fei sent him flying out of the throne room.

After a moment of shock, Ran Keqing flew out to help her husband, but Zhang Fei intercepted her and put the Yin-Yang absorber shackle on her hand, sealing her cultivation immediately. He threw her to Morgana, who immediately grabbed her.
"Husband!" Ran Keqing shouted loudly as she struggled to free herself from Morgana, but she was helpless with her cultivation sealed. "Let me go!"
"Just wait here, or you will suffer." Morgana casually replied as she looked at Shang Tinglong.
"You— Guah!" Zhang Fei directly kicked Shang Tinglong in the chest, sending him rolling on the floor several times until he stabilized himself.
Zhang Fei instantly teleported behind Shang Tinglong and thrust the demon extermination sword into his back until it penetrated his chest, causing him to spurt blood from his mouth.
Shang Tinglong was still lucky because Zhang Fei had no intention of killing him, and he only wanted to teach him a lesson, so he did not attack his vital organs.

Even so, Zhang Fei's action shocked the four people from the Shang Clan, especially since his action was too absurd with his cultivation still in the ten mortal realms, and Shang Tinglong's cultivation was in the Seven Divine Realms.
*Splurt!*

Blood spurted from Shang Tinglong's chest and back as soon as Zhang Fei pulled the demon extermination sword out of his body, causing his blood to drip out from his chest and back. "Cough... Cough..."

Zhang Fei immediately used another Yin-Yang absorber shackle to seal Shang Tinglong's cultivation, shocking and frightening him. He then pressed the demon extermination sword against his neck. "Your abilities are not as good as your mouth, old man. No wonder your son is such an idiot; it turns out he inherited your stupidity."
"Guah!" Zhang Fei kicked Shang Tinglong in the back, sending him tumbling forward.
"Tinglong!" Shang Chongyun and Shang Chenguang immediately flew towards Shang Tinglong, but Zhang Fei teleported twice and kicked their chests, forcing both men to land and stagger backward.

"Help! I—" Shang Tinglong swallowed his words back, especially since the cold blade of the demon extermination sword pressed against his neck again, and Zhang Fei stood behind him with an indifferent expression. 'Fuck! Who exactly is this kid?'
Inside the throne room, Ran Keqing's expression was completely panicked by her husband's situation, but Morgana firmly held her back. "Brother Chongyun! Chenguang! Save my husband!"
Shang Chongyun and Shang Chenguang naturally wanted to save Shang Tinglong, but Zhang Fei's speed far surpassed theirs, forcing them to find another solution to save him.

"Hand over the teleportation device to me, or you two will see this old man's head separated from his body." Zhang Fei pressed the demon extermination sword deeper, causing Shang Tinglong's neck to bleed. "I won't repeat myself."

Shang Chenguang shook his head at Shang Chongyun before threatening Zhang Fei. "We won't hand over the teleportation device to you, so you can kill him if you want. Our patriarch will immediately learn of his death, and he will send stronger people to this realm. At that time, you will die, and all the demons in this realm will also die with you."
Ran Keqing was shocked when she heard that and wanted to shout again, but Morgana immediately covered her mouth, so only a muffled sound came out of her mouth. "Mhmm! Mhmm!"

Shang Chenguang's threat caused Oxgorth and the other demon kings and queens to become tense, especially since they could not fight him and the other three. If their leader really sent stronger people, they would definitely die, and their realm would also be destroyed.

The demon kings and queens began to whisper to each other, and they intended to stop Zhang Fei. He immediately stared at them and frightened them by unleashing his killing intent, forcing them to shut their mouths.

"Oxgorth! Your guts are too small for a demon king, and Cain is much better than you." Demon King Oxgorth finally realized Zhang Fei's identity, especially since his son had told him some things about him. "Do you think I'm afraid of Shang Huaqiang? I already know that he sent you guys to this realm as sacrifices because he wants to bring down Murong Qianying and her Murong Clan, so he won't do anything if I kill this old man, and he will be happy with his death instead."

The expressions of the four people from the Shang Clan changed again after Zhang Fei mentioned that, but they were still confused and had difficulty understanding how a weak cultivator like him could know so much about their situation.
Shang Chenguang wanted to refute Zhang Fei, but Shang Chongyun stopped him. "Who exactly are you? How can you know so much about our problems?"

"My identity is not important, and you only need to know that Shang Huaqiang is my enemy." Zhang Fei answered with a shake of his head. "I may not be able to fight him and the Shang Clan now, but I will defeat them when I reach their level. Therefore, hand over the teleportation device to me now, or I will bury you all here."

Instead, Shang Chongyun took out an interspatial communication device and contacted Murong Qianying to find out his identity, but Zhang Fei snatched it away before returning behind Shang Tinglong again.

'Tch! His speed is really troublesome!' Shang Chongyun turned to Shang Chenguang. 'What do you think about this? This kid seems serious that he is targeting Shang Huaqiang and our clan, so I think we can hand over the teleportation device to him.'

'We don't know this kid's identity for sure, and he won't necessarily let us go if we hand over the teleportation device to him.' Shang Chenguang replied as he looked at Zhang Fei with doubts. "At least tell us your identity if you want to get the device."

"Hahaha!" Shang Chenguang laughed strangely after learning the truth. "I've cultivated for over ten thousand years, but I never expected to be fooled by a brat like you, Long'er."
"Do you know him?" Shang Chongyun asked.

Shang Chenguang nodded at him. "He is the heavenly fox kid that I told you about a few months ago, and your son found him in this realm. Back then, I thought Guangming found him by accident, but I now realize that this kid deliberately lured him to come to him, and he used us to bring him to the Wasteland Realm. Additionally, your second daughter is fond of this kid, and they live together there, so you no longer need to be surprised if he knows so much about our problems."

"Your guess is half right." Zhang Fei returned to his adult form. "Shang Guangming did find me by accident, but I already knew your identity before he found me. Therefore, I disguised myself and asked him to bring me along with you all, especially since I needed more in-depth information about Shang Huaqiang and the Shang Clan. As for Shang Yaolin, you could say she is my woman, and her heart is mine."

Shang Chongyun stared at Zhang Fei in shock, as he did not expect that he was related to two of his three children. Moreover, his words showed that he already had a special relationship with his second daughter, which he thought was impossible because of Shang Yaolin's character. "Do you really have a special relationship with my second daughter?"

"Are you surprised?" Shang Chongyun nodded to Zhang Fei, who immediately opened the portal to the training space. The old man was even more shocked when his first daughter, Shang Yumei, walked out of it. "Not only Yaolin, but Yumei is also my woman."
Not only was Shang Chongyun shocked by Shang Yumei's appearance, but Shang Chenguang, Shang Tinglong, and Ran Keqing were also shocked by it.

Shang Yumei immediately spoke to Shang Chongyun, who was still in shock after learning many things. "Old man, you must hand over the teleportation device to my husband, or the four of you will suffer at his hands, especially since he can be much more ruthless than Shang Huaqiang."
"H... husband?" Shang Chongyun stuttered. "How... how is that possible? Since when did you marry him? Moreover, you're still a virgin, so—"

"What does my virginity have to do with my status as his wife?" Shang Yumei responded with a shake of her head. "Whether you believe it or not, I am his wife, and I will become his true wife once his cultivation reaches the Seven Divine Realms. The fate of Shang Huaqiang and the Shang Clan has already been determined, and they will be destroyed in his hands in the future."
"What do you think?" Shang Chongyun asked his friend.
After Shang Yumei's appearance and knowing Zhang Fei's true identity, Shang Chenguang had no doubts in his mind. "Just hand over the teleportation device to that kid."
Shang Chongyun took the teleportation device and threw it to Zhang Fei, who immediately observed it. "How do I change the coordinates?"
"You have to meet the creator, but he lives in the Xianjin Realm."

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding and put it into his inventory before freeing Shang Tinglong from the Yin-Yang Absorber shackle. He took Ran Keqing from Morgana's hands and freed her as well, which relieved them.

"Since you guys can't leave this realm, you can stay here for the time being." Zhang Fei then looked at the demon kings and queens. "I know that you guys don't like them, but I have already decided on this matter. Whoever dares to oppose my decision, I will kill that person immediately. Do you guys understand?"
Oxgorth immediately represented the others by answering Zhang Fei. "According to your orders, we will receive them in this realm."
Zhang Fei then said to the witch demon. "Morgana, I still have other matters, so I leave the matters in this realm to you."

"All right, my husband and I will take care of everything." After Zhang Fei brought Shang Yumei into the training space, Morgana immediately spoke to the members of the Shang Clan. "Even though these demons are willing to accept the four of you into this realm because of his order, you guys cannot stay in this palace. Since your cultivation is already high, you should be able to find a suitable place in this realm, and you can go there now."
Shang Chongyun nodded in understanding before posing a question. "Are the women in the southern area his wives?"
"Yes." Morgana nodded in response. "All of them are his wives, and he never likes it when people bother them, so you guys better not bother them."
"All right." Ran Keqing supported Shang Tinglong, who sustained injuries due to Zhang Fei's actions, as Shang Chongyun immediately led them to leave the demon palace.

After they left, Morgana spoke to the demon kings and queens. "Zhang Fei is far more powerful and terrifying than you all can imagine, so you guys better not disobey his order, or he will really kill you. By the way, you guys may not know this yet, but he has brought your true demon emperor back to this realm, and he lives in the ghostveil forest with Arbeola and some of our friends."
"What?" Oxgorth and the others exclaimed in shock. "Has Demon Emperor Azaroth really returned to this realm? Why didn't he come to see us?"

"You guys can go to that forest and ask him directly." All the demon kings and queens left the demon palace in droves toward the ghostveil forest. "I think the peace in this realm won't last long, and Shang Huaqiang might send other people here."
"You are right." Oz the First replied with a nod. "Fortunately, Zhang Fei protected this realm, or else those people would have taken over it again."

chapters.title: Chapter 755: Meet Cheng Gaoji
paragraphs: "Are you two sure this won't bring trouble for us?" Shang Tinglong, who was receiving treatment from his wife, asked the others.

"Do you think there's anything we can do to fight that kid?" Shang Chenguang asked back with a shake of his head. "You couldn't even do anything when he beat you up earlier, and neither of us could see his movements. Moreover, that kid clearly has a deep grudge against our patriarch, and we have long wanted to be free from his control. Therefore, I think this is the best solution for us, at least for now."
"Why does that kid hate Shang Huaqiang so much?" Ran Keqing asked them.

Shang Chenguang first thought back to everything, starting from his meeting with Zhang Fei a few months ago to their meeting just now. "Back then, I thought he was a demon fox, but the one we met just now was clearly a human. I don't know how he could disguise himself so perfectly as a demon, but I am confident in my observation. He is probably a cultivator from the Sky Jade Realm, and the events of a few months ago undoubtedly affected some of his close people, so he hates our patriarch so much."

"How could he move between realms and create a portal with his cultivation still at the 6-Star Earth Realm?" Shang Tinglong asked in confusion. "Additionally, his movements earlier were too instantaneous, as if he was teleporting."

"That kid's previous movement technique is the same teleportation ability as that of the heavenly fox race, as well as his ability to move realms and create portals." Shang Tinglong frowned at Shang Chenguang's answer. "Back then, he told me that his father was a heavenly fox, and his mother was a demon fox. At first, I didn't believe him, but I once met a member of the heavenly fox race, and that kid managed to convince me after he used his teleportation. Because of that, I decided to take him with us to the Wasteland Realm, but I didn't expect that he had arranged everything so neatly, and I foolishly fell into his trap."
"Could it be that he used an artifact to hide his beast and demon aura?"

"That's possible." Shang Chenguang answered Ran Keqing with a nod. "If he were an ordinary human, he wouldn't be able to resist the demon aura in this realm with his low cultivation. Even senior cultivators like us need protective artifacts to protect ourselves from this demon aura, or else it will gradually turn us into demons."

"Contact my wife, Chenguang." The three of them turned to Shang Chongyun. "I just remembered that Qianying sent our eldest daughter to the Wasteland Realm specifically to control that kid a few months ago, but Yumei fell to him instead. I'm sure my wife already knows a lot about him, so you can contact her and ask her the truth, especially his true identity."

"All right." Shang Chenguang immediately contacted Murong Qianying using an interspatial communication device and asked her about many things. However, she doesn't know about Zhang Fei's true identity yet, so her information is not much different from his guess. "According to your wife, that kid is indeed a heavenly fox and a demon fox, and he used an artifact to disguise himself as a human. She said that he has a close relationship with the demons of this realm, and he already knows about our plan to come here, but she doesn't know anything about his relationship with people from the Sky Jade Realm. Your wife also said that he is Hun Di's newest disciple, so we shouldn't look for trouble with him, and we should build a good relationship with him instead."
"Are you serious about that?" The three people screamed in shock after learning that Zhang Fei was the soul emperor's newest disciple.

Shang Chenguang nodded. "Qianying knew that he was Hun Di's disciple when she brought Murong Zheyun and Murong Ning to the Wasteland Realm. The soul emperor brought the two kids along with the others, including Shang Yaolin and Shang Guangming, to the Blossom Heaven Realm to challenge the Sun Tower."
"The Sun Tower? What kind of tower is that?"

"Qianying didn't explain in detail about the Sun Tower, and she only told me that there are many challenges in it to improve ourselves, so they are training there now." Shang Chenguang then told them something else. "Shang Huaqiang has taken over our clan, and he has merged our members into other branches, so we have no place to return to now. Meanwhile, Qianying had already moved the Murong Clan near the Hong Clan before that happened, so they should be safe now."
The three people's expressions became gloomy after hearing that. "What about Xiaojuan? Has he returned to our realm?"

"Xiaojuan returned a long time ago, but he then went to the Blossom Heaven Realm to catch up with Shang Yaolin, and Ai Weiren followed him there." Ran Keqing was relieved to hear that, but the next piece of information shocked them. "Xi Hongyan has successfully subdued the other clans, and the Xi Clan is the sole ruler of the western region. The Huo and Niu clans are still undisturbed in the eastern region, but the clans in the northern region are divided in two. Some of them joined the Hong Clan, and some others joined Shang Huaqiang. Currently, only the Ren and Jin clans have not yet chosen which side to side with, but they will decide soon."

"I didn't expect the situation to change so quickly in two months, but there's nothing we can do since we're far away in this realm now." Shang Chongyun then used his senses to find a suitable place for them. "There aren't many demons in the western area, so we should stay there for the time being. However, I'm uncertain about how to report to Shang Huaqiang, particularly regarding the teleportation device."

"I think we should stall for time, or else Shang Huaqiang will immediately send other people to this realm. Moreover, the situation in the Red Sun Realm is unstable with all the changes happening there, so I'm sure he won't have time to think about anything else." Ran Keqing then looked towards the west. "There's a big city in the northwest, and it seems quite busy. We should stay not far from there, and we can look for daily necessities there."
"All right." Shang Chongyun immediately flew their flying artifact in that direction.

Zhang Fei was already in front of the fallen moon cave with Feng Jinqiu. The ice phoenix immediately melted the ice before leading him inside, where she locked up the frozen Cheng Gaoji. "What do you want from this guy?"

"This." Zhang Fei showed the teleportation device. "Shang Huaqiang got it from Cheng Gaoji, and I snatched it from his subordinates. I thought about using it, but only the creator can change the coordinates, so I want you to temporarily free him."
"I see." After they arrived at the end of the cave, Feng Jinqiu immediately released Cheng Gaoji from her ice prison, but she only melted the ice covering his upper body.
"What do you want from me?" Cheng Gaoji asked with a furious expression.

"I don't need anything from you, but he needs your help." Cheng Gaoji turned to Zhang Fei and frowned, especially after he noticed his cultivation level. Feng Jinqiu immediately spoke again. "For your information, he is a close friend of my princess, and he is also the soul emperor's newest disciple."

"Huh?" Cheng Gaoji looked incredulous after hearing Hun Di take a cultivator with strength in the ten mortal realms as his disciple, but Zhang Fei immediately showed him the soul emperor's badge, proving that he was indeed his disciple.
Zhang Fei then took out the teleportation device and handed it to Cheng Gaoji. "I want you to change the destination coordinates of this device."
"Did you get this from Shang Huaqiang?" Cheng Gaoji asked as he accepted the device. "I remember for sure that I gave it to him when he visited me last time."
Zhang Fei nodded at him. "Shang Huaqiang gave it to some of his subordinates to invade this realm from the Netherworld Realm, but I snatched it from them, and I want to use it for my own interests."

'Tch! That Shang Huaqiang bastard! He already had trouble with the phoenix race, but he was still looking for trouble with Hun Di's disciple. If I had known that earlier, I would never have helped him, and I wouldn't be in a situation like this now.' Cheng Gaoji then spoke to Zhang Fei. "It's not difficult to change the destination coordinates, but I can only change it to the realm I know."

"The phoenix realm." Cheng Gaoji and Feng Jinqiu looked at Zhang Fei in shock. "My big sister can only perfect herself by going there, so I want to connect my current realm with the phoenix realm, which will make it easier for me to bring her there."
"Unfortunately, this device cannot connect the lower realms with the upper realms; not even Gong Ren can do it."
Zhang Fei shook his head. "My current realm is not in the lower realms but the middle realms, so it shouldn't be a problem, right?"
"It can be done as long as your origin realm is in the middle realms." Cheng Gaoji immediately started working on changing the destination coordinates of the teleportation device.

Feng Jinqiu then asked. "Do you really want to take Zhang Yue to the phoenix realm this soon? Her cultivation is still at the 1-Star Earth Realm, and her experience is still too shallow, so she is not ready to undergo those tests."

"Naturally, I understand that, so I won't be bringing my big sister there anytime soon." Zhang Fei then touched Feng Jinqiu's forehead and shared Zhang Yue's activities in the Netherworld realm, which surprised the ice phoenix. "She has been training there since two weeks ago, and her determination to become strong is getting stronger. She is no longer hesitant to kill, and she has killed hundreds of demons or demon beasts in the past two weeks. If she continues to train like that, I'm sure that she will be ready to undergo those ice phoenix tests much earlier than your original estimate."

Feng Jinqiu nodded in agreement. "Apparently, your decision to display your true killing intent to Zhang Yue bore fruit, and it spurred her spirit to become strong. If she could be ready earlier to undergo those tests, it would be even better for her, and she could help you to deal with your strongest enemies. However, I don't know whether she will pass those tests or not, and no one can help her, including me, so the final result depends on her own."
"My big sister is not stupid, and I believe she will pass those tests."

"I hope so." Feng Jinqiu replied with a soft sigh. "Truthfully, there were several humans with the ice phoenix bloodline who underwent the tests before her. Regrettably, none of them succeeded in passing the tests, resulting in their freezing deaths in the Frozen Lotus Basin.
Zhang Fei frowned upon hearing that, but he was confident that Zhang Yue would be able to pass those tests, and he would help her with other ways to pass them.

"Hmm?" Both Zhang Fei and Feng Jinqiu glared at Cheng Gaoji.

Cheng Gaoji let out a soft sigh. "Shang Huaqiang didn't tell me that he had a problem with you two, and I helped him because he told me about the relics left behind by the ten-tailed fox in this realm. I admit I was too greedy, and I wanted to get some of them."

"Those relics were in this realm before, but Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing have long taken them, so your coming here was in vain." Zhang Fei then thought for a while. "I have no problem releasing you, but you must be willing to be my subordinate and be loyal to me, or else you can freeze here for the rest of your life."

Cheng Gaoji was shocked by the conditions Zhang Fei gave him. After all, he was more senior and stronger than him, and his status in the upper realms as one of the artifact crafters was not small, but he actually asked him to be his subordinate.

"Has my master ever accepted a disciple as young as me in the past?" Zhang Fei asked confidently. "I may be much younger and weaker than you now, but you should be aware that my master would never accept me if I didn't have special qualifications. The road ahead of me is still long, and I still have a lot of time to develop myself. One day in the future, I will not only surpass you, but I will also surpass my master and the Nameless One. At that time, I will stand at the peak of mortal cultivation, and I will be the strongest in the upper realms."

"Hahaha." Cheng Gaoji laughed upon hearing that. "What makes you so confident that you can surpass those two monsters? "Oh?" Cheng Gaoji was momentarily surprised by that, especially since a 20-year-old grandmaster-ranked alchemist was really unusual. His expression turned serious once he saw the grade of Zhang Fei's pills. "Did you really concoct these pills?"

Zhang Fei shrugged. "It's up to you whether you want to believe it or not, but it's the truth. If you are willing to become my subordinate, I will give you these pills, and I will also give you some other pills that are even more useful."

'Should I accept his offer? He is Hun Di's disciple, and he is also a talented alchemist. Moreover, he has a close relationship with the phoenix race, and not many cultivators can do so. It would be a shame if I were to lower myself and become his subordinate, but I can gain a lot of benefits by accepting his offer.' After thinking about it seriously, Cheng Gaoji immediately gave his answer. "All right, I accept your offer to become your subordinate."
"Release your soul."
"Hmm?"
"I need a guarantee that you will never betray me, and my soul mark is that guarantee."
'This kid is too careful, huh?' Cheng Gaoji immediately released his soul and allowed Zhang Fei to imprint his soul mark on him.
After everything was done, Feng Jinqiu immediately melted all the ice from Cheng Gaoji's body.
"I'll take him to my realm now." Zhang Fei immediately took Cheng Gaoji to the Nine Stars Realm, and Feng Jinqiu returned to the Blazing Phoenix Sect.
"Hey, Kid! Isn't your ability just now the heavenly fox race's?" Zhang Fei did not answer Cheng Gaoji's question and brought him to Duan Zhao's residence directly.

Duan Zhao and his disciple were shocked by Cheng Gaoji's presence, especially since his cultivation was too high for them. 'This kid! He repeatedly brought strong cultivators from the upper realms to this realm!'
However, the old man was confused by the presence of Zhang Fei [5] at that place. "Oh? How come there are two of you? Moreover, both of you are real, and I have never seen such a thing before."

"This guy is my clone, and he learned blacksmithing under Senior Duan's guidance." Zhang Fei then spoke to Duan Zhao. "Senior, Cheng Gaoji is one of the most skilled artifact crafters in the upper realms, and I brought him here to help you create my new weapon."
