chapters.title: Chapter 756: Visit The Ren Clan
paragraphs: After he sent Cheng Gaoji there, and his fifth clone was with them, Zhang Fei immediately went to the Hong Clan to meet Hong Xinxin and the others.

"Show me the weapon design." Duan Zhao took it out and handed it to Cheng Gaoji, who immediately looked at the details seriously. "For a blacksmith from the middle realms, I must admit that your design is quite interesting. However, this design is still too ordinary and lacks efficiency, and you can improve it in some areas."
"Please tell me, Senior."

"Let's talk inside, and I will teach you to perfect it. Once the design is perfect, the effect of this weapon will increase significantly." Duan Zhao happily led Cheng Gaoji into his residence, where they had a serious discussion.
Gang Zhishou then asked Zhang Fei [5]. "Where did you meet that senior?"

"Cheng Gaoji comes from the Xianjin Realm, which is the most advanced realm in our universe." Gang Zhishou and the other three were surprised by Zhang Fei [5]'s answer. "Honestly, I have never been to that realm because its location is at the edge of the upper realms, and I have only heard about it from some of my wives and acquaintances, so I cannot explain to you guys in detail about it. If all of you are curious about that realm, you should focus on your cultivation, and you can go there when your cultivation reaches the Divine Manifestation Realm or above."

Gang Zhishou and the other three let out heavy sighs because their cultivation was still at the Divine Transcend Realm and the Divine Expansion Realm, and they had already experienced heavy obstacles to breaking through to the next stage, which made them feel that the Divine Manifestation Realm or above was still far from their reach.

"Why are you guys so pessimistic?" Zhang Fei [5] shook his head in response. "Nothing in this life is easy, okay? Some people have advantages and can cultivate quickly, and others need hard work to achieve their best. I do have many advantages compared to all of you, but that doesn't necessarily make me instantly great, and I still have to work hard to improve myself. By the way, which floor have you guys reached in the Star Tower?"
"Ah Hu and I have reached the third floor, but we failed there." Lu Zhong replied while pointing to one of his friends.
Xian Xian also answered him. "I've reached the second floor, but I failed the last challenge."
"Does that mean you failed the first floor, Old Gang?"
Gang Zhishou responded to Zhang Fei [5] with a bitter smile. "I failed five times in the natural challenge because I always had the bad luck to meet different elements."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "In four months, I will bring all my closest people to the Star Tower, and I want the four of you to join us to challenge it once again."
"Eh?" The four people were surprised by that.

Zhang Fei [5] directly told them. "I am confident that I can break through to the Heaven Realm in four months, and I will challenge the second floor of the Star Tower after that. I already know more or less the challenges on the second floor, and my old party would have had a difficult time facing them with our previous numbers. Thus, we need more party members to challenge them, and you guys are the most ideal to join us."
"Four months, right? I don't think that's a problem, so I'll join you." Ah Hu was the first to decide.
Lu Zhong thought for a moment before agreeing. "All right, I'm in."
"Since those two are coming with you, I'll join in too." Xian Xian then asked Gang Zhishou. "What about you? Have you given up on challenging the Star Tower?"

"To be honest, I'm tired of dealing with those challenges." With a deep sigh, Gang Zhishou responded. "However, I realize that I will reach a dead end if I give up, and I will never be able to improve further, so I will join you guys."
Xian Xian and the others smiled with joy at Gang Zhishou's decision. After all, they've known each other for decades, and they're like family, so they don't want him to give up.

Zhang Fei [5] then distributed several bottles of pills to the four of them, which were the Core Refining Pill, the True Dantian Pill, the Yin Purifying Pill, the Yang Purifying Pill, and several other pills. "Since you guys have swallowed my basic pills, you can use these pills. Two of them will increase your core and dantian strength, and the others will increase the Yin and Yang Qi in your bodies, which will accelerate your cultivation speed."
After obtaining those pills, the four of them hurriedly entered their master's residence to swallow them, making Zhang Fei [5] smile in amusement at their antics.
Since he had learned the correct way to forge earth-grade equipment, Zhang Fei [5] immediately entered the training space, where he began forging.

In the Shang Clan, Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan looked gloomy, especially after they received news of Xi Hongyan and her Xi clan's actions in subduing all the clans in the western region. "What about Shi Wuxian, wife? Why isn't she here yet?"

"I contacted her two months ago, but she still has a lot of other things to do, so I don't know when she will arrive." Fei Qinyuan's answer made her husband even more anxious because many of their plans had failed miserably. "What about Ziyuan? Have you asked her to come back? She's been gone for quite a while, and it's hard for us to carry out our other plans without her."

"I already told Ziyuan about Xi Hongyan's actions, but she was more concerned about Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin's affairs than ours. She has arrived at the lower realms and searched several realms, but she still hasn't managed to find them, and she wants to find them as soon as possible." Fei Qinyuan scowled in response to Shang Huaqiang's answer. "Shang Chongyun and the others should have arrived at the Netherworld Realm by now, but they haven't given me any updates yet, so I don't know if they've installed the teleportation device or not."

"Forget about the Netherworld Realm and the Sky Jade Realm's affairs for now, and we should focus on the matter at hand." Fei Qinyuan then took out a piece of paper with many notes. "Currently, there are three camps in this realm, with Xi Hongyan's camp being the largest. However, if Hong Quan successfully persuades Ren Dongcheng and Jin Ruyue, the Hong Clan has the potential to surpass her group. Fortunately, those two old people are stubborn, and they haven't made a decision. However, I heard that they are considering joining the Huo Clan, especially since that clan has the support of Tian Shuixiang and Lin Jingxia. If they join that clan, our toughest enemy will be the Xi Clan, and they will probably attack us first before the Hong Clan."

Shang Huaqiang nodded with a solemn expression. "Xi Hongyan hates us so much because her parents died at the hands of my parents, and I'm sure she will target our clan first rather than the Hong Clan. However, I'm sure she won't dare move carelessly to attack us, especially with my ancestors around. The only solution we have now is to convince the Jin and Ren Clans to join us, and we can use them to push her back if she attacks us."

"I will go to the Ren Clan now, and I will force Ren Dongcheng to submit to us. As for Jin Ruyue, we can only wait for Shi Wuxian to arrive." After she said that, Fei Qinyuan immediately stood up and left, and she rushed towards the northern region.
Meanwhile, Shang Huaqiang went to the back of his clan to meet his two ancestors, Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun, to discuss the matters with them.

Zhang Fei, together with Hong Xinxin and the Hong Clan members, discussed Shang Chongyun and the others. "I originally thought you would kill them, but you spared them and revealed your identities to them."

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed at that. "I did want to kill them at first, but you said that Xi Hongyan managed to unite the western region by force, so I decided to spare them because we needed more people to fight her and the Shang Clan. Moreover, they had a deep grudge against Shang Huaqiang, especially Shang Chongyun and Shang Tinglong, so I intended to use them against him."
"Are you going to let Shang Chongyun and Shang Tinglong die in their hands?" Yan Yizhen asked him.
Zhang Fei shook his head. "I haven't decided on my plans for them yet, and I'm still thinking about a few things before making a decision."

"Fei Qinyuan has just left the Shang Clan and headed to the northern region." Zhang Fei and the others turned to Hong Chong directly. "I'm sure Xi Hongyan's actions forced her and Shang Huaqiang to plan some countermeasures against her, especially since she hated them so much due to her parents' deaths at their parents' hands. Currently, all the clans have taken sides, so only the Ren and Jin clans are left, but I don't know which clan they will target first."

Hong Xinxin immediately conveyed her thoughts. "I think Fei Qinyuan will meet Ren Dongcheng first, so Zhang Fei and I are going to the Ren clan now, and we will go to the Jin clan to meet Jin Ruyue afterward."
"How long will it take for Fei Qinyuan to arrive at the Ren Clan?"
"With her cultivation and speed, she should be able to arrive at the Ren Clan in five hours, so you two still have plenty of time to get ahead of her." Hong Quan answered Zhang Fei.
"I see." Zhang Fei then lifted Hong Xinxin to her feet. "In that case, I will take Xinxin to the Ren Clan now, and I will set up a trap for Fei Qinyuan there."

"What do you plan to do with her?" Zhang Fei just smiled at Cai Yinzhi and took Hong Xinxin to leave directly, leaving them sighing to themselves. "Judging from his evil smile, I'm sure Fei Qinyuan will suffer a terrible fate."
Hong Quan nodded in agreement with his wife. "Let them deal with Fei Qinyuan and the Ren Clan, and we will wait for the results."
Zhang Fei effortlessly transported Hong Xinxin to the northern region with his Level 5 Nine Cloud Steps, and they arrived at the Red Clan within minutes.
However, they refrained from entering the clan immediately and instead observed it from a distance, with Zhang Fei closely monitoring the situation inside using the system map.
"What do you say if we meet Ren Dongcheng now?" Hong Xinxin asked.

"I think it's no problem." Zhang Fei immediately took the concealment ring, which his third clone usually uses. Additionally, he used his body modification ability to change his bone age to thousands of years, and he also changed his appearance so Ren Dongcheng would not be suspicious of him.
Hong Xinxin shook her head after she witnessed Zhang Fei's changes. "I thought only you could do this in the universe, and people would never know your true identity."
"Let's go there now."

Ren Dongcheng glared fiercely and pressured Zhang Fei with his aura, but he countered the old man by unleashing his killing intent, causing him to tremble.
*Drap... Drap...*
A bunch of people from the Ren clan immediately ran into the room as soon as they sensed Zhang Fei's killing intent, and they surrounded him and Hong Xinxin with weapons in their hands.
"Stop it." Ren Dongcheng immediately stopped his people. "Leave now."
"But—"

"Leave!" Hesitantly, the people followed Ren Dongcheng's orders and left the room, but they stood guard outside the main hall. "Hahaha! I don't know your identity, but I have to admit that your killing intent is indeed terrifying. Your offer is indeed tempting to me, but my hidden desires are only fleeting, and they cannot be compared to the benefits I can gain from relationships with the Huo Clan. The future of my clan is much more important than my personal desires, so I have to reject your offer."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding and helped Hong Xinxin stand up. "Since you have decided so, we will not force you to join us, and we will take our leave now."

Ren Dongcheng immediately ordered his people to make way for both of them, especially since Zhang Fei's killing intent frightened him greatly. As he watched them walking away, he raised both of his trembling hands. "I have met too many enemies in my life, but only a few of them can make me tremble like this. What exactly is that man's identity? Which realm did he come from? Since when did the Hong Clan have such a terrifying person by their side?"

chapters.title: Chapter 757: The Jin Clan Join
paragraphs: "Are you going to do something to Ren Dongcheng?" Hong Xinxin asked once they were far enough from the Ren Clan residence.

Zhang Fei responded by pinching her nose. "Naturally, I will do something to that old man and Fei Qinyuan, but I can't do it openly. Therefore, I have to go back there now, and the two of them will enjoy my gift."

Hong Xinxin could only shake her head once Zhang Fei disappeared, but her smile widened as she imagined what would happen next. "I still didn't expect that old man to be so depraved and disgusting; he even dared to think about possessing my grandmother and mother."
In a few minutes, Zhang Fei had returned to Hong Xinxin's side and told her a few things about his plans for Ren Dongcheng and Fei Qinyuan, and they went to the Jin clan afterward.
They were already in the main hall of the Jin clan, and Hong Xinxin told Zhang Fei, who was monitoring the clan through the map, some things about Jin Ruyue.

Soon, an old woman with waist-length white hair walked out from inside, and her eyes narrowed as she watched Zhang Fei. There was a hint of disdain in her eyes, as she could recognize his cultivation despite the concealment ring that had hidden it, which was in stark contrast to his thousands-of-year-old bone age.
Zhang Fei naturally noticed Jin Ruyue's look of disdain toward him, but he didn't say anything and gave a faint smirk, causing her to shiver.
Jin Ruyue shook her head slightly and sat down in the head seat. "Did your grandfather send you here to persuade me, little girl Hong?"
"Grandma Jin, my future husband has an interesting offer for you, and I believe you won't be able to refuse it." Hong Xinxin spoke confidently.

"Oh?" Jin Ruyue was surprised to hear about their relationship. "Who exactly are you? How did you manage to win little girl Hong's heart? You're thousands of years old, but your cultivation is still at the 6-Star Earth Realm. Furthermore, your cultivation is still unstable, which means your cultivation has just been broken through."
As Shang Yingyue had told Zhang Fei when she gave him the ring, there were some people who had the ability to see through the concealment even without using artifacts, and Jin Ruyue was one of them.

"Have you ever heard the saying, Don't judge a book by its cover?" Jin Ruyue frowned at Zhang Fei's question. "I know you have the ability to see through the concealment of my cultivation, but you must not forget that the world of cultivation is too mysterious. Sometimes our eyes often deceive us, and we are often overconfident to the point of preventing us from seeing what is actually hidden in front of us."
Jin Ruyue nodded to him. "You are right; our arrogance and overconfidence often make us see things only from the outside, but we ignore the truth hidden inside."
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed and cupped his hands to her. "I admire you, Senior. Most senior cultivators would be furious after hearing my words, but you are willing to acknowledge them."

"You don't need to beat around the bush and show me the hidden truth of yourself." Jin Ruyue immediately grabbed her seat's handrests as soon as Zhang Fei's aura changed, and his faint killing intent was enough to make her shiver. "I have underestimated you, and the truth about you is deeper than I previously imagined. How many living beings have you killed?"
"I never counted them, but I think millions." Zhang Fei casually answered.
Jin Ruyue exhaled slowly after hearing that. "I am over ten thousand years old now, and I have faced too many battles, but my body count is much lower than yours."

"Unlike you, I don't have a strong background, and I have so many people I care about. That's why I can't be lenient and merciful like you, and I have to fight hard to protect myself and the people closest to me." Jin Ruyue nodded in agreement to Zhang Fei. "The world of cultivation has always been harsh and cruel, and so many powerful cultivators threaten our safety. Thus, I have to be cruel and merciless to protect myself and the others, and I will kill anyone who comes to us regardless of their background."

"Your mindset is good, but your bad karma will continue to accumulate if you continue to soak your hands in blood." Zhang Fei did not refute Jin Ruyue because it was true. "You may still be able to withstand it at first, but the heavens will not be merciful to you forever, and they will give you much more severe punishments every time you break through in your cultivation."
Zhang Fei then asked. "Would you believe it if I told you that I have faced hundreds of lightning tribulations?"
"With your many victims, you are too bloody, so I don't have any doubts about it." Jin Ruyue said it with a serious expression.

"In fact, my cultivation only broke through today, and I had to face ten lightning tribulations before." Zhang Fei's answer made Jin Ruyue let out a soft sigh, but her eyes widened as soon as she took out two pills. "To be honest, I have never given these two pills to anyone outside of my inner circle. However, I admire you as a senior, so I thought of giving them to you, but on the condition that you are willing to join the Hong Clan. There are so many alchemists in this universe, with the alchemist god and the alchemist goddess being the best among them, but neither of them has the ability to concoct my pills."

Jin Ruyue looked doubtful after hearing that, especially since there were no alchemists better than the alchemist god and the alchemist goddess. If they didn't have the ability to concoct such pills, she was sure that no other alchemist would be able to, but the two pills in Zhang Fei's hands still piqued her interest. "What are the effects of those two pills?"

"You can witness the effects for yourself, and I dare to guarantee that you will love them." Zhang Fei gave both pills to Hong Xinxin, who immediately swallowed them in order. "The effects will take a little while to work, so I hope you can wait patiently."
"All right." Jin Ruyue nodded.

Half an hour later, Jin Ruyue was shocked to see black liquid starting to appear on Hong Xinxin's body, and the smell was also incredibly pungent, forcing her to cover her nose. "What kind of pill is that exactly? Why is the effect similar to the impurity cleansing pill?"
"You will see the results soon."
After a while, Hong Xinxin's entire body was covered by the black liquid, but Zhang Fei immediately cleaned it all up and dried her dress, and she swallowed the second pill directly.
Jin Ruyue's jaw dropped open, and her eyes opened wide as she stared at Hong Xinxin's face. "How... how..."

Hong Xinxin was indeed not too old, but she was quite old for a woman of her age, and the Beauty Restoring Pill restored her youthful appearance. She immediately took out a mirror to see her new appearance, and a flowery smile spread across her lovely face.
"Do you like it, Xinxin?"
"Why didn't you give them to me before?"

"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled and pointed at Jin Ruyue, who was completely dumbfounded. "If I gave them to you earlier, how could I prove their effects to her? Look at her; she's shocked to that extent."

Hong Xinxin smiled amusedly at Jin Ruyue's expression. "What do you think now, Grandma Jin? Do you still have doubts about my future husband's words? Senior Tian Shuixiang and Senior Lin Jingxia are indeed renowned alchemists; they have reached the pinnacle of alchemy. However, I have never heard of them concocting pills that can restore our youth, or else they would not look as old as they do now."
"You're right." Jin Ruyue replied with a nod of approval. "Are the effects of the two pills only temporary?"

Zhang Fei took another two pills and explained their effects to Jin Ruyue. "These two pills complement each other, so you should swallow them both. The Beauty Restoring Pill will restore your youth, and the Youthful Retaining Pill will maintain its effects, so you will never age again forever. However, these pills will give you a lot of trouble if people find out about them, so you should use a disguise to hide their effects."

"Such pills with wonderful effects will arouse the envy of many people; both men and women always yearn for eternal youth, and it is one of the many reasons we work hard to improve our cultivation." Jin Ruyue thought as she looked at the two pills. "Did you concoct them yourself? Even Tian Shuixiang and Lin Jingxia have long wanted to concoct such pills, but they have never succeeded in creating them."

"In fact, I am a grandmaster-rank alchemist, and I got the recipe for these two pills by luck, so only I can concoct them in this universe. However, I will never sell them to the public, especially since it would only add a lot of trouble for me." Zhang Fei then asked her. "What about your decision? Are you willing to join the Hong Clan? "You're right." Hong Xinxin then asked. "What about Fei Qinyuan? Is she almost arriving in this region?"

If the final result is as I expected, we can kill two birds with one stone, so we don't have to bother anymore."
"I'm looking forward to it, and I want to see Fei Qinyuan's shocked expression." Hong Xinxin said it with a chuckle.
An hour later, Jin Ruyue had returned to them with her new appearance, and she couldn't stop smiling because of it. "Are you going to teach me about the soul cultivation path now?"

"We're still waiting for someone to arrive, and she'll be here in an hour, so we'll do it after that." Zhang Fei immediately explained to Jin Ruyue about Fei Qinyuan, who was on her way to the Ren Clan. "If the results are as I wish, Ren Dongcheng will have no other choice but to join our group, which will make our group bigger and more solid. As for that woman, I have my own plans for her, but I won't explain them now, and she will be useful in bringing down Shang Huaqiang."
As they waited for Fei Qinyuan to arrive, Zhang Fei explained to Jin Ruyue the outline of the soul cultivation path, but she seemed to have difficulty understanding it.

chapters.title: Chapter 758: Two People Fight
paragraphs: Zhang Fei, Hong Xinin, and Jin Ruyue were already not far from the Ren Clan, waiting for Fei Qinyuan, who was getting closer to the clan.
"What exactly are you planning to do to them?" Jin Ruyue asked Zhang Fei.
Zhang Fei just smiled and didn't tell her anything. "Be patient, and you'll find out once Fei Qinyuan arrives at the Ren Clan."

Fifteen minutes later, Fei Qinyuan had arrived at the Ren Clan, but he didn't go inside right away. Instead, she checked the surrounding area of the clan with her senses to make sure, and she entered it after finding nothing suspicious.
"You guys wait here, and I'll sneak in."
Jin Ruyue wanted to stop Zhang Fei, but he had already disappeared before she could. "How could he disappear like that?"

"That's one of his unique abilities, and he still has many other unique abilities." Jin Ruyue frowned because Hong Xinxin was too secretive. "Whether you believe it or not, no cultivator in this realm can catch him; even Grandpa Yan can't keep up with his speed, let alone other cultivators."
"Does his speed really surpass Yan Liebao? How did he train his speed to be that fast?"

"Zhang Fei's speed is already much faster than my grandfather's even before he uses his wind element, and his speed will be even faster if he uses it." Hong Xinxin's answer shocked Jin Ruyue because she knew that the Yan clan was one of the fastest clans in the upper realms, and only two other clans could surpass them. "Honestly, I still don't know how he was able to train his speed to that fast, but I'm willing to bet that the people from the Lei Clan won't be able to catch up to him either. Perhaps the only person who can match his speed is the Nameless One, especially with his void element."

All of this made Jin Ruyue feel that Zhang Fei was too mysterious, and she found it difficult to gauge his depth. "How could you be interested in him? Weren't you madly in love with Shang Guangming back then?"

"Haha." Hong Xinxin had no intention of telling her the truth, so she made up a story. "I don't know how to say it, but I was attracted to him at first sight. I've spent a few months with him to guide him on the body cultivation path, and I'm determined to be his wife now."

"Love and feelings are always strange and difficult to understand." Jin Ruyue said with a faint smile on her face. "The first time I met my late husband, I immediately fell in love with him. We didn't date for too long, and we got married a month after we met. Unfortunately, his talent in cultivation was too low, and he died of old age because his cultivation was stuck in the ten mortal realms."
"At least you guys lived happily for several thousand years, so there's nothing for you to regret, right?"

Jin Ruyue nodded in agreement. "Even though we couldn't be together longer, I am completely delighted with our time together for several thousand years, and our memories will always remain in my heart forever. Hey! They are already gathered in the main hall, so let's eavesdrop on them."
"Yeah."
Ren Dongcheng was annoyed by Fei Qinyuan's visit, especially since Shang Ziyuan had come to see him two months ago, and he had firmly refused to join their Shang Clan.

"If you came here to persuade me to join you, you can go back to your clan right now." Fei Qinyuan wanted to interrupt Ren Dongcheng, but the old man hurriedly continued. "I have no interest in joining people with too much ambition like you and your husband, and I have no interest in joining the Hong Clan either. I only want a quiet and peaceful life for my clan members, so I decided to join the Huo Clan. Moreover, Huo Jiguang has a favorable relationship with Tian Shuixiang and Lin Jingxia, so joining them is our best choice, and my son is discussing it with him now."

'I didn't expect this old bastard had already made up his mind to join the Huo Clan! If I fail to draw the Ren and Jin Clan to our side, our side's strength will not be able to match the Xi Clan, and Xi Hongyan will definitely attack us one day.' Fei Qinyuan then asked Ren Dongcheng. "How can I change your mind?"

"Are you and Shang Huaqiang able to supply us with the best pills, potions, and elixirs like the Huo Clan?" Ren Dongcheng's mocking question caused Fei Qinyuan to frown. "Heh! Tian Shuixiang and Lin Jingxia are the best alchemists in this universe, and your Shang Clan has no relationship with them. Therefore, you can go back to your clan and don't waste my time, especially since I will never change my mind about joining the Huo Clan."

Fei Qinyuan was completely furious and exerted her cultivation straight away, causing Ren Dongcheng to tremble in shock, forcing him to jump away from her. 'Fuck! This bitch's cultivation has already broken through to the 2-Moon Divine Ascendant.'
"I came here to speak nicely to you, but you kept mocking me since earlier." A blue sword immediately appeared in Fei Qinyuan's hand. "Since you can't speak nicely, I will force you to submit to us."

'Shit! This bitch has gone mad!' Ren Dongcheng immediately took out a guandao and summoned his clan members to surround Fei Qinyuan. "You are indeed stronger than me by one level, but you are in my clan now, and I will not allow you to act tyrannically here."
*Drap... Drap...*
Quickly, several groups of men from the Ren Clan had surrounded the main hall, and some of them moved inside and stood behind Ren Dongcheng while holding their respective weapons.
"Do you think you guys can stop me?" A blue aura quickly enveloped Fei Qinyuan's body, and her aura instantly spread out, suppressing the Ren Clan people.
*Bam... Bam...*
Fei Qinyuan's aura caused some of them to fall, and others supported their bodies with their weapons. Their bodies were shaking, and sweat began to wet their clothes.

Ren Dongcheng directly fought back against Fei Qinyuan's pressure with his own, but he couldn't fully dispel it, and his people still felt pressured by her. "Even if I have to die by your hands today, my son and family will attack your Shang Clan with the help of the Huo Clan, and you will understand how terrifying Huo Jiguang is."

"Heh!" Fei Qinyuan snorted and wanted to attack Ren Dongcheng, but she suddenly inhaled something unusual, which caused her Qi and aura to become chaotic. 'What the hell is this? Why did my Qi suddenly become like this?'

Ren Dongcheng noticed Fi Qinyuan's reaction and wanted to move to attack him first, but smoke suddenly entered the main hall and quickly filled it, which made it difficult for him and his men to control themselves.
However, the smoke did not affect Fei Qinyuan, and it only affected Ren Dongcheng and the other men. In a few seconds, the sclera of their eyes turned red, as if they were berserk.

'What the hell with this smoke? This is bad! This smoke makes them like that!' Without thinking twice, Fei Qinyuan immediately ran out, but Ren Dongcheng and his subordinates right away attacked her like madmen.
Even though her Qi was still chaotic, Fei Qinyuan was still able to easily knock the people from the Ren Clan back, but Ren Dongcheng rushed over and swung his guandao towards her back.
Sensing that, Fei Qinyuan spun around and parried Ren Dongcheng's guandao, but his brute force was stronger than hers due to her chaotic Qi, pushing her back several steps.

'Shit!' Fei Qinyuan inwardly cursed, realizing that Ren Dongcheng was clearly not himself, and his killing intent was already controlling him. She immediately turned around and ran away, and she took out her returning jade to return to the Shang Clan straight away.

Fei Qinyuan panicked when her jade vanished from her grasp before she could break it, as Ren Dongcheng and his subordinates pursued her relentlessly. Additionally, more people from the Ren Clan surrounded her after hearing the commotion, and they immediately helped their patriarch and other members.

'I have to escape as soon as possible, or I will die in their hands.' Fei Qinyuan tried hard to stabilize her Qi as she paved her way to escape from the Ren clan by attacking the people who stood in her way, leaving most of them seriously injured. She also contacted her husband, but Shang Huaqiang was busy discussing with his ancestors.

Fei Qinyuan suddenly felt Ren Dongcheng dart toward her from behind with intense killing intent. She immediately took out an artifact and threw it at him, but it also disappeared on its own. 'Fuck! I bet someone did this to us on purpose! That person definitely wants us to kill each other!'
*Clang*
Ren Dongcheng's guandao hit the ground as Fei Qinyuan dodged it, which made him even more furious, and his killing intent became even more terrifying.

Fei Qinyuan continued to run forward while attacking everyone in front of her without caring about Ren Dongcheng, who was chasing behind her with his eyes even redder than before. When she arrived not far from the gate, she was frustrated because the gate suddenly closed by itself, forcing her to use her chaotic Qi to fly, which had a detrimental effect on her.

Just as Fei Qinyuan was sure that she could escape from the place, she felt someone grab her right leg and restrain her movement, giving Ren Dongcheng the chance to leap toward her and slash his guandao at her back.
"Argh!" Fei Qinyuan screamed in pain after being hit by Ren Dongcheng's attack, and blood flowed profusely from her deep wound, soaking the back of her dress.

Ren Dongcheng's subordinates immediately charged toward Fei Qinyuan to kill her, but the hand holding her right leg suddenly let go of her leg. She swiftly flew away as fast as possible, leaving the Ren Clan with heavy injuries on her back.

Meanwhile, Ren Dongcheng and his subordinates were bounced back, but an artificial forest immediately appeared and trapped them inside, with many tree roots binding their bodies. "You're right." Jin Ruyue immediately put away her dagger again. "So, what should we do with this woman?"

"She is a soul cultivator, and her cultivation and soul power are still too high for me, so I can't do much to her." Zhang Fei then squatted in front of Fei Qinyuan and took out a bottle containing a clear liquid. "I made this liquid using the Serpent's Kiss Flower, and its poison has no odor, so she and Shang Huaqiang won't notice it."
"What effect does it have?"

Zhang Fei explained to them directly. "It will cause internal organ failure, and its poison is not easy to neutralize, so she and Shang Huaqiang will suffer for quite a while, giving us plenty of time to better prepare our group."
"Why don't you use a stronger poison on her?"

"Do you want to destroy your clan?" Zhang Fei then smeared the liquid on Fei Qinyuan's lips and some other parts of her body, and he also did a few things to her. "They have Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun behind them, and the two old men will attack us immediately if they die too quickly. Since she was injured in this region, the two of them will attack the clans in this region first, including your Jin Clan."
"No." Jin Ruyue replied with a shake of her head. "In that case, let's use your plan."

chapters.title: Chapter 759: Teach Jin Ruyue
paragraphs: Zhang Fei and Jin Ruyue were already sitting opposite each other on the bed. Hong Xinxin waited on the side chair, waiting for him to teach Matriarch Jin about the soul cultivation path.

"Release your soul first, and I will guide you manually." Although she was a little uncomfortable because Zhang Fei was holding her hands, with their fingers interlocked with each other, Jin Ruyue followed suit by releasing her soul, and their souls also joined hands. "I will gradually flow my Yang Qi into your soul, and you can flow your Yin Qi into my soul without needing to think about anything."
"Is that really okay with you?"
"Unlike you, I often dual soul cultivated with dozens of women, and the cultivation of some of them has reached the Seven Divine Realm, so you don't need to think about me."

Jin Ruyue nodded to Zhang Fei before closing her eyes, and they began channeling their Yin and Yang Qi into each other's souls. However, she did not realize that he implanted his soul mark in her soul, preventing her from betraying him.

Hong Xinxin repeatedly looked out the window and used her senses to monitor Fei Qinyuan, who was still fast asleep by the river. 'She and Shang Huaqiang will be confused if they have organ failure, and it will keep them busy looking for an antidote, so we can find another solution to defeat them.'

In the Ren Clan, Ren Dongcheng and some of his subordinates had already returned to their senses, but their heads felt so heavy. He was confused after he saw his residence become a forest, and the majority of his clan members were cutting them down. "Why did my residence become like this?"

One of Ren Dongcheng's subordinates, who was not affected by the effects of Zhang Fei's herb, immediately explained to him about their previous situation, including when they were chasing Fei Qinyuan and the mysterious appearance of the forest in their residence.

Ren Dongcheng's expression became deadly serious once the person told him that he had injured Fei Qinyuqn quite badly. He remembered that she wanted to suppress him, but he was confused about how he could become berserk and attack her, and the mysterious appearance of the forest confused him even more.

Ren Dongcheng immediately returned to the main hall and sat down on his chair, with all kinds of questions in his mind. 'Did someone purposely cause us to go berserk? Did that person deliberately pit me against Fei Qinyuan? Could it be that that person wants to destroy my Ren clan and the Shang clan at the same time? That mad woman must have contacted Shang Huaqiang by now, and that crazy bastard will come here soon.'
After he thought about it carefully, Ren Dongcheng immediately activated the formation in his residence, and he also ordered his clan members to prepare to face Shang Huaqiang and the Shang Clan.

The previous incident had made the Ren Clan members aware of the danger that threatened them. They followed Ren Dongcheng's orders by evacuating all the women, elderly, and children to another place quite far from their clan residence in the hope that Shang Huaqiang and the Shang Clan would not be able to find them.

The townspeople were confused by the Ren clan's sudden action, but most of them were already aware of the situation in the clan, especially with the mysterious appearance of the forest in their residence.
The news of the Ren clan's movements quickly spread to the ears of the leaders of other clans, including the Wang and Dai clans, who had decided to join the Shang Clan.

The two leaders of the Wu and Li Clans, Wu Yuhong and Li Ping, went to the Jin Clan after they received news from Hong Quan that Jin Ruyue had decided to join them. They wanted to discuss the Ren clan's situation with her, but she was busy with Zhang Fei, so the two were forced to wait.
Two hours later, Shang Huaqiang and his clan members arrived at Fei Qinyuan's location, and he immediately checked his wife's condition. "Wife, wake up, it's me."

Fei Qinyuan's eyelashes trembled before she slowly opened her eyes, and she was relieved to see her husband and their clan members. She then hugged Shang Huaqiang and gave him a deep kiss, which he immediately returned.

Unfortunately, Fei Qinyuan did not realize that their kiss caused Zhang Fei's poison on her lips to directly affect her and Shang Huaqiang, but it would not work immediately, and their internal organs would gradually fail.
"How about your condition?" Shang Huaqiang asked with concern.

"My injury is quite serious, but I have swallowed several pills to heal and stop the bleeding, and I have applied ointment to my wound." Shang Huaqiang immediately helped Fei Qinyuan up and supported her. "We shouldn't go to the Ren Clan now, especially since Ren Dongcheng and some of his subordinates are in bad shape, and their strength is a bit higher than it should be."

"What do you mean by that?" Fei Qinyuan immediately explained to Shang Huaqiang about her suspicions about the presence of a mysterious person who was deliberately setting them against each other. "Did you see that person?"

"No." Fei Qinyuan shook her head. "I was too panicked to escape from Ren Dongcheng and the others at that time, and that person also used a concealment artifact, so I couldn't see his or her face. I'm sure Xi Hongyan has already placed her spies in this region, and the previous commotion must have reached her ears by now, so we should return to our clan immediately."

"All right." Shang Huaqiang gave his wife another returning jade before ordering his clan members. "Go see Wang Jinghsan and Dai Guowei now! Order them to investigate the identity of that mysterious person! Don't forget to investigate the Jin clan; I suspect that the mysterious person has something to do with Jin Ruyue."
"Yes, Patriarch." After Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuqn left, the people of the Shang Clan rushed into the city to meet the two patriarchs of the Wang and Di clans.
Upon arriving at their clan, Shang Huaqiang brought Fei Qinyuan back to their bedroom, but pink gas suddenly came out of her body and caused their lust to soar instantly.

Without thinking twice, Shang Huaqiang pounced on his wife, even though Fei Qinyuan was still in a state of severe injury, and the two quickly began their sexual activity, which would last until both were completely exhausted.

In the Xi clan, Xi Hongyan seemed to be thinking seriously, but Xi Qiuwei suddenly asked her, "Are you thinking of attacking the Shang clan now? Shang Huaqiang is not weak, and his cultivation seems to have broken through to the 2-Moon Divine Ascendant Realm. Moreover, Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun are protecting them, and I am unable to fight both of them by myself."

"At first, I thought of attacking them, but I felt that it was too rash." Xi Qiuwei was relieved by Xi Hongyan's answer. "By the way, I have already sent Xi Yinying to the Shang Clan to monitor Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan, and I am sure those two old god sticks will not notice her presence."

Xi Qiuwei nodded in agreement. "Yinying's shadow abilities are quite amazing, and I myself cannot detect her presence as long as she hides in the shadows, so I believe they will not be able to detect her presence. I just got news from Xi Youfeng, and he told me that Shang Xishun has been in the Wasteland Realm for a month. Shang Huaqiang seems to have ordered her to investigate something, especially about the disappearance of Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin."
"Oh?" Xi Hongyan was surprised to hear that. "Since when did those two disappear?"
Xi Qiuwei told her directly. "They disappeared three months ago, and I heard that Shang Ziyuan was also out looking for them."

"I see." Xi Hongyan then said. "Aunt Qiuwei, I want you to go to the Wasteland Realm and capture Shang Xishun. She is one of the best elders of the Shang clan, so we can use her to destroy them from within. However, I need to think of something to control her first, and Lin Moxian might be able to help me with that."

"Lin Moxian is Hun Di's first disciple, right? How did you meet him?" Xi Hongyan recounted to Xi Qiuwei about her encounter with the man several years ago. "As far as I remember, that brat is Lin Jingxia's nephew, and that cold woman doesn't like it when others take advantage of her family, so you have to be careful with your intentions. If she finds out about it, she will suppress our clan, and it will be a huge loss for us."
Xi Hongyan nodded to her aunt. "I know your worries, and I will make sure that Lin Jingxia will not find out about this matter."
"I hope you are really careful." Xi Qiuwei then went to the back. "I will go to the Wasteland Realm to capture Shang Xishun now, and you can contact Lin Moxian."

After her aunt left, Xi Hongyan immediately contacted Lin Moxian and asked her to come to her Xi clan as soon as possible. His reply made a beautiful but evil smile spread across her lovely face. "Shang Huaqiang! My long-held desire to destroy you and your Shang Clan will soon come true, and you'd never have thought one of your trusted elders would help me!"

A few hours later, they had already put their souls back into their bodies, and Jin Ruyue was satisfied with the results after she became a soul cultivator. "Somehow, I feel like I'm really stupid! The soul cultivation path is not as difficult as I imagined, but I have always failed to become a soul cultivator, and I would never have become one if not for your guidance."

"The soul cultivation path can be easy, but it can also be difficult, and it depends on our comprehension." Zhang Fei then took out two hundred empty bottles, confusing Jin Ruyue. "I have a few people with cultivation in the Divine Expansion Realm, and I want to help them improve their cultivation faster. Unfortunately, there aren't many female cultivators with cultivation as high as yours by my side, so I hope you're willing to give me your Yin Qi, and I'll have them use it to cultivate."

Jin Ruyue was stunned for quite a while after Zhang Fei asked that, but he then gave her three superior-grade Qi recovery pills so she could recover her Qi. "All right, I will give you my Yin Qi, but you have to wait outside."

Zhang Fei went down from the bed and walked out of Jin Ruyue's room, but he immediately put on his disguise because Wu Yuhong and Li Ping were in the main hall, and he didn't want them to know his true identity.
"How many people are there actually on his side?" Jin Ruyue questioned Hong Xinxin while she was removing her dress and filling the bottles with her Yin Qi.

Hong Xinxin then told Jin Ruyue about the demon fox group, including Zhang Fei's purpose in establishing it. "For now, his group already exists on two planets in the lower and middle realms, and he seems to want to use this realm as the headquarters of his organization for the upper realms. However, he will not open his organization here anytime soon, and he will probably do so after he succeeds in eliminating the Shang Clan."

"That's still not enough, right?" Jin Ruyue asked again. "Even if he manages to get rid of the Shang Clan, there are still Xi Hongyan and her Xi clan in this realm, and that woman is no less ambitious than Shang Huaqiang. If he establishes his organization here, she will attack and destroy him directly."

"If you allow her to swallow the other men's Yang Qi, I have some in my storage ring, and I can give them to my mother-in-law."

"Release your soul first, and I will guide you manually." Although she was a little uncomfortable because Zhang Fei was holding her hands, with their fingers interlocked with each other, Jin Ruyue followed suit by releasing her soul, and their souls also joined hands.

"Is that really okay with you?"

Ren Dongcheng's expression became deadly serious once the person told him that he had injured Fei Qinyuqn quite badly.
He remembered that she wanted to suppress him, but he was confused about how he could become berserk and attack her, and the mysterious appearance of the forest confused him even more.
Ren Dongcheng immediately returned to the main hall and sat down on his chair, with all kinds of questions in his mind. 'Did someone purposely cause us to go berserk?
Did that person deliberately pit me against Fei Qinyuan?
Could it be that that person wants to destroy my Ren clan and the Shang clan at the same time?
That mad woman must have contacted Shang Huaqiang by now, and that crazy bastard will come here soon.'
After he thought about it carefully, Ren Dongcheng immediately activated the formation in his residence, and he also ordered his clan members to prepare to face Shang Huaqiang and the Shang Clan.
The previous incident had made the Ren Clan members aware of the danger that threatened them.

They followed Ren Dongcheng's orders by evacuating all the women, elderly, and children to another place quite far from their clan residence in the hope that Shang Huaqiang and the Shang Clan would not be able to find them.

The townspeople were confused by the Ren clan's sudden action, but most of them were already aware of the situation in the clan, especially with the mysterious appearance of the forest in their residence.
The news of the Ren clan's movements quickly spread to the ears of the leaders of other clans, including the Wang and Dai clans, who had decided to join the Shang Clan.
The two leaders of the Wu and Li Clans, Wu Yuhong and Li Ping, went to the Jin Clan after they received news from Hong Quan that Jin Ruyue had decided to join them.

Two hours later, Shang Huaqiang and his clan members arrived at Fei Qinyuan's location, and he immediately checked his wife's condition.

"How about your condition?" Shang Huaqiang asked with concern.

"My injury is quite serious, but I have swallowed several pills to heal and stop the bleeding, and I have applied ointment to my wound." Shang Huaqiang immediately helped Fei Qinyuan up and supported her.

"What do you mean by that?" Fei Qinyuan immediately explained to Shang Huaqiang about her suspicions about the presence of a mysterious person who was deliberately setting them against each other.
"Did you see that person?"
"No." Fei Qinyuan shook her head.

"All right." Shang Huaqiang gave his wife another returning jade before ordering his clan members.

"Yes, Patriarch." After Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuqn left, the people of the Shang Clan rushed into the city to meet the two patriarchs of the Wang and Di clans.

"At first, I thought of attacking them, but I felt that it was too rash." Xi Qiuwei was relieved by Xi Hongyan's answer.
"By the way, I have already sent Xi Yinying to the Shang Clan to monitor Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan, and I am sure those two old god sticks will not notice her presence."
Xi Qiuwei nodded in agreement.
"Yinying's shadow abilities are quite amazing, and I myself cannot detect her presence as long as she hides in the shadows, so I believe they will not be able to detect her presence.
I just got news from Xi Youfeng, and he told me that Shang Xishun has been in the Wasteland Realm for a month.
Shang Huaqiang seems to have ordered her to investigate something, especially about the disappearance of Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin."
"Oh?" Xi Hongyan was surprised to hear that.
"Since when did those two disappear?"
Xi Qiuwei told her directly.
"They disappeared three months ago, and I heard that Shang Ziyuan was also out looking for them."
"I see." Xi Hongyan then said.
"Aunt Qiuwei, I want you to go to the Wasteland Realm and capture Shang Xishun.
She is one of the best elders of the Shang clan, so we can use her to destroy them from within.
However, I need to think of something to control her first, and Lin Moxian might be able to help me with that."
"Lin Moxian is Hun Di's first disciple, right?
How did you meet him?" Xi Hongyan recounted to Xi Qiuwei about her encounter with the man several years ago.
"As far as I remember, that brat is Lin Jingxia's nephew, and that cold woman doesn't like it when others take advantage of her family, so you have to be careful with your intentions.
If she finds out about it, she will suppress our clan, and it will be a huge loss for us."
Xi Hongyan nodded to her aunt.
"I know your worries, and I will make sure that Lin Jingxia will not find out about this matter."
"I hope you are really careful." Xi Qiuwei then went to the back.
"I will go to the Wasteland Realm to capture Shang Xishun now, and you can contact Lin Moxian."
After her aunt left, Xi Hongyan immediately contacted Lin Moxian and asked her to come to her Xi clan as soon as possible.
His reply made a beautiful but evil smile spread across her lovely face.
"Shang Huaqiang!

chapters.title: Chapter 760: Toward The Nine Hells Darkland
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [5] was already at the Yun Royal Palace, and he gave Yun Shang fifty bottles of Jin Ruyue's Yin Qi.

Unlike Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang, Guo Xuehua had no problem swallowing another man's Yang Qi, and Yun Shang had no objections to it as long as she didn't drink it from the source directly. Therefore, Zhang Fei [5] gave his mother-in-law a few bottles of Yang Qi from a male cultivator with cultivation in the Seven Divine Realms, but it was not as strong as Jin Ruyue's Yin Qi, especially since its owner was much weaker than her.

Yun Shang and Guo Xuehua decided to carry out seclusion in turn, and Empress Guo did it first, mainly because Emperor Yun wanted to monitor the situation in the Zhou Kingdom, which was already under the complete control of the Yun and Xian Kingdoms.

After that, Zhang Fei [5] went to Earth specifically to retrieve all the Earth items because he had to replenish the supplies for all his shops in the Sky Jade Realms and the Nine Stars Realm, and he also had to replenish the supplies for his two shops on Earth.

At first, Zhang Fei [5] wanted to send Yang Lu'er and the others to the training space, but Huang Rong informed him that she had already started drawing up a plan to open a new branch of their store, and her target was the American market. "I have a building there, ready for use as a store. As for the product licenses, I have already taken care of them along with the licenses for our store in Paris, so I will open it in a month."
"What about the person who will handle the branch store?" Zhang Fei [5] asked.

"Haha." Huang Rong laughed as she showed Zhang Fei [5] a photo. "Huang Ying is my niece, and she has lived in America for two decades. She has a lot of experience in managing stores, so I will hand over our store there to her, and I have asked her to look for employees there."
Zhang Fei [5] briefly glanced at Huang Ying's photo. "All right, you can arrange everything, and I will prepare the stock for our new shop in that country."
"After the opening of our new branch store, we will live with you in the Nine Stars Realm, and we will stay there for a few months to have fun with you."

Zhang Fei [5] immediately pulled Huang Rong to his side. "In fact, you guys don't need to stay on Earth anymore, and all of you can move to the Nine Stars Realm. Even though you all can't become cultivators, the Qi there is still useful for your bodies. You just need to find the most suitable person to take care of our company, and you can control everything once a month. If that person dares to betray your trust, I will kill him or her directly."

"Why do I feel like your brain is filled with nothing but killing now?" Huang Rong asked with a shake of her head. "All right, I will prepare the most suitable person to take care of everything, and we will live in the Nine Stars Realm forever."

"I'm going to Paris now to add more stock to our shop there, and I'll take all the goods in those warehouses before returning to the Nine Stars Realm." After that, Zhang Fei [5] went to that country and spent some time with Yang Lu'er and the others before taking all those items and returning to his current realm.

Once he returned there, Zhang Fei [5] went to his shop in the Bai Kingdom and handed over all the shop and restaurant needs to Han Bingxing and Xuan Cunhua, especially since Liu Hua and Liu Qingyu were still training in the Netherworld Realm with the others.

Zhang Fei [5]'s next destination was the Natural Race Kingdom to hand over those items to Sabina and the others, but he did not meet Xian Linghua and Xue Jingling. He tried to go to the Cyanwood Mountain, but he didn't get too close to it and monitored it from a distance. "Can you detect the location of the lightning elemental seed, Mei?'

[Master, the location of the lightning elemental seed is right in the middle of that mountain peak, and it is protected by the lightning spirit, who once watched you break through to the Earth Realm the first time.]

"The lightning spirit, huh?" Zhang Fei [5] muttered to himself. "If I can get the seed, I might be able to gain the spirit's recognition. If that happens, it will be a double benefit for me. Unfortunately, I haven't found the light and wind spirits, but I will definitely get them in the future. Hey, Mei! Why doesn't the system give me any quests in the Red Sun Realm?"

[Master, I've told you many times that the system is beyond my control, and it always runs automatically, so I have no answer for that. Moreover, it's not the first time, right? You didn't get any quests in the Wasteland Realm, but you got a lot of quests in this realm.]
"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in agreement. "Could it be that the system will only give me quests in the realm I choose as my base?"
[That's possible, master. Somehow, I feel like the system is working in line with your wishes, and you have no intention of staying in the Red Sun Realm, right?]

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head slightly. "The Red Sun Realm is not bad, but I am not interested in using it as my base in the upper realms. Rather than that realm, I am more interested in building my base in the Xianjin Realm, the Void Heaven Realm, or the Starry Sky Realm."
[Master, I understand if you want to build your base in the Xianjin Realm or the Void Heaven Realm, but I don't understand why you are considering the Starry Sky Realm as one.]

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed. "The Xianjin Realm is the most advanced realm in the universe, but the Nameless One lives there, so I don't think it's suitable for my base. Meanwhile, Tian Shuixiang and Lin Jingxia inhabit the Void Heaven Realm, and their reputation is too high. Besides, there are too many alchemists there, and I will face a lot of trouble if I sell my pills there. Therefore, I am considering the Starry Sky Realm because that realm is the origin realm of the demon extermination sword, and that realm has been completely destroyed, so not many cultivators will bother me there."
[Won't you consider the Phoenix Realm or the Evergreen Spirit Haven Realm as your base, Master?]

Zhang Fei [5] pondered for a while before answering. "The Phoenix Realm is one of the best choices, and those heavenly foxes wouldn't dare look for me there. As for the Evergreen Spirit Haven Realm, I still don't know whether the natural races there are hostile to humans and demons or not, so I haven't considered that realm, and I will go there first before deciding."
Ma Kuangyu suddenly spoke into Zhang Fei [5]'s mind. 'Kid, I know a realm in the upper realms that is suitable for you and your loved ones, and I'm sure you guys will like living there.'
'Aren't you a cultivator from the realms beyond the upper realms, Old Ma? How do you know about that realm?' Zhang Fei [5] asked in confusion.

'Hey! I actually didn't want to tell you about my home realm yet, but you're different from other cultivators, so I think it's okay if I tell you about it now.' Zhang Fei [5] himself was curious about those realms, and he really wanted to know about them. 'There, all the realms merge into a single, vast realm that rivals the size of these three mortal realms. In total, there were ninety-nine domains, and each domain had their own leader. As for how I know that realm in the upper realms, people from my realm can still descend to these three mortal realms, and I often did that long ago.'

Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding, and he already guessed that Luo Yunxiao came from that realm, so other cultivators from there could also do it. 'What are the names of those two realms, Old Ma?'

'The Sovereign Heaven Realm is located on the border between these three mortal realms and my realm.' Zhang Fei [5] raised his eyebrows slightly. 'I can tell you that realm is the strongest in the upper realms, but it is hidden from the public, so few know about it. By the way, you can forget about going to my realm through the border, especially since you will never be able to do so, even if your cultivation has reached the peak of the Seven Divine Realms.'
'Why is that?'

'A powerful void barrier separates the border, and only cultivators with a deep understanding of the void element can pass through it.' Ma Kuangyu's answer caused Zhang Fei [5] to sigh heavily, especially since he didn't have the void element. 'Furthermore, ten powerful beasts, not ordinary ones but ancient ones, guard the place behind the border.'
'Ten ancient beasts?' Zhang Fei [5] asked with a frown.

Ma Kuangyu told Zhang Fei [5] about the races of all those beasts. 'All of them are mythical rank beasts, and their cultivation has already surpassed the Seven Divine Realms. Even if you are a mythical beast and your cultivation has reached the 5-Moon Divine Ascension Realm, you still won't be able to defeat them.'
'So, what's the name of your realm, Old Ma?'
'We call it the Paradise Realm.'
'The Paradise Realm, huh?' Zhang Fei muttered. 'Since you mentioned there were ninety-nine domains there, I thought it was called 99 heavens.'

'Haha!' Ma Kuangyu laughed at that. 'When you break through to the seven divine realms, you will begin to feel and absorb the divine qi. However, the Qi in the Paradise Realm is completely different, and we call it the Celestial Qi. As for the cultivation levels above the seven divine realms, I will tell you after you break through to that stage.'

As a big fan of cultivation novels and the like, Zhang Fei [5] had long been aware that there were other stages above the Seven Divine Realms. He wanted to know about those stages, but he immediately gave up his intention, especially since his cultivation was still at the ten mortal realms. 'Old Ma, have you ever heard of the name Luo Yunxiao?'

'Oh! I remember you talking about that girl with your family before, and the relationship between the two of you seemed so close.' Zhang Fei [5] nodded slightly in response. 'To tell you the truth, I know Luo Yunxiao and her family, and—'
'Are you serious, Old Ma? Do you really know Luo Yunxiao and her family?'
'Do I need to lie to you, kid? Your soul mark is in my soul, remember? Luo Yunxiao's parents are Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi, right?'
'That's right; Uncle Fengyan and Aunt Xiaoyi are indeed her parents.' Zhang Fei [5] replied with a nod.

Ma Kuangyu continued straight away. 'Luo Fenghan and his family are one of the strongest in the Empyrean Domain, and they are the leaders of the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary. His first daughter is Luo Yunxiao, and he has two sons, Luo Zhenyu and Luo Jiaxuan.'
'Oh?' Zhang Fei [5] was surprised to hear that, especially since he remembered that Luo Yunxiao had no siblings at that time, and she herself was still a child. 'When did you last see them, Old Ma?'

'I last saw them several years before my death.' Zhang Fei [5] stiffened upon hearing that. 'As you guessed, kid. The current Luo Yunxiao is much older than you now, especially since the time difference between these three mortal realms and our realm is too long. If I remember correctly, she should be five hundred years old now, and she will be very old when you have the ability to go to our realm.'
Zhang Fei [5] was completely shocked to hear that. 'Has Luo Yunxiao's cultivation surpassed the Seven Divine Realm now?'

'Hehe.' Ma Kuangyu chuckled. 'Luo Yunxiao is one of the prodigies in the Paradise Realm, and her cultivation has already surpassed the Seven Divine Realm. In fact, Luo Fenghan hid her existence, and only a few people knew about her, but I don't know for sure why he did that.'

Zhang Fei [5] clenched both fists tightly after hearing all that. He had always been confident in his abilities and strengths, but he didn't have the confidence to reach Luo Yunxiao's level. 'Her level is already that high, and her time is much faster than mine. No matter how hard I try, I will never be able to reach her level.'

'Why are you so discouraged? This is not your character, kid.' Zhang Fei [5] responded to Ma Kuangyu with a heavy sigh. chapters.title: Chapter 761: Zhang Lin And Ru Xue's decision
paragraphs: Helian Yueyi was truly relieved to see the black liquid on Huangfu Xiaomei's and Huangfu Xiaoying's bodies slowly disappearing, proving that the liquid in the bottle was indeed the antidote. "Husband, we have finally cured our two daughters."
"Yeah." Huangfu Shou was also relieved to see the condition of the two women, but he then turned to Li Tiannan, who was seriously observing the Star Tower. "What are you thinking about, Senior?"

"Don't you feel suspicious about this tower?" Huangfu Shou nodded to Li Tiannan. "Even though we saw that woman with our eyes, I couldn't sense her presence from a relatively close distance. I'm sure that she is much stronger than me, and she might be stronger than your ancestors. Moreover, we don't know about Huangfu Fanbo's whereabouts, and he should still be trapped in there."
"Do you think that woman trapped him?" Huangfu Shou asked in doubt.

"Isn't that obvious?" Li Tiannan responded with a shake of his head. "Perhaps that woman is not the only resident of the tower, and there may be other people inside. However, I don't understand their reason for separating Huangfu Fanbo from us and trapping him there, but I am sure that they did it on purpose, and they probably did it at someone's request."

Li Tiannan's guess made Huangfu Shou fall into thought, and it reminded him of someone. "Could it be that those people did it at the request of Zhang Fei's father? He is clearly a cultivator from the upper realms, and this tower appeared in this realm out of nowhere. I think he has a special relationship with the people inside, and he asked them to lock him inside."
"Your guess could be right, but it could also be wrong."
"What made my guess wrong, Senior?"

"I may not be a member of your Huangfu Clan, but my Li Clan is not small either." Li Tiannan pointed at the tower. "My clan members often explore the upper realms, so I know for sure that there is no such tower there. Zhang Fei's father may have come from there, but I'm sure he doesn't know the mystery of this tower. Even your ancestors, who have lived much longer than him, didn't know anything about it."

Unfortunately, Li Tiannan still didn't know that Zhang Fei's father had never existed, and both were him himself. Moreover, he forgot the important fact that he had challenged the Star Tower, and the results were far better than other cultivators, which allowed him to meet and establish relationships with people in the tower.
Huangfu Shou nodded in agreement. "Then, what should we do now, Senior? We can't possibly enter the tower again after its expulsion, which makes it impossible for us to search for Senior Fanbo."

"Since your two daughters have recovered, we must take them back now, and I will contact your ancestors to report Huangfu Fanbo's situation. That way, they can send some other people to this realm, and they can challenge this tower to look for him." Li Tiannan immediately took out his flying artifact and led them to board it.

As soon as they left, Mai Xiaomeng appeared in front of the Star Tower barrier; she had been following and waiting for them there since two weeks ago. She actually wanted to challenge the tower, but Zhang Fei told her that she could not challenge it alone and asked her to wait for all his women to be ready. "Where did this tower actually come from? If what those people said earlier was true, this tower definitely didn't come from the upper realms. Moreover, I've never seen the black liquid that caused the two little girls pain, yet the people in this tower have an antidote. That kid definitely knows something about this tower, so I'll return to the members of my race now, and I'll wait for him to take me to challenge it."
Although Li Tiannan's flying artifact was not as fast as Huangfu Fanbo's, it was still too swift for the Nine Stars Realm, and they could arrive at the Huangfu Kingdom in just a few minutes.

Li Tiannan went with Huangfu Shou and the other two to the meeting room, as he contacted the ancestors of the Huangfu clan. Helian Yueyi, assisted by the fake Ruo Yanxi, took Huangfu Xiaomei and Huangfu Xiaoying to their room.

Arriving at their room, Helian Yueyi tried to wake up her two daughters, but they didn't give any reaction, especially since Zhang Fei was still imprisoning their subconscious in dreams. "Why are they still not awake?"

"Sister Yueyi, they have been asleep for three months, and the previous black liquid must have affected their health. Thus, you don't need to rush to wake them up, and I'm sure that they'll wake up soon." The fake Ruo Yanxi spoke to Helian Yueyi.
Helian Yueyi let out a soft sigh and nodded to her. "We've been trapped in the Star Tower for two weeks, and the situation there is frustrating me, so I want to take a break now."
"Hehe." The fake Ruo Yanxi giggled and hugged Helian Yueyi's arm. "How about we have some fun now?"

Helian Yueyi turned to the fake Ruo Yanxi with a smile and kissed her directly. "Let's go to my room. We'll have fun while waiting for our husband to finish discussing with Senior Tiannan, and I'll ask our other sisters to come back, especially since that lecherous old man is still trapped in the tower."

Li Tiannan had just finished discussing with the ancestors of the Huangfu Clan using an interspatial communication device, and he immediately informed Huangfu Shou of their decision. "One of your ancestors decided to go to this realm, and he will bring some powerful cultivators from your clan to challenge the Star Tower."
"Eh?" Huangfu Shou was momentarily surprised by that, but he immediately turned to joy. "Do you think they will also capture Zhang Fei and his father?"

"No." Li Tiannan immediately denied that. "They don't want to deal with the cultivators from the Red Sun Realm, so they won't do anything to Zhang Fei or his father, and they will only focus on looking for Huangfu Fanbo in the tower."
Huangfu Shou sighed in disappointment, especially since Zhang Fei and 'his father' were thorns in his plans to become the sole ruler of the human island.
Li Tiannan ignored her reaction and stood up. "I will go to the Bai Royal Palace to meet Wushuang, as well as check on the conditions of Bai Yaowei and Linghu Yincheng."
After Li Tiannan left, Huangfu Shou asked Huangfu Ziyuan and Ling Baozi. "Should we attack Zhou Xiaochuan?"
"I don't recommend that, Brother." Huangfu Ziyuan replied with a shake of his head.

Then, Ling Baozi spoke. "Emperor, we will only cause more trouble for ourselves if we attack Zhou Xiaochuan now, especially since Zhang Fei's father is targeting him. Your ancestors don't even dare to deal with the people behind him, so we'll just be courting death by fighting him."

Huangfu Shou clenched his fists in fury, especially since the appearance of Zhang Fei and 'his father' had a major impact on the human island. "Since we are unable to attack the Yun, Xian, and Zhou Kingdoms, I will begin implementing my alternative plan to integrate the Bai Kingdom into my own kingdom. If those two bastards also target that kingdom, it will only put us in a tight spot, and they will target our kingdom after they take control of the other four."

'Too late! Zhang Fei already controls this kingdom and the Bai Kingdom; he's just waiting for the right time to take over.' Huangfu Ziyuan and Ling Baozi immediately left the meeting room after Huangfu Shou gave them some orders, but they obviously would not carry out his orders, and they reported his orders to their master instead.

After that, Huangfu Shou went to the throne room and gathered all his ministers and confidants, but he did not realize that some of them had already changed sides, especially after Huangu Lian persuaded and convinced them to side with him.

Li Tiannan had arrived at the Bai Royal Palace, but he was furious because he couldn't find Linghu Yincheng there. He vented his anger toward Wushuang by beating her several times, causing her to bleed. "You bitch! I put you here to monitor the two of them, but that damn woman disappeared under your supervision!"

Wushuang didn't say anything to refute Li Tiannan, or rather, she couldn't say anything to him, especially since she was Zhang Fei's slave. 'You can beat me up all you want, but your fate is already decided, and you will die once my master takes action against you.'

Li Tiannan immediately spread his senses to search for Linghu Yincheng throughout the Bai Kingdom, including the two residences of the Bai Clan under Bai Zizhen and Bai Shushi. He also searched for her in the Linghu clan's hideout, but he couldn't find her anywhere, which made him even more furious. 'Could it be that Zhang Fei's father has done something to this kingdom? I don't believe that woman can hide from me, and I'm sure that someone has hidden her. Moreover, her three children have been missing since they returned from the Star Tower, and the only person who can protect them is him. Sigh! I will discuss this matter with ancestor Huangfu Shong after he arrives in this realm, and I will ask him to send other people to protect Huangfu Shou and his family.'

After that, Li Tiannan went to the underground of the Bai Royal Palace, followed by Wushuang, who kept staring at him from behind with hatred. He stood in front of the sealed door and touched the barrier. 'Even though this barrier is an ancient barrier, it is too old and has been weakened, so I can easily break it with my artifact. However, the beast behind this door is the Ancient Devourer Demon Beast, and it should be powerful. If I release it, it will immediately destroy this realm, and I may not be able to control it.'
"Are you going to release the beast, Master Tiannan?" Wushuang asked worriedly.

"Are you afraid that the beast will kill you?" Wushuang answered Li Tiannan with repeated nods. "I did think about releasing the beast, but I won't do it now, and I will only do it if the situation is truly unfavorable to us."
'This guy is crazy! If he frees the beast, this realm will collapse!' Wushuang screamed in her heart.
Li Tiannan suddenly turned around and walked away. "If Bai Yaowei disappears under your watch, I will kill you directly. Do you understand?"
"Yes, Master."
Zhang Fei had brought all his women back to the training space, and he explained to them about his latest plan of going to the Nine Hells Darkland using his fifth clone.
"Why did you suddenly send your fifth clone to that realm, Fei'er?" Qing Yi asked her son.
Zhang Fei recounted his previous conversation with Ma Kuangyu about Luo Yunxiao and the Paradise Realm to them, which shocked all of them.
Qing Yi, Zhang Lin, and Zhang Yue, who knew Luo Yunxiao, were shocked after they heard about her current age. "Is she really that old, Big Brother?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded to Zhang Lin. "Old Ma is a cultivator from the Paradise Realm, so he knows for sure about the difference in time flow between his realm and our realm. Honestly, I have too many questions about the reason for Luo Yunxiao's departure and the reason her parents sealed my memories of her, but I can only get answers to all my questions by meeting her. Unfortunately, her level is far out of my reach, especially with her cultivation already surpassing the Seven Divine Realms. Therefore, I decided not to bother with other useless matters, and I will fully focus on myself from now on. Otherwise, I will never be able to reach her level, especially since her cultivation will leave me further behind with such a vast difference in time flow."

Zhang Fei's words made Liu Qingyu and the others realize that Luo Yunxiao's existence was weighing heavily on his heart, but unfortunately, he had never shared the burden in his heart with them, so they realized it too late.

"Fei." Zhang Fei looked up at Zhou Shenxin directly. "Since you have arranged many things for my father and our kingdom, and you still can't absorb my Yin Qi, I decided to go back there and take care of the rest. I'm sure I can take care of everything with the help of my mother and the others, so you don't need to think about things there, and you can focus on your cultivation."
"Are you sure about that?"

"Yes." Zhou Shenxin nodded in response. "Didn't you say that the entire area of my kingdom is already under the control of the Xian and Yun Kingdoms forces? Moreover, my father and master are your slaves, and you have also enslaved several others, so they shouldn't dare to go against me."
Zhang Fei nodded at her. "In that case, I will send you and Aunt Tingxi back to the Zhou Kingdom, and you two can take care of everything with their help."
Zhou Shenxin immediately called his mother to meet them, and Zhang Fei sent them back to their kingdom after explaining some things to Jiang Tingxi.
"Husband, did Old Ma tell you about the cultivation stages after the Seven Divine Realms?" Shang Yumei suddenly asked.

"Not yet." Zhang Fei answered with a shake of his head. "Our cultivation is still too far from the Divine Ascension Realm, so it is useless for us to know those cultivation stages, and we only need to focus on the path ahead. However, Old Ma told me that the Qi is different from the divine Qi in the Seven Divine Realms, and he calls it the celestial Qi."
