sentences.text: Helian Yueyi was truly relieved to see the black liquid on Huangfu Xiaomei's and Huangfu Xiaoying's bodies slowly disappearing, proving that the liquid in the bottle was indeed the antidote.
"Husband, we have finally cured our two daughters."
"Yeah." Huangfu Shou was also relieved to see the condition of the two women, but he then turned to Li Tiannan, who was seriously observing the Star Tower.
"What are you thinking about, Senior?"
"Don't you feel suspicious about this tower?" Huangfu Shou nodded to Li Tiannan.
"Even though we saw that woman with our eyes, I couldn't sense her presence from a relatively close distance.
I'm sure that she is much stronger than me, and she might be stronger than your ancestors.
Moreover, we don't know about Huangfu Fanbo's whereabouts, and he should still be trapped in there."
"Do you think that woman trapped him?" Huangfu Shou asked in doubt.
"Isn't that obvious?" Li Tiannan responded with a shake of his head.
"Perhaps that woman is not the only resident of the tower, and there may be other people inside.
However, I don't understand their reason for separating Huangfu Fanbo from us and trapping him there, but I am sure that they did it on purpose, and they probably did it at someone's request."
Li Tiannan's guess made Huangfu Shou fall into thought, and it reminded him of someone.
"Could it be that those people did it at the request of Zhang Fei's father?
He is clearly a cultivator from the upper realms, and this tower appeared in this realm out of nowhere.
I think he has a special relationship with the people inside, and he asked them to lock him inside."
"Your guess could be right, but it could also be wrong."
"What made my guess wrong, Senior?"
"I may not be a member of your Huangfu Clan, but my Li Clan is not small either." Li Tiannan pointed at the tower.
"My clan members often explore the upper realms, so I know for sure that there is no such tower there.
Zhang Fei's father may have come from there, but I'm sure he doesn't know the mystery of this tower.
Even your ancestors, who have lived much longer than him, didn't know anything about it."
Unfortunately, Li Tiannan still didn't know that Zhang Fei's father had never existed, and both were him himself.

Moreover, he forgot the important fact that he had challenged the Star Tower, and the results were far better than other cultivators, which allowed him to meet and establish relationships with people in the tower.
Huangfu Shou nodded in agreement.
"Then, what should we do now, Senior?
We can't possibly enter the tower again after its expulsion, which makes it impossible for us to search for Senior Fanbo."
"Since your two daughters have recovered, we must take them back now, and I will contact your ancestors to report Huangfu Fanbo's situation.
That way, they can send some other people to this realm, and they can challenge this tower to look for him." Li Tiannan immediately took out his flying artifact and led them to board it.
As soon as they left, Mai Xiaomeng appeared in front of the Star Tower barrier; she had been following and waiting for them there since two weeks ago.
She actually wanted to challenge the tower, but Zhang Fei told her that she could not challenge it alone and asked her to wait for all his women to be ready.
"Where did this tower actually come from?
If what those people said earlier was true, this tower definitely didn't come from the upper realms.
Moreover, I've never seen the black liquid that caused the two little girls pain, yet the people in this tower have an antidote.
That kid definitely knows something about this tower, so I'll return to the members of my race now, and I'll wait for him to take me to challenge it."
Although Li Tiannan's flying artifact was not as fast as Huangfu Fanbo's, it was still too swift for the Nine Stars Realm, and they could arrive at the Huangfu Kingdom in just a few minutes.
Li Tiannan went with Huangfu Shou and the other two to the meeting room, as he contacted the ancestors of the Huangfu clan.
Helian Yueyi, assisted by the fake Ruo Yanxi, took Huangfu Xiaomei and Huangfu Xiaoying to their room.
Arriving at their room, Helian Yueyi tried to wake up her two daughters, but they didn't give any reaction, especially since Zhang Fei was still imprisoning their subconscious in dreams.
"Why are they still not awake?"
"Sister Yueyi, they have been asleep for three months, and the previous black liquid must have affected their health.
Thus, you don't need to rush to wake them up, and I'm sure that they'll wake up soon." The fake Ruo Yanxi spoke to Helian Yueyi.
Helian Yueyi let out a soft sigh and nodded to her.
"We've been trapped in the Star Tower for two weeks, and the situation there is frustrating me, so I want to take a break now."
"Hehe." The fake Ruo Yanxi giggled and hugged Helian Yueyi's arm.
"How about we have some fun now?"
Helian Yueyi turned to the fake Ruo Yanxi with a smile and kissed her directly.
"Let's go to my room.

We'll have fun while waiting for our husband to finish discussing with Senior Tiannan, and I'll ask our other sisters to come back, especially since that lecherous old man is still trapped in the tower."
Li Tiannan had just finished discussing with the ancestors of the Huangfu Clan using an interspatial communication device, and he immediately informed Huangfu Shou of their decision.
"One of your ancestors decided to go to this realm, and he will bring some powerful cultivators from your clan to challenge the Star Tower."
"Eh?" Huangfu Shou was momentarily surprised by that, but he immediately turned to joy.
"Do you think they will also capture Zhang Fei and his father?"
"No." Li Tiannan immediately denied that.
"They don't want to deal with the cultivators from the Red Sun Realm, so they won't do anything to Zhang Fei or his father, and they will only focus on looking for Huangfu Fanbo in the tower."
Huangfu Shou sighed in disappointment, especially since Zhang Fei and 'his father' were thorns in his plans to become the sole ruler of the human island.
Li Tiannan ignored her reaction and stood up.
"I will go to the Bai Royal Palace to meet Wushuang, as well as check on the conditions of Bai Yaowei and Linghu Yincheng."
After Li Tiannan left, Huangfu Shou asked Huangfu Ziyuan and Ling Baozi.
"Should we attack Zhou Xiaochuan?"
"I don't recommend that, Brother." Huangfu Ziyuan replied with a shake of his head.
Then, Ling Baozi spoke.
"Emperor, we will only cause more trouble for ourselves if we attack Zhou Xiaochuan now, especially since Zhang Fei's father is targeting him.
Your ancestors don't even dare to deal with the people behind him, so we'll just be courting death by fighting him."
Huangfu Shou clenched his fists in fury, especially since the appearance of Zhang Fei and 'his father' had a major impact on the human island.
"Since we are unable to attack the Yun, Xian, and Zhou Kingdoms, I will begin implementing my alternative plan to integrate the Bai Kingdom into my own kingdom.
If those two bastards also target that kingdom, it will only put us in a tight spot, and they will target our kingdom after they take control of the other four."
'Too late!

Zhang Fei already controls this kingdom and the Bai Kingdom; he's just waiting for the right time to take over.' Huangfu Ziyuan and Ling Baozi immediately left the meeting room after Huangfu Shou gave them some orders, but they obviously would not carry out his orders, and they reported his orders to their master instead.

After that, Huangfu Shou went to the throne room and gathered all his ministers and confidants, but he did not realize that some of them had already changed sides, especially after Huangu Lian persuaded and convinced them to side with him.
Li Tiannan had arrived at the Bai Royal Palace, but he was furious because he couldn't find Linghu Yincheng there.
He vented his anger toward Wushuang by beating her several times, causing her to bleed.
"You bitch!
I put you here to monitor the two of them, but that damn woman disappeared under your supervision!"

Wushuang didn't say anything to refute Li Tiannan, or rather, she couldn't say anything to him, especially since she was Zhang Fei's slave. 'You can beat me up all you want, but your fate is already decided, and you will die once my master takes action against you.'
Li Tiannan immediately spread his senses to search for Linghu Yincheng throughout the Bai Kingdom, including the two residences of the Bai Clan under Bai Zizhen and Bai Shushi.
He also searched for her in the Linghu clan's hideout, but he couldn't find her anywhere, which made him even more furious. 'Could it be that Zhang Fei's father has done something to this kingdom?
I don't believe that woman can hide from me, and I'm sure that someone has hidden her.
Moreover, her three children have been missing since they returned from the Star Tower, and the only person who can protect them is him.
Sigh!
I will discuss this matter with ancestor Huangfu Shong after he arrives in this realm, and I will ask him to send other people to protect Huangfu Shou and his family.'
After that, Li Tiannan went to the underground of the Bai Royal Palace, followed by Wushuang, who kept staring at him from behind with hatred.
He stood in front of the sealed door and touched the barrier. 'Even though this barrier is an ancient barrier, it is too old and has been weakened, so I can easily break it with my artifact.
However, the beast behind this door is the Ancient Devourer Demon Beast, and it should be powerful.
If I release it, it will immediately destroy this realm, and I may not be able to control it.'
"Are you going to release the beast, Master Tiannan?" Wushuang asked worriedly.
"Are you afraid that the beast will kill you?" Wushuang answered Li Tiannan with repeated nods.
"I did think about releasing the beast, but I won't do it now, and I will only do it if the situation is truly unfavorable to us."
'This guy is crazy!
If he frees the beast, this realm will collapse!' Wushuang screamed in her heart.
Li Tiannan suddenly turned around and walked away.
"If Bai Yaowei disappears under your watch, I will kill you directly.
Do you understand?"
"Yes, Master."
Zhang Fei had brought all his women back to the training space, and he explained to them about his latest plan of going to the Nine Hells Darkland using his fifth clone.
"Why did you suddenly send your fifth clone to that realm, Fei'er?" Qing Yi asked her son.
Zhang Fei recounted his previous conversation with Ma Kuangyu about Luo Yunxiao and the Paradise Realm to them, which shocked all of them.
Qing Yi, Zhang Lin, and Zhang Yue, who knew Luo Yunxiao, were shocked after they heard about her current age.
"Is she really that old, Big Brother?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded to Zhang Lin.
"Old Ma is a cultivator from the Paradise Realm, so he knows for sure about the difference in time flow between his realm and our realm.
Honestly, I have too many questions about the reason for Luo Yunxiao's departure and the reason her parents sealed my memories of her, but I can only get answers to all my questions by meeting her.
Unfortunately, her level is far out of my reach, especially with her cultivation already surpassing the Seven Divine Realms.
Therefore, I decided not to bother with other useless matters, and I will fully focus on myself from now on.
Otherwise, I will never be able to reach her level, especially since her cultivation will leave me further behind with such a vast difference in time flow."

Zhang Fei's words made Liu Qingyu and the others realize that Luo Yunxiao's existence was weighing heavily on his heart, but unfortunately, he had never shared the burden in his heart with them, so they realized it too late.
"Fei." Zhang Fei looked up at Zhou Shenxin directly.

paragraphs: Zhang Fei looked at Zhang Lin and Ru Xue seriously. "Why do you two want to become demons so badly?"

"Fei'er, you have 21 official wives now, okay?" Zhang Fei smiled wryly upon hearing that from Ru Xue. "There are still Ling'er, Angela, Guo Lan, Lin Dong'er, Mu Lingshu, the Wen Twins, Shang Yumei, Hong Xinxin, and several other women who will become official ones in the future. The first time we accepted you, we were ready to share you with so many women, but we still hope that you can hold yourself back from adding more women."

Zhang Fei glanced at Liu Hua and the others, but all of them nodded their heads as a sign of agreement with Ru Xue's words, causing him to sigh in his heart. He himself realized that the number of women by his side was too many, especially his official women.

Unlike them, Mei actually continues to force Zhang Fei to increase the number of women by his side, both his official and unofficial women. [Don't listen to them, master. You will never reach Luo Yunxiao's level with just a small number of women, and you will need to add more.]
'Small your ass, Mei!' Zhang Fei cursed the AI. 'I have 21 official wives, and my clones' partners are 25. Not to mention, I still have some other women who have an unclear relationship with me.'
[Their number is too small for a lust demon like you, and a thousand women are most suitable for you.]

'For God's sake! Do you think I can share my time with a thousand women? If you had a real body, I would fuck you right here, right now!' The female AI snorted in response, and Zhang Fei asked the others. "Do any of you also want to become demons?"

"Me." Zhang Fei turned to Zhang Yue. "I want to become a demon, but I don't want to become one anytime soon, and I want to do that after I go through the Ice Phoenix Trials. If I become a demon now, the ice phoenix will probably kill me straight away."

Zhang Fei concurred, then turned his attention to his other wives, each of whom began to share their perspectives, particularly on the pros and cons of becoming demons. "Honestly, you guys don't need to think about those people, especially since they can't do anything to you with your current speed. However, I respect your wishes, so you don't need to force yourselves to become demons. Even if none of you want to become demons, I don't have a problem with that."

Liu Qingyu and the others were relieved to hear that, and that was also one of the reasons they were willing to accept Zhang Fei, especially since he never forced them to do anything they didn't like.
Liu Hua then spoke. "Since Lin'er and Xue want to become demons, you can't look for low-grade demons for them, and you have to look for demons with high-level bloodlines."

"Unfortunately, I don't know much about the demons in this universe, so I still can't decide which demon bloodlines are best for them." Zhang Fei then turned to Lillea and Janette. "Do you two have any ideas about that?"
"The Diyu Realm is just a lower demon realm, so I don't think there is any good demon bloodline there." Janette answered him.

"What do you think about Oz the First and Morgana?" Lillea asked him instead. "I think the Celestial Demon and the witch demon should be high-level bloodlines, and there's still Zygoz the sorceress demon. As for Tharnon, you don't need to consider him, or one of them will be a freak like him."
"I don't want to be a pig demon!" Zhang Lin exclaimed as she remembered Tharnon's demon form.
Ru Xue nodded in agreement. "I don't want to be like Tharnon either."

"Haha!" Zhang Fei hugged Zhang Lin and Ru Xue. "Naturally, I don't want my pretty wives to be pigs like Tharnon, so you two don't have to think about that. Since Oz the First and Morgana are in the Netherworld Realm, I will take you two there to meet them now."
Sometime later, the three of them were standing in front of Oz the First and Morgana, and Zhang Fei immediately explained to them about Ru Xue and Zhang Lin's desire to become demons.
Morgana immediately rejected Zhang Fei. "I can't give my demon witch bloodline to them because my bloodline is cursed, and they will inherit my curse."
"A curse?"

Morgana nodded and explained to them about the curse on her bloodline, which could never be removed except by death. "My husband's celestial demon bloodline is one of the best among hundreds or thousands, so I thought it was okay if you wanted one of them to have it."
"I will give my demon bloodline to one of them." Oz the First then asked. "Which of them do you want to receive my bloodline?"
Zhang Fei felt confused about deciding, especially since Zhang Lin and Ru Xue both had dragon bloodlines, and their strengths were also equal.
Morgana suddenly told Zhang Fei, "I think I know the perfect demon for your little sister, especially since she has the water element, and that demon bloodline would suit her."
"What kind of demon are you referring to, Big Sis?" Zhang Lin curiously asked.
"The Abyssal Leviathan Demon Beast." Morgana's answer surprised Zhang Fei and Zhang Lin. "You have a demon from the Blue Water Realm on your side, right?"
"Balena does come from the Blue Water Realm." Zhang Fei replied with a nod.
Morgana gave a light nod. "In that case, you can go to that realm to look for the Abyssal Leviathan Demon, and it is hiding in the sunken kingdom."

"Oh?" Zhang Fei was surprised again. "Balena told me about the Sunken Kingdom, and the kingdom was the origin of her realm. The kingdom was destroyed for no apparent reason, and no one could enter that place again after its destruction, but she never mentioned the Abyssal Leviathan Demon hiding there."

"The Abyssal Leviathan Demon is one of the ancient demons in the upper realms, and it is extremely powerful, especially with its control over water. If you turn your little sister into that demon, she will be invincible in the water." Morgana's words made Zhang Lin excited and impatient to become that demon. "As for that kingdom, the person who destroyed it was Xereth."

"Xereth?" Zhang Fei frowned because that demon was also the one who destroyed the Starry Sky Realm, the realm where the demon extermination sword came from. "What was his purpose in destroying the kingdom?"

"No one knows the real purpose of Xereth to destroy many realms." Morgana then informed Zhang Fei about something else. "Speaking of him, I got information from other demons that someone saw him in the upper realms some time ago, but he disappeared again."
"Did he destroy other realms?"

Morgana shook her head. "I'm uncertain if the demon represented Xereth, particularly considering that no realms had suffered destruction. If it were him, the other realms would have been destroyed, especially considering his past track record."

"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding before speaking to Oz the First. "Please give me your demon origin bloodline and some of your body parts, such as hair and nails, and I will use them to transform Ru Xue into a celestial demon like you."

Oz the First immediately gave several items as Zhang Fei requested, including several drops of his demon-origin bloodline. "My celestial demon bloodline is not an ordinary demon bloodline, and your wife may need to adapt for quite a while after she becomes one."
"All right, I will help her with that."
Once they returned to the Cloud Mansion, Zhang Fei immediately took out the science capsule, and Ru Xue lay inside it directly to begin the process of transforming into a demon.

Once everything was ready, Zhang Fei inserted Oz the First's celestial demon bloodline and some of his body parts into the holes in the capsule, and Mei immediately carried out the process to turn Ru Xue into a demon.
Zhang Lin and the other women surrounded the capsule and waited impatiently for the process to end, especially since they were too curious about Ru Xue's demon form.

Three hours later, based on the time in the training space, the process was complete. Zhang Fei immediately opened the capsule cover and helped Ru Xue out, but her new appearance left Liu Hua and the others stunned because it was beyond their expectations.

Overall, Ru Xue's appearance is no different from before, but her long black hair has turned white. Her black eyes turned red like Oz the First's eyes, and two different powerful auras radiated from her body. Two black dragon horns appeared above her head, two dragon wings on his back, and a dragon tail behind his hips.
Liu Qingyu and the others could feel calm from Ru Xue because of her light element, but they could also feel the horror from her demon aura.
"What happened to Big Sis Xue, Big Brother? Why does she look like this?" Zhang Lin asked in confusion.
Zhang Yu spoke. "Somehow, I feel like she's not a celestial demon, but she's a demon dragon."
Zhang Fei himself was confused by Ru Xue's changes. 'Mei, show her status.'
[Wait a minute.]
Name: Ru Xue
Age: 36
Gender: Female
Race: Celestial Dragon Demon
Demon Rank: Lesser
Cultivation: 1-Star Earth Realm
Core: Intermediate Light Core
Elements: Light + Dark
Bloodline: Light Dragon + Celestial Demon
Physique: Celestial Dragon Demon Physique
'Eh? Why did her race become the Celestial Dragon Demon?'

[I myself don't know how Ru Xue became like this, Master. I suspect that the light dragon bloodline she got from Long Baiyun fused with the celestial demon bloodline, which turned her into the Celestial Dragon Demon.]
'Does this mean Ru Xue has become a true dragon?'

[Master, Ru Xue does have dragon characteristics, but I don't think she's a true dragon like Long Baiyun. After all, you didn't use dragon beast cores or other dragon body parts to transform her, and she's more like a humanoid dragon, just like when you use your half-fox form.]
Zhang Fei then provided an explanation to Ru Xue and the others based on Mei's guess, as he had no alternative explanation. "How do you feel now?"

"I don't feel any significant difference other than my demon aura." Ru Xue then used the transformation technique to return to her human form. "Since this is my first time becoming a demon, I still feel a little strange about my horns, wings, and tail."

"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled at that. "It's okay; I also felt like that when I first became a heavenly fox and a lust demon, and you just need to get used to your changes. Do you feel bloodthirsty now?"

"Yes." Ru Xue replied with a nod. "My transformation into a demon made me bloodthirsty, and I'm so eager to kill now. You have to help me control it, or I will become a bloodthirsty demon, which will be troublesome for us."

"You don't need to worry about that, and I will definitely help you control it." Zhang Fei then said to the others. "Since Ru Xue has just become a demon, and her demon rank is still at the lesser rank, I will start dual cultivating with her to increase her demon rank first."

Naturally, Zhang Lin and the others had no objections to that, and they waited on the sofa while discussing their next training plans in the Netherworld Realm, especially since their killing intents were still pale in comparison to Zhang Fei's killing intent.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei immediately took Ru Xue to bed, where they started to dual cultivate, and they didn't forget to cultivate their souls at the same time.

A month passed quickly in the cultivation world, and many events occurred in several realms, especially in the Red Sun Realm. As Zhang Fei expected, Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan suffered greatly in the past month, especially since several of their internal organs failed due to the effects of his poison, which made the situation in the Shang Clan completely chaotic.
Shang Ziyuan, who had previously gone to search for Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin, decided to return to the Red Sun Realm to control the situation in the Shang Clan.

The two ancestors of the Shang Clan, Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun, decided to come out of their seclusion. After all, the conditions of Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan caused their clan's strength to decline significantly, and Xi Hongyan was targeting them, so they had to protect their clan. They called many doctors to treat their two juniors, but they still couldn't cure them.

News of Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan's condition quickly spread throughout the Red Sun Realm, and Xi Hongyan intended to attack them, but the appearance of Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun forced her to abandon her plans.

However, Xi Hongyan was fortunate that Xi Qiuwei managed to capture Shang Shang Xishun and lock her up in their Xi clan. Unfortunately, she couldn't do anything to her yet, especially since Lin Moxian hadn't arrived in their realm yet.

On the other hand, Zhang Xiaolong [3] repeatedly met Murong Qianying at the Murong clan, and they often spent time together there, especially since Ba Shuxiang and Xie Jingxian's physical strength was not yet strong enough to dual cultivate with him nonstop. Naturally, he didn't forget to visit Hong Xinxin, Shang Xinyu, and Shang Yifen to dual soul cultivate with them.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] also repeatedly met Jin Ruyue to ask for her Yin Qi so he could help Xian Feng and Yun Shang. He also went to the Netherworld Realm several times to check on Shang Chongyun and the other three, who had decided to settle down not far from Lust City. Since Shang Huaqiang's condition was bad, he had never contacted the four in the past month.

Additionally, Zhang Xiaolong [3] managed to convince Ren Dongcheng to join the Hong Clan, especially after his actions pitted him against Fei Qinyuan, which made their group even bigger than Xi Hongyan's group. However, that was not the main reason the old man was willing to join them, and the main cause was the Huo Clan's rejection, especially since Huo Jiguang was too familiar with his character.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] stood at the front end of the Pandora Odyssey, and his eyes kept looking at the black planet in front of him. After a month of traveling, he finally arrived at his destination, which was none other than the Nine Hells Darkland.
Zhang Fei [5] could see that the Nine Hells Darkland was not very large when compared to the Wasteland Realm or the Nine Stars Realm, but the atmosphere in the realm was extremely gloomy.

Although he had not entered the realm, Zhang Fei [5] could already feel the horror coming from within it, and he could see the souls of countless living beings wandering within it. sentences.text: Zhang Fei looked at Zhang Lin and Ru Xue seriously.
"Why do you two want to become demons so badly?"
"Fei'er, you have 21 official wives now, okay?" Zhang Fei smiled wryly upon hearing that from Ru Xue.
"There are still Ling'er, Angela, Guo Lan, Lin Dong'er, Mu Lingshu, the Wen Twins, Shang Yumei, Hong Xinxin, and several other women who will become official ones in the future.
The first time we accepted you, we were ready to share you with so many women, but we still hope that you can hold yourself back from adding more women."
Zhang Fei glanced at Liu Hua and the others, but all of them nodded their heads as a sign of agreement with Ru Xue's words, causing him to sigh in his heart.
He himself realized that the number of women by his side was too many, especially his official women.
Unlike them, Mei actually continues to force Zhang Fei to increase the number of women by his side, both his official and unofficial women.
[Don't listen to them, master.
You will never reach Luo Yunxiao's level with just a small number of women, and you will need to add more.]
'Small your ass, Mei!' Zhang Fei cursed the AI. 'I have 21 official wives, and my clones' partners are 25.
Not to mention, I still have some other women who have an unclear relationship with me.'
[Their number is too small for a lust demon like you, and a thousand women are most suitable for you.]
'For God's sake!
Do you think I can share my time with a thousand women?
If you had a real body, I would fuck you right here, right now!' The female AI snorted in response, and Zhang Fei asked the others.
"Do any of you also want to become demons?"
"Me." Zhang Fei turned to Zhang Yue.
"I want to become a demon, but I don't want to become one anytime soon, and I want to do that after I go through the Ice Phoenix Trials.
If I become a demon now, the ice phoenix will probably kill me straight away."
Zhang Fei concurred, then turned his attention to his other wives, each of whom began to share their perspectives, particularly on the pros and cons of becoming demons.
"Honestly, you guys don't need to think about those people, especially since they can't do anything to you with your current speed.
However, I respect your wishes, so you don't need to force yourselves to become demons.
Even if none of you want to become demons, I don't have a problem with that."

Liu Qingyu and the others were relieved to hear that, and that was also one of the reasons they were willing to accept Zhang Fei, especially since he never forced them to do anything they didn't like.
Liu Hua then spoke.
"Since Lin'er and Xue want to become demons, you can't look for low-grade demons for them, and you have to look for demons with high-level bloodlines."
"Unfortunately, I don't know much about the demons in this universe, so I still can't decide which demon bloodlines are best for them." Zhang Fei then turned to Lillea and Janette.
"Do you two have any ideas about that?"
"The Diyu Realm is just a lower demon realm, so I don't think there is any good demon bloodline there." Janette answered him.
"What do you think about Oz the First and Morgana?" Lillea asked him instead.
"I think the Celestial Demon and the witch demon should be high-level bloodlines, and there's still Zygoz the sorceress demon.
As for Tharnon, you don't need to consider him, or one of them will be a freak like him."
"I don't want to be a pig demon!" Zhang Lin exclaimed as she remembered Tharnon's demon form.
Ru Xue nodded in agreement.
"I don't want to be like Tharnon either."
"Haha!" Zhang Fei hugged Zhang Lin and Ru Xue.
"Naturally, I don't want my pretty wives to be pigs like Tharnon, so you two don't have to think about that.
Since Oz the First and Morgana are in the Netherworld Realm, I will take you two there to meet them now."
Sometime later, the three of them were standing in front of Oz the First and Morgana, and Zhang Fei immediately explained to them about Ru Xue and Zhang Lin's desire to become demons.
Morgana immediately rejected Zhang Fei.
"I can't give my demon witch bloodline to them because my bloodline is cursed, and they will inherit my curse."
"A curse?"
Morgana nodded and explained to them about the curse on her bloodline, which could never be removed except by death.
"My husband's celestial demon bloodline is one of the best among hundreds or thousands, so I thought it was okay if you wanted one of them to have it."
"I will give my demon bloodline to one of them." Oz the First then asked.
"Which of them do you want to receive my bloodline?"
Zhang Fei felt confused about deciding, especially since Zhang Lin and Ru Xue both had dragon bloodlines, and their strengths were also equal.
Morgana suddenly told Zhang Fei, "I think I know the perfect demon for your little sister, especially since she has the water element, and that demon bloodline would suit her."
"What kind of demon are you referring to, Big Sis?" Zhang Lin curiously asked.
"The Abyssal Leviathan Demon Beast." Morgana's answer surprised Zhang Fei and Zhang Lin.
"You have a demon from the Blue Water Realm on your side, right?"
"Balena does come from the Blue Water Realm." Zhang Fei replied with a nod.
Morgana gave a light nod.
"In that case, you can go to that realm to look for the Abyssal Leviathan Demon, and it is hiding in the sunken kingdom."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei was surprised again.
"Balena told me about the Sunken Kingdom, and the kingdom was the origin of her realm.
The kingdom was destroyed for no apparent reason, and no one could enter that place again after its destruction, but she never mentioned the Abyssal Leviathan Demon hiding there."
"The Abyssal Leviathan Demon is one of the ancient demons in the upper realms, and it is extremely powerful, especially with its control over water.
If you turn your little sister into that demon, she will be invincible in the water." Morgana's words made Zhang Lin excited and impatient to become that demon.
"As for that kingdom, the person who destroyed it was Xereth."
"Xereth?" Zhang Fei frowned because that demon was also the one who destroyed the Starry Sky Realm, the realm where the demon extermination sword came from.
"What was his purpose in destroying the kingdom?"
"No one knows the real purpose of Xereth to destroy many realms." Morgana then informed Zhang Fei about something else.
"Speaking of him, I got information from other demons that someone saw him in the upper realms some time ago, but he disappeared again."
"Did he destroy other realms?"
Morgana shook her head.
"I'm uncertain if the demon represented Xereth, particularly considering that no realms had suffered destruction.
If it were him, the other realms would have been destroyed, especially considering his past track record."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding before speaking to Oz the First.
"Please give me your demon origin bloodline and some of your body parts, such as hair and nails, and I will use them to transform Ru Xue into a celestial demon like you."
Oz the First immediately gave several items as Zhang Fei requested, including several drops of his demon-origin bloodline.
"My celestial demon bloodline is not an ordinary demon bloodline, and your wife may need to adapt for quite a while after she becomes one."
"All right, I will help her with that."
Once they returned to the Cloud Mansion, Zhang Fei immediately took out the science capsule, and Ru Xue lay inside it directly to begin the process of transforming into a demon.

Once everything was ready, Zhang Fei inserted Oz the First's celestial demon bloodline and some of his body parts into the holes in the capsule, and Mei immediately carried out the process to turn Ru Xue into a demon.
Zhang Lin and the other women surrounded the capsule and waited impatiently for the process to end, especially since they were too curious about Ru Xue's demon form.
Three hours later, based on the time in the training space, the process was complete.
Zhang Fei immediately opened the capsule cover and helped Ru Xue out, but her new appearance left Liu Hua and the others stunned because it was beyond their expectations.
Overall, Ru Xue's appearance is no different from before, but her long black hair has turned white.
Her black eyes turned red like Oz the First's eyes, and two different powerful auras radiated from her body.
Two black dragon horns appeared above her head, two dragon wings on his back, and a dragon tail behind his hips.
Liu Qingyu and the others could feel calm from Ru Xue because of her light element, but they could also feel the horror from her demon aura.
"What happened to Big Sis Xue, Big Brother?
Why does she look like this?" Zhang Lin asked in confusion.
Zhang Yu spoke.
"Somehow, I feel like she's not a celestial demon, but she's a demon dragon."
Zhang Fei himself was confused by Ru Xue's changes. 'Mei, show her status.'
[Wait a minute.]
Name: Ru Xue
Age: 36
Gender: Female
Race: Celestial Dragon Demon
Demon Rank: Lesser
Cultivation: 1-Star Earth Realm
Core: Intermediate Light Core
Elements: Light + Dark
Bloodline: Light Dragon + Celestial Demon
Physique: Celestial Dragon Demon Physique
'Eh?
Why did her race become the Celestial Dragon Demon?'
[I myself don't know how Ru Xue became like this, Master.
I suspect that the light dragon bloodline she got from Long Baiyun fused with the celestial demon bloodline, which turned her into the Celestial Dragon Demon.]
'Does this mean Ru Xue has become a true dragon?'
[Master, Ru Xue does have dragon characteristics, but I don't think she's a true dragon like Long Baiyun.
After all, you didn't use dragon beast cores or other dragon body parts to transform her, and she's more like a humanoid dragon, just like when you use your half-fox form.]
Zhang Fei then provided an explanation to Ru Xue and the others based on Mei's guess, as he had no alternative explanation.
"How do you feel now?"
"I don't feel any significant difference other than my demon aura." Ru Xue then used the transformation technique to return to her human form.
"Since this is my first time becoming a demon, I still feel a little strange about my horns, wings, and tail."
"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled at that.
"It's okay; I also felt like that when I first became a heavenly fox and a lust demon, and you just need to get used to your changes.
Do you feel bloodthirsty now?"
"Yes." Ru Xue replied with a nod.
"My transformation into a demon made me bloodthirsty, and I'm so eager to kill now.
You have to help me control it, or I will become a bloodthirsty demon, which will be troublesome for us."
"You don't need to worry about that, and I will definitely help you control it." Zhang Fei then said to the others.
"Since Ru Xue has just become a demon, and her demon rank is still at the lesser rank, I will start dual cultivating with her to increase her demon rank first."

Naturally, Zhang Lin and the others had no objections to that, and they waited on the sofa while discussing their next training plans in the Netherworld Realm, especially since their killing intents were still pale in comparison to Zhang Fei's killing intent.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei immediately took Ru Xue to bed, where they started to dual cultivate, and they didn't forget to cultivate their souls at the same time.
A month passed quickly in the cultivation world, and many events occurred in several realms, especially in the Red Sun Realm.

As Zhang Fei expected, Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan suffered greatly in the past month, especially since several of their internal organs failed due to the effects of his poison, which made the situation in the Shang Clan completely chaotic.
Shang Ziyuan, who had previously gone to search for Shang Baishi and Shang Xiaoyin, decided to return to the Red Sun Realm to control the situation in the Shang Clan.
The two ancestors of the Shang Clan, Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun, decided to come out of their seclusion.
After all, the conditions of Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan caused their clan's strength to decline significantly, and Xi Hongyan was targeting them, so they had to protect their clan.
They called many doctors to treat their two juniors, but they still couldn't cure them.

News of Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan's condition quickly spread throughout the Red Sun Realm, and Xi Hongyan intended to attack them, but the appearance of Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun forced her to abandon her plans.
However, Xi Hongyan was fortunate that Xi Qiuwei managed to capture Shang Shang Xishun and lock her up in their Xi clan.
Unfortunately, she couldn't do anything to her yet, especially since Lin Moxian hadn't arrived in their realm yet.

On the other hand, Zhang Xiaolong [3] repeatedly met Murong Qianying at the Murong clan, and they often spent time together there, especially since Ba Shuxiang and Xie Jingxian's physical strength was not yet strong enough to dual cultivate with him nonstop.
Naturally, he didn't forget to visit Hong Xinxin, Shang Xinyu, and Shang Yifen to dual soul cultivate with them.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] also repeatedly met Jin Ruyue to ask for her Yin Qi so he could help Xian Feng and Yun Shang.
He also went to the Netherworld Realm several times to check on Shang Chongyun and the other three, who had decided to settle down not far from Lust City.
Since Shang Huaqiang's condition was bad, he had never contacted the four in the past month.

Additionally, Zhang Xiaolong [3] managed to convince Ren Dongcheng to join the Hong Clan, especially after his actions pitted him against Fei Qinyuan, which made their group even bigger than Xi Hongyan's group.
However, that was not the main reason the old man was willing to join them, and the main cause was the Huo Clan's rejection, especially since Huo Jiguang was too familiar with his character.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] stood at the front end of the Pandora Odyssey, and his eyes kept looking at the black planet in front of him.
After a month of traveling, he finally arrived at his destination, which was none other than the Nine Hells Darkland.
Zhang Fei [5] could see that the Nine Hells Darkland was not very large when compared to the Wasteland Realm or the Nine Stars Realm, but the atmosphere in the realm was extremely gloomy.

paragraphs: Zhang Fei [5] had landed in one of the areas of the Nine Hells Darkland, but he immediately summoned the demon extermination sword and attacked two wandering souls that were heading towards him.
*Slash*

The souls were directly absorbed by the demon extermination sword, but Zhang Fei [5] saw that there were many other souls in the distance. He immediately released the sword, and it enthusiastically attacked those souls and absorbed them as well. "I didn't expect to get so many quests in this realm, and there's no way I can complete them all by myself."

Zhang Fei [5] immediately opened the portal to the training space before his two clones walked out of it, leading their ten demon partners. Balena also followed behind them, especially since she didn't dual cultivate with her original body.

Feltia [2] and Zhang Fei [4] immediately sat cross-legged to absorb the demon aura and Qi in that realm. The ten female demons chose to look around the area of the realm. They could only shake their heads once they saw the demon extermination sword flying around and attacking those souls, and it was so greedy in absorbing them.

"The demon aura in this realm is really thick and strong compared to that in the Netherworld Realm or the Nine Stars Realm." Zilvora began to absorb the demon aura. "If I stay here long enough to absorb it, I might be able to become a demon empress soon."
"I want to stay here too." Orith said with a nod. "My demon rank has yet to rise to the archduchess rank, so I want to reach it as soon as possible."
Ilsath then asked Zhang Fei [5]. "Can we stay here for the time being? I want to absorb this demon aura and reach archduchess rank."

"I have many things to do in this realm, so we will stay here for the time being." The female demons were excited when they heard that, and they immediately sat cross-legged to absorb the Qi and demon aura simultaneously. Zhang Fei [5] then spoke to Balena. "I will break through to the 7-Star Earth Realm in the next few days, and I will pursue the Heaven Realm after that. If I manage to reach that stage in the next three months, I will directly bring you back to the Blue Water Realm."

Balena was naturally happy with that because she had been trapped in the Netherworld Realm for too long, and she missed her family so much, but she was also worried about him. "I am pleased with your consideration of me, but you should not force yourself too much. If a mishap occurs in your cultivation, there will be so many people who will be sad, so you must cultivate carefully to avoid any untoward incidents."

"Don't worry, okay?" Zhang Fei [5] pulled Balena closer and gently caressed her cheek. "I have considered everything carefully, and I will try to reach that stage in three months. Moreover, Lin'er can't wait to become a demon, and the most suitable demon for her is hiding in your realm, so I want to go there as soon as possible."

"Honestly, I was still shocked when you told me about the Abyssal Leviathan Demon Beast, especially since no one in my realm knows about that demon's existence." Balena then asked. "Are you sure that the demon is really hiding in the Sunken Kingdom? You may have trouble finding the demon if it's hiding in that place, especially since no one has been able to enter since its destruction."

"Morgana did say that the demon beast was hiding there, but I can only confirm it after we go to your realm. Even if others can't find the way in to that place, it doesn't mean I can't. As you already know, I have many things that others don't have, so I'm sure I can find the way in." Zhang Fei [5] then pulled the demon extermination sword back into his hand before continuing. "You can join them to absorb the Qi and demon aura here."

After Balena started doing it, Mei immediately asked Zhang Fei [5]. [Why don't you bring Ru Xue and the other female demons to this realm, Master? Rather than them training in the Netherworld Realm, this realm is much better for them, especially since they can absorb both of them at the same time.]

'Well, you're right.' Zhang Fei [5] opened the portal again once, and Ru Xue, Angela, Yan Zhixiu, Lillea, Janette, and Qian Ying immediately walked out of it. "The six of you can cultivate and absorb demon aura in this realm with the others, and I will protect you all."
Ru Xue and the others agreed with that, and they immediately sat down on the ground with Zilvora and the others to begin cultivating and absorbing the demon aura.

Zhang Fei [5] wanted to bring Zhang Lin and the others to that realm, but unfortunately, they would not be able to fight those wandering souls since only a few of them had the light elements, and he was afraid that those souls would possess them, which would only bring trouble for him.

Zhang Fei [5] then tried to spread his senses to several other areas, and he found countless wandering souls filling those areas. Some of them even looked vicious and powerful, and he also found many corpses scattered all over the area, just as Morgana had told him back then. 'This realm is truly terrifying! These wandering souls probably belonged to the residents of this realm and the invaders who died in the past, especially since their numbers are simply too numerous. I'm sure human cultivators wouldn't dare to come here! Even if they did, they would flee immediately after seeing them. However, I'm curious about the last two quests, especially the wandering soul demon. Do you think that demon trapped all these souls in this realm, Mei?'

[I think so, Master. The two quests must be related to each other, and you can complete both after you successfully find and eliminate the wandering soul demon, but I can't find its location yet because the system hasn't finished mapping this realm, so we can only wait for now.]

'Yeah.' Zhang Fei [5] then sat cross-legged on the ground and allowed the demon extermination sword to attack the wandering souls that were starting to approach their location. 'Jian Hei'an and Jian Guang'an seemed to really like this realm, especially since the sword could absorb these wandering souls to strengthen it.'
[Don't you want to absorb these wandering souls, Master? If you absorb them, your soul power might be able to break through to the half-perfection stage of the earthly soul level.]

'Naturally, I want to absorb them, especially since it has been three months since my soul power broke through to this stage. However, Jian Hei'an's and Jian Guang'an's souls are still weak now, so let them absorb these wandering souls first, and the extermination sword will become stronger as their souls strengthen. Once they are satisfied, I will start absorbing them.' Since he couldn't do anything before the map finished mapping that realm, Zhang Fei [5] started absorbing the Qi and demon power there, and Mei helped him to monitor the situation around them.

In the Shang Clan, Shang Yuan kept frowning as he watched two female physicians examine Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan's condition. Their ancestors were forced to put the two to sleep, especially since they continued to suffer from organ failure. "How did it go?"

"Madam Ziyuan, the source of their illness is the failure of their internal organs, and I have given them several pills to strengthen them. Unfortunately, none of them worked, and the condition of their internal organs continued to deteriorate." One of the female physicians spoke with fear.

"I found traces of poison in Madam Qinyuan's body, Madam Ziyuan." Shang Ziyuan turned to the other physician. "I suspect the poison is the cause of her internal organ failure, but I have never seen such a poison before. I will try to extract it from her body to study it, and I will try to find an antidote afterwards."
"All right, you can do it, and you should succeed in healing them." Shang Ziyuan then turned to the two old men who had just arrived. "Did you manage to find the intruder, Ancestors?"
Shang Yanhan shook his head in response. "I could sense the intruder's presence, but he or she disappeared before I could move to capture him or her."

"If my guess is correct, that person should be one of Xi Hongyan's subordinates." Shang Ziyuan was not too surprised by Shang Yanjun's answer, especially since the Xi clan hated their clan so much. "There are some descendants of that clan who have shadow abilities, and no one can detect their presence as long as they hide in the shadows. What we can do now is continue to monitor our clan, and we have to move as soon as that person shows movement."

"I will order our clan members to monitor the entire area of the residence so they can move as soon as that person appears." Shang Ziyuan then walked out. "Ancestors, I will go to the Huo clan and ask for Huo Jiguang's help to cure my brother and sister-in-law, so I entrust our clan to you two."

A young man leisurely walked into the Xi clan, but none of the people from the clan dared to look at him. Although he looked relaxed, his aura gave off a certain pressure on them, which frightened them.
Xi Xiuling suddenly appeared before the man and greeted him. "Young master Lin Moxian, my mistress has been waiting for you, and she ordered me to escort you to her now."
"Lead the way." As he followed Xi Xiuling, Lin Moxian had many questions in his mind, especially about Xi Hongyan's purpose in asking him to come.

A while later, they arrived before a dungeon, causing Lin Moxian to frown. He remained silent as he followed Xi Xiuling into the dungeon, where he saw Xi Hongyan standing in front of one of the prison rooms.

Lin Moxian immediately recognized the identity of the woman in the room, but her condition seemed bad because Xi Hongyan had repeatedly tortured her. "Oh? Isn't she Shang Xishun? Did you call me here because of her, Hongyan?"
"Leave us, Xiuling." After Xi Xiuling left, Xi Hongyan immediately told Lin Moxian about her plans for Shang Xishun. "Can you help me with that?"
"That's easy for me." Lin Moxian then turned to Xi Hongyan, looking her body up and down. "There is no free lunch in this world, and I will only help you if you can give me something in return."

'Tch! This bastard! If I wasn't afraid of Hun Di and Lin Jingxia, I would definitely gouge out his eyes straight away.' Xi Hongyan then answered him. "I'm sorry, but I can't fulfill your request. If you want it, I will prepare some women for you, and you can have fun with them as you like."

Lin Moxian gave a faint smirk and lifted Xi Hongyan's chin, causing her face to darken. "I don't want other women, and I only want you. Moreover, you should be aware that I can force you, but I am not a rapist. Therefore, consider my conditions first, and I will help you with Shang Xishun after you agree."

If another man treated her in such a way, Xi Hongyan would undoubtedly kill him on the spot. Unfortunately, Lin Moxian was different from them, mainly because of his status as Hun Di's first disciple, and he was also the nephew of the alchemist goddess, Lin Jingxia. "All right, I will think about it first. Do you want to stay in my clan for a while?"

"No." Xi Hongyan raised her eyebrows once Lin Moxian rejected her. "I heard that my master has appointed a new disciple, and it was Qiao Liangren who recommended him to our master, so I want to go to the Qiao Clan to meet him."

The information shocked Xi Hongyan, especially since all the cultivators in the upper realms never knew that Hun Di had taken a new disciple. According to the information circulating in the public, his last disciple was Shang Yinyue, and he had never taken another disciple after that. "Can you tell me the man's name?"

"Unfortunately, my master has not told me anything about my junior brother, so I can't tell you anything." Lin Moxian replied with a sigh. "That's why I want to go to the Qiao Clan to find out his identity from Qiao Liangren."
Xi Hongyan nodded slightly before saying again. "I think it would only be a waste of time for you to go to the Qiao Clan, especially since Qiao Liangren is not in his clan now."
"Oh? Do you know where he is now?"

"I don't have any information about that." Xi Hongyan shook her head in response. "However, Qiao Liangren usually lives in the Wasteland Realm, but he is not there now. I heard from one of my subordinates that Hun Di went to that realm about four months ago, and he took him, Shang Yingyue, and the younger generations of several other clans away."
Lin Moxian fell into thought after hearing that. 'Where did they actually go? Why didn't my master tell me and the others? Why did he only take Qiao Liangren and Shang Yingyue with him?'

"If you want to know their destination, you can go see Hong Xinxin or Murong Qianying." Lin Moxian raised his eyebrows at Xi Hongyan. "Back then, the two of them brought four people from their clans, and the four of them left with Hun Di. I believe they should know their destination, and they probably also know the identity of his new disciple."
"I see." Lin Moxian nodded in understanding. "In that case, I will go to the Murong Clan to see Murong Qianying now."

"By the way, the Murong Clan no longer lives in their old residence, and Murong Qianying brought them to move not far from the Hong clan." Lin Moxian simply nodded and disappeared from Xi Hongyan's sight, causing her to curse in annoyance. "That bastard! I have rejected him many times, but he still continues to covet my body! Both of his statuses are indeed extraordinary, but he is still not worthy of me!"

Two hours later, Lin Moxian had arrived in the southern region, and he rushed to the Murong clan's new residence, but the clan's people told him that Murong Qianying was at the Hong clan, so he rushed to the clan.
Lin Moxian's sudden arrival surprised the members of the Hong Clan, and Hong Quan immediately asked him. "What brings you here suddenly, little Moxian?"

sentences.text: Zhang Fei [5] had landed in one of the areas of the Nine Hells Darkland, but he immediately summoned the demon extermination sword and attacked two wandering souls that were heading towards him.
*Slash*
The souls were directly absorbed by the demon extermination sword, but Zhang Fei [5] saw that there were many other souls in the distance.
He immediately released the sword, and it enthusiastically attacked those souls and absorbed them as well.
"I didn't expect to get so many quests in this realm, and there's no way I can complete them all by myself."
Zhang Fei [5] immediately opened the portal to the training space before his two clones walked out of it, leading their ten demon partners.
Balena also followed behind them, especially since she didn't dual cultivate with her original body.
Feltia [2] and Zhang Fei [4] immediately sat cross-legged to absorb the demon aura and Qi in that realm.
The ten female demons chose to look around the area of the realm.
They could only shake their heads once they saw the demon extermination sword flying around and attacking those souls, and it was so greedy in absorbing them.
"The demon aura in this realm is really thick and strong compared to that in the Netherworld Realm or the Nine Stars Realm." Zilvora began to absorb the demon aura.
"If I stay here long enough to absorb it, I might be able to become a demon empress soon."
"I want to stay here too." Orith said with a nod.
"My demon rank has yet to rise to the archduchess rank, so I want to reach it as soon as possible."
Ilsath then asked Zhang Fei [5].
"Can we stay here for the time being?
I want to absorb this demon aura and reach archduchess rank."

"I have many things to do in this realm, so we will stay here for the time being." The female demons were excited when they heard that, and they immediately sat cross-legged to absorb the Qi and demon aura simultaneously.
Zhang Fei [5] then spoke to Balena.
"I will break through to the 7-Star Earth Realm in the next few days, and I will pursue the Heaven Realm after that.
If I manage to reach that stage in the next three months, I will directly bring you back to the Blue Water Realm."
Balena was naturally happy with that because she had been trapped in the Netherworld Realm for too long, and she missed her family so much, but she was also worried about him.
"I am pleased with your consideration of me, but you should not force yourself too much.
If a mishap occurs in your cultivation, there will be so many people who will be sad, so you must cultivate carefully to avoid any untoward incidents."
"Don't worry, okay?" Zhang Fei [5] pulled Balena closer and gently caressed her cheek.
"I have considered everything carefully, and I will try to reach that stage in three months.
Moreover, Lin'er can't wait to become a demon, and the most suitable demon for her is hiding in your realm, so I want to go there as soon as possible."
"Honestly, I was still shocked when you told me about the Abyssal Leviathan Demon Beast, especially since no one in my realm knows about that demon's existence." Balena then asked.
"Are you sure that the demon is really hiding in the Sunken Kingdom?
You may have trouble finding the demon if it's hiding in that place, especially since no one has been able to enter since its destruction."
"Morgana did say that the demon beast was hiding there, but I can only confirm it after we go to your realm.
Even if others can't find the way in to that place, it doesn't mean I can't.
As you already know, I have many things that others don't have, so I'm sure I can find the way in." Zhang Fei [5] then pulled the demon extermination sword back into his hand before continuing.
"You can join them to absorb the Qi and demon aura here."
After Balena started doing it, Mei immediately asked Zhang Fei [5].
[Why don't you bring Ru Xue and the other female demons to this realm, Master?
Rather than them training in the Netherworld Realm, this realm is much better for them, especially since they can absorb both of them at the same time.]
'Well, you're right.' Zhang Fei [5] opened the portal again once, and Ru Xue, Angela, Yan Zhixiu, Lillea, Janette, and Qian Ying immediately walked out of it.
"The six of you can cultivate and absorb demon aura in this realm with the others, and I will protect you all."
Ru Xue and the others agreed with that, and they immediately sat down on the ground with Zilvora and the others to begin cultivating and absorbing the demon aura.

Zhang Fei [5] wanted to bring Zhang Lin and the others to that realm, but unfortunately, they would not be able to fight those wandering souls since only a few of them had the light elements, and he was afraid that those souls would possess them, which would only bring trouble for him.
Zhang Fei [5] then tried to spread his senses to several other areas, and he found countless wandering souls filling those areas.
Some of them even looked vicious and powerful, and he also found many corpses scattered all over the area, just as Morgana had told him back then. 'This realm is truly terrifying!
These wandering souls probably belonged to the residents of this realm and the invaders who died in the past, especially since their numbers are simply too numerous.
I'm sure human cultivators wouldn't dare to come here!
Even if they did, they would flee immediately after seeing them.
However, I'm curious about the last two quests, especially the wandering soul demon.
Do you think that demon trapped all these souls in this realm, Mei?'
[I think so, Master.

The two quests must be related to each other, and you can complete both after you successfully find and eliminate the wandering soul demon, but I can't find its location yet because the system hasn't finished mapping this realm, so we can only wait for now.]

'Yeah.' Zhang Fei [5] then sat cross-legged on the ground and allowed the demon extermination sword to attack the wandering souls that were starting to approach their location. 'Jian Hei'an and Jian Guang'an seemed to really like this realm, especially since the sword could absorb these wandering souls to strengthen it.'
[Don't you want to absorb these wandering souls, Master?
If you absorb them, your soul power might be able to break through to the half-perfection stage of the earthly soul level.]
'Naturally, I want to absorb them, especially since it has been three months since my soul power broke through to this stage.
However, Jian Hei'an's and Jian Guang'an's souls are still weak now, so let them absorb these wandering souls first, and the extermination sword will become stronger as their souls strengthen.

Once they are satisfied, I will start absorbing them.' Since he couldn't do anything before the map finished mapping that realm, Zhang Fei [5] started absorbing the Qi and demon power there, and Mei helped him to monitor the situation around them.
In the Shang Clan, Shang Yuan kept frowning as he watched two female physicians examine Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan's condition.
Their ancestors were forced to put the two to sleep, especially since they continued to suffer from organ failure.
"How did it go?"
"Madam Ziyuan, the source of their illness is the failure of their internal organs, and I have given them several pills to strengthen them.
Unfortunately, none of them worked, and the condition of their internal organs continued to deteriorate." One of the female physicians spoke with fear.
"I found traces of poison in Madam Qinyuan's body, Madam Ziyuan." Shang Ziyuan turned to the other physician.
"I suspect the poison is the cause of her internal organ failure, but I have never seen such a poison before.
I will try to extract it from her body to study it, and I will try to find an antidote afterwards."
"All right, you can do it, and you should succeed in healing them." Shang Ziyuan then turned to the two old men who had just arrived.
"Did you manage to find the intruder, Ancestors?"
Shang Yanhan shook his head in response.
"I could sense the intruder's presence, but he or she disappeared before I could move to capture him or her."
"If my guess is correct, that person should be one of Xi Hongyan's subordinates." Shang Ziyuan was not too surprised by Shang Yanjun's answer, especially since the Xi clan hated their clan so much.
"There are some descendants of that clan who have shadow abilities, and no one can detect their presence as long as they hide in the shadows.
What we can do now is continue to monitor our clan, and we have to move as soon as that person shows movement."
"I will order our clan members to monitor the entire area of the residence so they can move as soon as that person appears." Shang Ziyuan then walked out.
"Ancestors, I will go to the Huo clan and ask for Huo Jiguang's help to cure my brother and sister-in-law, so I entrust our clan to you two."
A young man leisurely walked into the Xi clan, but none of the people from the clan dared to look at him.
Although he looked relaxed, his aura gave off a certain pressure on them, which frightened them.
Xi Xiuling suddenly appeared before the man and greeted him.
"Young master Lin Moxian, my mistress has been waiting for you, and she ordered me to escort you to her now."
"Lead the way." As he followed Xi Xiuling, Lin Moxian had many questions in his mind, especially about Xi Hongyan's purpose in asking him to come.
A while later, they arrived before a dungeon, causing Lin Moxian to frown.
He remained silent as he followed Xi Xiuling into the dungeon, where he saw Xi Hongyan standing in front of one of the prison rooms.
Lin Moxian immediately recognized the identity of the woman in the room, but her condition seemed bad because Xi Hongyan had repeatedly tortured her.
"Oh?
Isn't she Shang Xishun?
Did you call me here because of her, Hongyan?"
"Leave us, Xiuling." After Xi Xiuling left, Xi Hongyan immediately told Lin Moxian about her plans for Shang Xishun.
"Can you help me with that?"
"That's easy for me." Lin Moxian then turned to Xi Hongyan, looking her body up and down.
"There is no free lunch in this world, and I will only help you if you can give me something in return."
'Tch!
This bastard!
If I wasn't afraid of Hun Di and Lin Jingxia, I would definitely gouge out his eyes straight away.' Xi Hongyan then answered him.
"I'm sorry, but I can't fulfill your request.
If you want it, I will prepare some women for you, and you can have fun with them as you like."
Lin Moxian gave a faint smirk and lifted Xi Hongyan's chin, causing her face to darken.
"I don't want other women, and I only want you.
Moreover, you should be aware that I can force you, but I am not a rapist.
Therefore, consider my conditions first, and I will help you with Shang Xishun after you agree."
If another man treated her in such a way, Xi Hongyan would undoubtedly kill him on the spot.
Unfortunately, Lin Moxian was different from them, mainly because of his status as Hun Di's first disciple, and he was also the nephew of the alchemist goddess, Lin Jingxia.
"All right, I will think about it first.
Do you want to stay in my clan for a while?"
"No." Xi Hongyan raised her eyebrows once Lin Moxian rejected her.
"I heard that my master has appointed a new disciple, and it was Qiao Liangren who recommended him to our master, so I want to go to the Qiao Clan to meet him."
The information shocked Xi Hongyan, especially since all the cultivators in the upper realms never knew that Hun Di had taken a new disciple.
According to the information circulating in the public, his last disciple was Shang Yinyue, and he had never taken another disciple after that.
"Can you tell me the man's name?"
"Unfortunately, my master has not told me anything about my junior brother, so I can't tell you anything." Lin Moxian replied with a sigh.
"That's why I want to go to the Qiao Clan to find out his identity from Qiao Liangren."
Xi Hongyan nodded slightly before saying again.
"I think it would only be a waste of time for you to go to the Qiao Clan, especially since Qiao Liangren is not in his clan now."
"Oh?
Do you know where he is now?"
"I don't have any information about that." Xi Hongyan shook her head in response.
"However, Qiao Liangren usually lives in the Wasteland Realm, but he is not there now.
I heard from one of my subordinates that Hun Di went to that realm about four months ago, and he took him, Shang Yingyue, and the younger generations of several other clans away."

"If you want to know their destination, you can go see Hong Xinxin or Murong Qianying." Lin Moxian raised his eyebrows at Xi Hongyan.

I believe they should know their destination, and they probably also know the identity of his new disciple."
"I see." Lin Moxian nodded in understanding.

"By the way, the Murong Clan no longer lives in their old residence, and Murong Qianying brought them to move not far from the Hong clan." Lin Moxian simply nodded and disappeared from Xi Hongyan's sight, causing her to curse in annoyance.

paragraphs: Lin Moxian was shocked when he arrived at the back building because Zhang Xiaolong [3] was in his half-fox form, and he was dual soul cultivating with Hong Xinxin, Murong Qianying, Shang Xiyun, and Shang Yifen.

'Why did master take a ten-year-old demihuman kid as his disciple? He was indeed a genius, and he had already reached the Earth Realm, even though he was only ten years old.' Lin Moxian then looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s soul before being shocked by dozens of white lotuses with five petals beneath each of them. 'What kind of soul cultivation technique did he learn? How did he create those dozens of lotuses in his soul? As far as I remember, the master didn't have such a technique, or else he would have taught it to me and the others.'

Mei had already warned Zhang Xiaolong [3] about Lin Moxian's arrival, but he didn't have time to draw his Yang Qi back from the souls of the four women, especially since his speed was speedy, even though it was still not comparable to his.

'Master once told me that Hong Xinxin and Murong Qianying have no talent in the soul cultivation path, yet they are both soul cultivators now. No wonder my master accepted this kid as his disciple, especially since his talent on the cultivation path was amazing, and he could help them become soul cultivators.' Lin Moxian did not disturb them, and he sat a distance away from them while watching their activities. 'This kid is still young, but his control over his Yang Qi is already like an expert's, and he is flowing it into their souls evenly. Even I wouldn't dare to do such a thing, especially since it is too risky. If he loses control, then their soul will suffer serious injury. Furthermore, his soul level is still at the early stage of the earthly soul level, but he dares to accommodate the Yin Qi from four women at the same time.'

After some time, Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the four women began to withdraw their Yang and Yin Qi back before returning their souls into their bodies. As soon as they opened their eyes, Murong Qianying immediately questioned Lin Moxian. "Why did you suddenly come here?"
"Did Xin Hongyan ask you to come here?" Hong Xinxin also asked him.

"You're right, Xinxin. Xi Hongyan contacted me a month ago, and she asked me to help her do something." Lin Moxian's answer made Hong Xinxin and Murong Qianying frown. "Actually, I didn't have any plans to come here before, and I planned to look for Qiao Liangren in the Qiao clan. However, she told me that he left with our master to the Blossom Heaven Realm, and she also told me about the relationship between you two and my junior brother, so I came here to ask you two about him. Unexpectedly, he was here, so I was lucky to come here."
"Long'er, he is Senior Hun Di's first disciple, Lin Moxian, so he is your senior brother." Murong Qianying said.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] was surprised to hear that, especially since he didn't know about his master's other disciples besides Qiao Liangren and Shang Yingyue. He immediately stood up and introduced himself. "Please to meet you, Senior Brother Moxian. My name is Zhang Xiaolong, and everyone calls me Long'er."
"Haha." Lin Moxian laughed. "Junior Brother, I have to admit that you are a genius among geniuses, and you are indeed worthy of being our master's disciple."
"Your praise is too much, Senior Brother. I am still young now, and there are many cultivators who are more genius than me out there." Zhang Xiaolong [3] politely replied.
Hong Xinxin then asked Lin Moxian. "What does Xi Hongyan want from you?"

"Shang Xishun." All of them looked at Lin Moxian in confusion. "Xi Qiuwei managed to capture her in the Wasteland Realm a month ago, and Xi Hongyan needs my help to control her in order to destroy the Shang Clan from within. However, I have not agreed to her request, and I gave her one condition if she wants me to help her."

"Haha." Hong Xinxin laughed as she realized the conditions. "Why are you so crazy about Xi Hongyan? She is indeed one of the best women in this realm, but she doesn't like men, and she prefers women. Moreover, you can get any woman you want with your status as Senior Hun Di's disciple and Senior Lin Jingxia's nephew."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] was surprised to hear the latter name. 'I didn't expect that he was also the nephew of the alchemist goddess.'

"Even with my two statuses, I still can't get you as my wife, right?" Lin Moxian replied with a frivolous smile, causing Hong Xinxin to shake her head. "Haha! I was just joking, so there's no need to be serious, but I didn't expect your habit of falling in love with young leaves still hasn't changed. Back then, you were infatuated with Shang Guangming, and you always followed him wherever he went. But now, you choose my junior brother, who is much younger than him, as your future husband."

"Love knows no age." Hong Xinxin nonchalantly replied. "Long'er is still young now, but he will mature in a few years, and I will marry him when his cultivation reaches the Seven Divine Realm. Will you really help Xi Hongyan if she agrees to the conditions you give her?"
"What do you two think about that? Should I help Xi Hongyan?" Lin Moxian asked them instead.

"I think you shouldn't do that." Lin Moxian looked at Murong Qianying. "Your master has always been neutral in matters of other clans, and he wouldn't like it if you helped Xi Hongyan. Furthermore, do you really want to get her using such a method? Aren't you ashamed as a man to use such a method to get a woman?"

"If you find it difficult to get Xi Hongyan using normal means, you can learn from Long'er how to conquer a woman's feelings." Hong Xinxin then pointed to Shang Yifen and Shang Xinyu. "They are also his future wives, and he still has several other women by his side, such as Shang Yumei and Shang Yaolin."

"Eh?" Ling Moxian immediately looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was scratching his head awkwardly, especially since he was disguised as a child. "Are your two daughters really my junior brother's future wives, Qianying?"
Murong Qianying confirmed it with a nod. "Yumei and Yaolin have fallen in love with him, so I allowed them to be with him."
Lin Moxian immediately moved to Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s side and grabbed his shoulder. "Hey, Junior Brother, how did you manage to conquer their hearts? Did you use some special technique?"
'This guy has no shame!' The four women exclaimed, their hearts filled with laughter.

"Senior Brother, winning a woman's heart is both easy and hard, and there is no special technique for it." Lin Moxian raised his eyebrows at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Generally, many women like men who are patient and affectionate, but in other cases, some women like men who are aggressive. Both of those cases do not apply to a woman like Xi Hongyan because she doesn't like men, and she will never like you if you force her, so you need to put in extra effort to get her. If you want to get her, you can play tug-of-war with her, and her feelings might melt one day."
"What do you mean by tug-of-war?" Lin Moxian asked in confusion.

'He's very old, but he's like an inexperienced virgin.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] then explained. "You can try to be aggressive towards her at one time, and you can act indifferent towards her at the other time."
"Are you sure it will work?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head. "I don't know Xi Hongyan's character yet because I've never met her, so I can't say whether it will work or not, and you should try it on her first to find out the results."
"How about you come with me to meet Xi Hongyan?"
"No!" Hong Xinxin and Murong Qianying shouted at Lin Moxian.

Murong Qianying then spoke. "Moxian, I know you can protect Long'er with both of your statuses, and Xi Hongyan won't dare to do anything to him if she knows that he is your junior brother. However, there are many cultivators who dare to go against your master and aunt, and they will hunt him down if they find out his talent. If that happens, no one can protect him, and he will die in their hands."

"Long'er has already told you how to conquer Xi Hongyan, so you should try it first. If it still doesn't work, you can discuss it with him again, but you must never bring him to see her." Lin Moxian looked hesitant after listening to Hong Xinxin. "Furthermore, he has his own charm, and she might fall in love with him if you bring him to see her."

Lin Moxian was momentarily stunned, but he then remembered that Zhang Xiaolong [3] already had several women by his side, which made him worry that Xi Hongyan would fall in love with him instead. "All right, I won't take him to meet her, and I will try to use his ideas first. As for her request, I think I will refuse her, and she won't be able to do anything to force me."

"That's the best choice!" Hong Xinxin and Murong Qianying said it in unison. "If the Shang Clan is destroyed, Xi Hongyan and her Xi clan will have no more opponents in this realm, and she might target us next."
Lin Moxian nodded in agreement and changed the topic of their conversation. "Junior brother, can you tell me about those white lotuses inside your soul? How did you create them inside it?"

"I learned that technique from my mother, but not everyone can master it." Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s answer actually made Lin Moxian even more curious about it. "In fact, those white lotuses symbolize the number of women who sincerely love me, especially since to create one requires the unification of three things: mind, heart, and soul. If a pair of lovers cannot unite these three, then it cannot form, and they will suffer backlash instead."

Lin Moxian's jaw dropped after hearing that, especially since there were dozens of white lotuses inside Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s soul, which meant he had dozens of women by his side. "Oh god! I feel pathetic! I've lived for thousands of years, but I've never had a lover! But you, my junior brother who is only 10 years old, have dozens of women by your side! If my other junior brothers and junior sisters knew about this, they would laugh and mock me endlessly!"
"Pftt!" Hong Xinxin and the three women burst into laughter listening to Lin Moxian.

'This guy is quite funny.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] inwardly said with an amused smile. "Senior brother, I don't know all the senior brothers and senior sisters, but I remember that Senior Brother Liangren doesn't have a girlfriend either."
*Clasped*

Lin Moxian clasped his hands. "Oh! You're right, Junior Brother! Qiao Liangren is a virgin like me, so I don't have to worry about them making fun of me! But how can you get so many women at your current age? Can you make them all happy?"

"I'm just being myself, and I don't need to do anything strange." Lin Moxian's lips twitched at that. "Senior Brother, if they weren't happy with me, I wouldn't be able to create so many white lotuses in my soul."

"That's right." Lin Moxian then put his arm around Zhang Xiaolong [3] and led him out. "This is our first meeting, and we are brothers under one master, so I want to get to know you better. Additionally, I want you to teach me more about women so I can win Xi Hongyan's heart."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] sighed helplessly in his heart as he walked beside Lin Moxian. "The most important thing is that you have to believe in yourself, and you also have to learn to understand the woman you are targeting."
"Let's talk somewhere else so these women can't eavesdrop on us." Lin Moxian immediately took Zhang Xiaolong [3] away from the Hong Clan.
After their departure, Shang Xinyu proceeded to question Hong Xinxin and Murong Qianying. "Is that senior's character really like that, Aunts?"

"Yes." Murong Qianying replied with a nod. "Lin Moxian's character is a bit strange, and he often acts childishly. Even though he is like that, he is a very loyal person, and he is a cultivator with outstanding talent, or else Hun Di would not have accepted him as his first disciple. Furthermore, he is the nephew of the alchemist goddess, and Long'er herself is an alchemist, so he is lucky to be able to meet him so soon."

Hong Xinxin then asked her. "How about we ask Lin Moxian to introduce Long'er to Lin Jingxia, Sister Qianying? I'm sure she will be amazed by his talent in alchemy, and she might be willing to accept him as her disciple."
"I think you can talk to Lin Moxian once they come back, and I will return to my clan now." After that, Murong Qianying walked out before leaving the Hong clan.
Hong Xinxin and the other two women also left the room, and they took care of their own affairs.
