sentences.text: Lin Moxian was shocked when he arrived at the back building because Zhang Xiaolong [3] was in his half-fox form, and he was dual soul cultivating with Hong Xinxin, Murong Qianying, Shang Xiyun, and Shang Yifen.
'Why did master take a ten-year-old demihuman kid as his disciple?

He was indeed a genius, and he had already reached the Earth Realm, even though he was only ten years old.' Lin Moxian then looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s soul before being shocked by dozens of white lotuses with five petals beneath each of them. 'What kind of soul cultivation technique did he learn?
How did he create those dozens of lotuses in his soul?
As far as I remember, the master didn't have such a technique, or else he would have taught it to me and the others.'

Mei had already warned Zhang Xiaolong [3] about Lin Moxian's arrival, but he didn't have time to draw his Yang Qi back from the souls of the four women, especially since his speed was speedy, even though it was still not comparable to his.
'Master once told me that Hong Xinxin and Murong Qianying have no talent in the soul cultivation path, yet they are both soul cultivators now.

No wonder my master accepted this kid as his disciple, especially since his talent on the cultivation path was amazing, and he could help them become soul cultivators.' Lin Moxian did not disturb them, and he sat a distance away from them while watching their activities. 'This kid is still young, but his control over his Yang Qi is already like an expert's, and he is flowing it into their souls evenly.
Even I wouldn't dare to do such a thing, especially since it is too risky.
If he loses control, then their soul will suffer serious injury.
Furthermore, his soul level is still at the early stage of the earthly soul level, but he dares to accommodate the Yin Qi from four women at the same time.'
After some time, Zhang Xiaolong [3] and the four women began to withdraw their Yang and Yin Qi back before returning their souls into their bodies.
As soon as they opened their eyes, Murong Qianying immediately questioned Lin Moxian.
"Why did you suddenly come here?"
"Did Xin Hongyan ask you to come here?" Hong Xinxin also asked him.
"You're right, Xinxin.
Xi Hongyan contacted me a month ago, and she asked me to help her do something." Lin Moxian's answer made Hong Xinxin and Murong Qianying frown.
"Actually, I didn't have any plans to come here before, and I planned to look for Qiao Liangren in the Qiao clan.

However, she told me that he left with our master to the Blossom Heaven Realm, and she also told me about the relationship between you two and my junior brother, so I came here to ask you two about him.
Unexpectedly, he was here, so I was lucky to come here."
"Long'er, he is Senior Hun Di's first disciple, Lin Moxian, so he is your senior brother." Murong Qianying said.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] was surprised to hear that, especially since he didn't know about his master's other disciples besides Qiao Liangren and Shang Yingyue.
He immediately stood up and introduced himself.
"Please to meet you, Senior Brother Moxian.
My name is Zhang Xiaolong, and everyone calls me Long'er."
"Haha." Lin Moxian laughed.
"Junior Brother, I have to admit that you are a genius among geniuses, and you are indeed worthy of being our master's disciple."
"Your praise is too much, Senior Brother.
I am still young now, and there are many cultivators who are more genius than me out there." Zhang Xiaolong [3] politely replied.
Hong Xinxin then asked Lin Moxian.
"What does Xi Hongyan want from you?"
"Shang Xishun." All of them looked at Lin Moxian in confusion.
"Xi Qiuwei managed to capture her in the Wasteland Realm a month ago, and Xi Hongyan needs my help to control her in order to destroy the Shang Clan from within.
However, I have not agreed to her request, and I gave her one condition if she wants me to help her."
"Haha." Hong Xinxin laughed as she realized the conditions.
"Why are you so crazy about Xi Hongyan?
She is indeed one of the best women in this realm, but she doesn't like men, and she prefers women.
Moreover, you can get any woman you want with your status as Senior Hun Di's disciple and Senior Lin Jingxia's nephew."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] was surprised to hear the latter name. 'I didn't expect that he was also the nephew of the alchemist goddess.'
"Even with my two statuses, I still can't get you as my wife, right?" Lin Moxian replied with a frivolous smile, causing Hong Xinxin to shake her head.
"Haha!
I was just joking, so there's no need to be serious, but I didn't expect your habit of falling in love with young leaves still hasn't changed.
Back then, you were infatuated with Shang Guangming, and you always followed him wherever he went.
But now, you choose my junior brother, who is much younger than him, as your future husband."
"Love knows no age." Hong Xinxin nonchalantly replied.
"Long'er is still young now, but he will mature in a few years, and I will marry him when his cultivation reaches the Seven Divine Realm.
Will you really help Xi Hongyan if she agrees to the conditions you give her?"
"What do you two think about that?
Should I help Xi Hongyan?" Lin Moxian asked them instead.
"I think you shouldn't do that." Lin Moxian looked at Murong Qianying.
"Your master has always been neutral in matters of other clans, and he wouldn't like it if you helped Xi Hongyan.
Furthermore, do you really want to get her using such a method?
Aren't you ashamed as a man to use such a method to get a woman?"
"If you find it difficult to get Xi Hongyan using normal means, you can learn from Long'er how to conquer a woman's feelings." Hong Xinxin then pointed to Shang Yifen and Shang Xinyu.
"They are also his future wives, and he still has several other women by his side, such as Shang Yumei and Shang Yaolin."
"Eh?" Ling Moxian immediately looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was scratching his head awkwardly, especially since he was disguised as a child.
"Are your two daughters really my junior brother's future wives, Qianying?"
Murong Qianying confirmed it with a nod.
"Yumei and Yaolin have fallen in love with him, so I allowed them to be with him."
Lin Moxian immediately moved to Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s side and grabbed his shoulder.
"Hey, Junior Brother, how did you manage to conquer their hearts?
Did you use some special technique?"
'This guy has no shame!' The four women exclaimed, their hearts filled with laughter.
"Senior Brother, winning a woman's heart is both easy and hard, and there is no special technique for it." Lin Moxian raised his eyebrows at Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Generally, many women like men who are patient and affectionate, but in other cases, some women like men who are aggressive.
Both of those cases do not apply to a woman like Xi Hongyan because she doesn't like men, and she will never like you if you force her, so you need to put in extra effort to get her.
If you want to get her, you can play tug-of-war with her, and her feelings might melt one day."
"What do you mean by tug-of-war?" Lin Moxian asked in confusion.
'He's very old, but he's like an inexperienced virgin.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] then explained.
"You can try to be aggressive towards her at one time, and you can act indifferent towards her at the other time."
"Are you sure it will work?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head.
"I don't know Xi Hongyan's character yet because I've never met her, so I can't say whether it will work or not, and you should try it on her first to find out the results."
"How about you come with me to meet Xi Hongyan?"
"No!" Hong Xinxin and Murong Qianying shouted at Lin Moxian.
Murong Qianying then spoke.
"Moxian, I know you can protect Long'er with both of your statuses, and Xi Hongyan won't dare to do anything to him if she knows that he is your junior brother.
However, there are many cultivators who dare to go against your master and aunt, and they will hunt him down if they find out his talent.
If that happens, no one can protect him, and he will die in their hands."
"Long'er has already told you how to conquer Xi Hongyan, so you should try it first.
If it still doesn't work, you can discuss it with him again, but you must never bring him to see her." Lin Moxian looked hesitant after listening to Hong Xinxin.
"Furthermore, he has his own charm, and she might fall in love with him if you bring him to see her."
Lin Moxian was momentarily stunned, but he then remembered that Zhang Xiaolong [3] already had several women by his side, which made him worry that Xi Hongyan would fall in love with him instead.
"All right, I won't take him to meet her, and I will try to use his ideas first.
As for her request, I think I will refuse her, and she won't be able to do anything to force me."
"That's the best choice!" Hong Xinxin and Murong Qianying said it in unison.
"If the Shang Clan is destroyed, Xi Hongyan and her Xi clan will have no more opponents in this realm, and she might target us next."
Lin Moxian nodded in agreement and changed the topic of their conversation.
"Junior brother, can you tell me about those white lotuses inside your soul?
How did you create them inside it?"
"I learned that technique from my mother, but not everyone can master it." Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s answer actually made Lin Moxian even more curious about it.
"In fact, those white lotuses symbolize the number of women who sincerely love me, especially since to create one requires the unification of three things: mind, heart, and soul.
If a pair of lovers cannot unite these three, then it cannot form, and they will suffer backlash instead."
Lin Moxian's jaw dropped after hearing that, especially since there were dozens of white lotuses inside Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s soul, which meant he had dozens of women by his side.
"Oh god!
I feel pathetic!
I've lived for thousands of years, but I've never had a lover!
But you, my junior brother who is only 10 years old, have dozens of women by your side!
If my other junior brothers and junior sisters knew about this, they would laugh and mock me endlessly!"
"Pftt!" Hong Xinxin and the three women burst into laughter listening to Lin Moxian.
'This guy is quite funny.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] inwardly said with an amused smile.
"Senior brother, I don't know all the senior brothers and senior sisters, but I remember that Senior Brother Liangren doesn't have a girlfriend either."
*Clasped*
Lin Moxian clasped his hands.
"Oh!
You're right, Junior Brother!
Qiao Liangren is a virgin like me, so I don't have to worry about them making fun of me!
But how can you get so many women at your current age?
Can you make them all happy?"
"I'm just being myself, and I don't need to do anything strange." Lin Moxian's lips twitched at that.
"Senior Brother, if they weren't happy with me, I wouldn't be able to create so many white lotuses in my soul."
"That's right." Lin Moxian then put his arm around Zhang Xiaolong [3] and led him out.
"This is our first meeting, and we are brothers under one master, so I want to get to know you better.
Additionally, I want you to teach me more about women so I can win Xi Hongyan's heart."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] sighed helplessly in his heart as he walked beside Lin Moxian.
"The most important thing is that you have to believe in yourself, and you also have to learn to understand the woman you are targeting."
"Let's talk somewhere else so these women can't eavesdrop on us." Lin Moxian immediately took Zhang Xiaolong [3] away from the Hong Clan.
After their departure, Shang Xinyu proceeded to question Hong Xinxin and Murong Qianying.
"Is that senior's character really like that, Aunts?"
"Yes." Murong Qianying replied with a nod.
"Lin Moxian's character is a bit strange, and he often acts childishly.
Even though he is like that, he is a very loyal person, and he is a cultivator with outstanding talent, or else Hun Di would not have accepted him as his first disciple.
Furthermore, he is the nephew of the alchemist goddess, and Long'er herself is an alchemist, so he is lucky to be able to meet him so soon."
Hong Xinxin then asked her.
"How about we ask Lin Moxian to introduce Long'er to Lin Jingxia, Sister Qianying?
I'm sure she will be amazed by his talent in alchemy, and she might be willing to accept him as her disciple."
"I think you can talk to Lin Moxian once they come back, and I will return to my clan now." After that, Murong Qianying walked out before leaving the Hong clan.
Hong Xinxin and the other two women also left the room, and they took care of their own affairs.

chapters.title: Chapter 765: Soul Fire Origin
paragraphs: 'An undead demon, eh? This is my first time meeting such a demon, but she doesn't seem to have evolved yet.' Zhang Fei [5] muttered as he watched Wang Yin from afar.

[According to the system, an undead demon can evolve twice into a mutated undead demon and a superior undead demon, but their evolution process is much longer than other demons. Are you interested in getting her, Master?]

'Are you crazy, Mei? Wang Yin's demon rank and cultivation are indeed high, but she is no different from a corpse, okay? I wouldn't be so crazy as to have a female corpse by my side, especially since it's too disgusting.'
[Hehehe! Even though she is no different from a corpse, she is quite beautiful and sexy. If you can get her, you—]
'Get that idea out of your mind!' Zhang Fei [5] then looked at the demon emperor. 'Scan him, Mei.'
[All right.]
Name: Shou Fubai
Age: 50,000+ Years Old
Gender: Male
Race: Corruption Demon
Rank: Emperor
Cultivation: 5-Moon Divine Transformation Realm
Element: Darkness
Physique: Undead
Abilities: decay touch, soul corruption, mind corruption, blood corruption, darkness erosion, fallen plague, injury immunity, pain immunity, negative effect immunity, and so on.
Strong: Darkness
Weak: Light
'Oh? Another demon race, but why is his physique an undead?'
[Based on the system's scan, there is no sign of life from Shou Fubai, and Wang Yin probably resurrected him with her corpse puppetry, Master.]

Zhang Fei [5] replied with a nod. 'These two demons have injury immunity, pain immunity, and negative effect immunity. Moreover, they are much stronger than me in demon rank and cultivation, so it will be difficult to defeat them.'

[Master, I think you should mimic Wang Yin's pain immunity and Shou Fubai's negative effect immunity. If you can mimic both of them, you will no longer feel pain, and you will also be immune to negative effects such as control techniques or the like.]

Zhang Fei [5] was tempted to mimic both abilities, but they were too strong for him, and none of his women could help him. Although Hong Xinxin and Murong Qianying's cultivation was on par with theirs, they wouldn't necessarily be able to help him fight them. After all, the demons' physiques are basically stronger than humans', and their abilities would affect them, especially Shou Fubai's corruption abilities. 'Let me approach them first, and I'll mimic their abilities if that's possible.'
[Are you sure you want to approach them now, master?]

'Even though they are much stronger than me, I'm sure they won't be able to match my speed, so you don't need to worry.' Zhang Fei [5] immediately returned to his complete fox form, but he made his form completely black, with two blood-red eyes and one tail.

When Zhang Fei [5] walked towards the Soul Pond, Shou Fubai showed no reaction, but Wang Yin directly suppressed him. The demons standing guard some distance away moved to stop him, but the demon empress ordered them to retreat immediately. "Where did you come from, Little Fox?"

"I came from the Netherworld Realm, and a senior brought me here to train." Zhang Fei [5]'s casual answer surprised Wang Yin, especially since her aura was still pressing him. "Big Sis, can you retract your aura? I just want to soak in this pond after practicing for a long time so I can relieve my fatigue."

Wang Yin immediately retracted her aura, which relieved Zhang Fei [5]. "Isn't the Netherworld Realm just an ordinary demon realm? As far as I know, there are no demon cultivators in that realm, but you are clearly a demon cultivator, and your cultivation is almost at the 7-Star Earth Realm."

"I'm not lying to you, Big Sis." Zhang Fei [5] carefully entered the Soul Pond, but he felt something trying to enter his body. Since the system didn't react to stop it, he fought it and knocked it back before continuing. "The Netherworld Realm is my origin realm, but I left that realm a few years ago because a senior demon brought me to the Abyssal Realm, and she taught me how to cultivate."
"Oh?" Wang Yin was surprised to hear that. "Who brought you to the Abyssal Realm?"
"Are you a demon from the Abyssal Realm, Big Sis?"
Wang Yin shook her head. "I come from the Demon Purgatory Realm, but my realm is not far from the Abyssal Realm, so I am quite familiar with the demons of that realm, especially their demon emperor."
'How many demon realms are there actually in this universe?' Zhang Fei [5] then told her. "My senior is Morgana, the witch demon."
"Oh?" Wang Yin was surprised once again. "Do you really know Morgana? How do you know her? Where is she now?"

'This Wang Yin also knows Morgana, eh?' Zhang Fei [5] then explained to Wang Yin about his encounter with the witch demon, but he didn't explain the truth, especially since he didn't know for sure about the relationship between them. "I don't know where she is now because she left again after she dropped me off in this realm, and she told me she would pick me up in the next few months. Do you have a good relationship with her, Big Sis?"

"Not really." Wang Yin answered with a shake of her head. "I met Morgana a few times in the past, and that witch was quite cunning. Even so, I don't have any problems with her, but I don't have a close relationship with her either. What's your name? You should be able to turn into a human, right?"
"Zhang Xiolong." Zhang Fei [5] then changed to his half-fox form. "I can't transform into a full human yet, and I can only transform to this extent, Big Sis."

Wang Yin immediately pulled Zhang Fei [5] to her side and groped his face, causing him discomfort, especially since her body gave off the smell of a corpse. "Not bad; you are still young and handsome, and I want to take you back to my realm. If you accompany me every day, I will give you lots of good demon resources, and you can reach the archduke rank faster than you should."

'Tch! Do you think I want to accompany a corpse like you? Your body odor is too disgusting, like a rotting carrion.' Zhang Fei [5] immediately rejected her. "I can't do that, Big Sis. Big Sis Morgana will look for me in this realm, so I won't leave here."

"Did I say I would be leaving this realm anytime soon?" Wang Yin responded with a shake of her head. "Many of my men are training in this realm, and I still have to look for the Soul Fire, so I will be staying here for quite some time."

'As expected! These demons also want to get the Soul Fire.' Zhang Fei [5] then asked her. "What is Soul Fire, Big Sis? Why have I never heard of it? Big Sis Morgana didn't tell me anything about it, and she only told me about this pond."

Wang Yin pointed to the wandering souls above them. "They are the souls of all living creatures who died in this realm, and they have been here for thousands of years. I don't know why they keep wandering here, but their existence here gave birth to a phenomenon, which is the soul fire."
"So, the soul fire was born from the burning resentment and will of these wandering souls?"

"Yes." Wang Yin nodded to Zhang Fei [5]. "According to the stories of the old demon cultivators, many of the first wandering souls gathered in the center of this realm because their corpses were buried there, and they vented their deep resentment there, which over time crystallized and burned until the Soul Fire was born. Unfortunately, thousands of years have passed, but no one has managed to find the Soul Fire."

'A fire born from the resentment of countless dead people, huh? Can I really absorb such a fire? Won't their resentment affect me?' Zhang Fei [5] was hesitant about getting the Soul Fire, but he had no other choice but to get it, especially since he would never be able to perfect the Yin-Yang Fire Art without it. "Do you know the history of this realm, Big Sis? Why are there only these wandering souls in this realm?"

"I don't know for sure about that, but the news outside says that a demon from the upper realms killed all the inhabitants of this realm, and the demon cursed their souls so that they ended up as these wandering souls." Zhang Fei [5] immediately guessed the identity of the demon, and Wang Yin's next words proved his guess. "According to the news, the demon is one of the ancient demons from the Abyssal Realm, and if I remember correctly, his name is Xereth."
'Fuck! Xereth again!' Zhang Fei [5] inwardly cursed, but he immediately ignored it. "Big Sis, is it okay for me to absorb the thing in this pond?"

"Oh? Is that thing trying to enter your body?" Zhang Fei [5] nodded to Wang Yin. "It's okay to absorb it, but you must be in control and do it slowly. Otherwise, it will control you and take over your body, and the worst thing is that you will die because it will devour your soul."

Zhang Fei [5] shuddered after hearing that, and he tried to check the inside of the pond, but he couldn't see anything. Mei and his map were also unable to find anything there, which worried him about what might be inside.

'Shit! I'll try to check the inside of this pond later, but I have to wait for Wang Yin and the other demons to leave.' Zhang Fei [5] then looked at Shou Fubai. "By the way, who is this male demon? Why is there no sign of life from him?"

"Hehe." Wang Yin chuckled. "You noticed it, huh? Shou Fubai was my old enemy, and I managed to kill him after we had been enemies for hundreds of years. Since he was a powerful demon and his abilities were quite terrifying to many other demons, I decided to use my puppetry to control his corpse, and he would only move under my command. Since then, my other enemies didn't dare attack me, and I could live peacefully in my corpse kingdom."
"Oh." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "Do you often kill humans and demons, Big Sis?"

Wang Yin shook her head before explaining. "To be honest, I was once a human, but someone turned me into a corpse demon. I don't know the identity of that person because I was already dead at that time, but I suddenly woke up again, and I had become a corpse demon. At first, I had a difficult time accepting my situation, and I tried to commit suicide many times. Unfortunately, I no longer have a soul, and one of my abilities continues to restore my body, so I can never die. In the end, I decided to accept my situation, and I continue to improve myself to protect myself. Therefore, I only kill whoever attacks me first, be they humans or demons, and Shou Fubai is one of them."
"Have you ever tried to find the person who turned you into this?"

"Countless times to no avail." Wang Yin replied with a heavy sigh. "Since I couldn't find that person, I decided to give up, and I haven't tried again since then. By the way, we've wasted a lot of time, so you can start absorbing that thing, but you have to do it carefully, and you have to control it. If it manages to control you, I won't be able to help you, and you'll die."
"I'll try it, Big Sis." Zhang Fei [5] closed his eyes and let that thing enter his body, but he swiftly restricted it and slowly absorbed it. 'Check the thing, Mei.'
[Yes, Master.]

On the other hand, Wang Yin did not immediately resume her activities, and she stared at Zhang Fei [5] while observing his inner body using her senses. Once she was sure that she could control the thing, she closed her eyes and started absorbing it as well. 'This young demon is really interesting! No wonder that witch demon is interested in him, but I remember for sure that she is married to that celestial demon, so I can't guess her reason for approaching this kid.'

"Senior Brother, I have an idea about Shang Xishun."
Lin Moxian turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "What is your idea of that woman?"

"You can make that woman pretend to obey Xi Hongyan, but you have to give control of that woman to someone else, such as Xinxin." Lin Moxian was surprised to hear that. "If Shang Xishun is under her control, she can use her to destroy the Shang Clan, and she can also use her to monitor the Xi Clan."
"Isn't it no different? Whether it's Xinxin or Hongyan who destroys the Shang Clan, the situation in this realm will still be chaotic."

"You're wrong about that, Senior Brother." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then explained. Therefore, Xinxin and the Hong Clan should destroy the Shang Clan and let Grandpa Hong inherit its possessions, which will benefit them and their alliance."

sentences.text: 'An undead demon, eh?
This is my first time meeting such a demon, but she doesn't seem to have evolved yet.' Zhang Fei [5] muttered as he watched Wang Yin from afar.
[According to the system, an undead demon can evolve twice into a mutated undead demon and a superior undead demon, but their evolution process is much longer than other demons.
Are you interested in getting her, Master?]
'Are you crazy, Mei?
Wang Yin's demon rank and cultivation are indeed high, but she is no different from a corpse, okay?
I wouldn't be so crazy as to have a female corpse by my side, especially since it's too disgusting.'
[Hehehe!
Even though she is no different from a corpse, she is quite beautiful and sexy.
If you can get her, you—]
'Get that idea out of your mind!' Zhang Fei [5] then looked at the demon emperor. 'Scan him, Mei.'
[All right.]
Name: Shou Fubai
Age: 50,000+ Years Old
Gender: Male
Race: Corruption Demon
Rank: Emperor
Cultivation: 5-Moon Divine Transformation Realm
Element: Darkness
Physique: Undead
Abilities: decay touch, soul corruption, mind corruption, blood corruption, darkness erosion, fallen plague, injury immunity, pain immunity, negative effect immunity, and so on.
Strong: Darkness
Weak: Light
'Oh?
Another demon race, but why is his physique an undead?'
[Based on the system's scan, there is no sign of life from Shou Fubai, and Wang Yin probably resurrected him with her corpse puppetry, Master.]
Zhang Fei [5] replied with a nod. 'These two demons have injury immunity, pain immunity, and negative effect immunity.
Moreover, they are much stronger than me in demon rank and cultivation, so it will be difficult to defeat them.'
[Master, I think you should mimic Wang Yin's pain immunity and Shou Fubai's negative effect immunity.
If you can mimic both of them, you will no longer feel pain, and you will also be immune to negative effects such as control techniques or the like.]
Zhang Fei [5] was tempted to mimic both abilities, but they were too strong for him, and none of his women could help him.
Although Hong Xinxin and Murong Qianying's cultivation was on par with theirs, they wouldn't necessarily be able to help him fight them.

After all, the demons' physiques are basically stronger than humans', and their abilities would affect them, especially Shou Fubai's corruption abilities. 'Let me approach them first, and I'll mimic their abilities if that's possible.'
[Are you sure you want to approach them now, master?]

'Even though they are much stronger than me, I'm sure they won't be able to match my speed, so you don't need to worry.' Zhang Fei [5] immediately returned to his complete fox form, but he made his form completely black, with two blood-red eyes and one tail.
When Zhang Fei [5] walked towards the Soul Pond, Shou Fubai showed no reaction, but Wang Yin directly suppressed him.
The demons standing guard some distance away moved to stop him, but the demon empress ordered them to retreat immediately.
"Where did you come from, Little Fox?"
"I came from the Netherworld Realm, and a senior brought me here to train." Zhang Fei [5]'s casual answer surprised Wang Yin, especially since her aura was still pressing him.
"Big Sis, can you retract your aura?
I just want to soak in this pond after practicing for a long time so I can relieve my fatigue."
Wang Yin immediately retracted her aura, which relieved Zhang Fei [5].
"Isn't the Netherworld Realm just an ordinary demon realm?
As far as I know, there are no demon cultivators in that realm, but you are clearly a demon cultivator, and your cultivation is almost at the 7-Star Earth Realm."
"I'm not lying to you, Big Sis." Zhang Fei [5] carefully entered the Soul Pond, but he felt something trying to enter his body.
Since the system didn't react to stop it, he fought it and knocked it back before continuing.
"The Netherworld Realm is my origin realm, but I left that realm a few years ago because a senior demon brought me to the Abyssal Realm, and she taught me how to cultivate."
"Oh?" Wang Yin was surprised to hear that.
"Who brought you to the Abyssal Realm?"
"Are you a demon from the Abyssal Realm, Big Sis?"
Wang Yin shook her head.
"I come from the Demon Purgatory Realm, but my realm is not far from the Abyssal Realm, so I am quite familiar with the demons of that realm, especially their demon emperor."
'How many demon realms are there actually in this universe?' Zhang Fei [5] then told her.
"My senior is Morgana, the witch demon."
"Oh?" Wang Yin was surprised once again.
"Do you really know Morgana?
How do you know her?
Where is she now?"

'This Wang Yin also knows Morgana, eh?' Zhang Fei [5] then explained to Wang Yin about his encounter with the witch demon, but he didn't explain the truth, especially since he didn't know for sure about the relationship between them.
"I don't know where she is now because she left again after she dropped me off in this realm, and she told me she would pick me up in the next few months.
Do you have a good relationship with her, Big Sis?"
"Not really." Wang Yin answered with a shake of her head.
"I met Morgana a few times in the past, and that witch was quite cunning.
Even so, I don't have any problems with her, but I don't have a close relationship with her either.
What's your name?
You should be able to turn into a human, right?"
"Zhang Xiolong." Zhang Fei [5] then changed to his half-fox form.
"I can't transform into a full human yet, and I can only transform to this extent, Big Sis."
Wang Yin immediately pulled Zhang Fei [5] to her side and groped his face, causing him discomfort, especially since her body gave off the smell of a corpse.
"Not bad; you are still young and handsome, and I want to take you back to my realm.
If you accompany me every day, I will give you lots of good demon resources, and you can reach the archduke rank faster than you should."
'Tch!
Do you think I want to accompany a corpse like you?
Your body odor is too disgusting, like a rotting carrion.' Zhang Fei [5] immediately rejected her.
"I can't do that, Big Sis.
Big Sis Morgana will look for me in this realm, so I won't leave here."
"Did I say I would be leaving this realm anytime soon?" Wang Yin responded with a shake of her head.
"Many of my men are training in this realm, and I still have to look for the Soul Fire, so I will be staying here for quite some time."
'As expected!
These demons also want to get the Soul Fire.' Zhang Fei [5] then asked her.
"What is Soul Fire, Big Sis?
Why have I never heard of it?
Big Sis Morgana didn't tell me anything about it, and she only told me about this pond."
Wang Yin pointed to the wandering souls above them.
"They are the souls of all living creatures who died in this realm, and they have been here for thousands of years.
I don't know why they keep wandering here, but their existence here gave birth to a phenomenon, which is the soul fire."
"So, the soul fire was born from the burning resentment and will of these wandering souls?"
"Yes." Wang Yin nodded to Zhang Fei [5].

"According to the stories of the old demon cultivators, many of the first wandering souls gathered in the center of this realm because their corpses were buried there, and they vented their deep resentment there, which over time crystallized and burned until the Soul Fire was born.
Unfortunately, thousands of years have passed, but no one has managed to find the Soul Fire."
'A fire born from the resentment of countless dead people, huh?
Can I really absorb such a fire?

Won't their resentment affect me?' Zhang Fei [5] was hesitant about getting the Soul Fire, but he had no other choice but to get it, especially since he would never be able to perfect the Yin-Yang Fire Art without it.
"Do you know the history of this realm, Big Sis?
Why are there only these wandering souls in this realm?"

"I don't know for sure about that, but the news outside says that a demon from the upper realms killed all the inhabitants of this realm, and the demon cursed their souls so that they ended up as these wandering souls." Zhang Fei [5] immediately guessed the identity of the demon, and Wang Yin's next words proved his guess.
"According to the news, the demon is one of the ancient demons from the Abyssal Realm, and if I remember correctly, his name is Xereth."
'Fuck!
Xereth again!' Zhang Fei [5] inwardly cursed, but he immediately ignored it.
"Big Sis, is it okay for me to absorb the thing in this pond?"
"Oh?
Is that thing trying to enter your body?" Zhang Fei [5] nodded to Wang Yin.
"It's okay to absorb it, but you must be in control and do it slowly.
Otherwise, it will control you and take over your body, and the worst thing is that you will die because it will devour your soul."
Zhang Fei [5] shuddered after hearing that, and he tried to check the inside of the pond, but he couldn't see anything.
Mei and his map were also unable to find anything there, which worried him about what might be inside.
'Shit!
I'll try to check the inside of this pond later, but I have to wait for Wang Yin and the other demons to leave.' Zhang Fei [5] then looked at Shou Fubai.
"By the way, who is this male demon?
Why is there no sign of life from him?"
"Hehe." Wang Yin chuckled.
"You noticed it, huh?
Shou Fubai was my old enemy, and I managed to kill him after we had been enemies for hundreds of years.
Since he was a powerful demon and his abilities were quite terrifying to many other demons, I decided to use my puppetry to control his corpse, and he would only move under my command.
Since then, my other enemies didn't dare attack me, and I could live peacefully in my corpse kingdom."
"Oh." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding.
"Do you often kill humans and demons, Big Sis?"
Wang Yin shook her head before explaining.
"To be honest, I was once a human, but someone turned me into a corpse demon.
I don't know the identity of that person because I was already dead at that time, but I suddenly woke up again, and I had become a corpse demon.
At first, I had a difficult time accepting my situation, and I tried to commit suicide many times.
Unfortunately, I no longer have a soul, and one of my abilities continues to restore my body, so I can never die.
In the end, I decided to accept my situation, and I continue to improve myself to protect myself.
Therefore, I only kill whoever attacks me first, be they humans or demons, and Shou Fubai is one of them."
"Have you ever tried to find the person who turned you into this?"
"Countless times to no avail." Wang Yin replied with a heavy sigh.
"Since I couldn't find that person, I decided to give up, and I haven't tried again since then.
By the way, we've wasted a lot of time, so you can start absorbing that thing, but you have to do it carefully, and you have to control it.
If it manages to control you, I won't be able to help you, and you'll die."
"I'll try it, Big Sis." Zhang Fei [5] closed his eyes and let that thing enter his body, but he swiftly restricted it and slowly absorbed it. 'Check the thing, Mei.'
[Yes, Master.]
On the other hand, Wang Yin did not immediately resume her activities, and she stared at Zhang Fei [5] while observing his inner body using her senses.
Once she was sure that she could control the thing, she closed her eyes and started absorbing it as well. 'This young demon is really interesting!
No wonder that witch demon is interested in him, but I remember for sure that she is married to that celestial demon, so I can't guess her reason for approaching this kid.'

chapters.title: Chapter 766: Zhou Shenxin The Empress
paragraphs: While his other two clones were busy with other matters, Zhang Fei was in the Zhou Kingdom. With a faint smile, he glanced at Zhou Xiaochuan, who stood frustrated in his throne room.

At first, Zhang Fei thought of waiting for his cultivation to break through to the Heaven Realm before cleaning up the Zhou Kingdom. However, he changed his mind after his conversation with Ma Kuangyu a month ago, and he decided to cure Zhou Xiaochuan because Zhou Shenxin needed him for the process of transferring power in their kingdom.
Zhou Xiaochuan continued to wear a gloomy face, especially after Zhang Fei told him his plans for today's event. Unfortunately, he was his slave, and it was impossible for him to disobey his orders.

Additionally, Zhou Xiaochuan had received information that the entire area of his kingdom had been occupied and controlled by troops from the Yun and Zhou Kingdoms since a month ago, and all his subordinates were already under Zhang Fei's control, making his status as emperor just an empty one.

After Zhou Shenxin prepared everything in the past month, Zhang Fei ordered all the royal family members of the Zhou Kingdom to gather in the throne room. Additionally, he ordered Zhou Xiaochuan to summon all the ministers, nobles, and clan leaders in the kingdom to attend, especially since he wanted to push her to the throne today.

Seeing Zhou Xiaochuan not sitting on his throne, the people lining up on the right side of the throne room began to wonder in their hearts about today's events, especially since he had not explained in detail his reasons for summoning them. On the left side of the throne room, two large tables with many chairs were available, but strangely, their emperor did not allow them to sit there.
*Tap... Tap... Tap...*

The ministers, nobles, and clan leaders immediately turned their attention toward the door after hearing the footsteps of many people from outside. They were shocked when they saw the royal members of the Xian and Yun Kingdoms walking into the throne room, which had never happened since Zhou Xiaochuan ascended the throne as their emperor.

The presence of another person was something they least expected, especially since they had long heard that Linghu Yingchen had fallen into Huangfu Shou's control. Moreover, they also heard that her three children disappeared after the Star Tower a few months ago, and no one knew their traces, but the four of them suddenly appeared today.

Xian Feng and the others immediately sat neatly on the sides of the two large tables, but they did not say anything and only looked at the expressions of the people present in the room, especially Zhou Xiaochuan's expression, which became even worse after their arrival.

After everyone gathered, Zhang Fei decided to enter the throne room, accompanied by all his wives, which shocked those people again. They knew that he was the husband of Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue, but they had never known about his relationship with Zhou Shenxin.

Unlike Xian Feing and the others, Zhang Fei and all his wives did not sit with them. Instead, he led them to the throne, which caused those people to frown. However, he did not sit on the throne and stood beside it, while all his wives stood behind it, anticipating the culmination of the event.

Zhang Fei watched those ministers, nobles, and clan leaders for a while before starting to speak. "I'm sure all of you have many questions about today's event, right? You guys don't need to be too curious about it because you will get the answers soon, and today's event will greatly change the future of this kingdom."
*Chatter... Chatter...*

Those people started whispering to each other, and one of them wanted to ask Zhang Fei. However, they suddenly heard the sound of several trumpets being sounded, and they heard some heavy footsteps from outside, so they once again looked in that direction.
Before long, Zhou Shenxin walked into the throne room, but her appearance shocked and confused them, especially since she looked like a crownless empress.

Dong Feiling leisurely walked on Zhou Shenxin's right side while carrying a tray covered in green cloth, but they could guess that it was her crown, especially since she wasn't wearing it. Meanwhile, Jiang Tingxi walked on her daughter's left side, and Zhou Xiaochuan's other concubines followed behind them.

Those people were shocked again when they arrived in front of the throne, and Zhou Shenxin was standing right in front of it. They finally realized what was going to happen next, and it was proven by Dong Feiling, who opened the green cloth covering the crown.
Dong Feiling stared at those people for some time before speaking. "My husband and I summoned you all here today to announce our decision, and we have decided to step down from our throne."

"What?" All of them exclaimed in shock, and they wanted to protest because they had always considered women unworthy of having important roles, let alone being the leader of their kingdom. "Empress, what—"

"Silence!" Zhang Fei shouted and released his killing intent, but he only directed it at the ministers, nobles, and clan leaders, suffocating them. "Like I said before, today's event will greatly change the future of this kingdom, and you should be aware of what I mean by now. Unlike you guys, I respect women very much because I was born from a woman, and there are so many influential women in my home realm or in this realm. From today on, Zhou Shenxin will ascend the throne and become the empress of this kingdom, and I don't want to hear any objections from anyone. Whoever dares to resist and rebel against her, I will eliminate that person's family without exception, so you must think carefully about your choice."

Hearing that, Zhou Xiaochuan clenched his fists tightly, especially since he would lose everything soon. Not only did he lose his throne, but he also lost his entire family because they sided with Zhang Fei and Zhou Shenxin, and he was powerless to fight back because of the slave mark in his soul.
Zhang Fei then withdrew his killing intent and turned to Dong Feiling. "Proceed with the coronation."
"Yes." Dong Feiling then called one of the old ministers and ordered him to carry out the coronation ceremony of Zhou Shenxin as the empress of their kingdom.

The old minister did not want Zhou Shenxin to become their empress, but his family was much more important to him, and he did not want them to be slaughtered by Zhang Fei. Moreover, he could see that Zhou Xiaochuan couldn't do anything to stop it, making him realize that he had already done something to him.

The old minister, with a heavy heart, initiated the coronation ceremony in accordance with their kingdom's tradition. Once everything was complete, he placed the crown on Zhou Shenxin's head, thereby establishing her as their official empress.

Xian Feng and the guests present applauded after the coronation ceremony was over, as did Zhang Fei and all his wives. Dong Feiling and Zhou Xiaochuan also congratulated Zhou Shenxin, and they publicly announced their support for her.
Although those people still did not accept Zhou Shenxin as their empress, their fear of Zhang Fei forced them to applaud her enthronement, and they began to congratulate her.

Zhou Shenxin's first act as an empress was not to give a speech to her people, but instead, she pulled Zhang Fei to her side and kissed him before the people's eyes, proclaiming that he was her future husband. Those people finally realized their relationship, which implicitly declared him as their emperor.
They briefly kissed before Zhang Fei separated their lips. "It's time for you to give your first speech as the empress."

"Yeah." Zhou Shenxin then faced the people and began to speak to them. "I know all of you are not ready to accept me as your empress, and I also know that you guys feel pressured by my future husband. To be honest, I have never thought about becoming an empress, but I have been too fed up and disgusted with your treatment of me or other women. Unfortunately, I don't have the power to change the traditions that have been ingrained since the founding of this kingdom, and the only way for me to change them is to take over my father's position. As my future husband explains that to me, I was still doubtful at first, but I decided to accept his idea, and I have become the empress of this kingdom now."
Hearing that, those people looked at Zhang Fei, and there was a glimmer of hatred in their eyes. However, he didn't care about them, and he once again determined them with his killing intent.

Zhou Shengxin continued straight away. "From today on, all women in this kingdom will have the same rights and positions as men, and I no longer want to see any woman tortured or sold into slavery. Any man who dares to go against my orders, I will sentence them to death. Do you all understand?"
"Yes, Empress!"
Xian Feng, Shi Qingzhuang, Yun Shang, Guo Xuehua, and Linghu Yincheng immediately walked to the throne and stood on either side of Zhou Shenxin.

Zhou Shenxin then spoke to her people again. "In the past, our kingdom has always been hostile to theirs, especially since my father has always had the ambition to become the sole ruler of this island. For hundreds of years, there have been so many victims who fell due to war between kingdoms, and many families suffered after losing their loved ones on the battlefield. However, everything will change from today onward, and the four kingdoms will work together to maintain peace on this island, so war will no longer be necessary."

Although those people did not like Zhou Shenxin as their empress, they liked her idea of ending the war between kingdoms because many of their families had also died due to war in the past, so they longed for peace.

"Unfortunately, we still cannot achieve absolute peace because Huangfu Shou and his Huangfu Kingdom still exist on this island, and he has several powerful backers behind him." They looked at Zhou Shenxin seriously after she mentioned that, but they then glanced at Zhang Fei, who was smiling casually. "They are strong, but we are not alone now, and the four kingdoms will fight together to bring down that kingdom. Sooner or later, that kingdom will surely fall, and we will have absolute peace then."

After that, Zhou Shenxin conveyed to them some of her orders for the residents of the Zhou Kingdom, and she also ordered them to spread the news about his ascension. She then gave Xian Feng, Yun Shang, and Linghu Yincheng to speak to her people.

After everything was done, the people immediately left the Zhou Royal Palace to carry out Zhou Shenxin's orders, but they did not expect that the capital was already filled with Zhou Xiaochuan's former generals, and Zhang Fei deliberately placed them there to control the situation in case the residents could not accept the news.

Zhang Fei then sent all his wives back to the training space, and he also sent the other people to their respective places. Jiang Tingxi led Dong Feiling and others to leave the throne room, and they began to prepare for their royal wedding.

Zhou Xiaochuan left with Zhang Fei's other slaves, but his mind was still occupied with how to reverse the situation. Unfortunately, everything was too late for him, especially since his master already had plans for him.

After they all left, Zhou Shenxin sighed in relief, but Zhang Fei, who was already seated on the throne, immediately pulled her into his lap and hugged her. "How do you feel after becoming an empress?"

"I don't feel the slightest bit happy, but I have no other choice." Zhou Shenxin then put her arms around his neck. "Even if you don't want it, you will still be the emperor of this kingdom after we get married. Moreover, I won't be able to face everything by myself, so you must always help me face it."

"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled. "You are my empress wife, and I gave you the idea for this. Therefore, I will always help you in royal affairs, but I will refrain from public appearances and instead assist you discreetly."
"That's fine with me." Zhou Shenxin then asked. "What are your next plans for the Huangfu Kingdom? You haven't been to that kingdom in the last month, right?"

Zhang Fei shook his head. "I haven't been to the kingdom for the past month, but Du She has kept me informed of the situation there. As for my next plan for Huangfu Shou, I can't decide right now because Wushuang told me that Li Tiannan contacted the Huangfu Clan's ancestor because of Huangfu Fanbo's matter, and they will be arriving in this realm soon. I will observe their situation first, and I will decide everything depending on their actions."
"Do you think they will attack us?" Zhou Shenxin inquired with a hint of fear in her voice, particularly considering the formidable strength of the Huangfu Clan from the Grand Royal Realm.

Zhang Fei kissed Zhou Shenxin before calming her down. "You don't need to be afraid about them, okay? I've discussed this matter with Grandpa Hong and the others since a month ago, and they are willing to help us if Huangfu Shou's ancestors and their people attack us. Additionally, my third clone met one of my senior brothers today, and he is a great man. If necessary, I will ask for his help to help us, and those people will not dare to do anything against us."

If he is willing to introduce you to his aunt, I'm sure you will become even more skilled in alchemy."

"The world of alchemy is more complicated than that of ordinary cultivators, and I am not close to my senior brother yet, so I have no intention of asking him to take me to his aunt yet." Zhang Fei then lowered Zhou Shenxin from his lap before giving her a gentle kiss. "I will go to the Huangfu Kingdom now, and I will prepare to break through to the 7-Star Earth Realm after that."
"All right." After Zhang Fei disappeared, Zhou Shenxin went straight to Jiang Tingxi, Dong Feiling, and the others to discuss some things with them.

Zhang Fei immediately entered the invisible state and sneaked into Huangfu Shou's room, where he found him talking to Helian Yueyi.

"What exactly happened to you, husband? Why do I feel like you've become more and more strange lately?" Helian Yueyi asked with concern. "Moreover, I started to feel your strange changes three months ago, but at first I thought it was because you were thinking too much about our kingdom affairs."

Huangfu Shou shook his head at her. "I'm probably too exhausted from thinking about royal affairs and the condition of our two daughters, so I often forget things. I just need a lot of rest, and my condition will recover by itself."
"Are you sure about that?"
"Yes."

"In that case, you can rest now, and I will check the condition of our two daughters." Huangfu Shou immediately closed his eyes after his wife left, but Helian Yueyi still felt that something was wrong with him. 'Did that mysterious guy do something to my husband? Where did he disappear to? Why hasn't he shown up in the past month?'

Before long, Helian Yueyi had arrived at her two daughters' room, but she was still confused about their condition. The black liquid had disappeared from their bodies a month ago, but they still had not woken up from their sleep.
Just as she was thinking about that, Helian Yueyi was startled by someone's hug, but her face darkened when Zhang Fei asked. "Did you miss me, peeping empress?"

sentences.text: While his other two clones were busy with other matters, Zhang Fei was in the Zhou Kingdom.
With a faint smile, he glanced at Zhou Xiaochuan, who stood frustrated in his throne room.
At first, Zhang Fei thought of waiting for his cultivation to break through to the Heaven Realm before cleaning up the Zhou Kingdom.

However, he changed his mind after his conversation with Ma Kuangyu a month ago, and he decided to cure Zhou Xiaochuan because Zhou Shenxin needed him for the process of transferring power in their kingdom.
Zhou Xiaochuan continued to wear a gloomy face, especially after Zhang Fei told him his plans for today's event.
Unfortunately, he was his slave, and it was impossible for him to disobey his orders.

Additionally, Zhou Xiaochuan had received information that the entire area of his kingdom had been occupied and controlled by troops from the Yun and Zhou Kingdoms since a month ago, and all his subordinates were already under Zhang Fei's control, making his status as emperor just an empty one.
After Zhou Shenxin prepared everything in the past month, Zhang Fei ordered all the royal family members of the Zhou Kingdom to gather in the throne room.
Additionally, he ordered Zhou Xiaochuan to summon all the ministers, nobles, and clan leaders in the kingdom to attend, especially since he wanted to push her to the throne today.

Seeing Zhou Xiaochuan not sitting on his throne, the people lining up on the right side of the throne room began to wonder in their hearts about today's events, especially since he had not explained in detail his reasons for summoning them.
On the left side of the throne room, two large tables with many chairs were available, but strangely, their emperor did not allow them to sit there.
*Tap...
Tap...
Tap...*
The ministers, nobles, and clan leaders immediately turned their attention toward the door after hearing the footsteps of many people from outside.
They were shocked when they saw the royal members of the Xian and Yun Kingdoms walking into the throne room, which had never happened since Zhou Xiaochuan ascended the throne as their emperor.
The presence of another person was something they least expected, especially since they had long heard that Linghu Yingchen had fallen into Huangfu Shou's control.
Moreover, they also heard that her three children disappeared after the Star Tower a few months ago, and no one knew their traces, but the four of them suddenly appeared today.

Xian Feng and the others immediately sat neatly on the sides of the two large tables, but they did not say anything and only looked at the expressions of the people present in the room, especially Zhou Xiaochuan's expression, which became even worse after their arrival.
After everyone gathered, Zhang Fei decided to enter the throne room, accompanied by all his wives, which shocked those people again.
They knew that he was the husband of Xian Xianqin and Yun Xinyue, but they had never known about his relationship with Zhou Shenxin.
Unlike Xian Feing and the others, Zhang Fei and all his wives did not sit with them.
Instead, he led them to the throne, which caused those people to frown.
However, he did not sit on the throne and stood beside it, while all his wives stood behind it, anticipating the culmination of the event.
Zhang Fei watched those ministers, nobles, and clan leaders for a while before starting to speak.
"I'm sure all of you have many questions about today's event, right?
You guys don't need to be too curious about it because you will get the answers soon, and today's event will greatly change the future of this kingdom."
*Chatter...
Chatter...*
Those people started whispering to each other, and one of them wanted to ask Zhang Fei.
However, they suddenly heard the sound of several trumpets being sounded, and they heard some heavy footsteps from outside, so they once again looked in that direction.
Before long, Zhou Shenxin walked into the throne room, but her appearance shocked and confused them, especially since she looked like a crownless empress.
Dong Feiling leisurely walked on Zhou Shenxin's right side while carrying a tray covered in green cloth, but they could guess that it was her crown, especially since she wasn't wearing it.
Meanwhile, Jiang Tingxi walked on her daughter's left side, and Zhou Xiaochuan's other concubines followed behind them.
Those people were shocked again when they arrived in front of the throne, and Zhou Shenxin was standing right in front of it.
They finally realized what was going to happen next, and it was proven by Dong Feiling, who opened the green cloth covering the crown.
Dong Feiling stared at those people for some time before speaking.
"My husband and I summoned you all here today to announce our decision, and we have decided to step down from our throne."
"What?" All of them exclaimed in shock, and they wanted to protest because they had always considered women unworthy of having important roles, let alone being the leader of their kingdom.
"Empress, what—"
"Silence!" Zhang Fei shouted and released his killing intent, but he only directed it at the ministers, nobles, and clan leaders, suffocating them.
"Like I said before, today's event will greatly change the future of this kingdom, and you should be aware of what I mean by now.
Unlike you guys, I respect women very much because I was born from a woman, and there are so many influential women in my home realm or in this realm.
From today on, Zhou Shenxin will ascend the throne and become the empress of this kingdom, and I don't want to hear any objections from anyone.
Whoever dares to resist and rebel against her, I will eliminate that person's family without exception, so you must think carefully about your choice."
Hearing that, Zhou Xiaochuan clenched his fists tightly, especially since he would lose everything soon.
Not only did he lose his throne, but he also lost his entire family because they sided with Zhang Fei and Zhou Shenxin, and he was powerless to fight back because of the slave mark in his soul.
Zhang Fei then withdrew his killing intent and turned to Dong Feiling.
"Proceed with the coronation."
"Yes." Dong Feiling then called one of the old ministers and ordered him to carry out the coronation ceremony of Zhou Shenxin as the empress of their kingdom.
The old minister did not want Zhou Shenxin to become their empress, but his family was much more important to him, and he did not want them to be slaughtered by Zhang Fei.
Moreover, he could see that Zhou Xiaochuan couldn't do anything to stop it, making him realize that he had already done something to him.
The old minister, with a heavy heart, initiated the coronation ceremony in accordance with their kingdom's tradition.
Once everything was complete, he placed the crown on Zhou Shenxin's head, thereby establishing her as their official empress.
Xian Feng and the guests present applauded after the coronation ceremony was over, as did Zhang Fei and all his wives.
Dong Feiling and Zhou Xiaochuan also congratulated Zhou Shenxin, and they publicly announced their support for her.
Although those people still did not accept Zhou Shenxin as their empress, their fear of Zhang Fei forced them to applaud her enthronement, and they began to congratulate her.

Zhou Shenxin's first act as an empress was not to give a speech to her people, but instead, she pulled Zhang Fei to her side and kissed him before the people's eyes, proclaiming that he was her future husband.
Those people finally realized their relationship, which implicitly declared him as their emperor.
They briefly kissed before Zhang Fei separated their lips.
"It's time for you to give your first speech as the empress."
"Yeah." Zhou Shenxin then faced the people and began to speak to them.
"I know all of you are not ready to accept me as your empress, and I also know that you guys feel pressured by my future husband.
To be honest, I have never thought about becoming an empress, but I have been too fed up and disgusted with your treatment of me or other women.

Unfortunately, I don't have the power to change the traditions that have been ingrained since the founding of this kingdom, and the only way for me to change them is to take over my father's position.
As my future husband explains that to me, I was still doubtful at first, but I decided to accept his idea, and I have become the empress of this kingdom now."
Hearing that, those people looked at Zhang Fei, and there was a glimmer of hatred in their eyes.
However, he didn't care about them, and he once again determined them with his killing intent.
Zhou Shengxin continued straight away.
"From today on, all women in this kingdom will have the same rights and positions as men, and I no longer want to see any woman tortured or sold into slavery.
Any man who dares to go against my orders, I will sentence them to death.
Do you all understand?"
"Yes, Empress!"
Xian Feng, Shi Qingzhuang, Yun Shang, Guo Xuehua, and Linghu Yincheng immediately walked to the throne and stood on either side of Zhou Shenxin.
Zhou Shenxin then spoke to her people again.
"In the past, our kingdom has always been hostile to theirs, especially since my father has always had the ambition to become the sole ruler of this island.
For hundreds of years, there have been so many victims who fell due to war between kingdoms, and many families suffered after losing their loved ones on the battlefield.
However, everything will change from today onward, and the four kingdoms will work together to maintain peace on this island, so war will no longer be necessary."

Although those people did not like Zhou Shenxin as their empress, they liked her idea of ending the war between kingdoms because many of their families had also died due to war in the past, so they longed for peace.

"Unfortunately, we still cannot achieve absolute peace because Huangfu Shou and his Huangfu Kingdom still exist on this island, and he has several powerful backers behind him." They looked at Zhou Shenxin seriously after she mentioned that, but they then glanced at Zhang Fei, who was smiling casually.
"They are strong, but we are not alone now, and the four kingdoms will fight together to bring down that kingdom.
Sooner or later, that kingdom will surely fall, and we will have absolute peace then."
After that, Zhou Shenxin conveyed to them some of her orders for the residents of the Zhou Kingdom, and she also ordered them to spread the news about his ascension.
She then gave Xian Feng, Yun Shang, and Linghu Yincheng to speak to her people.

After everything was done, the people immediately left the Zhou Royal Palace to carry out Zhou Shenxin's orders, but they did not expect that the capital was already filled with Zhou Xiaochuan's former generals, and Zhang Fei deliberately placed them there to control the situation in case the residents could not accept the news.
Zhang Fei then sent all his wives back to the training space, and he also sent the other people to their respective places.
Jiang Tingxi led Dong Feiling and others to leave the throne room, and they began to prepare for their royal wedding.
Zhou Xiaochuan left with Zhang Fei's other slaves, but his mind was still occupied with how to reverse the situation.
Unfortunately, everything was too late for him, especially since his master already had plans for him.
After they all left, Zhou Shenxin sighed in relief, but Zhang Fei, who was already seated on the throne, immediately pulled her into his lap and hugged her.
"How do you feel after becoming an empress?"
"I don't feel the slightest bit happy, but I have no other choice." Zhou Shenxin then put her arms around his neck.
"Even if you don't want it, you will still be the emperor of this kingdom after we get married.
Moreover, I won't be able to face everything by myself, so you must always help me face it."
"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled.
"You are my empress wife, and I gave you the idea for this.
Therefore, I will always help you in royal affairs, but I will refrain from public appearances and instead assist you discreetly."
"That's fine with me." Zhou Shenxin then asked.
"What are your next plans for the Huangfu Kingdom?
You haven't been to that kingdom in the last month, right?"
Zhang Fei shook his head.
"I haven't been to the kingdom for the past month, but Du She has kept me informed of the situation there.

As for my next plan for Huangfu Shou, I can't decide right now because Wushuang told me that Li Tiannan contacted the Huangfu Clan's ancestor because of Huangfu Fanbo's matter, and they will be arriving in this realm soon.
I will observe their situation first, and I will decide everything depending on their actions."
"Do you think they will attack us?" Zhou Shenxin inquired with a hint of fear in her voice, particularly considering the formidable strength of the Huangfu Clan from the Grand Royal Realm.
Zhang Fei kissed Zhou Shenxin before calming her down.

If necessary, I will ask for his help to help us, and those people will not dare to do anything against us."

chapters.title: Chapter 767: To The Xi Clan
paragraphs: "You—"
"You what?" Zhang Fei let go of Helian Yueyi and sat on the side of the bed. "Are you still unaware of your situation?"
Helian Yueyi frowned. "What do you mean by that?"

"A month and a half have passed since we last met, and I have given you a chance to save yourself and your children. Unfortunately, you still haven't decided on the matter, and your time is rapidly running out." Helian Yueyi clenched his fists as he glared at Zhang Fei, especially since it was impossible for him to kill Huangfu Shou. "Zhou Shenxin has just ascended the throne, so she is the empress of the Zhou Kingdom now."
Helian Yueyi was completely shocked listening to Zhang Fei's revelation. "What? Why didn't I hear the news?"

"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled. "Naturally, you wouldn't hear that because I already got rid of all your husband's spies long ago, and Zhou Shenxin had everything ready since last month. Additionally, I have also gotten rid of all his spies in the Bai Kingdom since three months ago, and all the major clans of that kingdom have become my subordinates now."
Helian Yueyi froze in her spot after she heard that, and she did not expect that Zhang Fei had moved so quickly. "Does Linghu Yincheng's disappearance have anything to do with you?"

"Isn't that obvious?" Zhang Fei asked her back. "Li Tiannan used the Gu Insect on Linghu Yincheng and her husband, but I managed to free her, and she is in a safe place with her three children. I haven't been able to free Bai Yaowei yet, but it won't be long. This way, the four kingdoms are already by my side, and only your kingdom is left. By the way, you should not say anything to that guy and your husband, unless you want to lose your two daughters, especially since they are in my hands now."
"Why are you doing this? What are you doing to them?" Helian Yueyi asked in a high voice.

"I was never interested in attacking defenseless women, so I didn't do anything to them." Zhang Fei turned to the two women, who were still sound asleep and rubbing their cheeks. "Instead, I imprisoned their subconscious in the dreamland, and I gave them sweet dreams, so they weren't tormented by the effects of the black liquid back then."

After several months, Helian Yueyi finally got the answer to why her two daughters were falling asleep for so long. She remembered that they had been very calm since they fell into deep slumber, and they had not experienced the slightest pain in the past, but she was also shocked to hear that Zhang Fei could do such a thing. "Can you release them? I miss them so much, so I want to talk to them."
"Why should I release them?" Zhang Fei looked at Helian Yueyi again. "After you successfully kill Huangfu Shou, I will release your two daughters then."
"You—" Helian Yueyi swallowed her words. Her eyes widened as her body trembled, and she subconsciously took several steps back. "You... you are a demon!"

Zhang Fei, who was already in his demon form, got up from the bed and walked in front of Helian Yueyi. He lifted her chin and stared at her eyes with his blood-red eyes. "I am a demon, not a saint, and I will never do anything unless it benefits me. I will never harm you or your two daughters, and all I want is your husband's life, so you can choose between his life or theirs. If I kill him myself, then they will accompany him."
"Why? Why are you doing this to me? Why are you forcing me to choose between their lives?" Helian Yueyi asked him in a trembling voice as tears flowed down from the corners of her eyes.

"Didn't your husband want to capture and control my son before? Have you ever thought about the people you and your husband have persecuted and oppressed for the past few hundred years?" Zhang Fei turned the question around. "Fortunately, my son is different from them, and he has several strong protectors by his side; otherwise, he would have fallen into the hands of you two. Since you and your husband like to do such things, you can consider this incident as the karma of the two of you. If you can hand over his life to me, I will let you and your children go. I will never bother your life anymore, and you can live a new, more peaceful life with your children."

Helian Yueyi's lips opened and closed several times, and she wanted to refute Zhang Fei's words, but no words came out to refute him, especially since she herself was aware that she and her husband had caused so many people to suffer.

"Oh, I know that your husband's ancestors are on their way to this realm, and I have already prepared something to counter them. It would be wise for you to remain silent and avoid discussing this matter with them, or else you will regret it." After he said that, Zhang Fei immediately disappeared from Helian Yueyi's sight.

After some time, Helian Yueyi wiped her tears and sat on the bed, looking at her two sleeping daughters. She rubbed their cheeks as he thought of Zhang Fei's previous words. 'You two don't need to worry; I will definitely save you from the hands of that evil demon at all costs.'

After he left the Huangfu Kingdom, Zhang Fei entered the Yin-Yang Space. He did not stay in for long and came out again after he absorbed the Qi in the glass tube, especially since his Qi was still lacking to break through to the 7-Star Earth Realm.
[Ding]
[You gained 500,000 Qi.]
[Congratulations! The host's cultivation broke through to the 7 Star Earth Realm.]
"Having a few prisoners with high cultivation is indeed beneficial to me." After that, Zhang Fei left the Yin-Yang Space and looked for an empty place to break through.
After he found it, Zhang Fei immediately summoned Lei Que out of the beast space. "Let's do it again."
"Yes, Master." As usual, Lei Que, the thunderbird, led Zhang Fei into the darkened sky, accompanied by numerous lightning flashes.

In the soul pond, Wang Yin, who was cultivating inside it, immediately opened her eyes as soon as she sensed the Qi fluctuation in Zhang Fei [5]'s body. She looked at him in surprise, especially since he looked so calm, even though his cultivation was about to break through.
Moreover, Zhang Fei [5] did not stop absorbing the things in the pond, and he had already started absorbing the wandering souls above them.

Wang Yin nodded a few times as she noticed that Zhang Fei [5] encountered no obstacles in his breakthrough. 'This kid is indeed an outstanding demon cultivator, and those old folks will scramble to get him if they witness him doing all this. Thus, I have to do something to get him before they realize his presence, or I will lose out to them.'
Since Zhang Fei [5] was focused on his breakthrough, Wang Yin decided not to disturb him and would talk to him after he finished. She then closed her eyes again and resumed her cultivation.
"Hmm?" Lin Moxian immediately stopped flying as soon as he felt the Qi fluctuations within Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s body. "Do you want to break through first?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] no longer used his ten-year-old form, but he had returned to his true form with a slight change in his face, especially since he did not want Xi Hongyan to know his true identity.
"No need." Zhang Xiaolong [3] refused. "My breakthrough isn't too difficult, and I can do it while traveling, so you don't need to worry about me, Senior Brother."

Lin Moxian shook his head after hearing that. "Do you realize how ridiculous you are? Even our teacher wouldn't dare to move when he breaks through, but you said that you can break through while traveling, and I've never met such a cultivator before."

"Hehe." Zhang Xiaolong [3] chuckled in response. "I had difficulties when I broke through to the Earth Realm the first time, but I've improved a lot after that. My lightning body cultivation technique has already been broken through twice, so my body has become stronger to deal with my breakthrough. Moreover, I've gone through lightning tribulations too many times, so I'm used to it now."

Lin Moxian released a heavy sigh. "Even though you don't show it, I can still feel your killing intent and bloodlust. Therefore, I am no longer surprised if the heavens want to kill you, especially since you are too bloody, with the blood of countless living beings soaking your hands. I know you kill to protect yourself and those closest to you, but you must learn to control your desire to kill. If you can't control that, you will become a bloodthirsty murderer one day, and the heavens will punish you with much stronger lightning tribulations specifically to kill you."

"Thank you for your advice, Senior Brother." Zhang Xiaolong [3] sincerely replied. "I will try to control my desire to kill, especially because many people will be sad and suffer if I turn into such a person."
Lin Moxian nodded. "Let's speed up so we can arrive at the Xi Clan faster."
"Let me take you there, Senior Brother." Before Lin Moxian could react, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already grabbed his shoulders and carried him away using the Nine Cloud Steps.

In a few minutes, they had arrived not far from the Xi Clan's location, leaving Lin Moxian dumbfounded for a while. Soon, he came back to his senses and immediately messed up Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s hair. "You crazy kid! Your speed is even faster than Grandpa Yan Leibao!"

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed. "Actually, I met Grandpa Yan a month ago, and we had a race at that time, but he didn't manage to catch up to me. As a result, he passed on his clan's two speed techniques to two of my wives, and I have also learned both of them."

"Seriously! All your abilities leave me speechless!" Lin Moxian then told him something. "By the way, our master's third disciple is Yan Yingqin, and she is Hong Xinxin's cousin. Compared to Grandpa Yan, her speed is much faster, and our master is willing to accept her because of her unique soul. However, she is quite spoiled, stubborn, and childish. She will pester you endlessly if you manage to beat her in a speed race, especially since she always boasts of her speed. Therefore, you should give in to her if you don't want your life to be disturbed, or she will never stop until she manages to defeat you."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding. "All right, I will listen to your words, and I will immediately surrender if Senior Sister Yan Yingqin wants to race with me."
"Let's go." Lin Moxian directly led him to the Xi Clan. Like before, none of them dared to greet them, but they were curious about Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s identity.

Xi Hongyan, who sensed the presence of the two, immediately came out to meet them. She immediately stopped when she saw Zhang Xiaolong [3], and her expression changed to surprise after she checked his bone age and cultivation. She noticed that he was in the process of making a breakthrough, but he seemed unperturbed by it. "Who is he, Moxian? Is he your relative? Why doesn't he focus on his breakthrough first?"

"His name is Lin Xiaolong, and he is my cousin. I happened to meet him when I was visiting the Hong Clan, so I brought him here with me." Zhang Xiaolong [3] was a little surprised that Lin Moxian introduced him to Xi Hongyan as such, but he immediately played along with his game. "As you can see, he is different from other cultivators, and his breakthrough is not a big deal to him, so you don't need to worry about him. By the way, he is Hong Xinxin's future husband, and the Hong Clan will be close relatives with my Lin Clan in the future."

Xi Hongyan was shocked and furious after she heard that, especially since she also intended to target the Hong Clan after she destroyed the Shang Clan. If they had such a relationship with the Lin Clan, which was supported by the alchemist goddess, Lin Jingxia, then her plans would be in disarray.

Xi Hongyan and her Xi Clan were indeed powerful in the Red Sun Realm, but they would never win against the Lin Clan, and it would be no different from seeking destruction if she wanted to fight with the Hong Clan. After all, Lin Jingxia's reputation was too high, and all the cultivators in the upper realms always tried hard to please her in order to obtain her pills; even a cultivator of the caliber of the Nameless One was very respectful toward her.

"Is he really Hong Xinxin's future husband? Why have I never heard of it?" Xi Hongyan doubtfully asked. "As I recall, he was only interested in Shang Guangming, and all the cultivators in the realm already knew about that matter for a long time."

Lin Moxian naturally understood Xi Hongyan's thoughts. "You decide whether to believe me, but I've told you the truth, and lying to you won't help me. I know your ambition to become the sole ruler of this realm, but you must not seek trouble with the Hong Clan. My cousin is not only Hong Xinxin's future husband, but he is also my master's newest disciple. If you trouble them, you'll face my aunt and master."

Once again, Lin Moxian's words shocked Xi Hongyan, and she glared at Zhang Xiaolong [3] in disbelief. She had heard about Hun Di taking in a new disciple, but she did not expect that his new disciple would become a member of the Lin Clan. Moreover, he was also Hong Xinxin's future husband, which made the situation even more complicated.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately took out the Hun Di's badge and showed it to Xi Hongyan. "Do you still not believe that I am Master Hun's disciple, Big Sis? He gave this badge to me before he went to the Blossom Heaven Realm."

"You hold Senior Hun Di's badge; how could I dare not believe that you are his disciple?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled casually and put away the badge. "How did you manage to win Hong Xinxin's heart? Everyone in this realm knows that she is infatuated with Shang Guangmin, but she suddenly shifted her feelings towards you, so I was really surprised to hear that."

"Naturally, I have my own way to win Xinxin's heart, but our relationship is still not official right now." Xi Hongyan's expression changed slightly after hearing that, but it did not escape Zhang Xiaolong's [3] observation. "Although our relationship is not officially established yet, Grandpa Hong and Grandpa Yan have already agreed to it, and we will get married after my cultivation breaks through to the Seven Divine Realms."
Xi Hongyan gave a light nod before asking Li Moxian, "So, why did you suddenly come back here? Are you willing to help me do something about Shang Xishun?"
"Lead us to her." Lin Moxian answered briefly.
Xi Hongyan immediately led them to her clan's dungeon, where she locked Shang Xishun in one of the prisons. Upon arrival, she asked Lin Moxian. "How are you going to help me control him?"
"What do you think about that?" Lin Moxian asked Zhang Xiaolong [3] instead, causing Xi Hongyan to frown.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] pretended to be thinking as he glanced at Xi Hongyan. "I think I have an idea for that, but I need this big sister's help, especially her soul."
