sentences.text: "You—"
"You what?" Zhang Fei let go of Helian Yueyi and sat on the side of the bed.
"Are you still unaware of your situation?"
Helian Yueyi frowned.
"What do you mean by that?"
"A month and a half have passed since we last met, and I have given you a chance to save yourself and your children.

Unfortunately, you still haven't decided on the matter, and your time is rapidly running out." Helian Yueyi clenched his fists as he glared at Zhang Fei, especially since it was impossible for him to kill Huangfu Shou.
"Zhou Shenxin has just ascended the throne, so she is the empress of the Zhou Kingdom now."
Helian Yueyi was completely shocked listening to Zhang Fei's revelation.
"What?
Why didn't I hear the news?"
"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled.
"Naturally, you wouldn't hear that because I already got rid of all your husband's spies long ago, and Zhou Shenxin had everything ready since last month.
Additionally, I have also gotten rid of all his spies in the Bai Kingdom since three months ago, and all the major clans of that kingdom have become my subordinates now."
Helian Yueyi froze in her spot after she heard that, and she did not expect that Zhang Fei had moved so quickly.
"Does Linghu Yincheng's disappearance have anything to do with you?"
"Isn't that obvious?" Zhang Fei asked her back.
"Li Tiannan used the Gu Insect on Linghu Yincheng and her husband, but I managed to free her, and she is in a safe place with her three children.
I haven't been able to free Bai Yaowei yet, but it won't be long.
This way, the four kingdoms are already by my side, and only your kingdom is left.
By the way, you should not say anything to that guy and your husband, unless you want to lose your two daughters, especially since they are in my hands now."
"Why are you doing this?
What are you doing to them?" Helian Yueyi asked in a high voice.
"I was never interested in attacking defenseless women, so I didn't do anything to them." Zhang Fei turned to the two women, who were still sound asleep and rubbing their cheeks.
"Instead, I imprisoned their subconscious in the dreamland, and I gave them sweet dreams, so they weren't tormented by the effects of the black liquid back then."
After several months, Helian Yueyi finally got the answer to why her two daughters were falling asleep for so long.

She remembered that they had been very calm since they fell into deep slumber, and they had not experienced the slightest pain in the past, but she was also shocked to hear that Zhang Fei could do such a thing.
"Can you release them?
I miss them so much, so I want to talk to them."
"Why should I release them?" Zhang Fei looked at Helian Yueyi again.
"After you successfully kill Huangfu Shou, I will release your two daughters then."
"You—" Helian Yueyi swallowed her words.
Her eyes widened as her body trembled, and she subconsciously took several steps back.
"You... you are a demon!"
Zhang Fei, who was already in his demon form, got up from the bed and walked in front of Helian Yueyi.
He lifted her chin and stared at her eyes with his blood-red eyes.
"I am a demon, not a saint, and I will never do anything unless it benefits me.
I will never harm you or your two daughters, and all I want is your husband's life, so you can choose between his life or theirs.
If I kill him myself, then they will accompany him."
"Why?
Why are you doing this to me?
Why are you forcing me to choose between their lives?" Helian Yueyi asked him in a trembling voice as tears flowed down from the corners of her eyes.
"Didn't your husband want to capture and control my son before?
Have you ever thought about the people you and your husband have persecuted and oppressed for the past few hundred years?" Zhang Fei turned the question around.
"Fortunately, my son is different from them, and he has several strong protectors by his side; otherwise, he would have fallen into the hands of you two.
Since you and your husband like to do such things, you can consider this incident as the karma of the two of you.
If you can hand over his life to me, I will let you and your children go.
I will never bother your life anymore, and you can live a new, more peaceful life with your children."

Helian Yueyi's lips opened and closed several times, and she wanted to refute Zhang Fei's words, but no words came out to refute him, especially since she herself was aware that she and her husband had caused so many people to suffer.
"Oh, I know that your husband's ancestors are on their way to this realm, and I have already prepared something to counter them.
It would be wise for you to remain silent and avoid discussing this matter with them, or else you will regret it." After he said that, Zhang Fei immediately disappeared from Helian Yueyi's sight.
After some time, Helian Yueyi wiped her tears and sat on the bed, looking at her two sleeping daughters.
She rubbed their cheeks as he thought of Zhang Fei's previous words. 'You two don't need to worry; I will definitely save you from the hands of that evil demon at all costs.'
After he left the Huangfu Kingdom, Zhang Fei entered the Yin-Yang Space.
He did not stay in for long and came out again after he absorbed the Qi in the glass tube, especially since his Qi was still lacking to break through to the 7-Star Earth Realm.
[Ding]
[You gained 500,000 Qi.]
[Congratulations!
The host's cultivation broke through to the 7 Star Earth Realm.]
"Having a few prisoners with high cultivation is indeed beneficial to me." After that, Zhang Fei left the Yin-Yang Space and looked for an empty place to break through.
After he found it, Zhang Fei immediately summoned Lei Que out of the beast space.
"Let's do it again."
"Yes, Master." As usual, Lei Que, the thunderbird, led Zhang Fei into the darkened sky, accompanied by numerous lightning flashes.
In the soul pond, Wang Yin, who was cultivating inside it, immediately opened her eyes as soon as she sensed the Qi fluctuation in Zhang Fei [5]'s body.
She looked at him in surprise, especially since he looked so calm, even though his cultivation was about to break through.
Moreover, Zhang Fei [5] did not stop absorbing the things in the pond, and he had already started absorbing the wandering souls above them.

Wang Yin nodded a few times as she noticed that Zhang Fei [5] encountered no obstacles in his breakthrough. 'This kid is indeed an outstanding demon cultivator, and those old folks will scramble to get him if they witness him doing all this.
Thus, I have to do something to get him before they realize his presence, or I will lose out to them.'
Since Zhang Fei [5] was focused on his breakthrough, Wang Yin decided not to disturb him and would talk to him after he finished.
She then closed her eyes again and resumed her cultivation.
"Hmm?" Lin Moxian immediately stopped flying as soon as he felt the Qi fluctuations within Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s body.
"Do you want to break through first?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] no longer used his ten-year-old form, but he had returned to his true form with a slight change in his face, especially since he did not want Xi Hongyan to know his true identity.
"No need." Zhang Xiaolong [3] refused.
"My breakthrough isn't too difficult, and I can do it while traveling, so you don't need to worry about me, Senior Brother."
Lin Moxian shook his head after hearing that.
"Do you realize how ridiculous you are?
Even our teacher wouldn't dare to move when he breaks through, but you said that you can break through while traveling, and I've never met such a cultivator before."
"Hehe." Zhang Xiaolong [3] chuckled in response.
"I had difficulties when I broke through to the Earth Realm the first time, but I've improved a lot after that.
My lightning body cultivation technique has already been broken through twice, so my body has become stronger to deal with my breakthrough.
Moreover, I've gone through lightning tribulations too many times, so I'm used to it now."
Lin Moxian released a heavy sigh.
"Even though you don't show it, I can still feel your killing intent and bloodlust.
Therefore, I am no longer surprised if the heavens want to kill you, especially since you are too bloody, with the blood of countless living beings soaking your hands.
I know you kill to protect yourself and those closest to you, but you must learn to control your desire to kill.
If you can't control that, you will become a bloodthirsty murderer one day, and the heavens will punish you with much stronger lightning tribulations specifically to kill you."
"Thank you for your advice, Senior Brother." Zhang Xiaolong [3] sincerely replied.
"I will try to control my desire to kill, especially because many people will be sad and suffer if I turn into such a person."
Lin Moxian nodded.
"Let's speed up so we can arrive at the Xi Clan faster."
"Let me take you there, Senior Brother." Before Lin Moxian could react, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already grabbed his shoulders and carried him away using the Nine Cloud Steps.
In a few minutes, they had arrived not far from the Xi Clan's location, leaving Lin Moxian dumbfounded for a while.
Soon, he came back to his senses and immediately messed up Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s hair.
"You crazy kid!
Your speed is even faster than Grandpa Yan Leibao!"
"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed.
"Actually, I met Grandpa Yan a month ago, and we had a race at that time, but he didn't manage to catch up to me.
As a result, he passed on his clan's two speed techniques to two of my wives, and I have also learned both of them."
"Seriously!
All your abilities leave me speechless!" Lin Moxian then told him something.
"By the way, our master's third disciple is Yan Yingqin, and she is Hong Xinxin's cousin.
Compared to Grandpa Yan, her speed is much faster, and our master is willing to accept her because of her unique soul.
However, she is quite spoiled, stubborn, and childish.
She will pester you endlessly if you manage to beat her in a speed race, especially since she always boasts of her speed.
Therefore, you should give in to her if you don't want your life to be disturbed, or she will never stop until she manages to defeat you."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding.
"All right, I will listen to your words, and I will immediately surrender if Senior Sister Yan Yingqin wants to race with me."
"Let's go." Lin Moxian directly led him to the Xi Clan.
Like before, none of them dared to greet them, but they were curious about Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s identity.
Xi Hongyan, who sensed the presence of the two, immediately came out to meet them.
She immediately stopped when she saw Zhang Xiaolong [3], and her expression changed to surprise after she checked his bone age and cultivation.
She noticed that he was in the process of making a breakthrough, but he seemed unperturbed by it.
"Who is he, Moxian?
Is he your relative?
Why doesn't he focus on his breakthrough first?"
"His name is Lin Xiaolong, and he is my cousin.

I happened to meet him when I was visiting the Hong Clan, so I brought him here with me." Zhang Xiaolong [3] was a little surprised that Lin Moxian introduced him to Xi Hongyan as such, but he immediately played along with his game.
"As you can see, he is different from other cultivators, and his breakthrough is not a big deal to him, so you don't need to worry about him.
By the way, he is Hong Xinxin's future husband, and the Hong Clan will be close relatives with my Lin Clan in the future."
Xi Hongyan was shocked and furious after she heard that, especially since she also intended to target the Hong Clan after she destroyed the Shang Clan.
If they had such a relationship with the Lin Clan, which was supported by the alchemist goddess, Lin Jingxia, then her plans would be in disarray.

Xi Hongyan and her Xi Clan were indeed powerful in the Red Sun Realm, but they would never win against the Lin Clan, and it would be no different from seeking destruction if she wanted to fight with the Hong Clan.

After all, Lin Jingxia's reputation was too high, and all the cultivators in the upper realms always tried hard to please her in order to obtain her pills; even a cultivator of the caliber of the Nameless One was very respectful toward her.
"Is he really Hong Xinxin's future husband?
Why have I never heard of it?" Xi Hongyan doubtfully asked.
"As I recall, he was only interested in Shang Guangming, and all the cultivators in the realm already knew about that matter for a long time."
Lin Moxian naturally understood Xi Hongyan's thoughts.
"You decide whether to believe me, but I've told you the truth, and lying to you won't help me.
I know your ambition to become the sole ruler of this realm, but you must not seek trouble with the Hong Clan.
My cousin is not only Hong Xinxin's future husband, but he is also my master's newest disciple.
If you trouble them, you'll face my aunt and master."
Once again, Lin Moxian's words shocked Xi Hongyan, and she glared at Zhang Xiaolong [3] in disbelief.
She had heard about Hun Di taking in a new disciple, but she did not expect that his new disciple would become a member of the Lin Clan.
Moreover, he was also Hong Xinxin's future husband, which made the situation even more complicated.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately took out the Hun Di's badge and showed it to Xi Hongyan.
"Do you still not believe that I am Master Hun's disciple, Big Sis?
He gave this badge to me before he went to the Blossom Heaven Realm."
"You hold Senior Hun Di's badge; how could I dare not believe that you are his disciple?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled casually and put away the badge.
"How did you manage to win Hong Xinxin's heart?
Everyone in this realm knows that she is infatuated with Shang Guangmin, but she suddenly shifted her feelings towards you, so I was really surprised to hear that."

"Naturally, I have my own way to win Xinxin's heart, but our relationship is still not official right now." Xi Hongyan's expression changed slightly after hearing that, but it did not escape Zhang Xiaolong's [3] observation.

"Although our relationship is not officially established yet, Grandpa Hong and Grandpa Yan have already agreed to it, and we will get married after my cultivation breaks through to the Seven Divine Realms."
Xi Hongyan gave a light nod before asking Li Moxian, "So, why did you suddenly come back here?
Are you willing to help me do something about Shang Xishun?"
"Lead us to her." Lin Moxian answered briefly.
Xi Hongyan immediately led them to her clan's dungeon, where she locked Shang Xishun in one of the prisons.
Upon arrival, she asked Lin Moxian.
"How are you going to help me control him?"
"What do you think about that?" Lin Moxian asked Zhang Xiaolong [3] instead, causing Xi Hongyan to frown.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] pretended to be thinking as he glanced at Xi Hongyan.
"I think I have an idea for that, but I need this big sister's help, especially her soul."

chapters.title: Chapter 768: Sky Puppet Imperial Art
paragraphs: "My soul? What do you want to do with my soul?" Xi Hongyan asked with skepticism.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] pointed his finger at Shang Xishun. "Don't you want to control this woman? The only way to control her is to merge her soul with yours, so you need to release your soul before we can do that."

Although she was not a soul cultivator, Xi Hongyan was still an experienced cultivator, and she felt that there was something wrong with Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s method, but she did not know what was wrong with it.

Lin Moxian directly spoke to him. "He is my junior brother, and our master has taught him many things about the soul cultivation path. If you doubt him, it is the same as doubting our master. Therefore, we will not help you, and you can find another solution to control that woman."
'This bastard! He's trying to pressure me by using their master's name!' Xi Hongyan took a deep breath. "Fine! I will release my soul now."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Lin Moxian exchanged understanding glances and laughed in their hearts. 'It's too easy to fool and pressure this woman!'

Xi Hongyan still looked suspiciously at Zhang Xiaolong [3], but he responded with a relaxed smile. She sighed in her heart before releasing her soul, but the two men saw that there were several black spots in it, which caused them to frown.

"Her soul was affected by something." Lin Moxian said as he observed Xi Hongyan's soul. "I don't know exactly where these black spots came from, but they eroded her soul. If they spread further and covered her soul completely, she would lose her mind."

"These black spots in her soul came from demon miasma, which means she encountered and fought a demon in the past, Senior Brother." Lin Moxian turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3] with a frown. "I can't say for sure which demon race was her opponent back then, but you are right about the effect of these black spots. Once these black spots engulf her soul, her desire to kill will completely control her, turning her into a mindless demon."
"What should we do to get rid of these black spots from her soul?"
"We can't do anything to get rid of them." Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at Shang Xishun. "Senior Brother, force that woman's soul out, and we can ask Xi Hongyan about the demon later."

"Forget it, let her suffer first, and I'll talk to her when she starts to feel the effects." Lin Moxian then pulled Shang Xishun's soul out of her body and brought it before them, but he was shocked by Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s actions replicating her soul and Xi Hongyan's. He said nothing and watched him put the two soul replicas into his soul space.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] then created a soul thread between the two women's original souls, and he didn't forget to implant his soul mark into Shang Xishun's soul before returning their souls into their bodies. As an expert soul cultivator, Lin Moxian naturally understood his reason to use his soul mark on her soul.

Soon, Xi Hongyan returned to her senses, and she could feel her connection with Shang Xishun, but she was unaware of Zhang Xiaolong's [3]'s action of replicating their souls. "Does this mean she will completely obey my orders now?"

"You can try it yourself after you cure the woman, and you won't be disappointed with the results." Lin Moxian then embraced Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s shoulder and led him out of the Xi Clan's dungeon. "We will return to the Hong Clan now, and you can take care of your own business."

After they left, Xi Hongyan summoned several people and asked them to move Shang Xishun to another place, as well as treat her injuries. She then went to see Xi Qiuwei and discussed several things with her, especially regarding her future plans for the Shang Clan.

Unlike Xi Hongyan, Xi Qiuwei doubted that her plans against the Shang Clan would succeed because Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun had already come out of their isolation, and they might find out about Shang Xishun's strangeness.

Xi Hongyan then spoke. "I know your worries, Aunt. However, Xi Yinying is in the Shang Clan now, and she managed to trick the two old god sticks. If they find out about Shang Xishun's strangeness, then just let it be, and we won't lose anything. Instead, they will be the ones who lose if she dies, especially since she is one of their best elders."

"You're right." Xi Qiuwei then told her. "The situation has changed a lot now because Ren Dongcheng and Jin Ruyue have joined the Hong Clan's side, so their group is bigger than ours now, especially since they are a combination of many clans from the three regions."

Xi Hongyan's expression turned furious after hearing that, especially after she remembered her conversation with Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Lin Moxian earlier. "Aunt, we will likely never win against the Hong Clan, and we will have to share this realm with them and the Huo Clan."

"Why are you suddenly pessimistic?" Xi Hongyan immediately told Xi Qiuwei about Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s fake identity as a member of the Lin Clan, his relationship with Hong Xinxin, and his status as Hun Di's newest disciple. "Is all that true?"

"Lin Moxian introduced that brat to me himself, so I can't be wrong, right?" Xi Qiuwei nodded to Xi Hongyan. "That brat has the soul emperor's badge, and he helped me control Shang Xishun, so his status as Hun Di's disciple is self-evident. However, I still have doubts about his relationship with Hong Xinxin, and I plan to send someone to infiltrate the Hong Clan. Unfortunately, I can't do it now, especially since the two of them have returned to that clan."

Xi Qiuwei then spoke. "If you want to do that, you should wait for them to leave the Hong Clan. Hun Di's disciples are not ordinary cultivators, and he must have taught them many great techniques, so we must be extremely careful when dealing with them. If we act too hastily and rashly, we might end up facing him and Lin Jingxia, and both of them have the ability to raze our clan to the ground."

"Yeah." Xi Hongyan suddenly received a long-distance message. "Xi Baoxing and Xi Chaozu have already entered the middle realms, and they will arrive at the Netherworld Realm in about two weeks. By the way, Shang Ziyuan is currently at the Huo Clan, and she asked Huo Jiguang for help to cure Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan."
"Is Huo Jiguang willing to help her?"

"No." Xi Hongyan answered with a shake of her head. "My spy in the Huo Clan told me that Huo Jiguang refused Shang Ziyuan's request, but that bitch still doesn't want to give up. Perhaps there will be a battle between them if she dares to force him, making it easier for us to destroy the Shang Clan."

Xi Qiumei sighed. "Shang Ziyuan is too reckless if she dares to force Huo Jiguang, especially since that old-fashioned old man never likes it when someone forces him. Although he never had any problems with her clan, he never liked her clan members, especially her two ancestors."

"We don't need to think about them, and I hope that Shang Ziyuan really forced Huo Jiguang." Xi Hongyan then walked out while thinking about something. 'Where exactly is Mai Xiaomeng now? Could it be that she brought her clan members to another realm? They have been missing for two months, and my people still haven't managed to find them anywhere in this realm.'
Lin Moxian and Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already arrived at the Hong Clan, and the two of them immediately went to the rearmost building in the clan.
"Hey, how can you replicate their souls, Junior Brother?"

Instead, Zhang Xiaolong [3] pulled Xi Hongyan's soul replica out of his soul space and handed it to Lin Moxian. "Senior Brother, you've already realized my demon identity, right? That ability is one of my innate abilities, so I can't teach it to you unless you transform into a demon like me. As for this soul, you surely know what you can do with it, right?"

"Nah! I'm not a jealous or envious person, and I'm just curious about your abilities." Lin Moxian then looked at Xi Hongyan's soul replica with a playful smile. "Hehehe! I won't do weird things to that woman, and I'll prank her a few times through this soul replica. Anyway, thanks for your help, Junior Brother."

"As you said, we are both brothers under one master, so we should help each other." Lin Moxian nodded at Zhang Xiaolong [3] before taking out a small doll, and he then put Xi Hongyan's soul replica into it.

"Are you surprised by this?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded to Lin Moxian. "Apart from being a soul cultivator, I am also a puppet master. In this realm, only Miao Miao can match my puppet technique, but I am still slightly superior to her because my soul power is higher than hers."

Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s eyes sparkled like stars after hearing about puppet techniques. "Can you teach me your puppet technique, Senior Brother? Actually, I have met Senior Miao before, and I wanted to learn her puppet technique. Unfortunately, I had to join her clan to learn it, so I gave up on my intention."
Lin Moxian immediately touched Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s forehead and shared his puppet technique, triggering a notification.
[Ding]
[You obtained the Sky Puppet Imperial Art.]

"This way, you don't need to learn puppet techniques from Miao Miao, and you will be superior to her if you can master them." Lin Moxian then reminded Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "There are several types of puppets in that technique, but you should not create the Nine Yin Puppet and the Cursed Puppet."
"Is there a problem with those two puppets?"

Lin Moxian nodded at him. "The Nine Yin Puppet is quite sinister, and you have to use a woman's corpse to create it. However, you can't use a random corpse for it, and you have to find a female virgin corpse that was born on the night when Yin was at its peak, which is very rare. I don't know for sure why my grandfather forbade me from creating it, but he is very experienced in puppets, so I don't dare doubt his words."
"Then, what about the Cursed Puppet?"

"The cursed puppet will curse you and everyone it touches." Zhang Xiaolong [3] frowned at that. "According to my grandfather, the curse will drain our vitality, and it will also reduce our lifespan. Therefore, I never created it, and you should not try to create it either."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] expressed his understanding. "All right, I will always remember your words."
*Tap... Tap...*
Hong Xinxin walked into the room and questioned them. "Where have you two been? Why did you guys just come back?"

"The Xi Clan." Hong Xinxin immediately narrowed her eyes at Lin Moxian. "Why are you looking at me like that? Don't you already know my junior brother's true identity? That's why I brought him to see Xi Hongyan, and he helped me with something interesting, which can help me get her."
Hong Xinxin already knew Zhang Xiaolong [3] quite well, so she could immediately guess his actions toward Xi Hongyan. "Moxian, I want you to take Zhang Fei to see your aunt."

"Huh?" Lin Moxian was taken aback by Hong Xinxin's request. "Don't you know that my aunt won't be willing to meet just anyone? Even if he is my junior brother, I'm sure she won't be willing to meet him, so it would be useless."
"Have you still not noticed the change in my appearance?"

"Hmm?" Lin Moxian looked at Hong Xinxin up and down before looking at her face. "Oh god! I just realized that you have become so young now! Don't tell me that my junior brother helped you regain your youth."

"That's right." Hong Xinxin nodded to Lin Moxian, who immediately turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "He learned alchemy about five months ago, but he is already a grandmaster alchemist, and he will become a king-rank alchemist soon. Moreover, he is building his own force, so he has to help them with many things, and alchemy things are the best solution. If your aunt knows his talent, I'm sure she will be willing to meet him, and she will probably take him as her disciple."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately gave Lin Moxian his basic pills and the other two pills before explaining their effects. "Since you are the nephew of the alchemist goddess, people will definitely not be suspicious of your appearance, Senior Brother. However, I hope you can hide the effects of the pills from your aunt, at least for now."

Lin Moxian did not respond to Hong Xinxin or Zhang Xiaolong [3], and his gaze was only focused on the several pills in the two bottles, especially the two miracle pills. He knew for sure that Lin Jingxia had long coveted such pills, but unfortunately, she and Tian Shuixiang had never succeeded in concocting them. However, his junior has such pills, and their effects have been proven by the change in his future wife's appearance. "Did you really match these pills, Junior Brother?"

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] replied with a nod. "I gave you the two pills because you are my senior brother and you have already taught me your puppet technique. However, they will bring me serious trouble if too many people know about them, so I hope you can keep them both a secret to yourself. Once I'm ready to face all the cultivators from the upper realms, I will sell both of them to the public, but I will only sell them to certain people."

Lin Moxian was, of course, aware of the risks of both pills. "Don't worry, I won't tell anyone about the two pills. Since your talent in alchemy is so extraordinary, I will take you to the Void Heaven Realm to meet my aunt. However, she is not an easy person, and you must prove your alchemy abilities to her first. If she deems you worthy, she will definitely be willing to meet you or even take you as her disciple, so you must prepare yourself well when we are on our way there."
"How long does the journey to that realm take?"
"Two months."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then turned to Hong Xinxin. "Do you want to join us?"
"No." Hong Xinxin immediately refused. "The situation in this realm is more under control, but I still have to help my family monitor everything, so I will stay here."
"All right." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked Lin Moxian. "Shall we depart now, Senior Brother?"
"Let's go." Upon arriving outside, Lin Moxian immediately took out his flying artifact, brought Zhang Xiaolong [3] on board, and quickly sped away from the Hong Clan.

Hong Xinxin immediately left the building and went to see her family. She explained to them that Lin Moxian had taken Zhang Xiaolong [3] to the Void Heaven Realm, and they then discussed their long-term plans, especially since their group had grown bigger.

On the flying artifact, Zhang Xiaolong [3] felt relieved after his lightning tribulation was over, and his real body had returned to the Cloud Mansion to stabilize his cultivation. He turned to Lin Moxian, who had already started to swallow his basic pills before sitting down cross-legged. 'At first, I thought I would have to wait a long time to meet the alchemist god and the alchemist goddess, but I will meet one of them soon.'
[I hope the alchemist goddess is willing to accept you as her disciple, Master. That way, your alchemy skills will increase greatly, and you will be able to concoct more pills for your people.]

'I was hoping for that myself, and I hope the alchemist goddess has a pill to speed up our cultivation so I can take them to the upper realms ahead of schedule.' After that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] closed his eyes and began studying the Sky Puppet Imperial Art.

sentences.text: "My soul?
What do you want to do with my soul?" Xi Hongyan asked with skepticism.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] pointed his finger at Shang Xishun.
"Don't you want to control this woman?
The only way to control her is to merge her soul with yours, so you need to release your soul before we can do that."

Although she was not a soul cultivator, Xi Hongyan was still an experienced cultivator, and she felt that there was something wrong with Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s method, but she did not know what was wrong with it.
Lin Moxian directly spoke to him.
"He is my junior brother, and our master has taught him many things about the soul cultivation path.
If you doubt him, it is the same as doubting our master.
Therefore, we will not help you, and you can find another solution to control that woman."
'This bastard!
He's trying to pressure me by using their master's name!' Xi Hongyan took a deep breath.
"Fine!
I will release my soul now."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Lin Moxian exchanged understanding glances and laughed in their hearts. 'It's too easy to fool and pressure this woman!'
Xi Hongyan still looked suspiciously at Zhang Xiaolong [3], but he responded with a relaxed smile.
She sighed in her heart before releasing her soul, but the two men saw that there were several black spots in it, which caused them to frown.
"Her soul was affected by something." Lin Moxian said as he observed Xi Hongyan's soul.
"I don't know exactly where these black spots came from, but they eroded her soul.
If they spread further and covered her soul completely, she would lose her mind."
"These black spots in her soul came from demon miasma, which means she encountered and fought a demon in the past, Senior Brother." Lin Moxian turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3] with a frown.
"I can't say for sure which demon race was her opponent back then, but you are right about the effect of these black spots.
Once these black spots engulf her soul, her desire to kill will completely control her, turning her into a mindless demon."
"What should we do to get rid of these black spots from her soul?"
"We can't do anything to get rid of them." Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at Shang Xishun.
"Senior Brother, force that woman's soul out, and we can ask Xi Hongyan about the demon later."

"Forget it, let her suffer first, and I'll talk to her when she starts to feel the effects." Lin Moxian then pulled Shang Xishun's soul out of her body and brought it before them, but he was shocked by Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s actions replicating her soul and Xi Hongyan's.
He said nothing and watched him put the two soul replicas into his soul space.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] then created a soul thread between the two women's original souls, and he didn't forget to implant his soul mark into Shang Xishun's soul before returning their souls into their bodies.
As an expert soul cultivator, Lin Moxian naturally understood his reason to use his soul mark on her soul.
Soon, Xi Hongyan returned to her senses, and she could feel her connection with Shang Xishun, but she was unaware of Zhang Xiaolong's [3]'s action of replicating their souls.
"Does this mean she will completely obey my orders now?"
"You can try it yourself after you cure the woman, and you won't be disappointed with the results." Lin Moxian then embraced Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s shoulder and led him out of the Xi Clan's dungeon.
"We will return to the Hong Clan now, and you can take care of your own business."
After they left, Xi Hongyan summoned several people and asked them to move Shang Xishun to another place, as well as treat her injuries.
She then went to see Xi Qiuwei and discussed several things with her, especially regarding her future plans for the Shang Clan.

Unlike Xi Hongyan, Xi Qiuwei doubted that her plans against the Shang Clan would succeed because Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun had already come out of their isolation, and they might find out about Shang Xishun's strangeness.
Xi Hongyan then spoke.
"I know your worries, Aunt.
However, Xi Yinying is in the Shang Clan now, and she managed to trick the two old god sticks.
If they find out about Shang Xishun's strangeness, then just let it be, and we won't lose anything.
Instead, they will be the ones who lose if she dies, especially since she is one of their best elders."
"You're right." Xi Qiuwei then told her.

"The situation has changed a lot now because Ren Dongcheng and Jin Ruyue have joined the Hong Clan's side, so their group is bigger than ours now, especially since they are a combination of many clans from the three regions."
Xi Hongyan's expression turned furious after hearing that, especially after she remembered her conversation with Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Lin Moxian earlier.
"Aunt, we will likely never win against the Hong Clan, and we will have to share this realm with them and the Huo Clan."

"Why are you suddenly pessimistic?" Xi Hongyan immediately told Xi Qiuwei about Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s fake identity as a member of the Lin Clan, his relationship with Hong Xinxin, and his status as Hun Di's newest disciple.
"Is all that true?"
"Lin Moxian introduced that brat to me himself, so I can't be wrong, right?" Xi Qiuwei nodded to Xi Hongyan.
"That brat has the soul emperor's badge, and he helped me control Shang Xishun, so his status as Hun Di's disciple is self-evident.
However, I still have doubts about his relationship with Hong Xinxin, and I plan to send someone to infiltrate the Hong Clan.
Unfortunately, I can't do it now, especially since the two of them have returned to that clan."
Xi Qiuwei then spoke.
"If you want to do that, you should wait for them to leave the Hong Clan.
Hun Di's disciples are not ordinary cultivators, and he must have taught them many great techniques, so we must be extremely careful when dealing with them.
If we act too hastily and rashly, we might end up facing him and Lin Jingxia, and both of them have the ability to raze our clan to the ground."
"Yeah." Xi Hongyan suddenly received a long-distance message.
"Xi Baoxing and Xi Chaozu have already entered the middle realms, and they will arrive at the Netherworld Realm in about two weeks.
By the way, Shang Ziyuan is currently at the Huo Clan, and she asked Huo Jiguang for help to cure Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan."
"Is Huo Jiguang willing to help her?"
"No." Xi Hongyan answered with a shake of her head.
"My spy in the Huo Clan told me that Huo Jiguang refused Shang Ziyuan's request, but that bitch still doesn't want to give up.
Perhaps there will be a battle between them if she dares to force him, making it easier for us to destroy the Shang Clan."
Xi Qiumei sighed.
"Shang Ziyuan is too reckless if she dares to force Huo Jiguang, especially since that old-fashioned old man never likes it when someone forces him.
Although he never had any problems with her clan, he never liked her clan members, especially her two ancestors."
"We don't need to think about them, and I hope that Shang Ziyuan really forced Huo Jiguang." Xi Hongyan then walked out while thinking about something. 'Where exactly is Mai Xiaomeng now?
Could it be that she brought her clan members to another realm?
They have been missing for two months, and my people still haven't managed to find them anywhere in this realm.'
Lin Moxian and Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already arrived at the Hong Clan, and the two of them immediately went to the rearmost building in the clan.
"Hey, how can you replicate their souls, Junior Brother?"
Instead, Zhang Xiaolong [3] pulled Xi Hongyan's soul replica out of his soul space and handed it to Lin Moxian.
"Senior Brother, you've already realized my demon identity, right?
That ability is one of my innate abilities, so I can't teach it to you unless you transform into a demon like me.
As for this soul, you surely know what you can do with it, right?"
"Nah!
I'm not a jealous or envious person, and I'm just curious about your abilities." Lin Moxian then looked at Xi Hongyan's soul replica with a playful smile.
"Hehehe!
I won't do weird things to that woman, and I'll prank her a few times through this soul replica.
Anyway, thanks for your help, Junior Brother."

"As you said, we are both brothers under one master, so we should help each other." Lin Moxian nodded at Zhang Xiaolong [3] before taking out a small doll, and he then put Xi Hongyan's soul replica into it.
"Are you surprised by this?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded to Lin Moxian.
"Apart from being a soul cultivator, I am also a puppet master.
In this realm, only Miao Miao can match my puppet technique, but I am still slightly superior to her because my soul power is higher than hers."
Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s eyes sparkled like stars after hearing about puppet techniques.
"Can you teach me your puppet technique, Senior Brother?
Actually, I have met Senior Miao before, and I wanted to learn her puppet technique.
Unfortunately, I had to join her clan to learn it, so I gave up on my intention."
Lin Moxian immediately touched Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s forehead and shared his puppet technique, triggering a notification.
[Ding]
[You obtained the Sky Puppet Imperial Art.]
"This way, you don't need to learn puppet techniques from Miao Miao, and you will be superior to her if you can master them." Lin Moxian then reminded Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"There are several types of puppets in that technique, but you should not create the Nine Yin Puppet and the Cursed Puppet."
"Is there a problem with those two puppets?"
Lin Moxian nodded at him.
"The Nine Yin Puppet is quite sinister, and you have to use a woman's corpse to create it.
However, you can't use a random corpse for it, and you have to find a female virgin corpse that was born on the night when Yin was at its peak, which is very rare.
I don't know for sure why my grandfather forbade me from creating it, but he is very experienced in puppets, so I don't dare doubt his words."
"Then, what about the Cursed Puppet?"
"The cursed puppet will curse you and everyone it touches." Zhang Xiaolong [3] frowned at that.
"According to my grandfather, the curse will drain our vitality, and it will also reduce our lifespan.
Therefore, I never created it, and you should not try to create it either."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] expressed his understanding.
"All right, I will always remember your words."
*Tap...
Tap...*
Hong Xinxin walked into the room and questioned them.
"Where have you two been?
Why did you guys just come back?"
"The Xi Clan." Hong Xinxin immediately narrowed her eyes at Lin Moxian.
"Why are you looking at me like that?
Don't you already know my junior brother's true identity?
That's why I brought him to see Xi Hongyan, and he helped me with something interesting, which can help me get her."
Hong Xinxin already knew Zhang Xiaolong [3] quite well, so she could immediately guess his actions toward Xi Hongyan.
"Moxian, I want you to take Zhang Fei to see your aunt."
"Huh?" Lin Moxian was taken aback by Hong Xinxin's request.
"Don't you know that my aunt won't be willing to meet just anyone?
Even if he is my junior brother, I'm sure she won't be willing to meet him, so it would be useless."
"Have you still not noticed the change in my appearance?"
"Hmm?" Lin Moxian looked at Hong Xinxin up and down before looking at her face.
"Oh god!
I just realized that you have become so young now!
Don't tell me that my junior brother helped you regain your youth."
"That's right." Hong Xinxin nodded to Lin Moxian, who immediately turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"He learned alchemy about five months ago, but he is already a grandmaster alchemist, and he will become a king-rank alchemist soon.
Moreover, he is building his own force, so he has to help them with many things, and alchemy things are the best solution.
If your aunt knows his talent, I'm sure she will be willing to meet him, and she will probably take him as her disciple."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately gave Lin Moxian his basic pills and the other two pills before explaining their effects.
"Since you are the nephew of the alchemist goddess, people will definitely not be suspicious of your appearance, Senior Brother.
However, I hope you can hide the effects of the pills from your aunt, at least for now."
Lin Moxian did not respond to Hong Xinxin or Zhang Xiaolong [3], and his gaze was only focused on the several pills in the two bottles, especially the two miracle pills.
He knew for sure that Lin Jingxia had long coveted such pills, but unfortunately, she and Tian Shuixiang had never succeeded in concocting them.
However, his junior has such pills, and their effects have been proven by the change in his future wife's appearance.
"Did you really match these pills, Junior Brother?"
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] replied with a nod.
"I gave you the two pills because you are my senior brother and you have already taught me your puppet technique.
However, they will bring me serious trouble if too many people know about them, so I hope you can keep them both a secret to yourself.
Once I'm ready to face all the cultivators from the upper realms, I will sell both of them to the public, but I will only sell them to certain people."
Lin Moxian was, of course, aware of the risks of both pills.
"Don't worry, I won't tell anyone about the two pills.
Since your talent in alchemy is so extraordinary, I will take you to the Void Heaven Realm to meet my aunt.
However, she is not an easy person, and you must prove your alchemy abilities to her first.
If she deems you worthy, she will definitely be willing to meet you or even take you as her disciple, so you must prepare yourself well when we are on our way there."
"How long does the journey to that realm take?"
"Two months."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then turned to Hong Xinxin.
"Do you want to join us?"
"No." Hong Xinxin immediately refused.
"The situation in this realm is more under control, but I still have to help my family monitor everything, so I will stay here."
"All right." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked Lin Moxian.
"Shall we depart now, Senior Brother?"
"Let's go." Upon arriving outside, Lin Moxian immediately took out his flying artifact, brought Zhang Xiaolong [3] on board, and quickly sped away from the Hong Clan.
Hong Xinxin immediately left the building and went to see her family.
She explained to them that Lin Moxian had taken Zhang Xiaolong [3] to the Void Heaven Realm, and they then discussed their long-term plans, especially since their group had grown bigger.
On the flying artifact, Zhang Xiaolong [3] felt relieved after his lightning tribulation was over, and his real body had returned to the Cloud Mansion to stabilize his cultivation.

He turned to Lin Moxian, who had already started to swallow his basic pills before sitting down cross-legged. 'At first, I thought I would have to wait a long time to meet the alchemist god and the alchemist goddess, but I will meet one of them soon.'
[I hope the alchemist goddess is willing to accept you as her disciple, Master.
That way, your alchemy skills will increase greatly, and you will be able to concoct more pills for your people.]

'I was hoping for that myself, and I hope the alchemist goddess has a pill to speed up our cultivation so I can take them to the upper realms ahead of schedule.' After that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] closed his eyes and began studying the Sky Puppet Imperial Art.

chapters.title: Chapter 769: Ten Puppets
paragraphs: [The Sky Puppet Imperial Art: A divine puppet-controlling technique that originates from the Ancient Sky Puppet Sect, allowing the wielder to create and command divine-grade battle puppets infused with the essence of heaven and earth. Unlike ordinary puppet arts, which rely on physical materials and manual control, this technique allows the user the ability to control puppets with pure soul power, eliminating the need for external strings or talismans. There are ten types of puppets that can be created, and each puppet has its own function.]
[Puppet types.]

1. Guardian Puppet: Often equipped with defensive formations, these puppets are usually used to safeguard sects, tombs, homes, or masters. The grade depends on the material used, such as wood, iron, steel, stone, bone, and many more.
2. Battle Puppet: These puppets are used to assist the master in battle, and they have seven grades, depending on the materials used to create them.
3. Trap Puppet: These puppets are commonly used to confuse, lure, and trap enemies. Their grade depends on the material.
4. Alchemy Puppets: This type of puppet is usually used by alchemists in alchemy, such as keeping the fire stable, preparing herbs, and others.
5. Crafting Puppets: This type of puppet is usually used to assist in forging weapons and refining artifacts.
6. Blood Puppets: These puppets are created using the user's blood essence, linked directly to the user's vitality.

7. Soul Puppets: The users need several materials, such as the Soulbound Mithril, the Soulwood Essence, the Soulforged Bone, and living beings souls to create them. These puppets' power comes from the living beings and the user's soul as well.

8. Nine Yin Puppet: To create these puppets, the user needs female corpses that were born on the night when Yin was at its peak. The user must refine these puppets with various materials to increase their strength.
9. Cursed Puppet: These puppets are like a double-edged sword because the curse can drain vitality and reduce lifespan, including their creator.
10. Demonic Puppets: To create these puppets, the user needs demon or demon beast corpses and cores that have just died, and their strength depends on their demon ranks.
'The guardian puppet is not bad, but its strength depends on the materials. Therefore, I must find the best materials to make some, and I will use them to protect my residence.'
[Master, Cheng Gaoji is one of the best artifact crafters in the upper realms, so I think you can discuss it with him first, and he might be able to help you with the materials.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] gave a light nod. 'Even though I have five clones, the battle and trap puppets are still useful for me, so I don't need to be directly involved in battle, and I can use them to deal with my enemies. Additionally, I want to make one for each of my women so they have a protector when I'm away.'

[Your women are quite numerous now, so you need a lot of materials and money to give them one each. Moreover, creating one is definitely not easy and takes a long time, but it's not a big deal since you have five clones and your training space.]
'You are aware that the women by my side are quite numerous now, yet you still want me to have a thousand women.'

[Hehehe! Master, you are a lust demon, and your lust will become much higher once you evolve into a transcendent lust demon in the future. You may not believe me now, but you will realize that the number of women you have now will not be enough to quell your lust then.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised an eyebrow after hearing that. He himself was aware that his lust had indeed become higher after he evolved into a lust demon lord, and he would still evolve once more. He ignored that because he still needed a very long time to evolve into a transcendent lust demon. 'Hey! I have to create the alchemy and crafting puppets as soon as possible, and my two clones won't waste much time doing alchemy and blacksmithing. What do you think about the blood puppet, Mei?'

[Ordinary cultivators might have a hard time controlling a blood puppet, especially since it links with the user's vitality. However, you are a lust demon, and your vitality is simply too high. Not to mention, you still have some abilities to increase your vitality, so I think it's fine if you want to create and use one. As for the soul puppet, your soul power is not yet sufficient to control one, and the three materials used to create it are extremely rare, so you still have to be patient to create it.]

'I see.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding. 'The cursed puppet is too scary, so I will avoid creating it, at least for now. As for the Nine Yin Puppet, I don't understand why my senior brother's grandfather forbade him from creating it, but I have a good feeling about it, so I must find a female corpse that was born on the night when Yin was at its peak as soon as possible.'

Mei immediately spoke. [Isn't that easy, Master? There is a corpse demon by your fifth clone's side now, so you can try asking Wang Yin about it, and she might be able to help you get that female corpse.]

'Well, you're right, but I still have to be careful of Wang Yin because she doesn't have a soul, so I don't know whether she's truly good or evil.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] then thought about the last puppet. 'Demonic Puppet, huh? The strength of the puppet depends on the demon rank, so I have to look for the corpse of a demon or demon beast of at least King Rank. However, it requires the corpse of a demon or demon beast that has just died, so I have to kill it myself to turn it into a puppet. Are there many demon kings or queens in this realm, Mei?'

[Master. There are ten demon kings and five demon queens, and they are spread out in several other areas. They should be the subordinates of Wang Yin and the three demon emperors, and their strength is higher than yours because their cultivation is at the early stage of the Divine Manifestation Realm, so you must be careful if you want to fight any of them.]
'Yeah, you're right, Mei.'
"Have you started studying the technique?" Lin Moxian, who had just finished swallowing the pills, asked.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned his head to his senior brother. "I plan to create some puppets, especially the guardian and battle puppets, to protect my residence and all my family members. Unfortunately, I don't have their materials, so I have to look for them first."

"I see." Lin Moxian nodded in understanding. "Unfortunately, I don't have the materials to create them, and I usually create my puppets in my clan. If you want to try creating those puppets, I think we can drop by the Xianjin Realm, and you can buy all the materials you need there."
"Is the Xianjin Realm closer than the Void Heaven Realm?"

Lin Moxian immediately explained to him. "The Xianjin Realm is the main trading center in the upper realms because of its location right in the middle, and it's a month's journey from here. As for the Void Heaven Realm, its location is almost at the edge of the upper realms, so the journey there takes a long time."

"In that case, we will go to the Xianjin Realm first, Senior Brother." Lin Moxian immediately changed the direction of his flying artifact after Zhang Xiaolong [3] said that. "I'm not only wanting to buy materials to create puppets, but I want to look for herbs and forging materials as well."
"Forging materials? Don't tell me that you are also a blacksmith."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded with a smile. "I am a spirit-rank blacksmith, Senior Brother. Soon, I will become an earth-rank blacksmith, especially since I have almost succeeded in forging a perfect earth-grade weapon."

"Is there anything you can't do?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] told Lin Moxian that he was also a Rank-4 array master, causing him to massage his forehead. "I have no words for your absurdity, and you are the first person to walk so many paths at once. By the way, you can find all the materials you need for alchemy, formation arrays, blacksmithing, and other things in the Xianjin Realm. However, the prices of most materials, particularly the rare and extremely rare ones, are astronomically high. Furthermore, you have to compete with countless people from the upper realms, so you might have a hard time getting important materials and might have to queue for a long time."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding. "My three ranks are still low now, and I still can't create high-rank pills, arrays, or weapons, so I don't really need the rare and extremely rare materials. Senior Brother, is the blacksmith union headquarters in the Xianjin Realm?"

"The blacksmith union headquarters is in the Jiangong Realm, but their main shop is in the Xianjin Realm, and Ji Changlan is often there." Zhang Xiaolong [3] naturally remembered the man, especially since he had heard about him from Duan Zhao, Hong Xinxin, and the others. "Do you want to meet Old Ji? If you're lucky, you might be able to meet him there. As long as you show our master's badge, he will definitely be willing to meet you."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] naturally wouldn't waste such an opportunity. "Since we are going to the Xianjin Realm, I will try to meet him to talk about blacksmithing so I can improve my skills in that area."

"In that case, we'll try looking for Old Ji there first, but you don't need to be disappointed if he isn't there." Lin Moxian then took out the doll that held Xi Hongyan's soul replica, and a playful smile appeared on her face, making Zhang Xiaolong [3] laugh. "Hahaha! That woman would definitely never think of this!"

After he had absorbed the things in the pond and the wandering souls above them for quite some time, Zhang Fei [5] decided to stop his activities and opened his eyes. However, only Wang Yin was there, and she sent Shou Fubai somewhere else. 'My soul power is already getting closer to the half-perfection stage of the earthly soul level, and it might break through if I continue to absorb them in the next few days.'
"Are you finished?" Wang Yin suddenly asked.

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "My soul power has been increasing and is close to breaking through, so I will rest for some time before continuing. Can you tell me about a female corpse born the night Yin peaked, Big Sis?"
Wang Yin raised her eyebrows in surprise. "What do you want to do with it?"

"I have long obtained a puppet technique, and I need such a female corpse to create one." Wang Yin didn't expect that Zhang Fei [5] would want to do that. "However, I don't have any information about it, so I asked you because you are a corpse demon, and I thought you would know something about it."

Wang Yin immediately told him. "I do know about it, but such a female corpse is very hard to find because they are too rare. If you want to try looking for one, you can go to my Demon Purgatory Realm or other demon realms."
"Is such a corpse only available in the demon realm? Can't I look for it in the human realm?" Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow in response.

"Not really." Wang Yin answered with a shake of her head. "You can try looking for it in the human realm, but you will have difficulty finding it. Basically, the bodies of female demon cultivators are much stronger than those of female human cultivators, and their bodies will rot longer, so your best choice is to go to the demon realm. I don't know about your puppet technique, but I advise you not to create a puppet from such a corpse."
"What do you mean by that, Big Sis?" Zhang Fei [5] asked in confusion, especially since Lin Moxian also didn't know the reason his grandfather forbade him from creating the Nine Yin Puppet.

Wang Yin let out a soft sigh before explaining. "All women born at the time when Yin is at its peak are extremely lustful, and they need a large amount of Yang Qi to satisfy their lust. Even though they are dead, I believe their nature still lingers in their corpses. If you create a puppet from their corpse, you must prepare a large amount of Yang Qi. Otherwise, it will probably get out of control, and it will attack men because of their instinct to obtain their Yang Qi. Usually, their families will destroy their corpses so other people cannot use them for such a purpose, especially since it will endanger too many people."
Zhang Fei [5] didn't expect it to be so terrifying, but something confused them. "Big Sis, how can their nature and instinct linger on their corpses if they are already dead?"

"It's hard for me to explain it in words, but it's the truth." Wang Yin then pointed to herself. "A simple example is me. I am dead, and I have no soul, but I can still think and do many things. Have you ever met another living creature like me?"
"No." Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "Honestly, this is my first time meeting a corpse demon, so I don't have any information about it."

Wang Yin then told him something else. "Your puppet technique may be slightly the same as my corpse puppet technique. I turned Shou Fubai into my puppet, but his nature still lingered inside his corpse even though he was dead, and he fought me at first because his instincts considered me his enemy. Fortunately, my control was stronger, and I managed to control him completely. If you created such a puppet and couldn't control it, it would become a terrible enemy for many people, so you should think twice before creating it."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "All right, I will think about it carefully first. So, are you going to leave this pond, Big Sis?"
"Yes." Wang Yin then came out of the soul pond. "The other demon emperors summoned me, so I'm going to meet them now. Do you want to join me?"

Zhang Fei [5] immediately refused. "Big Sis, they are too strong for me, and they may not be as kind-hearted as you, so I won't go there to seek death. Moreover, my soul power is almost breaking through, so I will stay here to cultivate my soul."

"You're right, they are indeed not as good as me, especially that Mo Long. If he sees you, he might eat you alive right away, so you must stay here and cultivate your souls." Zhang Fei [5] sneered inwardly upon hearing that because he was sure that no one would be able to catch him, but he also didn't want to take the risk. Wang Yin hurriedly got dressed. "I'll come back here after my business with them is finished, and you should be careful of these wandering souls, especially since they'll become more aggressive once I'm gone."

As Wang Yin said, those wandering souls became aggressive and attacked Zhang Fei [5] as soon as she and her subordinates left. However, he did not think too much about them and activated his light element immediately, forcing them to retreat.

"Foolish souls! You will become food for my sword!" Zhang Fei [5] then summoned the demon extermination sword, which immediately flew away and attacked those wandering souls. "Jian Hei'an and Jian Guang'an! You two can absorb them to your heart's content!"
*Zing... Zing...*

The demon extermination sword answered Zhang Fei [5] with excited vibration, making him smile. He then looked into the pond to search for the mysterious thing inside it, but he still couldn't feel its presence. 'I think I'll have to dive into it to look for it.'

sentences.text: [The Sky Puppet Imperial Art: A divine puppet-controlling technique that originates from the Ancient Sky Puppet Sect, allowing the wielder to create and command divine-grade battle puppets infused with the essence of heaven and earth.

Unlike ordinary puppet arts, which rely on physical materials and manual control, this technique allows the user the ability to control puppets with pure soul power, eliminating the need for external strings or talismans.
There are ten types of puppets that can be created, and each puppet has its own function.]
[Puppet types.]
Guardian Puppet: Often equipped with defensive formations, these puppets are usually used to safeguard sects, tombs, homes, or masters.
The grade depends on the material used, such as wood, iron, steel, stone, bone, and many more.
Battle Puppet: These puppets are used to assist the master in battle, and they have seven grades, depending on the materials used to create them.
Trap Puppet: These puppets are commonly used to confuse, lure, and trap enemies.
Their grade depends on the material.
Alchemy Puppets: This type of puppet is usually used by alchemists in alchemy, such as keeping the fire stable, preparing herbs, and others.
Crafting Puppets: This type of puppet is usually used to assist in forging weapons and refining artifacts.
Blood Puppets: These puppets are created using the user's blood essence, linked directly to the user's vitality.
Soul Puppets: The users need several materials, such as the Soulbound Mithril, the Soulwood Essence, the Soulforged Bone, and living beings souls to create them.
These puppets' power comes from the living beings and the user's soul as well.
Nine Yin Puppet: To create these puppets, the user needs female corpses that were born on the night when Yin was at its peak.
The user must refine these puppets with various materials to increase their strength.
Cursed Puppet: These puppets are like a double-edged sword because the curse can drain vitality and reduce lifespan, including their creator.
Demonic Puppets: To create these puppets, the user needs demon or demon beast corpses and cores that have just died, and their strength depends on their demon ranks.
'The guardian puppet is not bad, but its strength depends on the materials.
Therefore, I must find the best materials to make some, and I will use them to protect my residence.'
[Master, Cheng Gaoji is one of the best artifact crafters in the upper realms, so I think you can discuss it with him first, and he might be able to help you with the materials.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] gave a light nod. 'Even though I have five clones, the battle and trap puppets are still useful for me, so I don't need to be directly involved in battle, and I can use them to deal with my enemies.
Additionally, I want to make one for each of my women so they have a protector when I'm away.'
[Your women are quite numerous now, so you need a lot of materials and money to give them one each.
Moreover, creating one is definitely not easy and takes a long time, but it's not a big deal since you have five clones and your training space.]
'You are aware that the women by my side are quite numerous now, yet you still want me to have a thousand women.'
[Hehehe!
Master, you are a lust demon, and your lust will become much higher once you evolve into a transcendent lust demon in the future.
You may not believe me now, but you will realize that the number of women you have now will not be enough to quell your lust then.]
Zhang Xiaolong [3] raised an eyebrow after hearing that.
He himself was aware that his lust had indeed become higher after he evolved into a lust demon lord, and he would still evolve once more.
He ignored that because he still needed a very long time to evolve into a transcendent lust demon. 'Hey!
I have to create the alchemy and crafting puppets as soon as possible, and my two clones won't waste much time doing alchemy and blacksmithing.
What do you think about the blood puppet, Mei?'
[Ordinary cultivators might have a hard time controlling a blood puppet, especially since it links with the user's vitality.
However, you are a lust demon, and your vitality is simply too high.
Not to mention, you still have some abilities to increase your vitality, so I think it's fine if you want to create and use one.
As for the soul puppet, your soul power is not yet sufficient to control one, and the three materials used to create it are extremely rare, so you still have to be patient to create it.]
'I see.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding. 'The cursed puppet is too scary, so I will avoid creating it, at least for now.

As for the Nine Yin Puppet, I don't understand why my senior brother's grandfather forbade him from creating it, but I have a good feeling about it, so I must find a female corpse that was born on the night when Yin was at its peak as soon as possible.'
Mei immediately spoke.
[Isn't that easy, Master?
There is a corpse demon by your fifth clone's side now, so you can try asking Wang Yin about it, and she might be able to help you get that female corpse.]

'Well, you're right, but I still have to be careful of Wang Yin because she doesn't have a soul, so I don't know whether she's truly good or evil.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] then thought about the last puppet. 'Demonic Puppet, huh?
The strength of the puppet depends on the demon rank, so I have to look for the corpse of a demon or demon beast of at least King Rank.
However, it requires the corpse of a demon or demon beast that has just died, so I have to kill it myself to turn it into a puppet.
Are there many demon kings or queens in this realm, Mei?'
[Master.
There are ten demon kings and five demon queens, and they are spread out in several other areas.

They should be the subordinates of Wang Yin and the three demon emperors, and their strength is higher than yours because their cultivation is at the early stage of the Divine Manifestation Realm, so you must be careful if you want to fight any of them.]
'Yeah, you're right, Mei.'
"Have you started studying the technique?" Lin Moxian, who had just finished swallowing the pills, asked.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned his head to his senior brother.
"I plan to create some puppets, especially the guardian and battle puppets, to protect my residence and all my family members.
Unfortunately, I don't have their materials, so I have to look for them first."
"I see." Lin Moxian nodded in understanding.
"Unfortunately, I don't have the materials to create them, and I usually create my puppets in my clan.
If you want to try creating those puppets, I think we can drop by the Xianjin Realm, and you can buy all the materials you need there."
"Is the Xianjin Realm closer than the Void Heaven Realm?"
Lin Moxian immediately explained to him.
"The Xianjin Realm is the main trading center in the upper realms because of its location right in the middle, and it's a month's journey from here.
As for the Void Heaven Realm, its location is almost at the edge of the upper realms, so the journey there takes a long time."
"In that case, we will go to the Xianjin Realm first, Senior Brother." Lin Moxian immediately changed the direction of his flying artifact after Zhang Xiaolong [3] said that.
"I'm not only wanting to buy materials to create puppets, but I want to look for herbs and forging materials as well."
"Forging materials?
Don't tell me that you are also a blacksmith."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded with a smile.
"I am a spirit-rank blacksmith, Senior Brother.
Soon, I will become an earth-rank blacksmith, especially since I have almost succeeded in forging a perfect earth-grade weapon."
"Is there anything you can't do?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] told Lin Moxian that he was also a Rank-4 array master, causing him to massage his forehead.
"I have no words for your absurdity, and you are the first person to walk so many paths at once.
By the way, you can find all the materials you need for alchemy, formation arrays, blacksmithing, and other things in the Xianjin Realm.
However, the prices of most materials, particularly the rare and extremely rare ones, are astronomically high.
Furthermore, you have to compete with countless people from the upper realms, so you might have a hard time getting important materials and might have to queue for a long time."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding.
"My three ranks are still low now, and I still can't create high-rank pills, arrays, or weapons, so I don't really need the rare and extremely rare materials.
Senior Brother, is the blacksmith union headquarters in the Xianjin Realm?"

"The blacksmith union headquarters is in the Jiangong Realm, but their main shop is in the Xianjin Realm, and Ji Changlan is often there." Zhang Xiaolong [3] naturally remembered the man, especially since he had heard about him from Duan Zhao, Hong Xinxin, and the others.
"Do you want to meet Old Ji?
If you're lucky, you might be able to meet him there.
As long as you show our master's badge, he will definitely be willing to meet you."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] naturally wouldn't waste such an opportunity.
"Since we are going to the Xianjin Realm, I will try to meet him to talk about blacksmithing so I can improve my skills in that area."

"In that case, we'll try looking for Old Ji there first, but you don't need to be disappointed if he isn't there." Lin Moxian then took out the doll that held Xi Hongyan's soul replica, and a playful smile appeared on her face, making Zhang Xiaolong [3] laugh.
"Hahaha!
That woman would definitely never think of this!"
After he had absorbed the things in the pond and the wandering souls above them for quite some time, Zhang Fei [5] decided to stop his activities and opened his eyes.

However, only Wang Yin was there, and she sent Shou Fubai somewhere else. 'My soul power is already getting closer to the half-perfection stage of the earthly soul level, and it might break through if I continue to absorb them in the next few days.'
"Are you finished?" Wang Yin suddenly asked.
"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her.
"My soul power has been increasing and is close to breaking through, so I will rest for some time before continuing.
Can you tell me about a female corpse born the night Yin peaked, Big Sis?"
Wang Yin raised her eyebrows in surprise.
"What do you want to do with it?"
"I have long obtained a puppet technique, and I need such a female corpse to create one." Wang Yin didn't expect that Zhang Fei [5] would want to do that.
"However, I don't have any information about it, so I asked you because you are a corpse demon, and I thought you would know something about it."
Wang Yin immediately told him.
"I do know about it, but such a female corpse is very hard to find because they are too rare.
If you want to try looking for one, you can go to my Demon Purgatory Realm or other demon realms."
"Is such a corpse only available in the demon realm?
Can't I look for it in the human realm?" Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow in response.
"Not really." Wang Yin answered with a shake of her head.
"You can try looking for it in the human realm, but you will have difficulty finding it.
Basically, the bodies of female demon cultivators are much stronger than those of female human cultivators, and their bodies will rot longer, so your best choice is to go to the demon realm.
I don't know about your puppet technique, but I advise you not to create a puppet from such a corpse."
"What do you mean by that, Big Sis?" Zhang Fei [5] asked in confusion, especially since Lin Moxian also didn't know the reason his grandfather forbade him from creating the Nine Yin Puppet.
Wang Yin let out a soft sigh before explaining.
"All women born at the time when Yin is at its peak are extremely lustful, and they need a large amount of Yang Qi to satisfy their lust.
Even though they are dead, I believe their nature still lingers in their corpses.
If you create a puppet from their corpse, you must prepare a large amount of Yang Qi.
Otherwise, it will probably get out of control, and it will attack men because of their instinct to obtain their Yang Qi.
Usually, their families will destroy their corpses so other people cannot use them for such a purpose, especially since it will endanger too many people."
Zhang Fei [5] didn't expect it to be so terrifying, but something confused them.
"Big Sis, how can their nature and instinct linger on their corpses if they are already dead?"
"It's hard for me to explain it in words, but it's the truth." Wang Yin then pointed to herself.
"A simple example is me.
I am dead, and I have no soul, but I can still think and do many things.
Have you ever met another living creature like me?"
"No." Zhang Fei [5] shook his head.
"Honestly, this is my first time meeting a corpse demon, so I don't have any information about it."
Wang Yin then told him something else.
"Your puppet technique may be slightly the same as my corpse puppet technique.
I turned Shou Fubai into my puppet, but his nature still lingered inside his corpse even though he was dead, and he fought me at first because his instincts considered me his enemy.
Fortunately, my control was stronger, and I managed to control him completely.
If you created such a puppet and couldn't control it, it would become a terrible enemy for many people, so you should think twice before creating it."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding.
"All right, I will think about it carefully first.
So, are you going to leave this pond, Big Sis?"
"Yes." Wang Yin then came out of the soul pond.
"The other demon emperors summoned me, so I'm going to meet them now.
Do you want to join me?"
Zhang Fei [5] immediately refused.
"Big Sis, they are too strong for me, and they may not be as kind-hearted as you, so I won't go there to seek death.
Moreover, my soul power is almost breaking through, so I will stay here to cultivate my soul."
"You're right, they are indeed not as good as me, especially that Mo Long.

If he sees you, he might eat you alive right away, so you must stay here and cultivate your souls." Zhang Fei [5] sneered inwardly upon hearing that because he was sure that no one would be able to catch him, but he also didn't want to take the risk.
Wang Yin hurriedly got dressed.
"I'll come back here after my business with them is finished, and you should be careful of these wandering souls, especially since they'll become more aggressive once I'm gone."
As Wang Yin said, those wandering souls became aggressive and attacked Zhang Fei [5] as soon as she and her subordinates left.
However, he did not think too much about them and activated his light element immediately, forcing them to retreat.
"Foolish souls!
You will become food for my sword!" Zhang Fei [5] then summoned the demon extermination sword, which immediately flew away and attacked those wandering souls.
"Jian Hei'an and Jian Guang'an!
You two can absorb them to your heart's content!"
*Zing...
Zing...*
The demon extermination sword answered Zhang Fei [5] with excited vibration, making him smile.
He then looked into the pond to search for the mysterious thing inside it, but he still couldn't feel its presence. 'I think I'll have to dive into it to look for it.'
