chapters.title: Chapter 770: Soul Fire And Demon
paragraphs: After the demon extermination sword returned to his hand, Zhang Fei [5] immediately dived into the soul pond. The inside of the pond was completely dark, but he had a light element to illuminate it. The water temperature was almost freezing, but he had also often cultivated with a woman as cold as Zhang Yue, and he also had the fire element, so the temperature had no effect on him. 'Where is that thing? Why doesn't it appear anymore? Moreover, this pond is much deeper than I previously thought.'

After he swam for some time, Zhang Fei [5] finally arrived at the bottom, but he did not find anything there. However, the demon extermination sword suddenly vibrated strongly and flew out of his hand, piercing through the wall in front of him and revealing a small water cave.
Since the demon extermination sword flew in there, Zhang Fei [5] immediately swam after his sword as his eyes kept looking at the map, but it didn't show anything inside and was only dark.

A quarter of the way through the small cave, Zhang Fei [5] began to feel a change in the water temperature as it grew warmer every time he swam forward. 'May! It seems that this path will lead me to the location of the Soul Fire.'
[It seems so, Master. Perhaps the thing you felt earlier came from the Soul Fire, or it could also be from the wandering soul demon.]

Zhang Fei [5] gave a light nod of approval. 'If you say so, it is likely that the wandering soul demon is near the Soul Fire, and it might be protecting it. Although I am confident in my ability to escape, I must be really careful this time because this place is too narrow, and I will not be able to escape if that demon is as strong as Wang Yin.'

[You can escape by entering the Yin-Yang Space or Training Space, but this demon aura will infect one of them and prevent your people from entering again. The second solution is to cancel your clone, Master.]
'Yeah, you're right.' Zhang Fei [5] immediately activated his invisibility and swam forward faster.
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Demon Essences.]
[Reward: 10,000 demon coins.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 10,000 blue jewels.]
[Daily Quest: Killing 1000 demons or demon beasts at the Earth Realm or above.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack X1.]

Zhang Fei [5] had no concern for the three quests, as his other clones could handle them, and his primary goal was to reach the cave's end as quickly as possible. He wanted to find the wandering soul demon and the Soul Fire as soon as possible so he could leave the Nine Hells Darkland sooner.

A few hours later, Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow when he saw the light from a distance, but the light gave him an eerie feeling; even the hairs on the back of his neck stood up. 'Fuck! Even before I became a cultivator, I had never felt such fear.'
[Ding]
[Quest: Finding the soul fire.]
[Quest rank: Medium]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Medium gift pack x 1 sent to the inventory.]

'As expected! This light really is coming from the Soul Fire!' Before long, Zhang Fei [5] arrived at the end of the cave and immediately swam to the surface, but he arrived at a spacious underground cave. However, he was greeted by a terrifying sight because there were numerous skeletons of living creatures there, as well as drying corpses on every side of the cave.

'Shit!' Zhang Fei [5] grabbed the demon extermination sword floating by his side and held it, but he could feel fear from his sword. He then looked at a huge demon sleeping in a sitting position at the end of the cave. 'Calm down, Hei'an and Guang'an. I'm here with you two, and I will never let you two get hurt.'

The demon's body was transparent like a soul, and an eerie aura radiated from it, which came from the countless wandering souls that formed it. Not only that, Zhang Fei [5] could also feel the horror of the blackish-white fire floating in front of the demon, which was his target.

[Haha! You guessed right, Master! This demon is the wandering soul demon, and it protects the Soul Fire! By the way, this demon rank is a king rank, and his cultivation is at the 5-Moon Divine Manifestation Realm.]

Even though the wandering soul demon was still much stronger than him, Zhang Fei [5] felt a little relieved because it was not as strong as Wang Yin. 'Mei, the thing I absorbed earlier came from this demon, right?'

[Yes, Master. Previously, the system couldn't detect it, but it has already given the scan results, and the thing you absorbed before was a small part of the soul that formed this wandering soul demon. According to the system scan, this demon was formed from millions of souls of those who died in this realm, and I think you can only defeat it if you absorb them all.]
'Millions of souls; yet this demon rank is only a king rank.' Zhang Fei [5] muttered as he thought of a way to defeat the wandering soul demon, especially since it seemed to be sleeping.

[Master, this underground cave is right in the middle of this realm, and the demons are gathering above you right now. However, I have bad news for you because this place is covered by a powerful formation, and it is preventing you from opening both of your spaces, so you must act with extreme caution.]

Zhang Fei [5] frowned and gripped his sword tighter, but the wandering soul demon suddenly opened its eyes, and two tiny soul fires emerged from its eyes. 'This fight will be the most difficult fight for me.'
Upon seeing Zhang Fei [5], the demon released its aura to instill fear in him, but he immediately countered it with his own aura and killing intent at the same time.

The wandering soul demon immediately stood up from its seat and stretched out both hands to both sides. Instantly, two bone swords shot into its hands, and it slashed both of them straight into the walls, causing those dried corpses to fall into a pile of skeletons.
*Bam... Bam...*
Zhang Fei [5] took a deep breath because the wandering soul demon's attack was powerful. 'Mei, is it possible to destroy the wall above me?'
[Impossible, Master. The formation is too powerful; even Wang Yin and those demon emperors couldn't detect this place because of it.]

Zhang Fei [5] thought of escaping from the cave, but the wandering soul demon suddenly moved behind him and slashed his two bone swords at him. Fortunately, he had sharp instincts and lightning-fast reflexes, so he immediately used teleportation to avoid the attack.

The wandering soul demon immediately chased after Zhang Fei [5] with an ability almost similar to his teleportation, which shocked him. Since he became a cultivator, no living being has been able to catch up to him if he uses his teleportation, but the demon can match his speed and isn't afraid of his light element.

Zhang Fei [5] continued to use his teleportation to avoid the wandering soul demon's pursuit, but it continued to stick behind him while attacking him repeatedly, sending the skeletons in that place scattering in various directions.
*Clang... Clang...*
As they played cat and mouse, Zhang Fei [5] repeatedly countered the wandering soul demon's attacks, but all of its attacks were extremely hard and caused his hands to become numb.
'Fuck!' Zhang Fei [5] teleported above the water and dove straight into it, but the wandering soul demon did not chase after him and stopped at the edge, staring at him with its blackish-white eyes.
'What happened? Why isn't this demon chasing me?' Zhang Fei [5] wondered to himself as he stared at the wandering soul demon.
[Master, it seems that the formation is blocking the wandering soul demon from leaving that underground cave.]

Mei's words confused Zhang Fei [5], especially since he was previously able to absorb the souls from the wandering soul demon's body. 'If that's true, how could this demon have sent those souls out before?'
[I don't have an answer for that, Master.]

Ma Kuangyu suddenly spoke into Zhang Fei [5]'s mind. 'Kid, you will never be able to win against this demon with your current cultivation, so you should retreat for the time being and find another way to defeat it.'

'Yeah.' Zhang Fei [5] suddenly had an idea. 'Old Ma, what do you think if I use my real body and my other clones to gang up on this demon? If we use the demon-absorbing at the same time, we can absorb those souls to weaken it.'

Ma Kuangyu let out a soft sigh. 'You can do that, but this demon is formed from millions of wandering souls. If you absorb too much of them too quickly, they will undoubtedly affect you, and they will take over your body. By the way, I have some methods you might be able to use; would you like to hear them?'
'Please tell me, Old Ma.'

Ma Kuangyu immediately informed Zhang Fei [5]. 'First, bring that female devourer demon here, and she can help you to weaken this demon by absorbing those wandering souls. Regretfully, she was too weak because she was not a demon cultivator, and this demon could kill her easily. Second, ask that female phoenix to help you, and this demon will not dare to approach her phoenix flames. Third, your senior brother is a puppeteer, and he must have powerful puppets, so you can ask him to send some of his puppets here.'
'Can I open the gate in this water, Mei?'
[As long as you don't enter the underground cave, you can use the gate, Master.]

The wandering soul demon suddenly sent hundreds of wandering souls into the water to attack Zhang Fei [5], but he immediately used the demon-absorbing to absorb them, and the demon extermination sword also immediately moved to help him.

Zhang Fei [5] immediately used his light element technique, and the light winged-race shot towards the wandering soul demon. However, the demon slashed it with its two bone swords, dispelling his attack directly.
'Fuck!' Zhang Fei [5] cursed. 'I guess I have no other choice, and I'll use my real body to meet Feng Yao first.'
[Ding]
[Quest: Go to the seventh kingdom.]
[Quest rank: Easy]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Easy gift pack x 1 sent to the inventory]
[Quest: Go to the eight kingdoms.]
[Quest rank: Easy]
[Reward: Easy gift pack x 1]
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*
Long Huang and Long Baiyun immediately moved as soon as they sensed Zhang Fei's presence in their kingdom. "Do you also want to go into seclusion in this volcano?"

"No." Zhang Fei shook his head at Long Huang. "I'm facing a powerful demon right now, and I can't defeat it alone because it's too strong. That's why I came here to see Feng Yao, especially since I need her phoenix flames to defeat it."
"Can we help you fight the demon?"

"Unfortunately, the cultivation of both of you is still below the demon's, with its cultivation at the 5-Moon Divine Manifestation Realm." Zhang Fei's answer shocked both of them. "Moreover, the demon is not afraid of the light element, and it can destroy my light summon, so you guys cannot help me fight him."
*Swoosh...*
Feng Yao, who was listening to their conversation from inside the volcano, immediately flew out. She then returned to her human form and asked Zhang Fei. "Where did you meet the demon?"
"The Nine Hells Darkland! Millions of living creatures form the wandering soul demon."
"I see." Feng Yao nodded in understanding. "Let me guess, the wandering soul demon is guarding the Soul Fire, right?"
Zhang Fei nodded at her and asked. "Can you help me with that?"
"Send me there." Zhang Fei immediately opened the gate to the Nine Hells Darkland and brought Feng Yao into it directly.
Long Huang let out a heavy sigh after they disappeared. "Even though I didn't go to that realm, I can feel the horror of that realm from here."

"Me too." Long Baiyun said it with a nod. "Compared to us and all the cultivators in this realm, Zhang Fei's progress is truly astonishing, especially since he continues to improve himself by fighting people who are much stronger than him."
"Let's go back."
Aboard the flying artifact, Zhang Xiaolong [3] explained to Lin Moxian about the situation, which shocked his senior brother, especially his explanation regarding his clones.

Lin Moxian felt truly dizzy about his junior brother, and he felt that nothing about Zhang Xiaolong [3] was normal. He then took out a golden battle puppet. "This puppet is my strongest battle puppet, and it is much stronger against the wandering soul demon. You can send it there now, and I will control it from here."
"Thank you, Senior Brother." Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s action of opening the gate shocked Lin Moxian again, but he immediately sent his golden battle puppet inside.

"Oh?" Lin Moxian was taken back when she saw Feng Yao with Zhang Fei through his puppet eyes. "I didn't expect you to have a close relationship with the phoenix princess, Junior Brother. With my golden battle puppet and her phoenix flames, we can definitely defeat the wandering soul demon. However, avoid directly absorbing the Soul Fire, as the negative emotions of the souls that formed it taint it. Absorbing it carelessly will destroy your soul, turning you into a soulless puppet."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at him. "I will definitely be careful in doing so."

Zhang Fei, Feng Yao, and Lin Moxian's golden battle puppet had already arrived at Zhang Fei [5]'s side. However, they did not immediately enter the underground cave, and they first formulated a strategy to deal with the wandering soul demon.
"Moxian, try using your battle puppet to distract the wandering soul demon."

The golden battle puppet immediately entered the underground cave and lured the demon away from the edge, but it did not care about it, and its eyes continued to stare at Feng Yao and the two Zhang Feis.

"This demon is not interested in dead things." Feng Yao then checked the surroundings of the underground cave before extending her right hand forward, and dozens of small fire phoenixes shot out from her hand before spreading to every side of the cave. The wandering soul demon was aware of its targets, so it immediately moved and destroyed them. "Oh? This demon isn't afraid of my phoenix flames either, huh? It can even destroy my small fire phoenixes."
"What do you think we should do now?" Zhang Fei asked with a gloomy expression.

Feng Yao thoughtfully looked at the wandering soul demon. "I will use my aura to protect this area, and you can summon the rest of your clones here. Those skeletons and dried corpses are also the source of this demon's power, so we must destroy them first. You guys can distract this demon, and I will try to destroy those skeletons and dried corpses to weaken it."

After Feng Yao enveloped the place with her aura, Zhang Fei immediately summoned his clones—except for Zhang Xiaolong [3]—to that place. His fourth clone sent Ru Xue and the others into the training space, especially since there was no one to protect them where they were cultivating. "Let's do it now."

Zhang Fei was the first to enter the underground cave, but the wandering soul demon immediately chased after him, and they competed in teleportation speed. After that, his four clones also entered the place to attack the demon together, and Lin Moxian's golden puppet also helped them, overwhelming it to repel their combined attacks.
As soon as the wandering soul demon was caught off guard, Feng Yao immediately released her phoenix flames, burning those skeletons and dried corpses.
*Roar*

The wandering demon let out an angry roar after seeing that, but its aura actually increased significantly. It glared at Feng Yao and released countless wandering souls to attack her, but the Phoenix Princess immediately enveloped her body with her phoenix flames, forcing them to retreat.
*Roar*

Perhaps the thing you felt earlier came from the Soul Fire, or it could also be from the wandering soul demon.]
Zhang Fei [5] gave a light nod of approval. 'If you say so, it is likely that the wandering soul demon is near the Soul Fire, and it might be protecting it.
Although I am confident in my ability to escape, I must be really careful this time because this place is too narrow, and I will not be able to escape if that demon is as strong as Wang Yin.'
[You can escape by entering the Yin-Yang Space or Training Space, but this demon aura will infect one of them and prevent your people from entering again.
The second solution is to cancel your clone, Master.]
'Yeah, you're right.' Zhang Fei [5] immediately activated his invisibility and swam forward faster.
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Demon Essences.]
[Reward: 10,000 demon coins.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 10,000 blue jewels.]
[Daily Quest: Killing 1000 demons or demon beasts at the Earth Realm or above.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack X1.]
Zhang Fei [5] had no concern for the three quests, as his other clones could handle them, and his primary goal was to reach the cave's end as quickly as possible.
He wanted to find the wandering soul demon and the Soul Fire as soon as possible so he could leave the Nine Hells Darkland sooner.
A few hours later, Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow when he saw the light from a distance, but the light gave him an eerie feeling; even the hairs on the back of his neck stood up. 'Fuck!
Even before I became a cultivator, I had never felt such fear.'
[Ding]
[Quest: Finding the soul fire.]
[Quest rank: Medium]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Medium gift pack x 1 sent to the inventory.]
'As expected!
This light really is coming from the Soul Fire!' Before long, Zhang Fei [5] arrived at the end of the cave and immediately swam to the surface, but he arrived at a spacious underground cave.
However, he was greeted by a terrifying sight because there were numerous skeletons of living creatures there, as well as drying corpses on every side of the cave.
'Shit!' Zhang Fei [5] grabbed the demon extermination sword floating by his side and held it, but he could feel fear from his sword.
He then looked at a huge demon sleeping in a sitting position at the end of the cave. 'Calm down, Hei'an and Guang'an.
I'm here with you two, and I will never let you two get hurt.'
The demon's body was transparent like a soul, and an eerie aura radiated from it, which came from the countless wandering souls that formed it.
Not only that, Zhang Fei [5] could also feel the horror of the blackish-white fire floating in front of the demon, which was his target.
[Haha!
You guessed right, Master!
This demon is the wandering soul demon, and it protects the Soul Fire!
By the way, this demon rank is a king rank, and his cultivation is at the 5-Moon Divine Manifestation Realm.]

Even though the wandering soul demon was still much stronger than him, Zhang Fei [5] felt a little relieved because it was not as strong as Wang Yin. 'Mei, the thing I absorbed earlier came from this demon, right?'
[Yes, Master.
Previously, the system couldn't detect it, but it has already given the scan results, and the thing you absorbed before was a small part of the soul that formed this wandering soul demon.
According to the system scan, this demon was formed from millions of souls of those who died in this realm, and I think you can only defeat it if you absorb them all.]
'Millions of souls; yet this demon rank is only a king rank.' Zhang Fei [5] muttered as he thought of a way to defeat the wandering soul demon, especially since it seemed to be sleeping.
[Master, this underground cave is right in the middle of this realm, and the demons are gathering above you right now.
However, I have bad news for you because this place is covered by a powerful formation, and it is preventing you from opening both of your spaces, so you must act with extreme caution.]

Zhang Fei [5] frowned and gripped his sword tighter, but the wandering soul demon suddenly opened its eyes, and two tiny soul fires emerged from its eyes. 'This fight will be the most difficult fight for me.'
Upon seeing Zhang Fei [5], the demon released its aura to instill fear in him, but he immediately countered it with his own aura and killing intent at the same time.
The wandering soul demon immediately stood up from its seat and stretched out both hands to both sides.
Instantly, two bone swords shot into its hands, and it slashed both of them straight into the walls, causing those dried corpses to fall into a pile of skeletons.
*Bam...
Bam...*
Zhang Fei [5] took a deep breath because the wandering soul demon's attack was powerful. 'Mei, is it possible to destroy the wall above me?'
[Impossible, Master.
The formation is too powerful; even Wang Yin and those demon emperors couldn't detect this place because of it.]
Zhang Fei [5] thought of escaping from the cave, but the wandering soul demon suddenly moved behind him and slashed his two bone swords at him.
Fortunately, he had sharp instincts and lightning-fast reflexes, so he immediately used teleportation to avoid the attack.
The wandering soul demon immediately chased after Zhang Fei [5] with an ability almost similar to his teleportation, which shocked him.
Since he became a cultivator, no living being has been able to catch up to him if he uses his teleportation, but the demon can match his speed and isn't afraid of his light element.

Zhang Fei [5] continued to use his teleportation to avoid the wandering soul demon's pursuit, but it continued to stick behind him while attacking him repeatedly, sending the skeletons in that place scattering in various directions.
*Clang...
Clang...*
As they played cat and mouse, Zhang Fei [5] repeatedly countered the wandering soul demon's attacks, but all of its attacks were extremely hard and caused his hands to become numb.
'Fuck!' Zhang Fei [5] teleported above the water and dove straight into it, but the wandering soul demon did not chase after him and stopped at the edge, staring at him with its blackish-white eyes.
'What happened?
Why isn't this demon chasing me?' Zhang Fei [5] wondered to himself as he stared at the wandering soul demon.
[Master, it seems that the formation is blocking the wandering soul demon from leaving that underground cave.]

Mei's words confused Zhang Fei [5], especially since he was previously able to absorb the souls from the wandering soul demon's body. 'If that's true, how could this demon have sent those souls out before?'
[I don't have an answer for that, Master.]

Ma Kuangyu suddenly spoke into Zhang Fei [5]'s mind. 'Kid, you will never be able to win against this demon with your current cultivation, so you should retreat for the time being and find another way to defeat it.'
'Yeah.' Zhang Fei [5] suddenly had an idea. 'Old Ma, what do you think if I use my real body and my other clones to gang up on this demon?
If we use the demon-absorbing at the same time, we can absorb those souls to weaken it.'
Ma Kuangyu let out a soft sigh. 'You can do that, but this demon is formed from millions of wandering souls.
If you absorb too much of them too quickly, they will undoubtedly affect you, and they will take over your body.
By the way, I have some methods you might be able to use; would you like to hear them?'
'Please tell me, Old Ma.'
Ma Kuangyu immediately informed Zhang Fei [5]. 'First, bring that female devourer demon here, and she can help you to weaken this demon by absorbing those wandering souls.
Regretfully, she was too weak because she was not a demon cultivator, and this demon could kill her easily.
Second, ask that female phoenix to help you, and this demon will not dare to approach her phoenix flames.
Third, your senior brother is a puppeteer, and he must have powerful puppets, so you can ask him to send some of his puppets here.'
'Can I open the gate in this water, Mei?'
[As long as you don't enter the underground cave, you can use the gate, Master.]

The wandering soul demon suddenly sent hundreds of wandering souls into the water to attack Zhang Fei [5], but he immediately used the demon-absorbing to absorb them, and the demon extermination sword also immediately moved to help him.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately used his light element technique, and the light winged-race shot towards the wandering soul demon.
However, the demon slashed it with its two bone swords, dispelling his attack directly.
'Fuck!' Zhang Fei [5] cursed. 'I guess I have no other choice, and I'll use my real body to meet Feng Yao first.'
[Ding]
[Quest: Go to the seventh kingdom.]
[Quest rank: Easy]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Easy gift pack x 1 sent to the inventory]
[Quest: Go to the eight kingdoms.]
[Quest rank: Easy]
[Reward: Easy gift pack x 1]
*Swoosh...
Swoosh...*
Long Huang and Long Baiyun immediately moved as soon as they sensed Zhang Fei's presence in their kingdom.
"Do you also want to go into seclusion in this volcano?"
"No." Zhang Fei shook his head at Long Huang.
"I'm facing a powerful demon right now, and I can't defeat it alone because it's too strong.
That's why I came here to see Feng Yao, especially since I need her phoenix flames to defeat it."
"Can we help you fight the demon?"
"Unfortunately, the cultivation of both of you is still below the demon's, with its cultivation at the 5-Moon Divine Manifestation Realm." Zhang Fei's answer shocked both of them.
"Moreover, the demon is not afraid of the light element, and it can destroy my light summon, so you guys cannot help me fight him."
*Swoosh...*
Feng Yao, who was listening to their conversation from inside the volcano, immediately flew out.
She then returned to her human form and asked Zhang Fei.
"Where did you meet the demon?"
"The Nine Hells Darkland!
Millions of living creatures form the wandering soul demon."
"I see." Feng Yao nodded in understanding.
"Let me guess, the wandering soul demon is guarding the Soul Fire, right?"
Zhang Fei nodded at her and asked.
"Can you help me with that?"
"Send me there." Zhang Fei immediately opened the gate to the Nine Hells Darkland and brought Feng Yao into it directly.
Long Huang let out a heavy sigh after they disappeared.
"Even though I didn't go to that realm, I can feel the horror of that realm from here."
"Me too." Long Baiyun said it with a nod.
"Compared to us and all the cultivators in this realm, Zhang Fei's progress is truly astonishing, especially since he continues to improve himself by fighting people who are much stronger than him."
"Let's go back."
Aboard the flying artifact, Zhang Xiaolong [3] explained to Lin Moxian about the situation, which shocked his senior brother, especially his explanation regarding his clones.
Lin Moxian felt truly dizzy about his junior brother, and he felt that nothing about Zhang Xiaolong [3] was normal.
He then took out a golden battle puppet.
"This puppet is my strongest battle puppet, and it is much stronger against the wandering soul demon.
You can send it there now, and I will control it from here."
"Thank you, Senior Brother." Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s action of opening the gate shocked Lin Moxian again, but he immediately sent his golden battle puppet inside.
"Oh?" Lin Moxian was taken back when she saw Feng Yao with Zhang Fei through his puppet eyes.
"I didn't expect you to have a close relationship with the phoenix princess, Junior Brother.
With my golden battle puppet and her phoenix flames, we can definitely defeat the wandering soul demon.
However, avoid directly absorbing the Soul Fire, as the negative emotions of the souls that formed it taint it.
Absorbing it carelessly will destroy your soul, turning you into a soulless puppet."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at him.
"I will definitely be careful in doing so."
Zhang Fei, Feng Yao, and Lin Moxian's golden battle puppet had already arrived at Zhang Fei [5]'s side.
However, they did not immediately enter the underground cave, and they first formulated a strategy to deal with the wandering soul demon.
"Moxian, try using your battle puppet to distract the wandering soul demon."

The golden battle puppet immediately entered the underground cave and lured the demon away from the edge, but it did not care about it, and its eyes continued to stare at Feng Yao and the two Zhang Feis.

"This demon is not interested in dead things." Feng Yao then checked the surroundings of the underground cave before extending her right hand forward, and dozens of small fire phoenixes shot out from her hand before spreading to every side of the cave.
The wandering soul demon was aware of its targets, so it immediately moved and destroyed them.
"Oh?
This demon isn't afraid of my phoenix flames either, huh?
It can even destroy my small fire phoenixes."
"What do you think we should do now?" Zhang Fei asked with a gloomy expression.
Feng Yao thoughtfully looked at the wandering soul demon.
"I will use my aura to protect this area, and you can summon the rest of your clones here.
Those skeletons and dried corpses are also the source of this demon's power, so we must destroy them first.
You guys can distract this demon, and I will try to destroy those skeletons and dried corpses to weaken it."
After Feng Yao enveloped the place with her aura, Zhang Fei immediately summoned his clones—except for Zhang Xiaolong [3]—to that place.
His fourth clone sent Ru Xue and the others into the training space, especially since there was no one to protect them where they were cultivating.
"Let's do it now."
Zhang Fei was the first to enter the underground cave, but the wandering soul demon immediately chased after him, and they competed in teleportation speed.
After that, his four clones also entered the place to attack the demon together, and Lin Moxian's golden puppet also helped them, overwhelming it to repel their combined attacks.
As soon as the wandering soul demon was caught off guard, Feng Yao immediately released her phoenix flames, burning those skeletons and dried corpses.
*Roar*
The wandering demon let out an angry roar after seeing that, but its aura actually increased significantly.
It glared at Feng Yao and released countless wandering souls to attack her, but the Phoenix Princess immediately enveloped her body with her phoenix flames, forcing them to retreat.
*Roar*

chapters.title: Chapter 771: Move The Soul Fire
paragraphs: The wandering soul demon tried to attack Feng Yao, but the formation blocked it. It immediately slashed its two bone swords at the barrier again and again, but the barrier did not budge or crack.

Zhang Fei and his four clones took advantage of the situation to absorb the wandering souls from the demon's body in turns, especially since they were one entity, and absorbing those souls together would only be detrimental to him.
The wandering soul demon turned around to attack them, but Lin Moxian's golden puppet moved and grabbed the two bone swords before breaking them both in half.
*Roar*
The wandering soul demon roared and released many wandering souls to attack it, but the puppet was an inanimate object, so they had no effect on it.

Lin Moxian's golden puppet turned to Zhang Fei, who immediately moved behind the Soul Fire. He enveloped it with his light element before starting to absorb it, but the negative emotions within the fire quickly affected his mind, causing him to involuntarily release killing intent and bloodlust.

The wandering soul demon was even more furious after seeing that, and it wanted to attack him because the fire was its treasure. However, Lin Moxian's golden puppet kept blocking its way, and Zhang Fei's four clones were relentlessly absorbing those souls using the demon-absorbing ability.

No matter how powerful the wandering soul demon's attack was, Lin Moxian's golden puppet did not flinch an inch, and it absorbed the impact of its attack. Unfortunately, the demon's body was made of soul, so the puppet couldn't attack it.

Seeing that Zhang Fei's condition was not good, Feng Yao moved into the underground cave as she burned the remaining skeletons and dried corpses. She then moved behind him, sat behind him, and pressed her palms against his back. "Calm yourself and do it slowly! Otherwise, those negative emotions will affect you more deeply, and you won't be able to get rid of them anymore."

[Master! Use one of your clones to go to the Netherworld Realm and bring Ursula here now! Those negative emotions are simply too evil, so you cannot absorb this Soul Fire by yourself, and you need her help to absorb it.]
Zhang Fei [1] immediately entered the water and opened the gate leading to the Netherworld Realm there. He left for that realm not too long ago, and he quickly returned, bringing Ursula with him.

Although Ursula's demon rank was at the empress rank, they trembled as soon as they saw the wandering soul demon. Zhang Fei [1] immediately brought the twin female demon to his original body's side and spoke. "Help me absorb the negative emotions inside this Soul Fire so that my original body can absorb it."

Meanwhile, Ursula stretched out their hands to the Soul Fire and used the devouring ability, devouring the negative emotions inside the fire. 'We have never encountered such evil negative emotions before! These emotions are definitely not possessed by a few living beings but countless of them; otherwise, they wouldn't be this powerful and evil.'
Ursula's help made Zhang Fei a little relieved because the influence of the negative emotions on him began to decrease, and he could focus more on absorbing the Soul Fire.

Feng Yao, who was sitting behind him, was also relieved by this. However, she did not relax her vigilance because the negative emotions were too evil, and she was worried that they would affect Zhang Fei.

Zhang Fei [1] immediately joined forces with Lin Moxian's golden puppet and his other clones again, and they continued to weaken the wandering soul demon. 'Crap! The wandering souls in this demon's body are simply too numerous! Moreover, we can't absorb it all at once, so it will take days to weaken him.'
When the wandering soul demon's situation became even more unfavorable, a jet-black aura suddenly enveloped it, making the wandering souls that formed its body release an aura of hatred and anger.
*Roar*
The wandering soul demon went berserk because of the situation, which increased its power several times higher. It blindly attacked Lin Moxian's golden puppet and Zhang Fei's clones.

[Master! It's an emergency! I don't know what happened, but all the wandering souls on the surface have started moving towards the location of the Soul Pool. Wang Yin and the two demon emperors noticed their movements, and they are already on their way to this place, so you have to move quickly.]

'Damn it! I can't possibly absorb this Soul Fire in a short time, and the situation will be even more difficult if they come here.' Zhang Fei racked his brains for the best solution, and then he asked Feng Yao. 'Can you break the barrier that surrounds this place? Three demon emperors and one demon empress will be arriving here soon, and they brought many powerful subordinates. We'll be in big trouble if they get here, so we have to avoid them.'

'Are you thinking of moving this Soul Fire and the wandering soul demon to the Netherworld Realm?' Zhang Fei nodded to Feng Yao, who seemed to be in a dilemma about following his wishes. 'Huo Ling, I need your help to break this barrier, especially since I can't do it with my current strength.'
{Are you sure, Master? You yourself said that you wouldn't let Ling Yun know about me before he went to the Paradise Realm, and Lin Moxian could also see me through his puppet's eyes.}
'Just do it.'

Huo Ling let out a heavy sigh before exiting Feng Yao's body, shocking Zhang Fei, Ursula, and Lin Moxian, who were looking at him through his puppet's eyes. Mei tried to scan her status, but the system couldn't display anything, which meant her existence surpassed it.
Huo Ling disdainfully looked at the wandering soul demon before flicking her finger, causing the demon to be pushed back and slam into the barrier.
*Roar!*
The wandering soul demon roared as it struggled to escape Huo Ling's pressure. "How dare such a lowly creature like you look at me! If it weren't for my master, I would be too lazy to deal with you."
"Huo Ling."
"I know." Huo Ling once again flicked his finger, and the barrier that enveloped the underground cave instantly shattered into pieces. "It's a piece of cake!"

Huo Ling turned to Zhang Fei, who was staring at her in astonishment. "Even though you are the successor of the ten-tailed fox and have many advantages, you are still too weak now, and your weakness forces me to take care of such a trivial matter. If you continue like this, you will not be able to survive in the Paradise Realm, and you will helplessly watch everyone around you die."
"That's enough, Huo Ling." Feng Yao then spoke to Zhang Fei. "Open the gate now."
As he looked at Huo Ling, Zhang Fei opened the gate. The fire spirit immediately moved everyone, including the wandering soul and the soul fire, there through it.
Upon their arrival in the realm, Huo Ling confined the wandering soul demon using a fire cage, causing it to become even more furious and continue to attack the fire cage.

"Humph!" Huo Ling coldly snorted at the demon and entered Feng Yao's body. 'Zhang Fei is too weak, Master! He can't even take care of trivial matters with his own abilities, and he keeps relying on you or others to take care of his problems.'

'Huo Ling, Zhang Fei is indeed still too weak, but he has only been a cultivator for less than a year, remember? Even in our realm, cultivators of his age have not been able to reach his level, so you can stop looking down on him.' Feng Yao then said to Zhang Fei. "Since the situation is under control, you can start absorbing this Soul Fire, and your clones can absorb the wandering souls in the demon's body."

Although he was curious about Huo Ling's identity and strength, Zhang Fei prioritized absorbing the Soul Fire and the wandering souls as soon as possible so he could complete all the quests he had in the Nine Hells Darkland.
[Master, the system can't detect anything from Huo Ling as if she is an inanimate object. If you are curious about her identity, you can absorb them first and ask Feng Yao later.]

Mei's words shocked Zhang Fei, especially since the system almost never failed to detect other people. Back then, the system failed to detect Lin Mengmeng because she was an avatar, making him think that she was also an avatar like her.
On top of the flying artifact, Lin Moxian directly stored the golden battle puppet after Zhang Xiaolong [3] brought it back. "Do you recognize that woman's identity, Junior Brother?"
"No." Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head. "I've only seen Huo Ling once, so I don't know his identity. Although I've never met the Nameless One, I have a feeling that she is much stronger than him."
"I also think the same as you." Lin Moxian then asked him again. "What does that woman mean about the Paradise Realm? Do the realms beyond the upper realms really exist?"

"Senior Brother, those realms do exist, and they formed a huge realm called the Paradise Realm." Lin Moxian's expression turned serious after Zhang Xiaolong [3] said that. "I've met a few people from that realm, and they are truly powerful. I don't know how to put it, but I've always suspected that Feng Yao also came from that realm, and Huo Ling's appearance just now confirmed my suspicions."

Lin Moxian shook his head. "Junior Brother, I am older than Feng Yao, and my Lin Clan has close ties with the Phoenix Race. My family and I were present when Empress Feng Jiu gave birth to her, so it was impossible for her to come from those realms. However, she was already extraordinary since she was little, and she was the only baby born with cultivation."
"Eh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was shocked when he heard that

"Feng Yao's cultivation had reached the 10-Star Elementary Realm when she was born, and she reached the 10-Star Soul Realm when she was five years old." Zhang Xiaolong [3] took a deep breath after Lin Moxian said that, but his next explanation shocked him even more. "She is the youngest cultivator to reach the Seven Divine Realm, and she did it before she even reached adulthood. I don't know what she was thinking, but I always felt that she was deliberately holding back her cultivation. If she didn't do that, she would have long surpassed her parents or the Nameless One, and I'm sure she would have reached the 5-Month Divine Ascension by now. However, I don't understand how she got to know Huo Ling, especially since that woman clearly came from the Heaven Realm."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] himself had long been aware that Feng Yao was too mysterious, and she repeatedly attempted to probe him as if she wanted to search for something inside his body. Although he had always been casual with her, he didn't really trust her, and Huo Ling's previous appearance made him even more suspicious of her, especially about her intentions towards him.
"How did you know about those people?" Lin Moxian asked.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] told Lin Moxian about the Sun Tower in the Blossom Heaven Realm. "Feng Yao and I once challenged the tower, and she told her parents about it. Her parents, the Nameless One, Gong Ren, and several mythical beast races are challenging it now. As for our master, I told Murong Mengying about it, and she then told the young generations of those clans, which spread to the ears of our master and Xia Tian."

"I see." Lin Moxian nodded in understanding. "At first, I was confused by our master's reason for bringing them to the middle realm, but it turns out that the way to go to the Paradise Realm is in that realm. Do you think they will succeed in going there?"

"No." Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head. "The Sun Tower is actually a trial tower, and the people from the Paradise Realm use it to test our abilities. Even if we successfully pass all the trials, we can't go there directly, and we have to reach the 5-Moon Divine Ascension first before they can send us there. Moreover, the number of people who can go there is only ten people at a time, and they will choose them from all the people who successfully reach the top of the tower. Therefore, we have to challenge the tower repeatedly, and we can only go there if they deem us worthy."

Lin Moxian was not surprised to hear that because it was the same in all realms, and people from sects or clans would only choose the best among the countless people who wanted to join them. "The tower piqued my interest, and I want to try undergoing those trials, but I won't go there now. Since we have to reach the 5-Moon Divine Ascension first to reach the peak, I will go there once my cultivation reaches that stage."

"Actually, you will lose if you choose like that, Senior Brother." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then told Lin Moxian about the enlightenment challenge and the reward. "I plan to bring all my close people to challenge the tower in the next three to four months, and you can join us if you want."
"I will join you guys." Lin Moxian decided without a second thought. "Since we don't have anything to do right now, you can tell me about the other challenges."
Meanwhile, Wang Yin and the others had arrived at the underground cave, but they found nothing but burnt spots and traces of fighting.

One of the demon emperors immediately approached the previous spot of the Soul Fire, squatted there, and rubbed the ground. He had long red hair, and his body was covered in red armor. "This race clearly belongs to the Soul Fire, but I didn't expect that it was buried under here for so long."
"Are you sure about that, Yan Huo?" The other demon emperor asked in doubt. He had short, jet-black hair, a tall and muscular body, and wore jet-black armor.

Yan Huo turned to him with narrowed eyes. "Are you doubting my knowledge of fire, Huan Ying? My flame demon race is expert in fire, so I couldn't have recognized it wrong, and this burning trace belonged to the Soul Fire. Unfortunately, we discovered it too late, and someone else was ahead of us in taking it."
"Who do you think took the Soul Fire?" Huan Ying asked.
Yan Huo did not answer and checked the other burning traces, but his expression became serious. "These burning traces are not caused by ordinary flames, but they are caused by extraordinary flames."
"What kind of flames?"
"The phoenix flames."
"Are you sure they were caused by the phoenix flames?"

"A hundred percent." Yan Huo then stood up and turned to us. "I don't understand the purpose of the phoenix race taking the Soul Fire, but we should forget about it. The Phoenix emperor and empress are too strong for us, and we will undoubtedly die in their hands. I am a fire demon, but their phoenix flames can still kill me."
Wang Yin and Huan Ying naturally understood Feng Tian and Feng Jiu's strength, so they would not act stupidly to challenge them.
Huan Ying then spoke. "Since the Soul Fire has disappeared, there is no point for us to stay in this realm any longer, so I will bring my subordinates back to our realm now."
"Me too." The two demon emperors immediately left the underground cave.

Unlike them, Wang Yin stayed behind and examined the traces of the battle left there. "Could it be that Zhang Xiaolong has a connection to the phoenix race? Yan Huo and Huan Ying couldn't sense it because they hadn't met him, but I'm sure he was here before, and he fought with something that protected the Soul Fire."

After thinking about it, Wang Yin left the underground cave and ordered her subordinates to return to their realms, but she and Shou Fubai remained in the Nine Hells Realm. "I knew you would come back here, so I waited for you here."

Meanwhile, Ursula stretched out their hands to the Soul Fire and used the devouring ability, devouring the negative emotions inside the fire. 'We have never encountered such evil negative emotions before!
These emotions are definitely not possessed by a few living beings but countless of them; otherwise, they wouldn't be this powerful and evil.'
Ursula's help made Zhang Fei a little relieved because the influence of the negative emotions on him began to decrease, and he could focus more on absorbing the Soul Fire.
Feng Yao, who was sitting behind him, was also relieved by this.
However, she did not relax her vigilance because the negative emotions were too evil, and she was worried that they would affect Zhang Fei.
Zhang Fei [1] immediately joined forces with Lin Moxian's golden puppet and his other clones again, and they continued to weaken the wandering soul demon. 'Crap!
The wandering souls in this demon's body are simply too numerous!
Moreover, we can't absorb it all at once, so it will take days to weaken him.'
When the wandering soul demon's situation became even more unfavorable, a jet-black aura suddenly enveloped it, making the wandering souls that formed its body release an aura of hatred and anger.
*Roar*
The wandering soul demon went berserk because of the situation, which increased its power several times higher.
It blindly attacked Lin Moxian's golden puppet and Zhang Fei's clones.
[Master!
It's an emergency!
I don't know what happened, but all the wandering souls on the surface have started moving towards the location of the Soul Pool.
Wang Yin and the two demon emperors noticed their movements, and they are already on their way to this place, so you have to move quickly.]
'Damn it!

I can't possibly absorb this Soul Fire in a short time, and the situation will be even more difficult if they come here.' Zhang Fei racked his brains for the best solution, and then he asked Feng Yao. 'Can you break the barrier that surrounds this place?
Three demon emperors and one demon empress will be arriving here soon, and they brought many powerful subordinates.
We'll be in big trouble if they get here, so we have to avoid them.'

'Are you thinking of moving this Soul Fire and the wandering soul demon to the Netherworld Realm?' Zhang Fei nodded to Feng Yao, who seemed to be in a dilemma about following his wishes. 'Huo Ling, I need your help to break this barrier, especially since I can't do it with my current strength.'
{Are you sure, Master?
You yourself said that you wouldn't let Ling Yun know about me before he went to the Paradise Realm, and Lin Moxian could also see me through his puppet's eyes.}
'Just do it.'
Huo Ling let out a heavy sigh before exiting Feng Yao's body, shocking Zhang Fei, Ursula, and Lin Moxian, who were looking at him through his puppet's eyes.
Mei tried to scan her status, but the system couldn't display anything, which meant her existence surpassed it.
Huo Ling disdainfully looked at the wandering soul demon before flicking her finger, causing the demon to be pushed back and slam into the barrier.
*Roar!*
The wandering soul demon roared as it struggled to escape Huo Ling's pressure.
"How dare such a lowly creature like you look at me!
If it weren't for my master, I would be too lazy to deal with you."
"Huo Ling."
"I know." Huo Ling once again flicked his finger, and the barrier that enveloped the underground cave instantly shattered into pieces.
"It's a piece of cake!"
Huo Ling turned to Zhang Fei, who was staring at her in astonishment.
"Even though you are the successor of the ten-tailed fox and have many advantages, you are still too weak now, and your weakness forces me to take care of such a trivial matter.
If you continue like this, you will not be able to survive in the Paradise Realm, and you will helplessly watch everyone around you die."
"That's enough, Huo Ling." Feng Yao then spoke to Zhang Fei.
"Open the gate now."
As he looked at Huo Ling, Zhang Fei opened the gate.
The fire spirit immediately moved everyone, including the wandering soul and the soul fire, there through it.
Upon their arrival in the realm, Huo Ling confined the wandering soul demon using a fire cage, causing it to become even more furious and continue to attack the fire cage.
"Humph!" Huo Ling coldly snorted at the demon and entered Feng Yao's body. 'Zhang Fei is too weak, Master!
He can't even take care of trivial matters with his own abilities, and he keeps relying on you or others to take care of his problems.'
'Huo Ling, Zhang Fei is indeed still too weak, but he has only been a cultivator for less than a year, remember?
Even in our realm, cultivators of his age have not been able to reach his level, so you can stop looking down on him.' Feng Yao then said to Zhang Fei.
"Since the situation is under control, you can start absorbing this Soul Fire, and your clones can absorb the wandering souls in the demon's body."

Although he was curious about Huo Ling's identity and strength, Zhang Fei prioritized absorbing the Soul Fire and the wandering souls as soon as possible so he could complete all the quests he had in the Nine Hells Darkland.
[Master, the system can't detect anything from Huo Ling as if she is an inanimate object.
If you are curious about her identity, you can absorb them first and ask Feng Yao later.]
Mei's words shocked Zhang Fei, especially since the system almost never failed to detect other people.
Back then, the system failed to detect Lin Mengmeng because she was an avatar, making him think that she was also an avatar like her.
On top of the flying artifact, Lin Moxian directly stored the golden battle puppet after Zhang Xiaolong [3] brought it back.
"Do you recognize that woman's identity, Junior Brother?"
"No." Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head.
"I've only seen Huo Ling once, so I don't know his identity.
Although I've never met the Nameless One, I have a feeling that she is much stronger than him."
"I also think the same as you." Lin Moxian then asked him again.
"What does that woman mean about the Paradise Realm?
Do the realms beyond the upper realms really exist?"
"Senior Brother, those realms do exist, and they formed a huge realm called the Paradise Realm." Lin Moxian's expression turned serious after Zhang Xiaolong [3] said that.
"I've met a few people from that realm, and they are truly powerful.
I don't know how to put it, but I've always suspected that Feng Yao also came from that realm, and Huo Ling's appearance just now confirmed my suspicions."
Lin Moxian shook his head.
"Junior Brother, I am older than Feng Yao, and my Lin Clan has close ties with the Phoenix Race.
My family and I were present when Empress Feng Jiu gave birth to her, so it was impossible for her to come from those realms.
However, she was already extraordinary since she was little, and she was the only baby born with cultivation."
"Eh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was shocked when he heard that

"Feng Yao's cultivation had reached the 10-Star Elementary Realm when she was born, and she reached the 10-Star Soul Realm when she was five years old." Zhang Xiaolong [3] took a deep breath after Lin Moxian said that, but his next explanation shocked him even more.
"She is the youngest cultivator to reach the Seven Divine Realm, and she did it before she even reached adulthood.
I don't know what she was thinking, but I always felt that she was deliberately holding back her cultivation.
If she didn't do that, she would have long surpassed her parents or the Nameless One, and I'm sure she would have reached the 5-Month Divine Ascension by now.
However, I don't understand how she got to know Huo Ling, especially since that woman clearly came from the Heaven Realm."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] himself had long been aware that Feng Yao was too mysterious, and she repeatedly attempted to probe him as if she wanted to search for something inside his body.
Although he had always been casual with her, he didn't really trust her, and Huo Ling's previous appearance made him even more suspicious of her, especially about her intentions towards him.
"How did you know about those people?" Lin Moxian asked.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] told Lin Moxian about the Sun Tower in the Blossom Heaven Realm.
"Feng Yao and I once challenged the tower, and she told her parents about it.
Her parents, the Nameless One, Gong Ren, and several mythical beast races are challenging it now.
As for our master, I told Murong Mengying about it, and she then told the young generations of those clans, which spread to the ears of our master and Xia Tian."
"I see." Lin Moxian nodded in understanding.
"At first, I was confused by our master's reason for bringing them to the middle realm, but it turns out that the way to go to the Paradise Realm is in that realm.
Do you think they will succeed in going there?"
"No." Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head.
"The Sun Tower is actually a trial tower, and the people from the Paradise Realm use it to test our abilities.
Even if we successfully pass all the trials, we can't go there directly, and we have to reach the 5-Moon Divine Ascension first before they can send us there.
Moreover, the number of people who can go there is only ten people at a time, and they will choose them from all the people who successfully reach the top of the tower.
Therefore, we have to challenge the tower repeatedly, and we can only go there if they deem us worthy."
Lin Moxian was not surprised to hear that because it was the same in all realms, and people from sects or clans would only choose the best among the countless people who wanted to join them.
"The tower piqued my interest, and I want to try undergoing those trials, but I won't go there now.
Since we have to reach the 5-Moon Divine Ascension first to reach the peak, I will go there once my cultivation reaches that stage."
"Actually, you will lose if you choose like that, Senior Brother." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then told Lin Moxian about the enlightenment challenge and the reward.
"I plan to bring all my close people to challenge the tower in the next three to four months, and you can join us if you want."
"I will join you guys." Lin Moxian decided without a second thought.
"Since we don't have anything to do right now, you can tell me about the other challenges."
Meanwhile, Wang Yin and the others had arrived at the underground cave, but they found nothing but burnt spots and traces of fighting.
One of the demon emperors immediately approached the previous spot of the Soul Fire, squatted there, and rubbed the ground.
He had long red hair, and his body was covered in red armor.
"This race clearly belongs to the Soul Fire, but I didn't expect that it was buried under here for so long."
"Are you sure about that, Yan Huo?" The other demon emperor asked in doubt.
He had short, jet-black hair, a tall and muscular body, and wore jet-black armor.
Yan Huo turned to him with narrowed eyes.
"Are you doubting my knowledge of fire, Huan Ying?
My flame demon race is expert in fire, so I couldn't have recognized it wrong, and this burning trace belonged to the Soul Fire.
Unfortunately, we discovered it too late, and someone else was ahead of us in taking it."
"Who do you think took the Soul Fire?" Huan Ying asked.
Yan Huo did not answer and checked the other burning traces, but his expression became serious.
"These burning traces are not caused by ordinary flames, but they are caused by extraordinary flames."
"What kind of flames?"
"The phoenix flames."
"Are you sure they were caused by the phoenix flames?"
"A hundred percent." Yan Huo then stood up and turned to us.
"I don't understand the purpose of the phoenix race taking the Soul Fire, but we should forget about it.
The Phoenix emperor and empress are too strong for us, and we will undoubtedly die in their hands.
I am a fire demon, but their phoenix flames can still kill me."
Wang Yin and Huan Ying naturally understood Feng Tian and Feng Jiu's strength, so they would not act stupidly to challenge them.
Huan Ying then spoke.
"Since the Soul Fire has disappeared, there is no point for us to stay in this realm any longer, so I will bring my subordinates back to our realm now."
"Me too." The two demon emperors immediately left the underground cave.
Unlike them, Wang Yin stayed behind and examined the traces of the battle left there.
"Could it be that Zhang Xiaolong has a connection to the phoenix race?
Yan Huo and Huan Ying couldn't sense it because they hadn't met him, but I'm sure he was here before, and he fought with something that protected the Soul Fire."
After thinking about it, Wang Yin left the underground cave and ordered her subordinates to return to their realms, but she and Shou Fubai remained in the Nine Hells Realm.
"I knew you would come back here, so I waited for you here."

chapters.title: Chapter 772: Li Tiannan Captured
paragraphs: Cheng Gaoji, who was helping Duan Zhao forge Zhang Fei's new weapon, suddenly felt several powerful auras entering the Nine Stars Realm. "Several cultivators from the upper realms have just entered this realm, and one of them has cultivation at the 5-Moon Divine Transformation Realm."

"They should be Huangfu Shou's ancestors." Duan Zhao answered with certainty, especially since Zhang Fei had already told those close to him about it. "They are cultivators from the Huangfu Clan who reside in the Grand Royal Realm."

Cheng Gaoji nodded in understanding. "I've heard of the Huangfu Clan, and their leader is Huangfu Fanling. Their second most powerful cultivator is Huangfu Shong, and I believe he is the one leading their entourage. Even though he is strong, he still has to bow if he meets me, so you don't need to think about them and focus on completing this weapon."

"Haha." Duan Zhao laughed. "I still didn't expect to have the chance to meet you, Senior Cheng. Although I am quite skilled in blacksmithing, my cultivation is not as good as my forging skills, and it has not progressed in the past decades. Therefore, I have no ambition to go to the upper realms, and I thought of spending the rest of my life here. However, things have changed since Zhang Fei appeared, and that kid continues to bring changes to this realm. He also gave me some pills, which made my cultivation start progressing again."

"Phew." Cheng Gaoji released a soft sigh, remembering his position as Zhang Fei's subordinate. "Little Duan, I'm uncertain about the kid's future plans, but I intend to return to the Xianjin Realm once we finish crafting this weapon. If you want, I can bring you and your four disciples with me there, and you guys can cultivate faster. Furthermore, I have a good status there, and I can help you all improve your blacksmithing abilities."
"Is that true, Senior?" Xian Xian asked as she approached them along with her three friends.

Cheng Gaoji nodded at her. "If all of you don't have a deep connection with this realm and want to further develop yourselves, you can come with me to the Xianjin Realm. The difference in Qi between the middle and upper realms is too stark, and you guys will be more enthusiastic about cultivating if you do it there."
"What do you guys think about that?"
"It's a rare opportunity, so I won't miss it." Ah Hu was the first to answer.
Lu Zhong was also interested in Cheng Gaoji's offer. "Such an opportunity won't come twice, and I'll go there if our master decides to go."

Gang Zhishou was also interested in it, but he had different thoughts. "Master, you are quite old now, and your cultivation has not been broken through for decades. If you continue to stay here, you might never break through, and your lifespan will eventually run out. Therefore, you must go with Senior Cheng, and you can bring them with you."
"What about you, Shou?" Duan Zhao asked.

"I'm not going anywhere, at least for now." Gang Zhishou's answer surprised Duan Zhao and his three disciples. "Master, such an opportunity is indeed rare, but I am not ready to go to the upper realms. Moreover, Zhang Fei has already helped me in several things, so I want to stay in this realm to help him. Once he is ready to go to the upper realms, I will go with him there, and we will meet again then."

"I still want to develop my forging abilities and reach the highest level in blacksmithing, but I won't be able to do that if my cultivation continues to stagnate like now, and going to the upper realms is my best choice, so I will go with Senior Cheng." Duan Zhao looked at his three disciples, who were overjoyed by his decision. "If you want it like that, you can stay in this realm, Shou. Once Zhang Fei goes to the upper realms, you should join him, and we will wait for you there."
"We will meet again in the future, Master." Gang Zhishou replied with a nod.

"That's good." Duan Zhao then spoke to the other three. "The three of you have promised to join Zhang Fei in going to the Star Tower, so you guys should wait for him to meet us to discuss this matter with him. If he is okay with it, you can go with us to the upper realms."
"Yes, Master."
After that, the four of them continued their cultivation, and Duan Zhao continued to forge Zhang Fei's new weapon with the help of Cheng Gaoji.

On a small island not far from the Beast Kingdom, Mai Xiaomeng stood on a large rock while watching the flying artifact move toward the Huangfu Kingdom. "Those people must be members of the Huangfu Clan, and they must want to find the old man trapped in the tower. Given that they are Zhang Fei's adversaries, I will assist him in monitoring them, which could potentially provide an opportunity for me to establish a closer relationship with him.
"Are you leaving again, Big Sis?" Mai Yuzhen suddenly appeared beside her.
"I will supervise those cultivators from the upper realm for Zhang Fei, so I leave the members of our race to you."
Mai Yuzhen could only shake her head after Mai Xiaomeng left. "Zhang Fei's refusal caused my big sister to become obsessed with him, and she tried to do anything to attract his attention."
Li Tiannan, Helian Yueyi, and several others were already waiting at the flying artifact landing site. Soon, a flying artifact landed there, and an old man led five other people down it.
"Ancestor Huangfu Shong." Li Tiannan respectfully greeting the old man.
Helian Yueyi led the others to bow their heads. "Welcome to our kingdom, Ancestor Shong."
"Where is your husband? Why isn't he here?"
'This old man is better than Huangfu Fanbo.' Helian Yueyi then answered him. "Ancestor, my husband is in his room, and his condition has been strange since three months ago."
Huangfu Shong turned to Li Tiannan, who immediately explained Huangfu Shou's condition to him. "Huangfu Shou seems to have made a mistake in his cultivation, which caused his memory to decline."
"Have you checked his condition?'

"I didn't find any residue of pills or anything in his body, so I came to that conclusion." Li Tiannan then asked the old man. "Ancestor, can you arrange a replacement for me? After decades in this realm, my cultivation has not been broken through, so I hope to return to my clan and enter seclusion."

"Ask your father to send someone else to this realm." Huangfu Shong's answer relieved Li Tiannan. "Before that, you have to take us to the Star Tower, and we have to find Huangfu Fanbo as soon as possible."
Li Tiannan nodded to him. "I will take you there, but I cannot join in the search for Senior Fanbo. A month ago, we failed in the tower, so I cannot enter there for the next few years."

"The six of us are enough to find him." Huangfu Shong looked at Helian Yueyi. "I want to help your husband, but Huangfu Fanbo is more important than him, so I will help him after we have successfully found him."
"Yes, Ancestor."
After that, Huangfu Shong and the others hurriedly left the Huangfu Kingdom.
"Mother, I feel like our ancestors don't care about us at all." Huangfu Lian suddenly spoke.

Helian Yueyi was also aware of that, but there was nothing she could do. "Lian'er, you have to be careful what you speak, especially when they are in our kingdom. You are our first son, but the Huangfu Clan is too big, and they have many members in other realms. I'm afraid they'll kill you if they hear what you just said, so you have to be careful at all times. Do you understand?"
"I understand, Mother."
Helian Yueyi immediately left the place and went to Huangfu Shou's room to check on his condition. When she arrived there, she found her husband asleep, but she sat beside him and looked at him.

'Do you know how heavy my feelings are right now? What should I do? Your obsession with Zhang Fei has gotten our family into big trouble, and his father asked me to kill you to save our two daughters. I want to save them, but I don't have the heart to kill you. If I don't kill you, he will kill you and our daughters, and he will probably kill our sons too.' Helian Yueyi then stroked her husband's face. 'I love you, but our children are much more important than our lives. If I have no other way to save them from that evil demon, I will kill you, but I will accompany you to the afterlife.'
After she spent some time in her husband's room, Helian Yueyi went straight to her two daughters' room, where she pondered the two choices Zhang Fei had given her.

Huangfu Lian was having a discussion with Huangfu Ziyuan and Ling Baozi in his room. "What about those generals, Grandpa Ling? Zhang Fei has married Zhou Shenxin, and Zhou Xiaochuan has also become his slave, so the Zhou Kingdom is now his. Besides, the Bai Kingdom is under his control through the people from those major clans, so we must move quickly to take over our kingdom from my father."

"Your father's generals still can't move unless Du She gives them the antidote, and the majority of their soldiers have already submitted to me, so we can move whenever we want." Ling Baozi then asked Huangfu Ziyuan. "What about the people from the Huangfu Imperial Sect?"

"Since my big brother never dealt with them directly, they have always been on my side, so you don't need to think about them," Huangfu Ziyuan said casually. "By the way, Du She's poison has started to have an effect on him, and his memory continues to decline because of it. Sooner or later, he will completely lose his memory, and Lian'er can take his place at that time."

In the past, Huangfu Lian harbored the ambition to replace Huangfu Shou as the emperor of their kingdom, but he no longer had the ambition because he was Zhang Fei's slave, and his status as emperor would be useless since he would be the one controlling the kingdom. "Grandpa Ling! Uncle Ziyuan! You two must move faster to convince those nobles and clan leaders to side with us, especially since I'm sure he will make his move soon."

Huangfu Ziyuan and Ling Baozi nodded to Huangfu Lian before leaving his room, and he himself went to another room to carry out another task that Zhang Fei had given him, but he moved cautiously so that Helian Yueyi would not notice his actions.

Huangfu Shong and his entourage had already arrived at the Star Tower, and Li Tiannan led them to undergo the first test, the strength test. With their overly high cultivation, it was not difficult for the six of them to pass the challenge, and they immediately entered the tower.
Like Huangfu Fanbo, the old man in charge of the tower sent them into the maze challenge, and he deliberately made things difficult for them by increasing the difficulty of the challenge.

Li Tiannan, who was waiting outside the tower, suddenly shivered, feeling the presence of another person behind him. Before he could escape, Mai Xiaomeng immediately knocked him unconscious, sealed his cultivation, and shouldered him. "Hehe! Since Zhang Fei needs him to free Emperor Bai, I will hand him over to him. However, he is in another realm now, so I will take him somewhere else first."

Sometime later, Mai Xiaomeng took Li Tiannan to land on another island, but two people stopped her. They were Linghu Xiaoting and Linghu Shiwei, so she handed him over to them directly. "You two can take care of this guy for the time being, especially since Zhang Fei is busy with his personal affairs. By the way, he is the one who controlled your emperor using the Gu Insect, and you guys need him to free him."
"Who are you, Senior?"
Mai Xiaomeng shook her head at Linghu Xiaoting. "You don't need to know my identity, and you must take care of this guy until Zhang Fei returns."

Linghu Xiaoting turned to Linghu Shiwei as Mai Xiaomeng disappeared, making the two curious about his identity. They then brought Li Tiannan into the residence on the island and woke up Linghu Yincheng, who was resting in her room.

As soon as Linghu Yincheng met them, Linghu Shiwei explained to her about Li Tiannan and Mai Xiaomeng. "Empress, that woman is unwilling to reveal her identity, but we are certain that she is one of Zhang Fei's subordinates, especially since she asked us to wait for him to return before we can free your husband from this man's control."
"I see." Linghu Yincheng then looked at Li Tiannan with a relieved expression. "My decision to support Zhang Fei was one of the best of my life, and we will soon reunite with my husband."
"What are your next plans after your husband is free, Empress?" Linghu Xiaoting asked.

"I haven't thought of any plans yet, and I will discuss the whole situation with my husband once he is free." Linghu Yincheng looked at the three children's rooms. "My husband and I have fallen into this guy's control for so long, so we are no longer worthy to lead our kingdom. Even if we were to return to lead our kingdom, our people have already joined Zhang Fei, so our status is no longer meaningful. With his help, our kingdom will definitely be safe, so I think it's time for Chongxi to step up to replace us."

Linghu Xiaoting and Linghu Shiwei were shocked to hear that, and they felt that Bai Chongxi still did not meet the qualifications to become the emperor. They believed, like Linghu Yincheng, that Zhang Fei's support would protect their kingdom, so it wouldn't matter if he became Emperor.
Linghu Yincheng spoke to them again. "Let's wait for Zhang Fei to come back first, and we will discuss everything with him and my husband later."
"Yes, Empress." Linghu Shiwei immediately took Li Tiannan to an empty room and locked him up there.
"How do you feel about being the empress?" Jiang Tingxi asked Zhou Shenxin, who had just arrived in her room.

Zhou Shenxin let out a soft sigh, sat down beside Jiang Tingxi, and rested his head on her shoulder. "Being an empress is not as easy as I imagined, but I am fortunate that my father and the others are obedient to my orders, so I didn't have too much difficulty living my first day as empress. Have you contacted Grandpa Jiang to bring the others back to this kingdom?"

"They're already on their way back here, and they'll be here in a few days." Zhou Shensin was relieved by that. "I've told him about your wedding plans with Zhang Fei, and he is looking forward to the day. He asked you to give him a grandchild soon, but I told him that it was impossible, especially since Zhang Fei's cultivation is still at the ten mortal realms."

"My grandpa has long wanted a grandchild, but he has to wait much longer. Even if Zhang Fei's cultivation breaks through to the Seven Divine Realm, he still has no plans to have children, and he wants to have children after our lives are completely secure." Zhou Shenxin looked up at her mother. "What about you? Don't you want to find new happiness?"

"No." Jiang Tingxi gently refused. "I am satisfied with my life, so I don't need other happiness. Since your father and the others are helping you take care of this kingdom, I plan to enter a long seclusion, and I will come out briefly during your wedding with Zhang Fei."
Zhou Shenxin then took her mother to lie down on the bed. "Accompany me to sleep tonight, Mother."
"All right."
