Once Zhang Fei goes to the upper realms, you should join him, and we will wait for you there."
"We will meet again in the future, Master." Gang Zhishou replied with a nod.
"That's good." Duan Zhao then spoke to the other three.
"The three of you have promised to join Zhang Fei in going to the Star Tower, so you guys should wait for him to meet us to discuss this matter with him.
If he is okay with it, you can go with us to the upper realms."
"Yes, Master."
After that, the four of them continued their cultivation, and Duan Zhao continued to forge Zhang Fei's new weapon with the help of Cheng Gaoji.
On a small island not far from the Beast Kingdom, Mai Xiaomeng stood on a large rock while watching the flying artifact move toward the Huangfu Kingdom.
"Those people must be members of the Huangfu Clan, and they must want to find the old man trapped in the tower.
Given that they are Zhang Fei's adversaries, I will assist him in monitoring them, which could potentially provide an opportunity for me to establish a closer relationship with him.
"Are you leaving again, Big Sis?" Mai Yuzhen suddenly appeared beside her.
"I will supervise those cultivators from the upper realm for Zhang Fei, so I leave the members of our race to you."
Mai Yuzhen could only shake her head after Mai Xiaomeng left.
"Zhang Fei's refusal caused my big sister to become obsessed with him, and she tried to do anything to attract his attention."
Li Tiannan, Helian Yueyi, and several others were already waiting at the flying artifact landing site.
Soon, a flying artifact landed there, and an old man led five other people down it.
"Ancestor Huangfu Shong." Li Tiannan respectfully greeting the old man.
Helian Yueyi led the others to bow their heads.
"Welcome to our kingdom, Ancestor Shong."
"Where is your husband?
Why isn't he here?"
'This old man is better than Huangfu Fanbo.' Helian Yueyi then answered him.
"Ancestor, my husband is in his room, and his condition has been strange since three months ago."
Huangfu Shong turned to Li Tiannan, who immediately explained Huangfu Shou's condition to him.
"Huangfu Shou seems to have made a mistake in his cultivation, which caused his memory to decline."
"Have you checked his condition?'
"I didn't find any residue of pills or anything in his body, so I came to that conclusion." Li Tiannan then asked the old man.
"Ancestor, can you arrange a replacement for me?
After decades in this realm, my cultivation has not been broken through, so I hope to return to my clan and enter seclusion."
"Ask your father to send someone else to this realm." Huangfu Shong's answer relieved Li Tiannan.
"Before that, you have to take us to the Star Tower, and we have to find Huangfu Fanbo as soon as possible."
Li Tiannan nodded to him.
"I will take you there, but I cannot join in the search for Senior Fanbo.
A month ago, we failed in the tower, so I cannot enter there for the next few years."
"The six of us are enough to find him." Huangfu Shong looked at Helian Yueyi.
"I want to help your husband, but Huangfu Fanbo is more important than him, so I will help him after we have successfully found him."
"Yes, Ancestor."
After that, Huangfu Shong and the others hurriedly left the Huangfu Kingdom.
"Mother, I feel like our ancestors don't care about us at all." Huangfu Lian suddenly spoke.
Helian Yueyi was also aware of that, but there was nothing she could do.
"Lian'er, you have to be careful what you speak, especially when they are in our kingdom.
You are our first son, but the Huangfu Clan is too big, and they have many members in other realms.
I'm afraid they'll kill you if they hear what you just said, so you have to be careful at all times.
Do you understand?"
"I understand, Mother."
Helian Yueyi immediately left the place and went to Huangfu Shou's room to check on his condition.
When she arrived there, she found her husband asleep, but she sat beside him and looked at him.
'Do you know how heavy my feelings are right now?
What should I do?
Your obsession with Zhang Fei has gotten our family into big trouble, and his father asked me to kill you to save our two daughters.
I want to save them, but I don't have the heart to kill you.

If I don't kill you, he will kill you and our daughters, and he will probably kill our sons too.' Helian Yueyi then stroked her husband's face. 'I love you, but our children are much more important than our lives.
If I have no other way to save them from that evil demon, I will kill you, but I will accompany you to the afterlife.'
After she spent some time in her husband's room, Helian Yueyi went straight to her two daughters' room, where she pondered the two choices Zhang Fei had given her.
Huangfu Lian was having a discussion with Huangfu Ziyuan and Ling Baozi in his room.
"What about those generals, Grandpa Ling?
Zhang Fei has married Zhou Shenxin, and Zhou Xiaochuan has also become his slave, so the Zhou Kingdom is now his.
Besides, the Bai Kingdom is under his control through the people from those major clans, so we must move quickly to take over our kingdom from my father."

"Your father's generals still can't move unless Du She gives them the antidote, and the majority of their soldiers have already submitted to me, so we can move whenever we want." Ling Baozi then asked Huangfu Ziyuan.
"What about the people from the Huangfu Imperial Sect?"
"Since my big brother never dealt with them directly, they have always been on my side, so you don't need to think about them," Huangfu Ziyuan said casually.
"By the way, Du She's poison has started to have an effect on him, and his memory continues to decline because of it.
Sooner or later, he will completely lose his memory, and Lian'er can take his place at that time."

In the past, Huangfu Lian harbored the ambition to replace Huangfu Shou as the emperor of their kingdom, but he no longer had the ambition because he was Zhang Fei's slave, and his status as emperor would be useless since he would be the one controlling the kingdom.
"Grandpa Ling!
Uncle Ziyuan!
You two must move faster to convince those nobles and clan leaders to side with us, especially since I'm sure he will make his move soon."

Huangfu Ziyuan and Ling Baozi nodded to Huangfu Lian before leaving his room, and he himself went to another room to carry out another task that Zhang Fei had given him, but he moved cautiously so that Helian Yueyi would not notice his actions.
Huangfu Shong and his entourage had already arrived at the Star Tower, and Li Tiannan led them to undergo the first test, the strength test.
With their overly high cultivation, it was not difficult for the six of them to pass the challenge, and they immediately entered the tower.
Like Huangfu Fanbo, the old man in charge of the tower sent them into the maze challenge, and he deliberately made things difficult for them by increasing the difficulty of the challenge.
Li Tiannan, who was waiting outside the tower, suddenly shivered, feeling the presence of another person behind him.
Before he could escape, Mai Xiaomeng immediately knocked him unconscious, sealed his cultivation, and shouldered him.
"Hehe!
Since Zhang Fei needs him to free Emperor Bai, I will hand him over to him.
However, he is in another realm now, so I will take him somewhere else first."
Sometime later, Mai Xiaomeng took Li Tiannan to land on another island, but two people stopped her.
They were Linghu Xiaoting and Linghu Shiwei, so she handed him over to them directly.
"You two can take care of this guy for the time being, especially since Zhang Fei is busy with his personal affairs.
By the way, he is the one who controlled your emperor using the Gu Insect, and you guys need him to free him."
"Who are you, Senior?"
Mai Xiaomeng shook her head at Linghu Xiaoting.
"You don't need to know my identity, and you must take care of this guy until Zhang Fei returns."
Linghu Xiaoting turned to Linghu Shiwei as Mai Xiaomeng disappeared, making the two curious about his identity.
They then brought Li Tiannan into the residence on the island and woke up Linghu Yincheng, who was resting in her room.
As soon as Linghu Yincheng met them, Linghu Shiwei explained to her about Li Tiannan and Mai Xiaomeng.

"Empress, that woman is unwilling to reveal her identity, but we are certain that she is one of Zhang Fei's subordinates, especially since she asked us to wait for him to return before we can free your husband from this man's control."
"I see." Linghu Yincheng then looked at Li Tiannan with a relieved expression.
"My decision to support Zhang Fei was one of the best of my life, and we will soon reunite with my husband."
"What are your next plans after your husband is free, Empress?" Linghu Xiaoting asked.
"I haven't thought of any plans yet, and I will discuss the whole situation with my husband once he is free." Linghu Yincheng looked at the three children's rooms.
"My husband and I have fallen into this guy's control for so long, so we are no longer worthy to lead our kingdom.
Even if we were to return to lead our kingdom, our people have already joined Zhang Fei, so our status is no longer meaningful.
With his help, our kingdom will definitely be safe, so I think it's time for Chongxi to step up to replace us."
Linghu Xiaoting and Linghu Shiwei were shocked to hear that, and they felt that Bai Chongxi still did not meet the qualifications to become the emperor.
They believed, like Linghu Yincheng, that Zhang Fei's support would protect their kingdom, so it wouldn't matter if he became Emperor.
Linghu Yincheng spoke to them again.
"Let's wait for Zhang Fei to come back first, and we will discuss everything with him and my husband later."
"Yes, Empress." Linghu Shiwei immediately took Li Tiannan to an empty room and locked him up there.
"How do you feel about being the empress?" Jiang Tingxi asked Zhou Shenxin, who had just arrived in her room.
Zhou Shenxin let out a soft sigh, sat down beside Jiang Tingxi, and rested his head on her shoulder.
"Being an empress is not as easy as I imagined, but I am fortunate that my father and the others are obedient to my orders, so I didn't have too much difficulty living my first day as empress.
Have you contacted Grandpa Jiang to bring the others back to this kingdom?"
"They're already on their way back here, and they'll be here in a few days." Zhou Shensin was relieved by that.
"I've told him about your wedding plans with Zhang Fei, and he is looking forward to the day.
He asked you to give him a grandchild soon, but I told him that it was impossible, especially since Zhang Fei's cultivation is still at the ten mortal realms."
"My grandpa has long wanted a grandchild, but he has to wait much longer.

Even if Zhang Fei's cultivation breaks through to the Seven Divine Realm, he still has no plans to have children, and he wants to have children after our lives are completely secure." Zhou Shenxin looked up at her mother.
"What about you?
Don't you want to find new happiness?"
"No." Jiang Tingxi gently refused.
"I am satisfied with my life, so I don't need other happiness.
Since your father and the others are helping you take care of this kingdom, I plan to enter a long seclusion, and I will come out briefly during your wedding with Zhang Fei."
Zhou Shenxin then took her mother to lie down on the bed.
"Accompany me to sleep tonight, Mother."
"All right."

chapters.title: Chapter 773: Absorb The Soul Fire
paragraphs: Since the wandering souls were too numerous and useful for strengthening the soul, Zhang Fei decided to summon all his wives to his location. All of them sat behind his four clones, which had transformed into their half-fox forms.
Zhang Fei's four clones helped Ru Xue and the others to absorb the wandering souls, especially since they couldn't absorb those souls directly.

Meanwhile, Elmyra protects all the women from the demon aura in the Netherworld Realm while helping Zhang Fei purify the negative emotions within the Soul Fire, and she works together with Ursula in doing so.

Since the situation was under control, Feng Yao withdrew her qi from Zhang Fei's body. She then looked at Shang Chenguang, Shang Chongyun, Shang Tinglong, and Ran Keqing, who had just arrived at their location. "What are you guys doing here?"

"I didn't expect to meet you here, Princess Feng." Shang Chongyun then led the others to land in front of Feng Yao. "We could feel the evil power of this fire and demon, so we decided to check it out."
Feng Yao nodded in understanding. "You guys should leave this place and don't bother them, or this kid will beat you all up."
"Princess Feng, if I may ask, what is your relationship with Zhang Xiaolong?" Shang Chenguang asked.

"We are good friends, and his big sister is a member of my phoenix race because she inherited our phoenix bloodline." Feng Yao's answer surprised them. "Sooner or later, Shang Huaqiang and the Shang Clan will be destroyed in his hands, so if you guys want to live, you better stand on his side."
Ran Keqing then asked her. "Does that mean you and your phoenix race will help him to destroy Shang Huaqiang, Princess Feng?"
"My phoenix race will always stand behind him." Feng Yao's answer convinced them that he would help Zhang Fei to do that. "Leave now."

Shang Chongyun and the others did not ask further and flew away, but they felt joy in their hearts as they believed that Shang Huaqiang would fall into Zhang Fei's hands, especially since Feng Yao would obviously help him. They couldn't wait for that day to come because their patriarch had oppressed them for too long, and he even intended to sacrifice them.
Not long after they left, Alder the wolf king landed at that location, but his gaze focused on the wandering soul demon, who was still struggling inside Huo Ling's fire cage.

Feng Yao herself already knew about Alder's relationship with Zhang Fei, especially since the wolf king left her daughter, Tasha, with him. "If you want, you can join them to absorb those wandering souls."
"I don't need them." Alder then asked Feng Yao. "What about my daughter? Is she okay?"

Feng Yao told him directly. "Tasha has become close to Xu Ling'er and Wu Lianzhi, and the three of them were always together, so she never felt lonely. Furthermore, Zhang Fei has helped her with some things, so her cultivation has started to progress again."
"I see." Alder smiled in relief when he heard that. "Do you think this kid will go to the upper realms soon?"

"He went to the upper realm two and a half months ago, and now he lives there." Alder turned to Feng Yao in surprise. "He has many acquaintances in the Red Sun Realm, and now he lives in that realm. However, he left his family members on one of the planets in the middle realms, but he will soon bring them there, including your daughter."

Alder nodded in understanding. "Please tell him to protect my daughters well and not let the demons from the Blackthorn Abyss Realm discover them. Once I'm ready, I'll pick her up, and we'll free our family."

"Haha." Feng Yao softly laughed. "He already considers your daughter as his family, and he will do anything to protect them, so you don't have to worry about her. If you need his help to save your family, you can tell him directly, and I'm sure he won't refuse to help you."
Alder didn't respond to that. "I'll go now."

After Alder left, Feng Yao looked at the Soul Fire and the wandering soul demon. 'There are indeed many of them, but they won't be able to absorb them in a short time, and their soul power will increase significantly.'

"How did your meeting with Huo Jiguang go, Ziyuan?" Shang Ziyuan immediately explained everything to Shang Yanhan. "You have made the right decision not to force him, or you will be the one who loses the fight with him in his Huo Clan. By the way, a woman named Shi Wuxian just arrived, and I told her to wait for you in the guest room."
"Hmm?" Shang Ziyuan raised an eyebrow at the name, and Shang Yanhan told her that Fei Qinyuang had summoned Shi Wuxian to come three months ago. "I'm going to see her now."

Shang Yanhan returned his focus to Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan, who were still unconscious. He then spoke to his brother. "Yanjun, I want you to go to the Void Heaven Realm now and find Lin Jingxia to ask for an antidote to cure them."

"Are you sure about that?" Shang Yanjun doubtfully asked. "Xi Hongyan has already unified the western region, and her spies are still lurking in our clan. If I leave now, she might lead them to attack our clan."

Shang Yanhan gave him a nod. "You don't need to worry about Xi Hongyan and those clans, and I can still deal with them myself. Moreover, Huaqiang and Qinyuan's condition continues to decline, and they will really die if we don't heal them as soon as possible."
"Okay, I will leave for that realm right now." Shang Yanjun immediately left the room."

Shang Yanhan looked at Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan with many questions in his mind. 'As far as I remember, Qinyuan only went to the Ren Clan a month ago, and Ren Dongcheng is not a poison expert. Moreover, she told me that he went berserk at that time, so I'm sure he couldn't poison her, and someone deliberately wanted to pit us against each other. Hong Quan is an upright man, and Jin Ruyue is not such a person, so I'm sure they are not the perpetrators. Who is behind their condition? Could it be that the perpetrator is a member of the clans in the western region?'

Shang Ziyuan had arrived at the guest room, but she was hesitant to enter it because she never liked Shi Wuxian due to her abilities, which she could never resist. She eventually went in, but the woman immediately grabbed her and pushed her against the wall. "What do you want to do?"

"Haha." Shi Wuxian chuckled and kissed Shang Ziyuan straight away, causing her to curse in her heart. She then threw a device, which immediately covered the room with a soundproof barrier, so no one could eavesdrop on their activities.

Despite her unwillingness, Shang Ziyuan still returned Shi Wuxian's kiss while hugging her neck. Their kiss quickly heated up with their tongues intertwined with each other, sucking each other in turn and enjoying each other's warm saliva.
Shi Wuxian's hands moved to her waist and pulled off the red cloth around her waist. After she took Shang Ziyuan's dress off and dropped it on the floor, her hands began to grope her naked body.
Shang Ziyuan didn't want to be naked alone, and she quickly stripped Shi Wuxian naked before starting to knead her soft and considerable buttocks.

Shi Wuxian suddenly stopped their kiss and looked at Shang Ziyuan, who was already looking horny. "I missed you so much, Ziyuan. The last time we were intimate was five years ago, and I've been busy since then, so I couldn't come here to see you."

"Why did you suddenly come here?" Shi Wuxian immediately told Shang Ziyuan about Fei Qinyuan's intention to invite him over, causing her to frown because her sister-in-law didn't tell her about it. "Unfortunately, you came too late because Jin Ruyue has already decided to join the Hong Clan since a month ago, and that old woman is unlikely to change her decision."

"Are you doubting my abilities?" Shi Wuxian faintly smirked. "Even if Jin Ruyue has joined that foolish old man, I can still change her mind and make her submit to you. That way, you can use her to destroy Hong Quan, and the other clans will not dare reject you anymore after you destroy him and his Hong Clan."

Even though Shang Ziyuan already knew Shi Wuxian's abilities, he still doubted that he could help him control Jin Ruyue, let alone destroy Hong Quan. "Wuxian, I don't doubt your abilities, but you don't know the situation of the Hong Clan."

"Then tell me." Shang Ziyuan immediately explained many things about the Hong Clan based on the information he got from his brother, sister-in-law, and spy. "Are you sure that Hong Xinxin's future husband is Hun Di's disciple?"

Shang Ziyuan nodded to her. "I still don't have clear information about the identity of Hong Xinxin's future husband, but his status as Hun Di's disciple has begun to spread in this realm, and I suspect that he helped them convince Jin Ruyue. All of the Soul Emperor's disciples are not ordinary cultivators, and some of them have terrifying statuses, such as Lin Moxian, who is Lin Jingxia's nephew. If that's true, that man might have done something to the old woman, so we must be careful in our actions, or we will suffer ourselves."
"You're right." Shi Wuxian then led Shang Ziyuan to the bed and laid her down before pinning her down underneath her. "Are you still seeing your father's daughter?"

Shang Ziyuan shook her head and put her arm around Shi Wuxian's neck. "We've known each other for hundreds of years, so you should already know that I never liked him, and I wanted to have children from him merely because of his talent. After Xiaoyin was born, I never saw him again, and I enjoyed my life more in solitude."

"Haha." Shi Wuxian laughed in satisfaction before asking again. "By the way, what exactly happened to Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan? I heard from your ancestors that your sister-in-law went to see Ren Dongcheng a month ago, and both of them have been sick ever since; even their internal organs continue to deteriorate."

Shang Ziyuan could only sigh deeply, recalling the condition of her brother and sister-in-law. "No one knows what really happened to them, but one of the doctors found poison in my sister-in-law's body, and he is trying to analyze the poison to make an antidote. I've asked Huo Jiguang for help, but he rejected me outright, so I haven't found a solution to cure them."

"Unfortunately, I'm not a poison expert, so I can't cure them." Shi Wuxian immediately took out an interspatial communication device. "However, I know a poison expert, and he is one of the best in the upper realms. I hope he is in a nearby realm, and I will contact him now so he can come here as soon as possible to cure them."
"Who is the poison expert you are referring to?"

"Du Yuanjia is one of the Poison God's disciples, and he owes me a favor, so he wouldn't dare refuse my request." Shang Ziyuan knew the identity of the poison god, but he never knew the identities of his disciples, especially since they always kept it a secret. Shi Wuxian immediately contacted the man before telling him. "Fortunately, he is actually in a nearby realm, and he will arrive here in two weeks."

Shang Ziyuan's smile broadened when she heard that. "I hope that Du Yuanjia can truly heal my brother and sister-in-law because their condition has weakened our clan, and I'm worried that Xi Hongyan will take advantage of our situation to attack us."

"You don't need to think about Xi Hongyan because I'm here now, and she wouldn't dare to come here if she knew I was here." Shang Ziyuan did not doubt Shi Wuxian's words. "For now, you can forget about all your clan affairs, and I want to have fun with you while waiting for Du Yuanjia to arrive."
Before Shang Ziyuan could reply, Shi Wuxian had already sealed her lips again and fondled her breasts, causing her lust to soar again.
Shang Ziyuan started to kiss Shi Wuxian back while one hand rubbed her back, and her other hand played with her buttocks.
In a few minutes, both women were already burning with their lust, and their activities became hotter with each stimulation they gave to each other, making their moans continue to echo in the room.

A week passed quickly, and the wandering soul demon had weakened significantly after Zhang Fei's clones and all his women had absorbed too many of the wandering souls. The negative emotions inside the Soul Fire had also been greatly reduced because Ursula devoured them nonstop, and Elmyra also helped her to purify them.
The Soul Fire, which was originally blackish-white in color, had begun to reduce its blackness due to the two women's actions, and it became increasingly white.

Zhang Fei's soul power broke through to the half-perfection stage of the Earthly Soul level four days ago, but it hasn't stopped increasing because the wandering souls are still so numerous, and his four clones continue to absorb them.

Feng Yao, who was waiting for them by the side, could only shake her head as she observed Zhang Fei. 'Are you still doubting him, Huo Ling? Look at him; he hasn't stopped absorbing those wandering souls, but he hasn't forgotten to stabilize his soul, and his four clones are doing the same, making his soul gradually stabilize.'

[Well? I admit that he is indeed great for being able to do something like this, but the fact is that he is still too weak, and he is still too dependent on others. If he continues like this, he will never be able to protect himself after going to the Paradise Realm, let alone if he goes to our home realm. Perhaps he will suffer a crushing defeat when he goes there, and he will regret his dependence too late.]

"There is no living being who does not need the help of others, and it is only natural that Zhang Fei still relies on others, especially since his strength is still not enough to handle everything by himself." Huo Ling chose not to answer Feng Yao as she continued to defend him. 'We've both lived several lifetimes, so we've had too much experience, and we can't judge him from our perspective. It's true that he still relies on others, but he's not completely dependent on them, and he's done a lot of things on his own. All this time, he only asks for help when the situation doesn't allow him to handle it himself.'
[Yeah... yeah... you're right, Master. Forget it; I don't want to talk about him anymore, and I will wait for the results in the future.]
Since Zhang Fei was immersed in his activities, he didn't realize that another week had passed. The wandering soul demon had already completely weakened, and the Soul Fire had become white.
Ursula and Elmyra immediately stopped their activities, especially since it was no longer needed. Since there were no negative emotions left, Zhang Fei immediately absorbed the Soul Fire.

Zhang Fei immediately opened his eyes, stood up, and approached his four clones and wives. He smiled faintly as he looked at the wandering soul demon. He immediately stretched his hand forward and used the demon-absorbing ability, and his four clones followed suit, absorbing them even faster than before.
A while later, two new notifications appeared in their minds, especially since the wandering soul demon had disappeared.

paragraphs: 'No other quests are following, huh?' Zhang Fei muttered to himself. 'The final quest is to clear those wandering souls left in the Nine Hells Darkland, and that realm will be useless to me after that.'

[Master, the Nine Hells Darkland might be useless to you, but it is still useful to the demons on your side. After all, that realm has Qi and demon aura, and it will be safe after you clear the wandering souls. Therefore, you can send them there, including Zhang Wuji. That way, they can increase their cultivation and demon power simultaneously, and they will be more useful to you.]

'Yeah, you're right.' Zhang Fei then spoke to all his wives. "All of you have worked hard to absorb the wandering souls for the past two weeks, and your soul cultivation levels have reached the perfection stage of the soul core level now, so I want you to rest in the training space for a few days. After I take care of some things, we will resume our seclusion again."
After they agreed, Zhang Fei immediately sent all his wives and Elmyra into the training space, but his four clones did not return there because he needed them for something.
"Why are you looking at me like that?" Feng Yao posed the question with a playful smile.
Zhang Fei immediately asked. "Who exactly are you? Who is Huo Ling? Are both of you the reincarnations of powerful cultivators from the Paradise Realm?"
"Eh?" Feng Yao and Huo Ling were both taken back by Zhang Fei's third question. "Did Ma Kuangyu tell you about the Paradise Realm?"
"Old Ma did tell me about that realm."
"Why do you think that the Huo Ling and I are reincarnated cultivators from that realm?"

"Your cultivation already reached the 10-Star Elementary Realm the moment you were born, and you reached the 10-Star Soul Realm when you were five years old. Additionally, you reached the Seven Divine Realms before you reached adulthood, making you the youngest cultivator to reach that stage." Huo Ling grumbled in Feng Yao's mind after Zhang Fei mentioned that. "At first, I thought that you were a cultivator from the Paradise Realm and deliberately disguised yourself for certain purposes, especially since the formation in the underground cave was clearly powerful, but Huo Ling was able to destroy it in a split second. However, my senior brother told me many things about you; thus, I thought you two were reincarnated cultivators."

"Haha." Feng Yao softly laughed and summoned Huo Ling out of her body. "You are right that I am a reincarnated cultivator, but you are wrong about her. She is a fire spirit, but she is different from your salamander, and we have been together for several lifetimes."
"Several lifetimes?" Zhang Fei was utterly shocked.
"Yes." Feng Yao nodded. "As I promised, I will tell you about me once your cultivation reaches the Seven Divine Realms, so you should focus on pursuing that stage if you can't wait to hear it."
Zhang Fei looked at Feng Yao and Huo Ling in turn before asking again. "Are you helping me because I am the future ten-tailed fox?"
"Yes and no." Feng Yao had no intention of elaborating further.
Zhang Fei couldn't help but sigh. "All right, I will definitely reach that stage in the future, and you must keep your promise at that time."
"I will." Feng Yao replied with a nod.

Huo Ling then spoke to him. [Hey, kids! You are a cultivator, and you should be more responsible for all your actions. If you keep relying on cultivators who are stronger than you, you will never be able to protect yourself in the Paradise Realm, and the people around you will die because of you.]

"Do you really think I'm like that?" Zhang Fei asked while shaking his head. "Since you've always been with Feng Yao, you should already know that I'm not that kind of person, right? I admit that I still rely on powerful cultivators in some ways, but I don't completely rely on them."
[Up to you.] Huo Ling immediately entered Feng Yao's body again.

Feng Yao could only shake her head at Huo Ling's behavior. "You don't need to listen to her, and you just need to be yourself as you have always been. The Paradise Realm is indeed much harsher than in the three mortal realms, but I believe that you will be able to face the harsh situation there. By the way, send me back to the Nine Stars Realm so I can continue my seclusion, and you can settle your affairs in the Nine Hells Darkland."

A while later, Zhang Fei and his four clones had arrived at the Nine Hells Darkland, and they used their invisibility. As he expected, Wang Yin and Shou Fubai were still in the Soul Pond, waiting for him to return. 'She should have realized my identity by now.'

Zhang Fei's four clones spread out in several directions to clean up the wandering souls remaining in the realm, and he went to meet the two demons because he wanted to mimic their abilities. "Are you waiting for me on purpose?"

"You are such a liar, you know that?" Wang Yin shook her head in question. "Did you take the Soul Fire? Did the people of the phoenix race help you? I could sense traces of your Qi in the underground cave, and Emperor Yan Huo found traces of phoenix flames there."

"Haha." Zhang Fei awkwardly laughed. "I did lie to you about some things, but I didn't lie to you that I know Morgana, and I also know her husband. In fact, she told me about this realm and the Soul Fire, so I came here to train and take the fire."
"How did you manage to find the Soul Fire?" Wang Yin curiously asked. "Countless demons have been looking for it since it appeared, but no one has managed to find it."

"Despite the entrance being right before their eyes, none of them, including you, have the courage to dive in." Wang Yin did not deny Zhang Fei's words, especially since she did not have the courage to dive to the bottom of the Soul Pond. "I'm a curious person, and the thing that was bothering me in the pond piqued my curiosity, so I decided to check there. As a result, I found the Soul Fire guarded by a wandering soul demon, but I've taken care of them now."

Wang Yin regretted that she was not as bold as Zhang Fei. Had she had the courage to explore the depths of the pond, she could have already acquired the Soul Fire. "How did you guys disappear from the underground cave?"

"I can't tell you about it, as it's my secret and involves something terrifying." Wang Yin squinted her eyes, but Zhang Fei still didn't intend to tell her. "Once I become truly strong, I will tell you my true identity, and you will know where my abilities come from."
Wang Yin couldn't help but sigh. "Do you want to go to my realm to look for the female Yin corpse?"
"Not now." Zhang Fei then grabbed Wang Yin's hand, surprising her.

[Unable to mimic the pain immunity.]
[Ding]
[Unable to mimic the negative effect of immunity.]

Zhang Fei was disappointed because he couldn't mimic both of Wang Yin's abilities. "I still have a lot of things to take care of now, but I will go to your realm someday, and we will meet again then."
"I will wait for you in my realm, so you must come to keep your promise."
"I will." Wang Yin then kissed Zhang Fei's cheek before taking Shou Fubai to fly with her, and the two quickly left the realm. "Can they really fly in space without any protection?"
[Master, they are both corpses, and their abilities allow them to do that.]

"Since the wandering soul demon is dead, this pond is no longer useful." Zhang Fei then looked in four different directions, especially since his four clones used their Exorcismus abilities, causing the gloomy realm to become quite bright. "These wandering souls have been dead for too long and cannot be purified, so this realm can only be cleansed by eliminating them forever. Since their numbers are too numerous, they may need several days to clear them all up."
Zhang Fei then returned to the Netherworld Realm to pick up Oz the Second, Tharnon, Zygoz, Ursula, Virgil, Nauvia, Kyllia, Naeth, and Zhang Wuji before bringing them to that realm.
Zhang Fei also summoned Yan Zhixiu, Fyr, Eve, Leora, the Amaris Twins, Ashreth, Nadea, Zilvora, Orith, and Ilsath.

Unfortunately, some of them were not demon cultivators, so they could only absorb the demon aura in the realm. On the other hand, demon cultivators like Zhang Wuji, Yan Zhixiu, and a few others could absorb it, along with the Qi.
As soon as they started cultivating, Zhang Fei immediately left them and went to the Hong Clan in the Red Sun Realm; the Qi in his training space increased again to the same level as in that realm.
"Where have you been? Why haven't you contacted me for the past two weeks?" Hong Xinxin asked as soon as Zhang Fei entered her room.

Zhang Fei immediately sat down beside Hong Xinxin and explained to her about all the events in the Nine Hells Darkland, surprising her. "My soul power has reached the perfection stage of the earthly soul level now, and I might be able to break through to the heavenly soul level soon."

"Congratulations! You have become stronger now." Hong Xinxin sincerely said. "Anyways, there has been a slight change in the situation in the Shang Clan since two weeks ago, and a poison master has just arrived in the clan to check on Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan's condition."
"Tell me everything." Hong Xinxin immediately told Zhang Fei about Shi Wuxian and Du Yuanjia. "Poison god, huh? Such an overbearing nickname!"

"Hehe." Hong Xinxin chuckled. "The poison god, You Shen, is no less powerful than Senior Hun Di. If your master is the best in the soul cultivation path, that old man is the best when it comes to poison. All his poisons are deadly, so people gave him such a nickname. Du Yuanjia is his first disciple, and his status is no less high than Lin Moxian's. If you don't do something soon, he might succeed in curing Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan."
"I'll do something about them after this." Zhang Fei nodded at her. "Do you have any information about the Xi Clan? Does Xi Hongyan have no intention of making a move to attack the Shang Clan?"

"The Shang Clan's two ancestors guarded their clan, so Xi Hongyan didn't dare to attack them." Hong Xinxin suddenly remembered something. "Shang Yanjun is not in their clan now, and our spy said that Shang Yanhan sent him to the Void Heaven Realm to meet Lin Jingxia, so your third clone and Lin Moxian will definitely meet him there."

"We're on our way to the Xianjin Realm now, so we probably won't meet him." Zhang Fei then asked Hong Xinxin to do something. "Call Yifen and Xinyu here first, and I'll send the three of you to my private place to start your training."
Hong Xinxin, who had been waiting for this for a long time, was overjoyed to hear it. She immediately called the two women to meet them, and she also made sure to inform her family about it.

After Shang Yifen and Shang Xiyun arrived there, Zhang Fei immediately sent the three women into his training space, causing the number of women there to become even more. After that, he left the Hong Clan and went to the Shang Clan, but he first monitored the situation within the clan through his map.

To Zhang Fei's surprise, he found Xi Yinying in the clan, and her surname convinced him that she was Xi Hongyan's spy, yet none of the clan members knew of her presence. 'A cultivator with shadow abilities, huh? I've long mastered the Shadow Abyss Scripture that I got from Pang Liyuan back then, but I've never used it other than in practice.'

Zhang Fei's attention was diverted by the two names gathered in one room, so he tried to check the room, where he found Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian being intimate, causing a strange smile to appear on his face.

Zhang Fei then checked another room, where he saw a young man examining the bodies of Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan. However, the man's appearance was more like an effeminate man because he was wearing a woman's dress, and he also used makeup like women in general.

Zhang Fei smiled in amusement as he watched Du Yuanjia examine Shang Huaqiang while groping his body, including his lower body. He could see the face of Shang Yanhan, who was standing behind him, contorting repeatedly at his actions.

Zhang Fei activated his invisibility and infiltrated the Shang Clan, and he carefully entered Shang Huaqiang's room. He froze at the door as soon as Shang Yanhan turned to him, and he immediately prepared to flee if the old man noticed his presence, especially since he was too strong for him.
Zhang Fei's worries were unfounded as Shang Yanhan immediately looked at Du Yuanjia again. "Hey, kid, can you recognize the poison on their bodies?"

"Do you need to ask that, old man?" Du Yuanjia responded with a mocking tone. "My master is the poison god, and if I can't recognize a small-time poison like this, then he won't recognize me as his disciple anymore. They were poisoned by the Serpent's Kiss Flower, which caused their internal organs to fail. They were unaware of their exposure to the poison due to its odorless nature and slow effects."
Shang Yanhan was slightly relieved after hearing that. "Can you neutralize the poison in their bodies?"

"Easy peasy." Du Yuanjia took out a paper and pen before writing down some herbs. He then handed it to Shang Yanhan. "Collect those herbs as soon as possible because their condition is at its lowest point, and they will die within a week if we don't cure them soon."

Without thinking twice, Shang Yanhan immediately left the room to collect those herbs himself. Meanwhile, Zhang Fei sat on an empty chair as he stared at Du Yuanjia, and he did not expect that he could find out the type of poison so easily. 'You can cure them now, but I will give them heavier poison afterward.'
Just as Zhang Fei was thinking about his next plan for Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan, Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian suddenly walked into the room.

Shang Ziyuan was stunned when she saw Du Yuanjia's appearance, but her expression turned to disgust because he looked like an effeminate man. Even so, she didn't comment on him, especially since his master was too scary. 'Why would Wuxian be friends with a disgusting guy like this?'
"Are you able to cure them, Yuanjia?" Shi Wuxian inquired as she approached the bedside.

Du Yuanjia nodded at her. "We just need to wait for that old man to bring the herbs I need, and I will cure them right away, but they cannot cultivate right away after they are cured because the condition of their internal organs is too bad. Otherwise, all their internal organs will rupture if they force themselves to cultivate, and they will die immediately."
"I will definitely warn them not to overexert themselves." Shang Ziyuan spoke, her tone filled with relief.

Xi Yinying, who was hiding in the shadow, immediately reported the incident to Xi Hongyan. She suddenly felt someone's gaze on her, but she couldn't see Zhang Fei, especially since he was still hiding using his invisibility. 'Is it just my feeling? Why do I feel like someone is watching me?'

After they waited for three hours, Shang Yanhan finally returned with some herbs needed to treat Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan. After he received them, Du Yuanjia immediately processed the herbs into a liquid before forcing the two to swallow it. "Their condition is too severe, so they can't recover immediately, and they should be able to wake up tonight."

"I did lie to you about some things, but I didn't lie to you that I know Morgana, and I also know her husband.
In fact, she told me about this realm and the Soul Fire, so I came here to train and take the fire."
"How did you manage to find the Soul Fire?" Wang Yin curiously asked.
"Countless demons have been looking for it since it appeared, but no one has managed to find it."

"Despite the entrance being right before their eyes, none of them, including you, have the courage to dive in." Wang Yin did not deny Zhang Fei's words, especially since she did not have the courage to dive to the bottom of the Soul Pond.
"I'm a curious person, and the thing that was bothering me in the pond piqued my curiosity, so I decided to check there.
As a result, I found the Soul Fire guarded by a wandering soul demon, but I've taken care of them now."
Wang Yin regretted that she was not as bold as Zhang Fei.
Had she had the courage to explore the depths of the pond, she could have already acquired the Soul Fire.
"How did you guys disappear from the underground cave?"
"I can't tell you about it, as it's my secret and involves something terrifying." Wang Yin squinted her eyes, but Zhang Fei still didn't intend to tell her.
"Once I become truly strong, I will tell you my true identity, and you will know where my abilities come from."
Wang Yin couldn't help but sigh.
"Do you want to go to my realm to look for the female Yin corpse?"
"Not now." Zhang Fei then grabbed Wang Yin's hand, surprising her.
[Ding]
[Unable to mimic the pain immunity.]
[Ding]
[Unable to mimic the negative effect of immunity.]
Zhang Fei was disappointed because he couldn't mimic both of Wang Yin's abilities.
"I still have a lot of things to take care of now, but I will go to your realm someday, and we will meet again then."
"I will wait for you in my realm, so you must come to keep your promise."
"I will." Wang Yin then kissed Zhang Fei's cheek before taking Shou Fubai to fly with her, and the two quickly left the realm.
"Can they really fly in space without any protection?"
[Master, they are both corpses, and their abilities allow them to do that.]

"Since the wandering soul demon is dead, this pond is no longer useful." Zhang Fei then looked in four different directions, especially since his four clones used their Exorcismus abilities, causing the gloomy realm to become quite bright.
"These wandering souls have been dead for too long and cannot be purified, so this realm can only be cleansed by eliminating them forever.
Since their numbers are too numerous, they may need several days to clear them all up."
Zhang Fei then returned to the Netherworld Realm to pick up Oz the Second, Tharnon, Zygoz, Ursula, Virgil, Nauvia, Kyllia, Naeth, and Zhang Wuji before bringing them to that realm.
Zhang Fei also summoned Yan Zhixiu, Fyr, Eve, Leora, the Amaris Twins, Ashreth, Nadea, Zilvora, Orith, and Ilsath.
Unfortunately, some of them were not demon cultivators, so they could only absorb the demon aura in the realm.
On the other hand, demon cultivators like Zhang Wuji, Yan Zhixiu, and a few others could absorb it, along with the Qi.
As soon as they started cultivating, Zhang Fei immediately left them and went to the Hong Clan in the Red Sun Realm; the Qi in his training space increased again to the same level as in that realm.
"Where have you been?
Why haven't you contacted me for the past two weeks?" Hong Xinxin asked as soon as Zhang Fei entered her room.
Zhang Fei immediately sat down beside Hong Xinxin and explained to her about all the events in the Nine Hells Darkland, surprising her.
"My soul power has reached the perfection stage of the earthly soul level now, and I might be able to break through to the heavenly soul level soon."
"Congratulations!
You have become stronger now." Hong Xinxin sincerely said.

"Anyways, there has been a slight change in the situation in the Shang Clan since two weeks ago, and a poison master has just arrived in the clan to check on Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan's condition."
"Tell me everything." Hong Xinxin immediately told Zhang Fei about Shi Wuxian and Du Yuanjia.
"Poison god, huh?
Such an overbearing nickname!"
"Hehe." Hong Xinxin chuckled.
"The poison god, You Shen, is no less powerful than Senior Hun Di.
If your master is the best in the soul cultivation path, that old man is the best when it comes to poison.
All his poisons are deadly, so people gave him such a nickname.
Du Yuanjia is his first disciple, and his status is no less high than Lin Moxian's.
If you don't do something soon, he might succeed in curing Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan."
"I'll do something about them after this." Zhang Fei nodded at her.
"Do you have any information about the Xi Clan?
Does Xi Hongyan have no intention of making a move to attack the Shang Clan?"
"The Shang Clan's two ancestors guarded their clan, so Xi Hongyan didn't dare to attack them." Hong Xinxin suddenly remembered something.
"Shang Yanjun is not in their clan now, and our spy said that Shang Yanhan sent him to the Void Heaven Realm to meet Lin Jingxia, so your third clone and Lin Moxian will definitely meet him there."
"We're on our way to the Xianjin Realm now, so we probably won't meet him." Zhang Fei then asked Hong Xinxin to do something.
"Call Yifen and Xinyu here first, and I'll send the three of you to my private place to start your training."
Hong Xinxin, who had been waiting for this for a long time, was overjoyed to hear it.
She immediately called the two women to meet them, and she also made sure to inform her family about it.
After Shang Yifen and Shang Xiyun arrived there, Zhang Fei immediately sent the three women into his training space, causing the number of women there to become even more.
After that, he left the Hong Clan and went to the Shang Clan, but he first monitored the situation within the clan through his map.

To Zhang Fei's surprise, he found Xi Yinying in the clan, and her surname convinced him that she was Xi Hongyan's spy, yet none of the clan members knew of her presence. 'A cultivator with shadow abilities, huh?
I've long mastered the Shadow Abyss Scripture that I got from Pang Liyuan back then, but I've never used it other than in practice.'

Zhang Fei's attention was diverted by the two names gathered in one room, so he tried to check the room, where he found Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian being intimate, causing a strange smile to appear on his face.
Zhang Fei then checked another room, where he saw a young man examining the bodies of Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan.
However, the man's appearance was more like an effeminate man because he was wearing a woman's dress, and he also used makeup like women in general.
Zhang Fei smiled in amusement as he watched Du Yuanjia examine Shang Huaqiang while groping his body, including his lower body.
He could see the face of Shang Yanhan, who was standing behind him, contorting repeatedly at his actions.
Zhang Fei activated his invisibility and infiltrated the Shang Clan, and he carefully entered Shang Huaqiang's room.
He froze at the door as soon as Shang Yanhan turned to him, and he immediately prepared to flee if the old man noticed his presence, especially since he was too strong for him.
Zhang Fei's worries were unfounded as Shang Yanhan immediately looked at Du Yuanjia again.
"Hey, kid, can you recognize the poison on their bodies?"
"Do you need to ask that, old man?" Du Yuanjia responded with a mocking tone.
"My master is the poison god, and if I can't recognize a small-time poison like this, then he won't recognize me as his disciple anymore.
They were poisoned by the Serpent's Kiss Flower, which caused their internal organs to fail.
They were unaware of their exposure to the poison due to its odorless nature and slow effects."
Shang Yanhan was slightly relieved after hearing that.
"Can you neutralize the poison in their bodies?"
"Easy peasy." Du Yuanjia took out a paper and pen before writing down some herbs.
He then handed it to Shang Yanhan.
"Collect those herbs as soon as possible because their condition is at its lowest point, and they will die within a week if we don't cure them soon."
Without thinking twice, Shang Yanhan immediately left the room to collect those herbs himself.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei sat on an empty chair as he stared at Du Yuanjia, and he did not expect that he could find out the type of poison so easily. 'You can cure them now, but I will give them heavier poison afterward.'
Just as Zhang Fei was thinking about his next plan for Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan, Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian suddenly walked into the room.
Shang Ziyuan was stunned when she saw Du Yuanjia's appearance, but her expression turned to disgust because he looked like an effeminate man.
Even so, she didn't comment on him, especially since his master was too scary. 'Why would Wuxian be friends with a disgusting guy like this?'
"Are you able to cure them, Yuanjia?" Shi Wuxian inquired as she approached the bedside.
Du Yuanjia nodded at her.

"We just need to wait for that old man to bring the herbs I need, and I will cure them right away, but they cannot cultivate right away after they are cured because the condition of their internal organs is too bad.
Otherwise, all their internal organs will rupture if they force themselves to cultivate, and they will die immediately."
"I will definitely warn them not to overexert themselves." Shang Ziyuan spoke, her tone filled with relief.
Xi Yinying, who was hiding in the shadow, immediately reported the incident to Xi Hongyan.
She suddenly felt someone's gaze on her, but she couldn't see Zhang Fei, especially since he was still hiding using his invisibility. 'Is it just my feeling?
Why do I feel like someone is watching me?'
After they waited for three hours, Shang Yanhan finally returned with some herbs needed to treat Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan.
After he received them, Du Yuanjia immediately processed the herbs into a liquid before forcing the two to swallow it.
"Their condition is too severe, so they can't recover immediately, and they should be able to wake up tonight."

chapters.title: Chapter 775: Act
paragraphs: "My debt with you has been paid off, and I no longer owe you anything, Shi Wuxian."
"Hehe." Shi Wuxian chuckled. "Are you going back to the Lingyu Realm now?"

Du Yuanjia nodded. "My master is coming out of seclusion soon, and he wants to take us to another realm to challenge a tower, so I have to go back there, but I will ensure the recovery of Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan first."
"A tower?"

Du Yuanjia immediately explained to Shi Wuxian and Shang Ziyuan. "Some time ago, my third junior brother was visiting his relatives in the Frozen Moon Realm, and they told him about the Moon Tower. According to him, the tower has ten floors, and there are many difficult challenges inside. Despite their difficulties, they will give us many excellent rewards, which are difficult for us to obtain even in the upper realms, including many divine-grade techniques."

Shang Ziyuan frowned after hearing all that. "Based on the information I got, Hun Di brought Qiao Liangren, Shang Yingyue, and many of the younger generations from those clans to the Blossom Heaven Realm four months ago to challenge the Sun Tower there. I don't know where he got the information about that tower, but I suspect that it is related to the Moon Tower you just mentioned."

"They should be related to each other." Du Yuanjia replied with a nod. "In fact, the Moon Tower is not the only one, and my third junior brother said there are many other towers. Strangely, they do not exist in the upper realms, and they only exist in the middle realms. My master suspected that there was something valuable hidden within them, so he wanted to take us to challenge the nearest tower to our realm."
"Do you know about the other towers?"

Du Yuanjia nodded. "There are four other towers that we know of, but they are too far from our realm. The Star Tower in the Nine Stars Realm, the Sky Tower in the Azure Sky Realm, the Light Tower in the Luminance Realm, and the Dark Tower in the Darkstar Abyss Realm."
"Isn't the Darkstar Abyss Realm a demon realm?"

"Those towers don't prevent demon cultivators from challenging them, so you don't need to be surprised by that." Du Yuanjia then looked away with a slight frown that went unnoticed by the two women. "I'll go somewhere else first, and you can contact me when Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan wake up."

After Du Yuanjia left, Shi Wuxian asked Shang Ziyuan. "Are you interested in challenging the tower? Since Hun Di and You Shen went to challenge those towers, I'm sure they aren't ordinary towers. Therefore, we have to go to one of them, but we will go to the nearest realm."

"Haven't you heard of the movements of the other cultivators?" Shi Wuxian raised an eyebrow in response to Shang Ziyuan's question. "Hun Di and his group weren't the only ones who challenged the Sun Tower, but the Nameless One, the Phoenix Race, Gong Ren, Xia Tian, and Ai Weiren's groups also went to challenge the Sun Tower. In fact, I wanted to challenge the tower, but there were so many problems at hand, starting from my daughter's disappearance to the condition of my brother and sister-in-law, so I gave up on my intention."

"How did your daughter disappear?" Shang Ziyuan explained to Shi Wuxian about the situation of Shang Xiaoyin and Shang Baishi, including her efforts to search for them for several months before Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan were poisoned. "Since your brother and sister-in-law will recover soon, I think you don't need to think about them anymore, and your ancestors can protect them. As for your daughter, I know you are worried about her, but the rewards in those towers are really tempting. Therefore, we will go to the Sun Tower first, and I will accompany you to look for her if we fail those challenges, or we will be left behind by the other cultivators."
Shang Ziyuan immediately agreed. "I will talk to my ancestors about that, but we have to go to the Jin Clan first, and you have to help me to subdue Jin Ruyue."
"Let's go then."

Xi Yinying, who eavesdropped on Shi Wuxian's conversation with Shang Ziyuan from the shadow, immediately informed Xi Hongyan of their departure. As she expected, her matriarch and Xi Qiuwei moved to intercept the two women.
Xi Yinying felt that someone had been watching her since earlier, and she looked towards Shang Huaqiang's room for a while before sneaking into Shang Yanhan's place.

Inside the room, Zhang Fei approached Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan, who were still unconscious. If the two were in their peak condition, then he wouldn't be able to do anything to them. Fortunately, they were at their lowest, and they had no guard whatsoever.

Zhang Fei grinned faintly and used his soul manipulation ability on Fei Qinyuan, forcefully pulling her soul out of her body. He replicated her soul and stored the replica in his soul space before returning it. 'I wanted to implant my soul mark into her soul, but Shang Yanhan is a soul cultivator. Even though he's not as skilled as Master Hun, I'm afraid he'll notice my action.'
[Why don't you just kill them, Master? If they die, Hong Quan and the others can just attack this clan, and you don't have to bother destroying them yourself.]

'They still have their two ancestors, remember?' Zhang Fei responded by shaking his head. 'Even Grandpa Hong didn't dare to face one of them, let alone face them together. Moreover, Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan caused Qingyu and her daughters to suffer because of Chu Hong's death, so I don't want them to die too soon, and I will make them suffer endlessly. Once they are ready, I will hand these two over to them, and they can kill both of them themselves.'

Zhang Fei then touched Shang Huaqiang's body and used the body modification ability to remove his dick, causing Mei to laugh out loud. [Hahaha! Master! You are so evil! I'm curious about his expression when he wakes up and finds his dick gone! He will definitely fall into a deep depression because of it!]

'His shocked expression will be funny.' Zhang Fei then used his plant generation ability to create seeds in their bodies. 'These soul-eroding seeds will grow by consuming their soul power and slowly weakening their soul.'

Zhang Fei then left the Shang Clan to go to the Jin Clan, especially since Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian wanted to attack her. However, Du Yuanjia suddenly intercepted him and restrained his movement, but he was not too surprised by that. "I knew you were pretending not to notice my presence."

"Oh?" Du Yuanjia was surprised by Zhang Fei's calmness and observation. "A young man like you is truly rare, you know? I couldn't detect your cultivation because of the concealment ring on your finger, but I'm sure it is still in the ten mortal realms. You already knew from the beginning that I was watching you secretly, but you deliberately appeared in front of me and let me capture you. So, who are you really? You were the one who poisoned Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan, right? Moreover, your actions towards that woman just now convinced me that you are a soul cultivator, and your mastery in the soul cultivation path is quite high."
"Shouldn't you be able to guess my identity?" Zhang Fei immediately released his killing intent to shake Du Yuanjia, freeing himself from his restraint.
Du Yuanjia's expression became serious because of that. "Your killing intent is truly terrifying, and only my master's killing intent has ever made me this scared."
"If you already knew about my presence, why didn't you report me to them?" Zhang Fei calmly spoke.

"I don't have any relationship with them, and I healed them to repay my debt to Shi Wuxian. Therefore, your enmity with them is none of my business, and I'm just curious about your identity." Du Yuanjia then asked him. "What is your relationship with the Soul Emperor?"

Zhang Fei showed Hun Di's badge, proving Du Yuanjia's guess. "My name is Zhang Xiaolong, and Master Hun accepted me as his disciple four months ago, so you should already know the origin of my abilities in the soul cultivation path, right?"

"Yeah." Du Yuanjia did not doubt Zhang Fei's identity, especially since no cultivator had Hun Di's badge other than his disciples. Even if others could make a counterfeit one, they would not dare to show it in public. "None of the Soul Emperor's disciples are ordinary, including you. Why are you enemies with the Shang Clan?"
Zhang Fei shrugged nonchalantly. "Shang Huaqiang has made my family suffer, so I want to take revenge on him."

"Shang Huaqiang is indeed overly ambitious, and he has made so many people enemies of him, including those in this realm. Although I am unfamiliar with you, your ability to conceal yourself from Shang Yanshan convinces me that you will be a nightmare for him and his Shang Clan." Du Yuanjia then looked north before continuing. "Since you want to chase them, I won't stop you anymore. If you have time, you can visit the Lingyu Realm, and we can talk a lot there."
"I'm curious about the poison god, so I'll visit that realm in the future." Zhang Fei instantly disappeared from Du Yuanjia's sight.

Du Yuanjia took a breath after his senses could not keep up with Zhang Fei's movements. "He is the Soul Emperor's disciple, but he also seems to be an expert in poison. If he is really a poison master, I will tell my master about him, and he might be interested in recruiting him as his disciple."

With Zhang Fei's Nine Cloud Steps, he was able to get ahead of Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian in the Jin Clan. When he arrived there, all the members of the clan had gathered in front of the main hall, especially since he had informed Jin Ruyue before he left the Shang Clan.
The Jin Clan's members were actually quite large, but they were divided into several branches like the other clans, and their main members were about one hundred people.

Zhang Fei immediately contacted Hong Quan before opening the portal to the Hong Clan so he could prepare a temporary place for the Jin Clan members, and Jin Ruyue ordered all her clan members to enter it.
"Do you want to fight Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian?" Jin Ruyue inquired after all her clan members had left.

"Let's look at the situation first." Zhang Fei led Jin Ruyue into the main hall, but he then used his forest manipulation to cover the entire clan area with trees. He also used his plant generation to create several things that could weaken Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian.
Even though Jin Ruyue had seen Zhang Fei do all that in the Ren Clan a month and a half ago, she still couldn't help being amazed by his abilities. "Do you have plans to build your residence here?"

"At first, I wanted to build my residence here, but I changed my mind about it, and I'm looking for another realm that is more suitable for me and my family." Jin Ruyue curiously turned to Zhang Fei. "I haven't decided which realm I want to go to next, but I already have a few choices, and one of them is the phoenix realm."
"Huh?" Jin Ruyue was shocked because the phoenix race would never accept humans living in their realm, but she remembered that Zhang Fei was a fox beast.

"Feng Yao is my good friend, and my big sister has become part of the phoenix race after she inherited the phoenix bloodline from one of their members, so there is no problem if we want to live there." Zhang Fei then looked at the map. "Xi Hongyan and Xi Qiuwei are on their way here, and they want to capture Shang Ziyuan."
"How did they know that Shang Ziyuan was on her way here?" Zhang Fei tells Jin Ruyue about Xi Yinying infiltrating the Shang Clan to spy on them. "Are you going to let her fall into their hands?"

Zhang Fei shook his head. "Xi Hongyan has already obtained Shang Xishun, so I will not hand Shang Ziyuan over to them, and I will use them to weaken her first. As for Shi Wuxian, I don't know about her abilities yet, but she is fully confident that she can control you, so her abilities are probably related to hypnosis or something like that. Anyways, let's dual soul cultivate while waiting for their arrival, and I'll think of another plan once they arrive."
Jin Ruyue herself had been waiting for Zhang Fei for a month and a half, so she immediately agreed, and they quickly began to dual soul cultivate.

'Fuck! Who actually captured me in that tower? How long has that person been holding me captive? Since I woke up, no one has come to see me, and I can't check out.' Li Tiannan, whose cultivation was sealed and whose hands and feet were tied, kept cursing and wondering in his heart.
*Crack*
'Hmm?' Li Tiannan stared at the door in shock. 'How... how did Linghu Yincheng and his three children get here? How did he break free from my Gu Insect's control?'

Linghu Yincheng smiled faintly and stood before Li Tiannan. "Are you surprised by my condition? I know you used your Gu Insects to control me and my husband, but I was lucky because someone kindly freed me from it. Even though my husband is still under your control, I'm sure he will be free soon. On the contrary, you will suffer, and the people from the Huangfu Clan will not be able to save you."

'How does this bitch know about the Huangfu Clan?' Li Tiannan immediately realized everything. 'Fuck! I should have realized everything from the start! Zhang Fei's father saved her, and Wushuang has also fallen into his hands, especially since her attitude is different compared to before I left!'
"Has Zhang Fei still not contacted you, Mother?" Bai Shouyi's question to Linghu Yincheng proved Li Tiannan's guess.
Linghu Yincheng shook her head. "Empress Zhou told me that Zhang Fei is still busy with other matters, so we can only wait for him to come to us, and he will help us to free your father."

"Fortunately, that female senior helped us capture this guy, and we can free our father from his control once Zhang Fei returns." Bai Renfu uttered these words while glaring hatefully at Li Tiannan. "Once our father is free, I will kill this man."

"You can't do that, Brother." Bai Chongxi said with a shake of his head. "This guy has indeed done many cruel things to our family, but he is Zhang Fei's prisoner, and we still don't know about his plans for him."

Linghu Yincheng then spoke to her two confidants. "Aunt Xiaoting and Uncle Shiwei, please keep a close watch on this man. I will bring my children to meet Bai Shushi and Bai Zizhen to discuss the problems of our kingdom."
"Yes, Empress."

After that, Linghu Yincheng took her three children away from the small island and went to the Bai Kingdom. She could contact Bai Zizhen, but she could not contact Bai Shushi. She then contacted her niece, Bai Tian'er, but the answer surprised her. 'Does Zhang Fei really intend to take Sister Shushi as his woman?'
Since she couldn't contact Bai Shushi, Linghu Yincheng asked Bai Tian'er, who was also a princess, to meet her in their kingdom on behalf of her mother, to which she immediately agreed.

Before long, they arrived at Bai Zizhen's residence, but the one who greeted them was Bai Hunyao, and the old man immediately kneeled before her. "Please forgive me, Empress. I couldn't protect you and your family, and all of you had to suffer because of my weakness."

"Forget it, Hunyao." Linghu Yincheng helped the old man stand up. "Our enemy came from the upper realms, and we can't possibly face him, so you don't have to blame yourself anymore. Let's meet Bai Zizhen now."

'His shocked expression will be funny.' Zhang Fei then used his plant generation ability to create seeds in their bodies. 'These soul-eroding seeds will grow by consuming their soul power and slowly weakening their soul.'
Zhang Fei then left the Shang Clan to go to the Jin Clan, especially since Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian wanted to attack her.
However, Du Yuanjia suddenly intercepted him and restrained his movement, but he was not too surprised by that.
"I knew you were pretending not to notice my presence."
"Oh?" Du Yuanjia was surprised by Zhang Fei's calmness and observation.
"A young man like you is truly rare, you know?
I couldn't detect your cultivation because of the concealment ring on your finger, but I'm sure it is still in the ten mortal realms.
You already knew from the beginning that I was watching you secretly, but you deliberately appeared in front of me and let me capture you.
So, who are you really?
You were the one who poisoned Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan, right?
Moreover, your actions towards that woman just now convinced me that you are a soul cultivator, and your mastery in the soul cultivation path is quite high."
"Shouldn't you be able to guess my identity?" Zhang Fei immediately released his killing intent to shake Du Yuanjia, freeing himself from his restraint.
Du Yuanjia's expression became serious because of that.
"Your killing intent is truly terrifying, and only my master's killing intent has ever made me this scared."
"If you already knew about my presence, why didn't you report me to them?" Zhang Fei calmly spoke.
"I don't have any relationship with them, and I healed them to repay my debt to Shi Wuxian.
Therefore, your enmity with them is none of my business, and I'm just curious about your identity." Du Yuanjia then asked him.
"What is your relationship with the Soul Emperor?"
Zhang Fei showed Hun Di's badge, proving Du Yuanjia's guess.
"My name is Zhang Xiaolong, and Master Hun accepted me as his disciple four months ago, so you should already know the origin of my abilities in the soul cultivation path, right?"
"Yeah." Du Yuanjia did not doubt Zhang Fei's identity, especially since no cultivator had Hun Di's badge other than his disciples.
Even if others could make a counterfeit one, they would not dare to show it in public.
"None of the Soul Emperor's disciples are ordinary, including you.
Why are you enemies with the Shang Clan?"
Zhang Fei shrugged nonchalantly.
"Shang Huaqiang has made my family suffer, so I want to take revenge on him."
"Shang Huaqiang is indeed overly ambitious, and he has made so many people enemies of him, including those in this realm.

Although I am unfamiliar with you, your ability to conceal yourself from Shang Yanshan convinces me that you will be a nightmare for him and his Shang Clan." Du Yuanjia then looked north before continuing.
"Since you want to chase them, I won't stop you anymore.
If you have time, you can visit the Lingyu Realm, and we can talk a lot there."
"I'm curious about the poison god, so I'll visit that realm in the future." Zhang Fei instantly disappeared from Du Yuanjia's sight.
Du Yuanjia took a breath after his senses could not keep up with Zhang Fei's movements.
"He is the Soul Emperor's disciple, but he also seems to be an expert in poison.
If he is really a poison master, I will tell my master about him, and he might be interested in recruiting him as his disciple."
With Zhang Fei's Nine Cloud Steps, he was able to get ahead of Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian in the Jin Clan.
When he arrived there, all the members of the clan had gathered in front of the main hall, especially since he had informed Jin Ruyue before he left the Shang Clan.
The Jin Clan's members were actually quite large, but they were divided into several branches like the other clans, and their main members were about one hundred people.

Zhang Fei immediately contacted Hong Quan before opening the portal to the Hong Clan so he could prepare a temporary place for the Jin Clan members, and Jin Ruyue ordered all her clan members to enter it.
"Do you want to fight Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian?" Jin Ruyue inquired after all her clan members had left.
"Let's look at the situation first." Zhang Fei led Jin Ruyue into the main hall, but he then used his forest manipulation to cover the entire clan area with trees.
He also used his plant generation to create several things that could weaken Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian.
Even though Jin Ruyue had seen Zhang Fei do all that in the Ren Clan a month and a half ago, she still couldn't help being amazed by his abilities.
"Do you have plans to build your residence here?"
"At first, I wanted to build my residence here, but I changed my mind about it, and I'm looking for another realm that is more suitable for me and my family." Jin Ruyue curiously turned to Zhang Fei.
"I haven't decided which realm I want to go to next, but I already have a few choices, and one of them is the phoenix realm."
"Huh?" Jin Ruyue was shocked because the phoenix race would never accept humans living in their realm, but she remembered that Zhang Fei was a fox beast.

"Feng Yao is my good friend, and my big sister has become part of the phoenix race after she inherited the phoenix bloodline from one of their members, so there is no problem if we want to live there." Zhang Fei then looked at the map.
"Xi Hongyan and Xi Qiuwei are on their way here, and they want to capture Shang Ziyuan."
"How did they know that Shang Ziyuan was on her way here?" Zhang Fei tells Jin Ruyue about Xi Yinying infiltrating the Shang Clan to spy on them.
"Are you going to let her fall into their hands?"
Zhang Fei shook his head.
"Xi Hongyan has already obtained Shang Xishun, so I will not hand Shang Ziyuan over to them, and I will use them to weaken her first.
As for Shi Wuxian, I don't know about her abilities yet, but she is fully confident that she can control you, so her abilities are probably related to hypnosis or something like that.
Anyways, let's dual soul cultivate while waiting for their arrival, and I'll think of another plan once they arrive."
Jin Ruyue herself had been waiting for Zhang Fei for a month and a half, so she immediately agreed, and they quickly began to dual soul cultivate.
'Fuck!
Who actually captured me in that tower?
How long has that person been holding me captive?
Since I woke up, no one has come to see me, and I can't check out.' Li Tiannan, whose cultivation was sealed and whose hands and feet were tied, kept cursing and wondering in his heart.
*Crack*
'Hmm?' Li Tiannan stared at the door in shock. 'How... how did Linghu Yincheng and his three children get here?
How did he break free from my Gu Insect's control?'
Linghu Yincheng smiled faintly and stood before Li Tiannan.
"Are you surprised by my condition?
I know you used your Gu Insects to control me and my husband, but I was lucky because someone kindly freed me from it.
Even though my husband is still under your control, I'm sure he will be free soon.
On the contrary, you will suffer, and the people from the Huangfu Clan will not be able to save you."
'How does this bitch know about the Huangfu Clan?' Li Tiannan immediately realized everything. 'Fuck!
I should have realized everything from the start!
Zhang Fei's father saved her, and Wushuang has also fallen into his hands, especially since her attitude is different compared to before I left!'
"Has Zhang Fei still not contacted you, Mother?" Bai Shouyi's question to Linghu Yincheng proved Li Tiannan's guess.
Linghu Yincheng shook her head.
"Empress Zhou told me that Zhang Fei is still busy with other matters, so we can only wait for him to come to us, and he will help us to free your father."
"Fortunately, that female senior helped us capture this guy, and we can free our father from his control once Zhang Fei returns." Bai Renfu uttered these words while glaring hatefully at Li Tiannan.
"Once our father is free, I will kill this man."
"You can't do that, Brother." Bai Chongxi said with a shake of his head.
"This guy has indeed done many cruel things to our family, but he is Zhang Fei's prisoner, and we still don't know about his plans for him."
Linghu Yincheng then spoke to her two confidants.
"Aunt Xiaoting and Uncle Shiwei, please keep a close watch on this man.
I will bring my children to meet Bai Shushi and Bai Zizhen to discuss the problems of our kingdom."
"Yes, Empress."
After that, Linghu Yincheng took her three children away from the small island and went to the Bai Kingdom.
She could contact Bai Zizhen, but she could not contact Bai Shushi.
She then contacted her niece, Bai Tian'er, but the answer surprised her. 'Does Zhang Fei really intend to take Sister Shushi as his woman?'
Since she couldn't contact Bai Shushi, Linghu Yincheng asked Bai Tian'er, who was also a princess, to meet her in their kingdom on behalf of her mother, to which she immediately agreed.
Before long, they arrived at Bai Zizhen's residence, but the one who greeted them was Bai Hunyao, and the old man immediately kneeled before her.
"Please forgive me, Empress.
I couldn't protect you and your family, and all of you had to suffer because of my weakness."
"Forget it, Hunyao." Linghu Yincheng helped the old man stand up.
"Our enemy came from the upper realms, and we can't possibly face him, so you don't have to blame yourself anymore.
Let's meet Bai Zizhen now."
