chapters.title: Chapter 776: Retreat
paragraphs: After Bai Tian'er arrived there, Linghu Yincheng immediately told her and Bai Zizhen about her plans regarding the future of the Bai Kingdom, shocking not only the two of them but also her three children. "Even though a cultivator from the upper realms helped Huangfu Shou to do that to us, it was undeniable that we were too negligent and weak, which caused us to fall into their control. I have thought about this matter after Zhang Fei freed me from their control, and I feel that we are no longer fit to lead our kingdom. Moreover, Zhou Shenxin has ascended the throne and become the empress of the Zhou Kingdom, so I think it's time for the younger generation to lead our kingdom. Chongxi is the crown prince, so I want him to succeed his father to lead our kingdom. However, he cannot lead it alone, and he still needs our help."

"Honestly, I have no problem with that, Yincheng. Bai Chongxi has been the crown prince for a long time, and he will ascend to become the emperor sooner or later." Bai Zizhen paused for a while. "However, we should not decide on this matter without your husband present, and we should wait for Zhang Fei to release him before making a decision."

"For now, this matter is just my thoughts, and the decision still has to wait for my husband." Linghu Yincheng then spoke to Bai Tian'er. "Once my husband is free, we will announce the return of your family and the others to the royal family, and I hope you can help Chongxi when he ascends the throne."

Bai Tian'er shook her head in refusal. "Aunt Lingzhu, it's not that I don't like your plan, and I'm actually thrilled if my family can return to the royal family. However, I'm not interested in royal affairs because they will only waste my time, and I want to focus on my cultivation and personal affairs, so you have to choose other people to help my cousin."
"Do you want to chase Zhang Fei?"

"Yes." Bai Tian'er immediately admitted it. "I fell in love with Zhang Fei after we spent some time together in the Star Tower, but there was something about me that made him unwilling to accept me, and he kept rejecting me. I have understood my shortcomings, and I have been trying to change them. Unfortunately, my changes are still not enough to convince him to accept me. Thus, I want to focus on personal life, and I will convince him to accept me in the future."

"I'm like you too, cousin." Bai Tian'er turned to Bai Shouyi. "I started liking Zhang Fei after he found me unconscious in the maze challenge, but he always acted indifferent to me, and he was not even willing to take the time to talk to me. Every time he visited us in the Azure Sky Realm, he only talked with my big brother and mother, and he immediately left again without greeting me. He told my mother that I wanted to take advantage of him like you, even though I never thought like that, and he didn't want to get close to me because of that."

"I did intend to take advantage of him at first, especially after I learned of his abilities." Bai Tian'er sighed heavily before continuing. "His abilities convinced me that he could help me seize the Bai Kingdom from Uncle Yaowei, so I wanted to take advantage of him to help me. However, he was aware of my intentions, and he kept his distance from me, no matter how hard I tried to get closer to him. Back at the Star Tower, I kept trying to seduce him, and we kissed, but he was never willing to accept me. Instead, he was more interested in my mother, and she lived with him for the past three months."
Bai Shouyi, Bai Chongxi, Bai Renfu, and Bai Zizhen fell into a daze after hearing Bai Tian's words about Bai Shushi.

"You guys must find it strange, right?" Bai Tian'er posed the question with a wry smile. "Honestly, I myself find it strange that Zhang Fei is more interested in my mother, but some of his wives are mothers and daughters, such as Shen Xueyi and Shen Yu. Therefore, I am no longer surprised that he is interested in her, and I think it's not a big deal because she is a free woman. Regardless, all the women you saw at his wedding to Zhou Shenxin were still not all of them, and he still had many other women by his side."

"Zhang Fei has so many women, huh?" Bai Shouyi muttered to herself, especially since the number of Zhang Fei's women she saw at that time was already numerous, and there were more than twenty of them.

Bai Tian'er nodded at her cousin. "I can understand your feelings for Zhang Fei, but you should rethink it again. You are different from me, and I'm sure you will have a challenging time accepting his polyamorous relationship."
"You're right, Cousin." Bai Shouyi replied with a soft sigh.

Linghu Yincheng stroked her daughter's head directly. "If you love Zhang Fei, you should learn to accept his relationship. If you can't accept it, you should learn to forget him, and you will find another man in the future."
"I know, Mother." Linghu Yincheng then spoke to Bai Zizhen. "Since you have no problem with it, we will make the final decision after my husband is free from their control."

After that, Linghu Yincheng did not bring her three children back to the small island, but instead, she brought them to the Bai Royal Palace. After all, Zhang Fei had cleared out all of Huangfu Shou's spies from their kingdom, and Old Wen lived together with Wushuang in the palace.
Unfortunately, Bai Yaowei was still like a soulless puppet, and he did not give any response to them without Wushuang and the others' orders.

As soon as Mei informed him that Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian were close, Zhang Fei and Jin Ruyue stopped their dual soul cultivation straight away. They waited for the arrival of the two women from the main hall, which was covered by the dense forest that covered the Jin Clan's residence.
"What about Xi Hongyan and Xi Qiuwei? Have they arrived in this region?" Jin Ruyue asked.

Zhang Fei first opened the map and searched for the location of the two women. "The two of them have already arrived at the outskirts of this region, and they should arrive a little later than Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian."
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*

"They're here." Zhang Fei immediately hugged Jin Ruyue and took her into the invisible state. They watched Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian, who were already standing in the sky above the residence, with puzzled looks.
'Shi Wuxian is as strong as Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan.' Jin Ruyue whispered.

Zhang Fei nodded to her. 'Shi Wuxian's cultivation has already reached the 2-Moon Ascendant Realm, but Xi Hongyan is as strong as her. However, Xi Qiuwei is slightly stronger than her, so she should be able to stop her. So let's wait for them to arrive, and I will wait for the winner among them before I act.'
'All right.'
"Where did this forest come from?" Shi Wuxian asked in confusion.

"Four months ago, I went to this region, and this forest still didn't exist at that time, so I'm confused about how this residence could become like this now." Shang Ziyuan then used her senses to check inside the Jin Clan's residence, but she frowned after she failed to find anyone inside. "There's no one inside."
"Hmm?" Shi Wuxian also checked the residence, but the results were the same. "Do you think Jin Ruyue has noticed our presence and moved all her clan members elsewhere?"

Shang Ziyuan nodded in response. "Jin Ruyue must have known our plan, but we only planned it today. However, the number of her clan members is not small, so she shouldn't be able to move them this quickly."
Both women suddenly felt two powerful auras moving towards them, and their expressions turned tense as Xi Hongyan and Xi Qiuwei arrived in front of them.
'Shit! I forgot that Xi Hongyan had her spies in my clan, and that person must have told her that we came here.' Shang Ziyuan frantically spoke.
Shi Wuxian grabbed her shoulder and spoke to her. 'Hey, relax! You don't have to be afraid of them with me here, and it's a good chance for us to get rid of them.'
'Are you sure you can control them?' Shi Wuxian nodded to Shang Ziyuan, but she still couldn't calm down because Xi Hongyan and Xi Qiuwei were clearly stronger than her.
Although Xi Hongyan and Xi Qiuwei were confident in capturing Shang Ziyuan, they still did not make a move to do so, mainly because of Shi Wuxian's presence by her side.

'I didn't expect this woman to be here, Aunt.' Xi Hongyan spoke to Xi Qiuwei. 'I've heard that all of her abilities are related to hypnosis and control, and not many cultivators can resist her abilities, especially non-soul cultivators like us.'
Xi Qiuwei gave a light nod. 'Has Lin Moxian left this realm? If he is still here, you can contact him for help, and he will definitely be able to stop him.'

'Lin Moxian left right away after she helped me control Shang Xishun.' Xi Hongyan then asked. 'Should we abandon our intention to capture Shang Ziyuan? We will be the ones to lose if we fall under that woman's control, and our clan will fall into their hands.'
'I think that's the best choice.'

"Didn't you two come here to capture Ziyuan? Why are you still not moving? Are you afraid of me?" Shi Wuxian posed the questions with a provocative smile on her face. "Didn't you want to be the sole ruler of this realm, Xi Hongyan? However, I didn't expect you to be such a coward, and you were afraid of a harmless woman like me."
Xi Hongyan's face darkened at Shi Wuxian's provocation, but Xi Qiuwei immediately grabbed her shoulders and shook her head at him. 'Don't let your anger get the better of you.'

Shi Wuxian's lips curled up before provoking Xi Qiuwei. "Hey, old woman! Your cultivation is three levels above me, yet you don't dare to face me. If I were you, I would cripple my cultivation and live as an ordinary woman."
"Haha." Xi Qiuwei laughed at that. "It's true that my cultivation is three levels above yours, but I'm not a stupid woman, and I won't act blindly after knowing my opponent's abilities."

"Humph!" Shi Wuxian snorted. "If you don't dare to fight me, then get lost and don't interfere with our affairs. If you guys don't want to go, I will attack you now, and you guys will be my playthings."
"You—"
"Stop it, Hongyan." Xi Qiuwei stopped Xi Hongyan directly. "We're unlucky that this woman is here now, so let's go back now and make another plan."
Xi Hongyan clenched both fists as she glared at Shi Wuxian, but she then gave Shang Ziyuan a strange smile, causing her to shiver. "You can escape us today, but you will fall into our hands soon."
After that, Xi Hongyan and Xi Qiuwei took out and broke their returning jade, disappearing from Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian's sight.

Zhang Fei and Jin Ruyue, who witnessed all of this from the Jin Clan's main hall, were disappointed with Xi Hongyan and Xi Qiuwei's departure. They hoped that the two women would fight with Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian, but the result was the opposite of their wishes.
Shang Ziyuan patted her chest in relief after the two women disappeared. "Shall we check on the Jin Clan now?"
"Let's go."

As soon as Shi Wuxian and Shang Ziyuan entered the artificial forest, white smoke began to fill the interior, forcing the two women to envelop their bodies with their Qi. However, they were a little late because they had already inhaled a little, which caused their Qi to become a little chaotic.

Shi Wuxian and Shang Ziyuan frowned at that, but they were shocked when the trees moved to attack them, followed by many roots shooting out from beneath them. Unfortunately, these trees and roots didn't pose any significant threat to them, and they could easily destroy them, but they endlessly regenerated and attacked them again.
After Shi Wuxian and Shang Ziyuan tried to destroy the forest for some time to no avail, the two women intended to escape by flying into the sky, but those trees followed them by growing taller.
"What the hell with these trees!" Shi Wuxian shouted as she destroyed the tree roots binding her legs. "Whoever controls this forest, I'm sure that person has the wood element."

Shang Ziyuan nodded in agreement as she attacked all the trees and roots that continued to attack them. "We can't keep going like this, and we have to escape as soon as possible, or we'll run out of Qi just fighting these damn trees."
Zhang Fei naturally wouldn't let Shi Wuxian and Shang Ziyuan escape from his grasp. He immediately moved behind them, touched their backs, and used his enhanced demon touch against them.

"Hyan!" Shi Wuxian and Shang Ziyuan instantly released loud moans as their lust overflowed, causing them to almost fall from the sky. However, they immediately suppressed the sensation, stabilized themselves, and released two powerful shockwaves from their bodies.
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*

Those trees and roots were blown away in various directions, and their attacks also affected the Jin Clan residence, causing many of the residence's walls to crack. Fortunately, Zhang Fei swiftly teleported far above them, so he was unaffected by their attacks.
"What happened just now? I felt someone touching me, and that touch caused my lust to overflow." Shang Ziyuan spoke while controlling her heavy breathing.

Shi Wuxian also regulated her heavy breathing. "Ziyuan, I once met someone with such an ability, but that person was a demon. Back then, I almost fell into his hands, but I managed to control myself and escape from him."
"Does that mean there is a demon lurking in this clan?" Shang Ziyuan asked in shock.

"Yes." Shi Wuxian then took out an artifact and activated it, and a white sphere immediately enveloped the two of them. "If the person who attacked us just now was really a demon, he wouldn't dare touch this sphere, so we'll be safe from him."

Zhang Fei, who was standing in the sky, smiled amusedly when he saw that. Shi Wuxian was not wrong that he was a demon, but he was not an ordinary demon, and the light sphere would not be able to stop him. 'These two women are quite amazing; they can still control themselves and think sanely after being affected by my enhanced demon touch. Let's try using my hormone manipulation on them. If they can still withstand the effects, I'll have to find another way to capture them.'
Zhang Fei released his pink gas and directed it at the two women, and it managed to pass through the light sphere, forcing them to inhale it.
"Ugh!"

Shi Wuxian and Shang Ziyuan once again let out loud moans, and their bodies heated up instantly as their lust quickly took over their minds, which shocked both of them. Even though pink heart symbols had appeared in their eyes, they still managed to maintain a bit of their sanity, so they quickly took out and crushed their returning jades.

"They are indeed different from other women! Although they are not soul cultivators, they managed to resist my hormone manipulation." Zhang Fei then removed his artificial forest from the Jin Clan before landing in front of Jin Ruyue. "Unfortunately, we missed the chance to capture them, so we have to think of another way for that. At least they failed to capture you and your clan members, but I think you should move out of here for the time being, and you can stay in the Hong Clan."
Jin Ruyue immediately agreed to that. "Let's go; we're leaving for the Hong Clan right now."

So let's wait for them to arrive, and I will wait for the winner among them before I act.'
'All right.'
"Where did this forest come from?" Shi Wuxian asked in confusion.

"Four months ago, I went to this region, and this forest still didn't exist at that time, so I'm confused about how this residence could become like this now." Shang Ziyuan then used her senses to check inside the Jin Clan's residence, but she frowned after she failed to find anyone inside.
"There's no one inside."
"Hmm?" Shi Wuxian also checked the residence, but the results were the same.
"Do you think Jin Ruyue has noticed our presence and moved all her clan members elsewhere?"
Shang Ziyuan nodded in response.
"Jin Ruyue must have known our plan, but we only planned it today.
However, the number of her clan members is not small, so she shouldn't be able to move them this quickly."
Both women suddenly felt two powerful auras moving towards them, and their expressions turned tense as Xi Hongyan and Xi Qiuwei arrived in front of them.
'Shit!
I forgot that Xi Hongyan had her spies in my clan, and that person must have told her that we came here.' Shang Ziyuan frantically spoke.
Shi Wuxian grabbed her shoulder and spoke to her. 'Hey, relax!
You don't have to be afraid of them with me here, and it's a good chance for us to get rid of them.'
'Are you sure you can control them?' Shi Wuxian nodded to Shang Ziyuan, but she still couldn't calm down because Xi Hongyan and Xi Qiuwei were clearly stronger than her.
Although Xi Hongyan and Xi Qiuwei were confident in capturing Shang Ziyuan, they still did not make a move to do so, mainly because of Shi Wuxian's presence by her side.

'I didn't expect this woman to be here, Aunt.' Xi Hongyan spoke to Xi Qiuwei. 'I've heard that all of her abilities are related to hypnosis and control, and not many cultivators can resist her abilities, especially non-soul cultivators like us.'
Xi Qiuwei gave a light nod. 'Has Lin Moxian left this realm?
If he is still here, you can contact him for help, and he will definitely be able to stop him.'
'Lin Moxian left right away after she helped me control Shang Xishun.' Xi Hongyan then asked. 'Should we abandon our intention to capture Shang Ziyuan?
We will be the ones to lose if we fall under that woman's control, and our clan will fall into their hands.'
'I think that's the best choice.'
"Didn't you two come here to capture Ziyuan?
Why are you still not moving?
Are you afraid of me?" Shi Wuxian posed the questions with a provocative smile on her face.
"Didn't you want to be the sole ruler of this realm, Xi Hongyan?
However, I didn't expect you to be such a coward, and you were afraid of a harmless woman like me."
Xi Hongyan's face darkened at Shi Wuxian's provocation, but Xi Qiuwei immediately grabbed her shoulders and shook her head at him. 'Don't let your anger get the better of you.'
Shi Wuxian's lips curled up before provoking Xi Qiuwei.
"Hey, old woman!
Your cultivation is three levels above me, yet you don't dare to face me.
If I were you, I would cripple my cultivation and live as an ordinary woman."
"Haha." Xi Qiuwei laughed at that.
"It's true that my cultivation is three levels above yours, but I'm not a stupid woman, and I won't act blindly after knowing my opponent's abilities."
"Humph!" Shi Wuxian snorted.
"If you don't dare to fight me, then get lost and don't interfere with our affairs.
If you guys don't want to go, I will attack you now, and you guys will be my playthings."
"You—"
"Stop it, Hongyan." Xi Qiuwei stopped Xi Hongyan directly.
"We're unlucky that this woman is here now, so let's go back now and make another plan."
Xi Hongyan clenched both fists as she glared at Shi Wuxian, but she then gave Shang Ziyuan a strange smile, causing her to shiver.
"You can escape us today, but you will fall into our hands soon."
After that, Xi Hongyan and Xi Qiuwei took out and broke their returning jade, disappearing from Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian's sight.
Zhang Fei and Jin Ruyue, who witnessed all of this from the Jin Clan's main hall, were disappointed with Xi Hongyan and Xi Qiuwei's departure.
They hoped that the two women would fight with Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian, but the result was the opposite of their wishes.
Shang Ziyuan patted her chest in relief after the two women disappeared.
"Shall we check on the Jin Clan now?"
"Let's go."
As soon as Shi Wuxian and Shang Ziyuan entered the artificial forest, white smoke began to fill the interior, forcing the two women to envelop their bodies with their Qi.
However, they were a little late because they had already inhaled a little, which caused their Qi to become a little chaotic.
Shi Wuxian and Shang Ziyuan frowned at that, but they were shocked when the trees moved to attack them, followed by many roots shooting out from beneath them.
Unfortunately, these trees and roots didn't pose any significant threat to them, and they could easily destroy them, but they endlessly regenerated and attacked them again.
After Shi Wuxian and Shang Ziyuan tried to destroy the forest for some time to no avail, the two women intended to escape by flying into the sky, but those trees followed them by growing taller.
"What the hell with these trees!" Shi Wuxian shouted as she destroyed the tree roots binding her legs.
"Whoever controls this forest, I'm sure that person has the wood element."
Shang Ziyuan nodded in agreement as she attacked all the trees and roots that continued to attack them.
"We can't keep going like this, and we have to escape as soon as possible, or we'll run out of Qi just fighting these damn trees."
Zhang Fei naturally wouldn't let Shi Wuxian and Shang Ziyuan escape from his grasp.
He immediately moved behind them, touched their backs, and used his enhanced demon touch against them.
"Hyan!" Shi Wuxian and Shang Ziyuan instantly released loud moans as their lust overflowed, causing them to almost fall from the sky.
However, they immediately suppressed the sensation, stabilized themselves, and released two powerful shockwaves from their bodies.
*Swoosh...
Swoosh...*
Those trees and roots were blown away in various directions, and their attacks also affected the Jin Clan residence, causing many of the residence's walls to crack.
Fortunately, Zhang Fei swiftly teleported far above them, so he was unaffected by their attacks.
"What happened just now?
I felt someone touching me, and that touch caused my lust to overflow." Shang Ziyuan spoke while controlling her heavy breathing.
Shi Wuxian also regulated her heavy breathing.
"Ziyuan, I once met someone with such an ability, but that person was a demon.
Back then, I almost fell into his hands, but I managed to control myself and escape from him."
"Does that mean there is a demon lurking in this clan?" Shang Ziyuan asked in shock.
"Yes." Shi Wuxian then took out an artifact and activated it, and a white sphere immediately enveloped the two of them.
"If the person who attacked us just now was really a demon, he wouldn't dare touch this sphere, so we'll be safe from him."
Zhang Fei, who was standing in the sky, smiled amusedly when he saw that.

Shi Wuxian was not wrong that he was a demon, but he was not an ordinary demon, and the light sphere would not be able to stop him. 'These two women are quite amazing; they can still control themselves and think sanely after being affected by my enhanced demon touch.
Let's try using my hormone manipulation on them.

Zhang Fei released his pink gas and directed it at the two women, and it managed to pass through the light sphere, forcing them to inhale it.
"Ugh!"
Shi Wuxian and Shang Ziyuan once again let out loud moans, and their bodies heated up instantly as their lust quickly took over their minds, which shocked both of them.
Even though pink heart symbols had appeared in their eyes, they still managed to maintain a bit of their sanity, so they quickly took out and crushed their returning jades.

"Unfortunately, we missed the chance to capture them, so we have to think of another way for that.

Jin Ruyue immediately agreed to that.
"Let's go; we're leaving for the Hong Clan right now."

Shang Xishun, who had recovered from his injuries, was frightened to see the two. Some time ago, Xi Hongyan had tortured her so severely, leaving her traumatized. "What... what do you want to do to me?"

"Heh!" Xi Hongyan snorted and unsealed Shang Xishun's cultivation, confusing her. "Even though you still have your consciousness, you are my slave now, and I can kill you whenever I want. Your first task is to return to the Shang Clan, and you must find a way to bring Shang Ziyuan to me. If you fail to do so, I will kill you directly."

Shang Xishun wanted to refute that, but no words came out of her mouth because Zhang Fei had already bound her soul to Xi Hongyan's soul, and she had no choice but to follow her orders. 'What happened to me? Why can't I refute her?'

"Are you confused by that?" Xi Hongyan asked mockingly. "I have asked for help from a soul cultivator, and he has bound your soul to mine. Therefore, if you don't want to die a horrible death, you must move your ass and bring Shang Ziyuan to me at all costs."
Shang Xishun's face turned pale after hearing that; she didn't even know when Xi Hongyan did such a thing to her, especially since her condition at that time was horrible.
"Go!" Xi Hongyan shouted.
Shang Xishun immediately got out of bed, took out a returning jade, and disappeared from their sight instantly.
"Do you think she'll make it?" Xi Qiuwei asked.

"From the start, I wasn't sure that she would succeed in bringing Shang Ziyuan to me, but I also had nothing to lose if she failed, and the Shang Clan would be the one to lose for losing an experienced elder like her." Xi Hongyan then turned around and left the room. "For now, we just need to wait for the results, and Xi Yinying will report to me whether she succeeded or not."

Although they were able to maintain their sanity, Zhang Fei's hormone manipulation still greatly affected Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian. As soon as they arrived at the Shang Clan, they rushed to their room to relieve their lust.
Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian hurriedly took off their dresses, sat facing each other on the bed with their palms pressed together, and channeled their Qi into each other's bodies.

Unfortunately, their efforts ended in vain, and their lust continued to increase, causing Shi Wuxian to curse. "Damn it! This effect is similar to what I experienced when that male demon used his abilities on me back then, but it's much stronger."
"What did you do to relieve the effects at that time?" Shang Ziyuan's chest continued to rise and fall as she struggled to keep her sanity.

Shi Wuxian's condition was no different from hers, especially since the effects of Zhang Fei's hormone manipulation were simply too strong. "I was forced to satisfy myself for a whole week at that time, but I couldn't do it by myself. I asked several women to help me, but they couldn't help me relieve it either, so I asked my old partner for help. In the end, we dual-cultivated for a week nonstop, and I almost died from Qi depletion at that time."

Shi Wuxian's last sentence caused Shang Ziyuan to frown, especially since she never wanted to have sex with another man, and the last time she did so was hundreds of years ago with her daughter's father.
*Knock... Knock...*
Both women immediately checked out of the room, and they saw Shang Xishun, who had just returned, standing in front of the room.

Shi Wuxian knew Shang Ziyuan didn't want to have sex with men, so she spoke to her. "It's impossible for the two of us to relieve our lust together with our conditions like this, so we need other people's help. Let that woman in and ask her to call some other woman to help us."
"Come in." Shang Xishun walked in with a shocked expression, especially after seeing Shi Wuxian and Shang Ziyuan naked. "Xishun, call some other women here; we need their help to ease our condition."
"Yes." Nine women quickly arrived in the room after Shang Xishun called them. "What should we do?"

"Get naked now and sit behind us." Shang Xishun and the others were taken aback by Shang Ziyuan's orders, but they immediately followed her instructions and sat behind them. "Channel your Qi into our bodies and help us suppress our lust first."

They immediately carried out Shi Wuxian's orders, but they wondered about the condition of the two women. Shang Xishun, who was sitting behind Zhang Ziyuan, racked her brains to carry out Xi Hongyan's order to capture her. 'Sigh! I have to think things through slowly, or I will die in her hands.'

Xi Yinyin, who sneaked into the two women's rooms, immediately informed her matriarch about the matter. Xi Hongyan told her about Shang Xishun's status as her slave, and she asked her to cooperate with her to bring Shang Ziyuan to their clan. 'I will wait for their situation to calm down first, and then I will take her away through the shadow.'

After he spoke with Hong Quan and the others, Zhang Fei immediately left the Hong Clan and went to the Shang Clan, monitoring the clan's residence through the map, especially Shang Ziyuan's room. "Oh? They asked those women to help them quell their lust, eh? Hehe! Unfortunately, they will never be able to do so, and they will be tormented by their lust until I help them."
[Do you want to join them now, Master?]
"No." Zhang Fei immediately refused. "Let them suffer long enough, and I will meet them once their condition is critical. By the way, open the four rewards from the quests, Mei."
[Sure.]
[You obtained the Spiritwood Bracers. Grade: Heaven.]
[You obtained the Demon's Eye Orb. Grade: Heaven.]
[You obtained the Cursed Demon Bell. Grade: Heaven.]
[You obtained the Demon Heartstone. Grade: Heaven.]

"The Spiritwood Bracers can help a wood element cultivator to speed up their element usage speed, so I will give them to Shi Wu, especially since Lillea and Janette don't need them." Zhang Fei immediately took out the three demon items and dripped his blood on them. The Demon's Eye Orb immediately floated to his side, and the Demon Heartstone stuck to his chest. "Hmm? This orb can help me monitor other areas like my demon familiars, but it can see through inanimate objects. As for the heartstone, it can only help me absorb demon aura ten percent faster, but I think it's better than nothing."

Zhang Fei scrutinized the small black bell closely, but then Mei spoke to him. [Master, this bell is really good, especially since it will spread insanity and chaos once you ring it. I'm not sure whether it will affect high-level cultivators like Shang Yanhan and the others, but I'm sure it will affect their younger generations, and you can use it to create chaos in the Shang Clan.]
"Haha! Let's try the bell." Zhang Fei immediately activated his invisibility ability and infiltrated the Shang Clan, where he rang the Cursed Demon Bell several times.
*Ding... Ding... Ding...*
Every time Zhang Fei rang it, a black wave immediately swept across the entire area of the Shang Clan, which quickly affected almost all members of the clan.
Zhang Fei suddenly sensed Shang Yanhan's aura moving towards his location, especially since the old man also experienced the effect, so he immediately teleported away.
Although Zhang Fei was confident in his invisibility ability, he did not want to risk being discovered by the old man, especially after Du Yuanjia had previously discovered his presence.

In the shadow, Xi Yinying was also experiencing the effects of the Cursed Demon Bell, and it almost caused her to lose her sanity. She was afraid of losing control because of it, so she rushed to leave the Shang Clan.

Zhang Fei, who noticed Xi Yinying's movements, immediately followed her from a distance. He left the Demon's Eye Orb in the Shang Clan to keep an eye on the clan, and he saw that Shang Yanhan had arrived at his previous location.

Shang Yanhan tried to find the source of the bell sound using his senses, but the screams of many people suddenly resounded from every corner of his clan. In a short time, some of the senior generations and all the younger generations of the Shang Clan went berserk, and they attacked everyone around them like madmen, causing enormous chaos to break out within their clan. "What the hell is going on here? Were they affected by the sound of the bell just now?"

An old woman immediately appeared behind Shang Yanhan. "Ancestor! This is terrible! The bell sound earlier almost affected my sanity, but I managed to ward off its effects. Unfortunately, some of the senior generations and all of our younger generations were affected by its effects, which caused them to go berserk."
"Order the other elders to move to knock them unconscious."

"They already did, but several elders are currently in Madam Ziyuan's room." Shang Yanhan turned to the old woman with a frown. "Something happened to her and Shi Wuxian, and they are helping them to get rid of their bad conditions."

"Go help the others." After the old woman disappeared, Shang Yanhan checked Shang Ziyuan's room, but he hurriedly withdrew his senses because all the women were naked. "What happened to them? Didn't they previously go to the Jin Clan? Jin Ruyue is quite strong, but she wouldn't be able to do anything to them, especially with Shi Wuxian present. Furthermore, where does the sound of the bell come from? Who dares to infiltrate my clan and ring it?"

After he thought about everything and couldn't find the answer, Shang Yanhan immediately flew into the air and spread his senses as far as possible, causing the leaders of the other clans to be on alert to face his attack.

Unlike them, Hong Quan and the others did not think much of Shang Yanhan's actions because Zhang Fei had already told them that he had deliberately caused chaos in the Shang Clan, and the old man was furious because of it.

Shang Yanhan eventually gave up after he couldn't find Zhang Fei, who was still following Xi Yinying using his invisibility. Moreover, he realized that his actions would only provoke the other clans, so he quickly withdrew his senses because the situation in his clan was really chaotic, and their important people were not in good shape. After that, he activated his clan's protection so no one could infiltrate and cause trouble within his clan.

After moving around for a while, Xi Yinying finally arrived at the outskirts of the city and came out of the shadow directly. She then sat cross-legged on the ground and tried to eliminate the influence of the Cursed Demon Bell on her mind, but the effect really messed up her mind, making it difficult for her to control herself.

Xi Yinying froze when she felt a hand grab her shoulder, but she suddenly felt the chaos in her mind slowly diminish. "I have no intention of harming you, so you don't need to be afraid of me, and I will help you get rid of the effects."
Xi Yinying nodded slightly and allowed Zhang Fei to help her calm down the chaos in her mind. In a few minutes, he had already pulled his light qi back and helped her stand up.

Xi Yinying immediately opened her eyes and turned to Zhang Fei, but she was shocked that she couldn't detect his cultivation. "Who are you? How did you follow me? Are you the one who previously infiltrated the Shang Clan? Were you the one who rang the bell earlier?"

"You asked too many questions, Yinying." Xi Yinying frowned upon hearing her name from Zhang Fei's mouth, but she simply smiled and sat down on a rock near them. "You're correct; I was the one who sneaked into the Shang Clan earlier, and I've been aware of your presence there ever since Du Yuanjia healed Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan. You're also correct that I was the one who rang the bell, primarily due to my desire to instigate chaos within the clan. As for your name, I can't tell you how I know it, but I know Xi Hongyan sent you to spy on the clan. By the way, your matriarch knows my identity because I met her two weeks ago, and I came to your clan with my senior brother, Lin Moxian."

Xi Yinying still had doubts about Zhang Fei, and she immediately contacted her matriarch to confirm his identity. Xi Hongyan told her that his name was Lan Xiaolong and the Soul Emperor's disciple, especially since Lin Moxian introduced him to her using that name, and she asked him not to go against him because it would be detrimental to their clan.
'I really didn't expect that he would be the Soul Emperor's disciple.' Xi Yinying then cupped her hands toward Zhang Fei. "Thank you for your help; I would have gone crazy if not for it."

"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled. "You don't have to thank me, right? I was the one who caused you to become like that, so it's my duty to help you. By the way, the situation in the Shang Clan is chaotic right now, and Shang Yanhan has already activated his clan's barrier, so you won't be able to infiltrate there."
Xi Yinying nodded in understanding. "In that case, I'll wait for them to deactivate the barrier before infiltrating again, or my matriarch will punish me if I neglect her duties."
"Wait a minute." Xi Yinying raised an eyebrow at Zhang Fei. "Where did you get your shadow demon bloodline?"
"How... how did you know about my bloodline?" Xi Yinying stuttered.
Zhang Fei shook his head at her. "I won't do anything to you, so you don't need to worry. In fact, I myself have shadow techniques, so I'm curious about your techniques."
"Eh?" Xi Yinying was surprised to hear that, but she was even more surprised when a black clone appeared from Zhang Fei's shadow. "A shadow clone?"
"That's right." Zhang Fei then asked. "Can you also create a shadow clone from your shadow?"
Xi Yinying nodded and created a clone of her shadow immediately. "I got the shadow demon bloodline from my father, but he is not a demon, and he inherited it from my grandfather."
"Does that mean your ancestor was a shadow demon?" Zhang Fei curiously asked.

"No." Xi Yinying immediately denied it. "According to my grandfather's story, my ancestor got the shadow demon bloodline from someone, but he did not know the identity of that person. Since then, the bloodline has passed down to all his descendants, and all of my generations have it in our bodies."
Zhang Fei immediately canceled his technique and stood up. "You can leave now, but you must be careful when infiltrating the Shang Clan.

Xi Yinying was stunned that Zhang Fei had just left, but she also felt relieved by his departure. "Will I be able to meet him again in the future? He has shadow techniques, so I want to discuss with him our techniques. Unfortunately, he is the Soul Emperor's disciple, and his status is higher than a servant like me."
Xi Yinying let out a soft sigh and entered the shadow again, but she suddenly received a voice transmission from Zhang Fei, causing her to smile.

Zhang Fei wanted to enter the training space, but he suddenly remembered the long-distance message he got from Mai Xiaomeng two weeks ago, and he immediately returned to the Nine Stars Realm before going to see Linghu Yincheng and her family.
"Zhang Fei." Bai Shaoyi, who was sitting in front of the residence, called out in surprise. "Did you come to do something to that man?"
Zhang Fei nodded at her. "I don't have much time now, so please lead me to him."
Bai Shaoyi was disappointed upon hearing that, and she felt that Zhang Fei always used the excuse of not having much time to avoid her. "Please follow me."

In the shadow, Xi Yinying was also experiencing the effects of the Cursed Demon Bell, and it almost caused her to lose her sanity.
She was afraid of losing control because of it, so she rushed to leave the Shang Clan.
Zhang Fei, who noticed Xi Yinying's movements, immediately followed her from a distance.
He left the Demon's Eye Orb in the Shang Clan to keep an eye on the clan, and he saw that Shang Yanhan had arrived at his previous location.
Shang Yanhan tried to find the source of the bell sound using his senses, but the screams of many people suddenly resounded from every corner of his clan.

In a short time, some of the senior generations and all the younger generations of the Shang Clan went berserk, and they attacked everyone around them like madmen, causing enormous chaos to break out within their clan.
"What the hell is going on here?
Were they affected by the sound of the bell just now?"
An old woman immediately appeared behind Shang Yanhan.
"Ancestor!

The bell sound earlier almost affected my sanity, but I managed to ward off its effects.
Unfortunately, some of the senior generations and all of our younger generations were affected by its effects, which caused them to go berserk."
"Order the other elders to move to knock them unconscious."
"They already did, but several elders are currently in Madam Ziyuan's room." Shang Yanhan turned to the old woman with a frown.
"Something happened to her and Shi Wuxian, and they are helping them to get rid of their bad conditions."
"Go help the others." After the old woman disappeared, Shang Yanhan checked Shang Ziyuan's room, but he hurriedly withdrew his senses because all the women were naked.
"What happened to them?
Didn't they previously go to the Jin Clan?
Jin Ruyue is quite strong, but she wouldn't be able to do anything to them, especially with Shi Wuxian present.
Furthermore, where does the sound of the bell come from?
Who dares to infiltrate my clan and ring it?"

After he thought about everything and couldn't find the answer, Shang Yanhan immediately flew into the air and spread his senses as far as possible, causing the leaders of the other clans to be on alert to face his attack.

Unlike them, Hong Quan and the others did not think much of Shang Yanhan's actions because Zhang Fei had already told them that he had deliberately caused chaos in the Shang Clan, and the old man was furious because of it.
Shang Yanhan eventually gave up after he couldn't find Zhang Fei, who was still following Xi Yinying using his invisibility.

Moreover, he realized that his actions would only provoke the other clans, so he quickly withdrew his senses because the situation in his clan was really chaotic, and their important people were not in good shape.
After that, he activated his clan's protection so no one could infiltrate and cause trouble within his clan.
After moving around for a while, Xi Yinying finally arrived at the outskirts of the city and came out of the shadow directly.

She then sat cross-legged on the ground and tried to eliminate the influence of the Cursed Demon Bell on her mind, but the effect really messed up her mind, making it difficult for her to control herself.
Xi Yinying froze when she felt a hand grab her shoulder, but she suddenly felt the chaos in her mind slowly diminish.
"I have no intention of harming you, so you don't need to be afraid of me, and I will help you get rid of the effects."
Xi Yinying nodded slightly and allowed Zhang Fei to help her calm down the chaos in her mind.
In a few minutes, he had already pulled his light qi back and helped her stand up.
Xi Yinying immediately opened her eyes and turned to Zhang Fei, but she was shocked that she couldn't detect his cultivation.
"Who are you?
How did you follow me?
Are you the one who previously infiltrated the Shang Clan?
Were you the one who rang the bell earlier?"
"You asked too many questions, Yinying." Xi Yinying frowned upon hearing her name from Zhang Fei's mouth, but she simply smiled and sat down on a rock near them.
"You're correct; I was the one who sneaked into the Shang Clan earlier, and I've been aware of your presence there ever since Du Yuanjia healed Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan.
You're also correct that I was the one who rang the bell, primarily due to my desire to instigate chaos within the clan.
As for your name, I can't tell you how I know it, but I know Xi Hongyan sent you to spy on the clan.
By the way, your matriarch knows my identity because I met her two weeks ago, and I came to your clan with my senior brother, Lin Moxian."
Xi Yinying still had doubts about Zhang Fei, and she immediately contacted her matriarch to confirm his identity.

Xi Hongyan told her that his name was Lan Xiaolong and the Soul Emperor's disciple, especially since Lin Moxian introduced him to her using that name, and she asked him not to go against him because it would be detrimental to their clan.
'I really didn't expect that he would be the Soul Emperor's disciple.' Xi Yinying then cupped her hands toward Zhang Fei.
"Thank you for your help; I would have gone crazy if not for it."
"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled.
"You don't have to thank me, right?
I was the one who caused you to become like that, so it's my duty to help you.
By the way, the situation in the Shang Clan is chaotic right now, and Shang Yanhan has already activated his clan's barrier, so you won't be able to infiltrate there."
Xi Yinying nodded in understanding.
"In that case, I'll wait for them to deactivate the barrier before infiltrating again, or my matriarch will punish me if I neglect her duties."
"Wait a minute." Xi Yinying raised an eyebrow at Zhang Fei.
"Where did you get your shadow demon bloodline?"
"How... how did you know about my bloodline?" Xi Yinying stuttered.
Zhang Fei shook his head at her.
"I won't do anything to you, so you don't need to worry.
In fact, I myself have shadow techniques, so I'm curious about your techniques."
"Eh?" Xi Yinying was surprised to hear that, but she was even more surprised when a black clone appeared from Zhang Fei's shadow.
"A shadow clone?"
"That's right." Zhang Fei then asked.
"Can you also create a shadow clone from your shadow?"
Xi Yinying nodded and created a clone of her shadow immediately.
"I got the shadow demon bloodline from my father, but he is not a demon, and he inherited it from my grandfather."
"Does that mean your ancestor was a shadow demon?" Zhang Fei curiously asked.
"No." Xi Yinying immediately denied it.
"According to my grandfather's story, my ancestor got the shadow demon bloodline from someone, but he did not know the identity of that person.
Since then, the bloodline has passed down to all his descendants, and all of my generations have it in our bodies."
Zhang Fei immediately canceled his technique and stood up.
"You can leave now, but you must be careful when infiltrating the Shang Clan.
Xi Yinying was stunned that Zhang Fei had just left, but she also felt relieved by his departure.
"Will I be able to meet him again in the future?
He has shadow techniques, so I want to discuss with him our techniques.
Unfortunately, he is the Soul Emperor's disciple, and his status is higher than a servant like me."
Xi Yinying let out a soft sigh and entered the shadow again, but she suddenly received a voice transmission from Zhang Fei, causing her to smile.

Zhang Fei wanted to enter the training space, but he suddenly remembered the long-distance message he got from Mai Xiaomeng two weeks ago, and he immediately returned to the Nine Stars Realm before going to see Linghu Yincheng and her family.
"Zhang Fei." Bai Shaoyi, who was sitting in front of the residence, called out in surprise.
"Did you come to do something to that man?"
Zhang Fei nodded at her.
"I don't have much time now, so please lead me to him."
Bai Shaoyi was disappointed upon hearing that, and she felt that Zhang Fei always used the excuse of not having much time to avoid her.
"Please follow me."

Linghu Xiaoting and Linghu Shiwei were overjoyed at Zhang Fei's arrival, but Li Tiannan was not, and he immediately suspected that he was the mastermind behind his misfortune, even more so when he saw Mai Xiaomeng. 'Shit! We were fooled by him! He and his father are the same person!'

Linghu Yincheng smiled and took Bai Shushi's hand. "Your husband passed away a long time ago, but you are still young now, so you deserve new happiness. "His family members are good people, and they always treat me like their own family, especially his grandmother, Zhang Chen.
As for his private place, I have promised him not to tell anyone, including you.
If you want to know about that place, you must convince him to accept you first, and he will definitely take you there afterward."
"How can I convince him to accept me, Mother?" With a bitter smile, Bai Tian'er posed the question.
"The last time we met was four months ago, but we only dual soul cultivated until morning, and we didn't talk about anything.
After that, I met him again three and a half months ago, but I went to the Zhou Kingdom together with the others at that time.
Since then, I haven't seen him again, nor did he contact me when he brought you here earlier."
"I have lived with them for three months, so I have more or less figured out their characters, and I can understand why Zhang Fei repeatedly rejected you.

Your character before the incident that befell our family was already good, but you changed a lot after that day, and you changed even more after your father died." Bai Shushi hugged her daughter tighter and rubbed her head.
"Unlike you, their feelings are completely sincere toward him, but some of them love him more."
"Who are they, Mother?
Are Shen Yu and Shen Xueyi among them?" Bai Tian'er curiously asked.
"Shen Yu is among them, but not Shen Xueyi." Bai Shushi's answer surprised Bai Tian'er because she had met the two at the Star Tower, and she could see that they loved Zhang Fei so much.
"Xueyi does love him, but her feelings are far less than her daughter's.
Liu Qingyu and Lillea are like her, and most of them love him more than the three of them."
Since her mother was more experienced than her in matters of love, Bai Tian'er did not doubt her judgment of the three women.
"Then, who are the other women who have feelings as deep as Shen Yu?"

"They are Liu Hua, Boitata, Chu Ying, Chu Qing, Tang Ziyu, Ye Lian, Zhang Lingxue, Zhao Ziqin, Zhong Yan, Janette, Qing Yi, Xian Xianqin, and Yun Xinyue." Bai Tian'er felt dizzy after hearing so many women's names, and Bai Shushi told her about their respective characters.
"Compared to all of them, Zhang Lin, Zhang Yue, Ru Xue, and Hu Yue have the deepest feelings for Zhang Fei.
Oh, there is still one more woman, but Xu Ling'er is still underage now."
"Does Zhang Fei have an abnormality in liking little girls?" Bai Tian'er asked with an incredulous look.
"Haha." Bai Shushi laughed at that.
"Xu Ling'er is Ru Xue's daughter, and she already liked Zhang Fei long before her mother had a relationship with him.
He decided to accept her after she found out about his relationships with many women, but they haven't done anything like that yet."
"Oh." Bai Tian'er nodded in understanding.
"What about the four women?"
Bai Shushi first told her daughter about Zhang Lin and Zhang Yue's identity as Zhang Fei's biological sisters, but Bai Tian'er was no longer surprised by that.
"Both of them have loved him since they were little, and their feelings for him were simply too deep, so they would never hesitate to do anything for him.
Even though Ru Xue's relationship with him was an accident, her feelings for him were as deep as theirs, and she was even willing to become a demon for him."
"What about Hu Yue?"
"Hu Yue is the most special among them." Bai Tian'er raised an eyebrow in surprise.
"She is a divine beast, the moon fox.
She had never experienced love before she met Zhang Fei, so he was her first love.
In the past, she was the fiancée of the son of her race's leader, but she fell in love with him at first sight.
At first, they had a five-year promise, but he ended it early by killing her fiancé and leader, so you don't need to be surprised if her feelings for him are one of the deepest among them."
Bai Tian'er let out a soft sigh and hugged her mother tightly.
"Listening to all your stories about them, I feel that I am far inferior to them, especially when compared to Zhang Lin, Zhang Yue, Ru Xue, and Hu Yue.
No wonder Zhang Fei rejected me over and over again; it turns out he has so many amazing women by his side.
Do you think I can convince him to accept me with all of them by his side, Mother?"
"Tian'er, you are a good woman, and I have always believed that.
However, your current character is really bad, and Zhang Fei rejected you because of it." Bai Shushi then lifted her daughter's head and rubbed her cheeks.
"Even though it is far too late, Bai Yaowei and Linghu Yincheng are back now, and our family will return to normal soon.
If you can throw away your current character and return to your true character, I think he'll accept you one day."
Bai Tian'er snuggled into her mother's arms again.
"You're right, Mother.
I have to return to my old self, or Zhang Fei will never be willing to accept me."
"Tian'er, you are a smart woman, and I believe you will succeed in doing so." Not long after that, both women fell asleep while hugging each other.

Zhang Fei stood looking at the two replica souls of Fei Qinyuan and Shang Xishun, with Ma Kuangyu and Nalan Yushu standing on either side of him.
"What are your plans for these two souls, Master?" Nalan Yushu curiously asked.
Instead, Zhang Fei turned to Ma Kuangyu and posed a question.
"Are these two souls suitable for use as weapon spirits, Old Ma?"
"No." Ma Kuangyu then told him.
"To become a weapon spirit, a soul must have consciousness.
Unfortunately, these two souls are replicas of the originals, and they do not have consciousness, so you cannot use them."
Zhang Fei and Ma Kuangyu then turned to Nalan Yushu, making her shudder and take a few steps back immediately.
"Do you really intend to use my soul as a weapon spirit, Master?
I still want to live and reshape my body, so please do not use my soul for that."

"Master!

paragraphs: Zhang Fei was already in the Yin-Yang Space, and he immediately woke Gu Jinling up before handing the self-detonating Gu Insect to her. "Is this the insect inside the man's soul, Master?"
"I enslaved the man who controlled this insect, and he helped me release it." Zhang Fei then asked. "Can you tame this insect? Or do you need his help to do it?"

Gu Jinling immediately explained to him. "Master, the gu insects are worse than humans who are infatuated with their partners, and they will be completely loyal to their master. Therefore, I need his help to control his insects, and we might be able to work together to create the Gu heart that you want."
"Oh! That's right! I can't learn the Gu technique without the Gu heart." Zhang Fei immediately took Gu Jinling out of the Yin-Yang Space.

Zhang Fei had already brought Gu Jinling to Li Tiannan's room in the Huangfu Palace. "I want you to teach her all your Gu techniques, and I want the two of you to work together to create the best Gu heart for me."
"Do you want to become a Gu master like us, Master?" Li Tiannan asked.

"Gu insects are quite interesting, and I have long wanted to learn about them. Unfortunately, Jinling cannot create the Gu heart by herself, so I brought her to you specifically to create one." Li Tiannan immediately explained to Zhang Fei about how to create one, and his explanation was not much different from what Gu Jinling explained to him a few months ago, but his knowledge of Gu insects was much deeper than hers. "Can you create the Gu heart in this realm? Or do you have to take Jinling to the upper realms?"

Li Tiannan answered immediately. "Master, there are so many beasts in the Seven Divine Realms in this realm, so we don't need to go to the upper realms to create the Gu heart. However, to create one requires a long process, and we need around six months to a year to do so."

"All right, you can start right away, but I want to get the best results, so you don't need to rush into it." Since almost everyone in the Huangfu Royal Palace was already under his control and his slaves, Zhang Fei left Li Tiannan's room at a leisurely pace. He went to see Huangfu Lian in his room, where he was having fun with a woman who was one of his father's concubines.
"Who... who are you?" The woman stuttered as she pulled the blanket to cover her body.

"Fei Yan, you don't need to be afraid of him because he is our master." The woman was confused to hear that, but Huangfu Lian immediately got out of bed and covered his lower body. "What can I do for you?"

"Have you still not succeeded in seducing your father's other concubines?" Huangfu Lian smiled bitterly and explained everything to Zhang Fei. "You must succeed in seducing them as soon as possible because I will move soon, and you will be the emperor of this kingdom at that time. If you have difficulty seducing them, you can ask Li Tiannan for help."
Huangfu Lian raised his eyebrows for a moment, but he immediately realized that Li Tiannan had also become Zhang Fei's slave. "I understand."
"Who exactly is that young man? Why do you address him as your master?" Fei Yan inquired after Zhang Fei had left.

Huangfu Lian immediately climbed onto the bed again and pinned Fei Yan under him. "He is a powerful monster, and the other four kingdoms already belong to him. Soon, this kingdom will also be his, and we won't be able to do anything to stop him. I don't want to die, so I acknowledge him as my master, and you have to act the same if you don't want to die."
"Does that mean he will kill your father?" Fei Yan asked with a frown.

"I don't know about his plans for my father yet, but I don't think he will kill him because of the people from the Huangfu Clan. Nevertheless, they won't be able to do anything to help us either, especially since the people behind him are much more powerful than them." Huangfu Lian then warned her. "Fei Yan, I know your thoughts, but you must stay out of this matter, okay? He is always monitoring us, and he will kill you if you get involved in this matter, especially if you tell my mother about everything."

Fei Yan's face turned pale, and her body shivered as she did not want to die. "I understand; I will keep my mouth shut. Moreover, I can't possibly tell Sister Yueyi about it, or she will be suspicious of me. If she finds out about our relationship, she will probably kill me herself."
"Yeah." Huangfu Lian nodded at her. "After my master has settled everything, he will crown me as the emperor of this kingdom, and you will replace my mother as the empress."
Fei Yan's smile widened, and she put her arms around his neck. "Are you really going to choose me as your empress?"

"Yes." Huangfu Lian replied with a smile. "Before that, you have to help me seduce my father's other concubines, okay? Guang Yi is the most difficult among them, and I have failed many times to seduce her."
Fei Yan responded with repeated nods. "I am very close to Sister Guang Yi, so I will help you seduce her, and she will fall for you soon. Love me, Lian'er."
"Sure."
Helian Yueyi, who was sleeping on her bed, immediately opened her eyes. She immediately turned to Zhang Fei, who was lying beside her. "What are you doing here?"

"Don't you already know my purpose?" Zhang Fei asked back with a faint smile. "It's been another two weeks since I was last here, and your time is getting shorter and shorter. If you don't make a decision soon, you already know the consequences, right?"

Helian Yueyi immediately sat up in bed and stared hatefully at Zhang Fei, especially since he gave her the most difficult choice in her life: to choose between her husband or her children. She loved Huangfu Shou very much, but she didn't want her children to die in his hands. Even so, she couldn't bear to kill her own husband for the sake of her safety and that of their children, which made her really depressed. "Please, I'm willing to do anything for you for my children, but I can't kill my husband. If you want it, I will serve you forever, but you must spare my children and let them go."

"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled before sitting in front of Helian Yueyi, and he then lifted her chin. "You are indeed attractive, but you are not attractive enough for me. If I wanted your body, I could have had you since our first meeting in that bar, and you wouldn't have been able to refuse me. I went this far because I only wanted revenge on you and your husband, especially since you two have threatened the safety of my son."
"But—"

Zhang Fei interrupted directly. "To tell you the truth, I don't usually give my enemies a chance to choose, and I will eliminate them down to their roots so their descendants will not bother me with vengeful problems in the future. Actually, I wanted to eliminate your family, but I changed my mind, so I gave you that choice. If you kill your husband, I will let you and your children go, and I will never bother you again forever, so the choice is up to you. Anyway, I'll give you two weeks to decide, and I will finish everything then."

Helian Yueyi fell onto the bed as soon as Zhang Fei disappeared, and the sound of her crying immediately filled her bedroom. "Why... why is he so evil? Why... why does he keep forcing me to kill my husband?"
"Mhmm."
Linghu Yincheng, who was sleeping, immediately opened her eyes as soon as she heard the groan. She then looked at Bai Yaowei, who had already opened his eyes. "How do you feel, husband?"

"Ugh." Bai Yaowei groaned again as his mind was still muddled up after being under Li Tiannan's control for so long. "I feel really bad, wife. My mind is really messy, and I feel like there's a lot missing from me."

Linghu Yincheng let out a sigh of relief before holding her husband's hand and channeling her qi into his body. "I felt the same way when I first woke up, and you just needed time for your consciousness to fully recover. Someone freed us from that person's control, and he also saved our children, so everything will be back to normal again."
"Who saved us from that person?"

Linghu Yincheng immediately explained everything to her husband, especially about Zhang Fei's identity. "By the way, you don't need to think about all that for now, and you should rest your mind first. When your mind is calm, we'll talk about everything."
"Yeah." Bai Yaowei immediately closed his eyes again, but he was not really sleeping, and he tried to calm his mind as soon as possible.

After she told her three children about their father's condition, Linghu Yincheng immediately hugged Bai Yaowei and accompanied him to sleep, and all the burdens in her heart were completely gone now.

Zhang Fei was already at Duan Zhao's residence, and the old man immediately gave him the new weapon. He immediately tried it out by channeling a little of his fire Qi into the crystal before shooting it toward a huge boulder not far away, and a ball of fire straight shot out from it.
*Boom*

Even though Zhang Fei only used a little of his fire Qi, the boulder instantly exploded into small pieces after being hit by his attack, which satisfied him. "This weapon is just what I want, Senior Duan."

"Kid, the more you use your fire Qi on that weapon, the greater its explosive power will be." Zhang Fei nodded to Cheng Gaoji. "Different elements have different effects and strengths, so the results will depend on which one you use."
Hearing that, Zhang Fei immediately channeled his wind Qi into his weapon, and he shot it toward the trees standing in a row.
*Swoosh*
Unlike when Zhang Fei used his fire Qi, those trees didn't explode, and his wind Qi pierced through their trunks, leaving large holes in them.

Zhang Fei then tried to use his darkness element and fired it at another tree, but the effect was not as he expected, and the explosive power was too small. However, his darkness quickly spread to every part of the tree, causing it to turn black.
"Oh?" Cheng Gaoji and Duan Zhao were surprised to see that. "Your darkness element seems to have a corrosive effect, and it is corroding the tree from the inside."

"Normally, my darkness element doesn't have such an effect, but I used one of my abilities, so it had a corrosion effect." Zhang Fei then turned to Cheng Gaoji and pointed his new weapon at him. "Stay still, old man. I want to know the effect of my light Qi if I use it through this weapon."
Cheng Gaoji's lips twitched because Zhang Fei wanted to use him as a guinea pig. "Do it then."

Zhang Fei shot a bit of his light Qi at Cheng Gaoji, but the old man did not feel the slightest pain. Instead, he felt his light Qi spreading into his body and enveloping his old injuries while healing them.
"What do you feel, old man?" Zhang Fei asked.

"Hmm?" Cheng Gaoji thought for a moment before explaining to him. "If your darkness element has a corrosive effect, your light element has a healing effect. The effect is slow because you only used a little light qi. If you use more, it will be faster."

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "My light element does have a stronger healing effect compared to other light elements, and combining it with this weapon is much more beneficial. This way, I don't need to get close to people to heal them, and I can heal them from afar, especially during battle."

"That's right." Cheng Gaoji then asked. "Do you want to produce more of this weapon? I've been gone for a few months, and my customers must be looking for me, so I have to return to the Xianjin Realm as soon as possible. If you want to produce more of this weapon, I can do it there, and I will bring little Duan with me."

"You don't need to go back to the Xianjin Realm, old man." Cheng Gaoji frowned at Zhang Fei. "My third clone and Lin Moxian are on their way to that realm, and we will arrive there around two weeks. After they arrive, I can send you two so you don't waste months traveling."

Cheng Gaoji was no longer surprised to hear that, especially since Zhang Fei had previously brought him from the Sky Jade Realm. "Tell me the truth, kid. What is your relationship with the Heavenly Fox Race? In this entire universe, only their race has the ability to open a gate like yours."

"Haha! Shouldn't you already know the answer, old man?" Zhang Fei transformed into his complete fox form, and his six tails danced behind him, which proved Cheng Gaoji's guess. "I am a heavenly fox, but I am not one of them. Instead, they are my enemies, and I will go to their realm to destroy them after I have reached their level."
Zhang Fei wanted to return to his human form, but Xian Xian suddenly ran at full speed from inside the residence, and she jumped onto his back directly.
"Wow! I didn't expect you to be such a cute and huge fox, Zhang Fei!" Xian Xian said as she lay on Zhang Fei's back and rubbed her face against his soft fur. "Hehe! I love your fur! They're so soft!"

Gang Zhishou and the two men, who had just walked out of the residence, could only shake their heads at their sister's behavior. However, they were also shocked after learning that Zhang Fei was a fox beast, but they still didn't know his demon identity.

Zhang Fei sighed helplessly at Xian Xian's behavior, especially since all the women always acted like her if they saw his fox form. "Senior sister, please get off my back now so I can return to my human form."
"No!" Xian Xian shouted in refusal. "Let me enjoy your soft fur first!"
Instead, Zhang Fei jumped into the air and returned to his human form, and he carried Xian Xian before landing again, causing her to purse her lips. "Come down now, Senior Sister."
"I don't want to." Xian Xian refused as she put her arms around Zhang Fei's neck. "I won't come down if you don't return to your fox form."

Zhang Fei folded his forehead in response, but a faint smirk suddenly appeared on his face, making Xian Xian shudder. Before she could react, he had already sealed her lips, causing her to fall into a daze.
Gang Zhishou and the others were stunned to see Zhang Fei kissing Xian Xian, and Duan Zhao smiled strangely as he watched that, but they immediately burst out laughing.

'Ugh! This kid stole my first kiss without my consent!' Xian Xian's face was completely red like a ripe tomato, but she panicked when Zhang Fei's tongue invaded her mouth, and she didn't know what she should do to respond to that. She eventually closed her eyes, hugged his neck tighter, and tried to follow his kiss. 'Mhmm! Kissing a man isn't as bad as I thought all this time.'
'She's so old, but she has no experience in kissing at all.' Zhang Fei inwardly muttered and led Xian Xian into a deeper kiss while guiding her, which she enjoyed.

After kissing for a few minutes, Zhang Fei broke off their kiss, but Xian Xian immediately jumped down from his arms and ran away like a shy rabbit. "You stole my kiss, so you have to be responsible for me!"
Sorry, I'm not feeling well today, and I have too much work at the office, so I can only write one chapter today.

Even though Zhang Fei only used a little of his fire Qi, the boulder instantly exploded into small pieces after being hit by his attack, which satisfied him.
"This weapon is just what I want, Senior Duan."
"Kid, the more you use your fire Qi on that weapon, the greater its explosive power will be." Zhang Fei nodded to Cheng Gaoji.
"Different elements have different effects and strengths, so the results will depend on which one you use."
Hearing that, Zhang Fei immediately channeled his wind Qi into his weapon, and he shot it toward the trees standing in a row.
*Swoosh*
Unlike when Zhang Fei used his fire Qi, those trees didn't explode, and his wind Qi pierced through their trunks, leaving large holes in them.
Zhang Fei then tried to use his darkness element and fired it at another tree, but the effect was not as he expected, and the explosive power was too small.
However, his darkness quickly spread to every part of the tree, causing it to turn black.
"Oh?" Cheng Gaoji and Duan Zhao were surprised to see that.
"Your darkness element seems to have a corrosive effect, and it is corroding the tree from the inside."
"Normally, my darkness element doesn't have such an effect, but I used one of my abilities, so it had a corrosion effect." Zhang Fei then turned to Cheng Gaoji and pointed his new weapon at him.
"Stay still, old man.
I want to know the effect of my light Qi if I use it through this weapon."
Cheng Gaoji's lips twitched because Zhang Fei wanted to use him as a guinea pig.
"Do it then."
Zhang Fei shot a bit of his light Qi at Cheng Gaoji, but the old man did not feel the slightest pain.
Instead, he felt his light Qi spreading into his body and enveloping his old injuries while healing them.
"What do you feel, old man?" Zhang Fei asked.
"Hmm?" Cheng Gaoji thought for a moment before explaining to him.
"If your darkness element has a corrosive effect, your light element has a healing effect.
The effect is slow because you only used a little light qi.
If you use more, it will be faster."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding.
"My light element does have a stronger healing effect compared to other light elements, and combining it with this weapon is much more beneficial.
This way, I don't need to get close to people to heal them, and I can heal them from afar, especially during battle."
"That's right." Cheng Gaoji then asked.
"Do you want to produce more of this weapon?
I've been gone for a few months, and my customers must be looking for me, so I have to return to the Xianjin Realm as soon as possible.
If you want to produce more of this weapon, I can do it there, and I will bring little Duan with me."
"You don't need to go back to the Xianjin Realm, old man." Cheng Gaoji frowned at Zhang Fei.
"My third clone and Lin Moxian are on their way to that realm, and we will arrive there around two weeks.
After they arrive, I can send you two so you don't waste months traveling."
Cheng Gaoji was no longer surprised to hear that, especially since Zhang Fei had previously brought him from the Sky Jade Realm.
"Tell me the truth, kid.
What is your relationship with the Heavenly Fox Race?
In this entire universe, only their race has the ability to open a gate like yours."
"Haha!
Shouldn't you already know the answer, old man?" Zhang Fei transformed into his complete fox form, and his six tails danced behind him, which proved Cheng Gaoji's guess.
"I am a heavenly fox, but I am not one of them.
Instead, they are my enemies, and I will go to their realm to destroy them after I have reached their level."
Zhang Fei wanted to return to his human form, but Xian Xian suddenly ran at full speed from inside the residence, and she jumped onto his back directly.
"Wow!
I didn't expect you to be such a cute and huge fox, Zhang Fei!" Xian Xian said as she lay on Zhang Fei's back and rubbed her face against his soft fur.
"Hehe!
I love your fur!
They're so soft!"
Gang Zhishou and the two men, who had just walked out of the residence, could only shake their heads at their sister's behavior.
However, they were also shocked after learning that Zhang Fei was a fox beast, but they still didn't know his demon identity.
Zhang Fei sighed helplessly at Xian Xian's behavior, especially since all the women always acted like her if they saw his fox form.
"Senior sister, please get off my back now so I can return to my human form."
"No!" Xian Xian shouted in refusal.
"Let me enjoy your soft fur first!"
Instead, Zhang Fei jumped into the air and returned to his human form, and he carried Xian Xian before landing again, causing her to purse her lips.
"Come down now, Senior Sister."
"I don't want to." Xian Xian refused as she put her arms around Zhang Fei's neck.
"I won't come down if you don't return to your fox form."
Zhang Fei folded his forehead in response, but a faint smirk suddenly appeared on his face, making Xian Xian shudder.
Before she could react, he had already sealed her lips, causing her to fall into a daze.
Gang Zhishou and the others were stunned to see Zhang Fei kissing Xian Xian, and Duan Zhao smiled strangely as he watched that, but they immediately burst out laughing.
'Ugh!

This kid stole my first kiss without my consent!' Xian Xian's face was completely red like a ripe tomato, but she panicked when Zhang Fei's tongue invaded her mouth, and she didn't know what she should do to respond to that.
She eventually closed her eyes, hugged his neck tighter, and tried to follow his kiss. 'Mhmm!
Kissing a man isn't as bad as I thought all this time.'
'She's so old, but she has no experience in kissing at all.' Zhang Fei inwardly muttered and led Xian Xian into a deeper kiss while guiding her, which she enjoyed.
After kissing for a few minutes, Zhang Fei broke off their kiss, but Xian Xian immediately jumped down from his arms and ran away like a shy rabbit.
"You stole my kiss, so you have to be responsible for me!"
