paragraphs: "So, do you want to produce more of this weapon?" Cheng Gaoji asked.

Zhang Fei immediately nodded. "If it is possible, I want you to make 25 more of these weapons, and I will give them to the main members of my harem. That way, they can protect them better, especially when I am not by their side."

"The most difficult part to obtain in making the weapon is the Luminous Qi crystal, and I only have five in my shop." Duan Zhao nodded in agreement with Cheng Gaoji, especially since he himself needed almost two months to get one. "However, I can ask some of my customers to pay me with it, so I don't have to waste time looking for it. As for the other materials, they are sold freely in the Xianjin Realm, especially in the shop belonging to the Blacksmith Union."

"I plan to meet Ji Changlan, so you can give me the list of materials, and my clone will buy them once he arrives in that realm." Cheng Gaoji directly gave the material list to Zhang Fei. "In that case, I'll go back now, and—"
"Please wait, kid." Zhang Fei looked at Duan Zhao. "I know you want to take my disciples to the Star Tower, but three of them want to go to the Xianjin Realm with us."
From the expressions of the three men, Zhang Fei could immediately guess that Ah Hu, Lu Zhong, and Xian Xian wanted to go to that realm. "Don't you want to join them, Old Gang?"
"I want to join them, but I won't be going there anytime soon, and I will fulfill my promise to you to go to the Star Tower first." Gang Zhishou seriously answered.

Zhang Fei was satisfied with Gang Zhishou's answer, especially since he was a man of his word. "Actually, you don't have to think about that, Old Gang. I still need three to four months to break through to the Heaven Realm, and I will be able to create the gate to that realm soon, so I can send all of you to that realm easily. Therefore, you can join them, and I will pick you up once we are ready to challenge the tower."
"I see." Gang Zhishou nodded in understanding. "Okay, I'll go with them to that realm, and you must remember to pick me up when you are ready to challenge the tower."
"That's for sure!" After that, Zhang Fei immediately returned to the Red Sun Realm.

Zhang Fei was already standing not far from the Shang Clan and monitoring the clan using the Demon's Eye Orb, especially Shang Huaqiang's room. He smiled contentedly at his gloomy expression due to the disappearance of his dick, and he could see Fei Qinyuan thinking about something seriously at her husband's side.

"Heh! There's no point in you even thinking about looking for me, especially since you'll never be able to find me." Zhang Fei then checked another room, but he raised an eyebrow after he found Xi Yinying in that room. "That woman is too careless, and she should wait for the clan's situation to calm down. Fortunately, Shang Yanhan didn't notice her presence, or else she would have died in his hands."
[Why do you care so much about Xi Yinying, Master? Do you want her as your woman?]

"Xi Yinying is not bad, and her soul is as plain as white paper, so it would be a shame if she died because of her recklessness." Zhang Fei smiled faintly when Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian started to satisfy each other because Shang Xishun and the others couldn't quell their lust, and the pill that Du Yuanjia gave them could only temporarily relieve it. "I don't know how Shi Wuxian was able to withstand the effects of my hormone manipulation for so long, but Shang Ziyuan was probably able to do it thanks to his unusual physique. Fortunately, my ability is not an attack ability, so he couldn't reflect it using his Reversal Mirror Technique."
[Are you interested in Shang Ziyuan's technique, Master?]

Zhang Fei gave a light nod. "I don't have any technique that can reflect enemy attacks, so I thought it would be useful if I could get that technique from her. Unfortunately, it's not easy to take her down, and I have to be more careful with her, or I'll be the one to fall into her hands."
Zhang Fei wanted to infiltrate the Shang Clan, but the protective barrier covering the clan was too strong for the current him, so he abandoned his intention and entered the training space instead.

As soon as Zhang Fei entered the Cloud Mansion, Xu Ling'er was already waiting for him in the living room. He immediately sat down on the sofa and lifted the little girl onto his lap. "Were you waiting for me, Ling'er? Where are Tasha and Wu Lianzhi?"

"Tasha and Wu Lianzhi have been sleeping for a long time." Xu Ling'er then hugged Zhang Fei. "Big brother, I am having difficulty sleeping because I am having a lot of vivid dreams, and they are all quite frightful. I believe my dreams are associated with Tian Huangjin, particularly because I witnessed a significant amount of destruction."
"Did you have those dreams after the Holy Radiance Crown chose you?" Xu Ling'er nodded and shared her dreams with Zhang Fei. "I'll look at them first."
"Yes."

Zhang Fei immediately closed his eyes and watched all of Xu Ling'er's dreams, causing his expression to continuously change for a while. 'How could such great destruction happen in that era? If I remember correctly, there was a mysterious figure that appeared in the era when Tian Huangjin lived, and it affected the living beings that lived in that era to cause a great destruction, wiping out more than half of the population.'
[Master, all the chaos described by all the paintings on the left wall of that place is too complicated, especially since they started from the era of the first living beings.]

'You're right.' Zhang Fei nodded slightly. 'Since ancient times to the present, all living beings have continuously brought destruction everywhere. Even wars have always occurred on earth because first-class countries are too ambitious to dominate other countries, and they use all means to achieve their ambitions, including provoking and selling war equipment to certain countries, without thinking about the consequences.'
[Why don't you act, Master? With your current strength, it is not difficult for you to dominate the earth, and you can destroy all those countries to become the sole ruler there.]

'Why do I feel that you are becoming like the evil AI in movies, Mei?' The female AI laughed in Zhang Fei's mind. 'Honestly, I am still curious about the past calamity that happened on earth, but unfortunately, no one has any records of it, and the ancient records in the heaven's library also do not record the incident in detail. I don't want to become the sole ruler on earth because earth is just one of the planets in the lower realms, and there is no Qi there, so it will only waste my time.'
"Big brother."

Zhang Fei immediately opened his eyes and kissed Xu Ling'er on the forehead. "You're right, Ling'er. Those dreams are memories of Tian Huangjin when she was still alive, especially since you were her reincarnation. However, you don't need to think about them because you have me by your side, and I will never let you or the others experience something like that.
"Hehe." Xu Ling'er giggled and snuggled into his chest. "I'm not afraid of my dreams because I know you will always protect me, but they keep bothering me because they appear in bits and pieces."

"The only way for you to get Tian Huangjin's intact memories is to find the remaining pieces of the Holy Radiance equipment, but I have no information about their whereabouts, and she didn't tell me about their location either. Therefore, we can only search for them slowly, and I'm sure we'll find them all one day." Zhang Fei then carried Xu Ling'er and took her to Ru Xue's room, especially since Shi Wu and Shi Xi were still sleeping in his room.
"Hmm?" Ru Xue, who was cultivating on the bed, immediately opened her eyes. "What happened? Why was Ling'er acting spoiled?"

"Mom! I'm not being spoiled!" Xu Ling'er protested as she jumped down from Zhang Fei's arms, joining her mother on the bed. "I kept having nightmares because of Tian Huangjin's memories, so I waited for big brother to talk to him about them."

Ru Xue pulled Xu Ling'er into her lap, hugged her, and spoke to her. "I may not be as reliable as Fei'er, but I am still the mother who gave birth to you. Moreover, I am no longer as weak as before, and I have improved a lot as a cultivator, so you can also talk to me if you are troubled by something."

"Well, that's true; you are no longer weak, Mom." Xu Ling'er leaned on her mother's chest and looked up. "Back then, you could only cry in the bathroom every time my father beat you, but you have become braver, and you have killed many demons or demon beasts since you became a cultivator."

"Why did you bring up the matters of the past?" Ru Xue asked with a shake of her head. "It's been almost a year since we divorced, and I'm Fei'er's wife now, so you don't need to bring up the past anymore."
Xu Ling'er pouted her lips in response, but she immediately lay down in the middle of the bed. "I'm starting to get sleepy again, so let's sleep together, Mom and Big Brother!"
Zhang Fei and Ru Xue laid down on both sides of Xu Ling'er and hugged the little girl, and they accompanied her until she fell asleep.
Ru Xue then looked at Zhang Fei. 'What exactly did Ling'er see in her dreams?'

'A complete destruction of an era.' Zhang Fei told Ru Xue about all of Xu Ling'er's dreams, but he had no intention of sharing her dreams with her because they were too scary. 'We can't do anything to stop those memories from appearing in her dreams because she is Tian Huangjin's reincarnation, and sooner or later she will regain all of her past memories. However, you don't need to worry about her, and I will make sure that she will never change after she gets them back.'
Ru Xue nodded as she looked at her daughter's face. 'I know you love Ling'er as much as I love her, so I believe that you will never let anything bad happen to her.'

'That's for sure!' Zhang Fei then told her. 'Since your cultivation and soul are still unstable, I want you and the others to focus on practicing using the suppression feature, which is beneficial for increasing your mental strength. That way, you won't have any difficulty using high-level techniques, and you won't be vulnerable to mental attacks.'
Ru Xue nodded in agreement before looking at him. 'Fei'er, do you have any clone techniques we can learn?'
'Hmm?' Zhang Fei was surprised by that. 'Why do you suddenly want to learn a clone technique?'

Ru Xue let out a soft sigh before sharing the results of her discussion with Zhang Fei's other wives, and they decided on it because they didn't want him to continue adding more women to his side, especially since the number of his women was already too numerous.
Zhang Fei smiled wryly at that. 'Is there a clone technique in the system shop, Mei?
[There is one, Master. That technique was quite unique, and it was supposed to be on par with your demon body double.]
'Why did you never tell me that technique?'

[Don't you already have your demon body double? I thought you didn't need that technique, so I didn't tell you about it. Moreover, the price of that technique wasn't cheap, and you didn't have enough jewels at that time.]
'Buy it, Mei.'
[Okay.]
{You obtained the Yin-Yang Splitting Avatar Technique x1.}
{10,000,000 blue jewels have been deducted from your balance.}

[Yin-Yang Avatar Technique: This technique allows a cultivator to split his or her body to create an avatar, either a male or female avatar, depending on the user's wishes. The avatar can cultivate separately from the original body, and the user can merge it back to exponentially enhance their cultivation base.]
'Oh?' Zhang Fei was surprised by the technique's description. 'Splitting the body to create an avatar, huh? Is this technique similar to Li Mengmeng's Avatar technique?'

[Since the system couldn't detect Li Mengmeng's status, I'm not sure whether the two techniques are similar, Master. By the way, you can learn it too, and your avatar can focus completely on cultivating here, so your cultivation will improve even faster.]
'How about it, Fei'er? Do you have a clone technique?' Ru Xue asked.
Zhang Fei immediately shared the Yin-Yang Avatar Technique with Ru Xue. 'Let's try to learn it first.'

Zhang Fei and Ru Xue immediately sat on the bed to study the Yin-Yang Avatar Technique first. A few minutes later, they attempted to use the technique, but the sensation of their bodies splitting caused them discomfort.

Soon, two avatars appeared in front of the bed, so Zhang Fei and Ru Xue immediately got out of bed while observing them. "These avatars are really good, and they are similar to your other clones, Fei'er."

"You're right." Zhang Fei nodded in agreement. "This way, our cultivation can increase even faster if our avatars dual cultivate with each other, and we might be able to break through to the Seven Divine Realm much faster than we expected."
Ru Xue shook her head. "We want to learn the clone technique not so that our clones dual cultivate with yours, but we want you to dual cultivate with them so you don't need to add more women."

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed while rubbing his nose. "Since my cultivation still needs some time to stabilize, I will not dual cultivate with your avatar for now, so let your avatar cultivate by itself for the time being."
"Yeah." Ru Xue's avatar immediately sat down on the sofa and began cultivating there. "Fei'er, you can go to the others and teach them the technique, and I will accompany Ling'er to sleep."

Zhang Fei immediately went to all his official wives and future wives. He taught them the Yin-Yang Avatar Technique, which made them overjoyed. Since all his clones were busy with other matters, he went to the portable mansion and taught the technique to all his clones' partners.
After that, Zhang Fei brought Zhang Chen and his main family into the Cloud Mansion and told them about the technique, but he forbade them from telling the others about it.

Even though those people were all his friends and family members, Zhang Fei still wanted to maintain some gap between them and his main family. He didn't even teach the technique to his grandfather, Wang Zhetian, and his family.

Zhang Chen naturally knew Zhang Fei's character very well, so she did not refute his prohibition, and neither did Zhang Hanzhi and Qing Tan. Thereafter, he asked them to quickly learn the technique so they could cultivate faster by utilizing their avatars.
Sometime later, Zhang Chen and the others had successfully created their avatars, and Zhang Fei took them to a special room inside the cloud mansion, where they focused solely on cultivating.
After that, Zhang Chen and the others immediately returned to the training space, and they did not discuss the technique with anyone as Zhang Fei had forbidden.

Zhang Fei also went to the training ground, where he focused on practicing using the suppression feature to hone his mental strength, especially since his enemies in the upper realms were too strong for the current him.

Meanwhile, in the Sky Jade Realm, a gate suddenly opened in the sky above the western region, and five people walked out from it. They immediately checked the region, but their expressions looked upset because they couldn't find their target anywhere. "Do you think Zhang Fei has already left this realm, Tian Jiyuan?"

Ru Xue let out a soft sigh before sharing the results of her discussion with Zhang Fei's other wives, and they decided on it because they didn't want him to continue adding more women to his side, especially since the number of his women was already too numerous.
Zhang Fei smiled wryly at that. 'Is there a clone technique in the system shop, Mei?
[There is one, Master.
That technique was quite unique, and it was supposed to be on par with your demon body double.]
'Why did you never tell me that technique?'
[Don't you already have your demon body double?
I thought you didn't need that technique, so I didn't tell you about it.
Moreover, the price of that technique wasn't cheap, and you didn't have enough jewels at that time.]
'Buy it, Mei.'
[Okay.]
{You obtained the Yin-Yang Splitting Avatar Technique x1.}
{10,000,000 blue jewels have been deducted from your balance.}
[Yin-Yang Avatar Technique: This technique allows a cultivator to split his or her body to create an avatar, either a male or female avatar, depending on the user's wishes.
The avatar can cultivate separately from the original body, and the user can merge it back to exponentially enhance their cultivation base.]
'Oh?' Zhang Fei was surprised by the technique's description. 'Splitting the body to create an avatar, huh?
Is this technique similar to Li Mengmeng's Avatar technique?'
[Since the system couldn't detect Li Mengmeng's status, I'm not sure whether the two techniques are similar, Master.
By the way, you can learn it too, and your avatar can focus completely on cultivating here, so your cultivation will improve even faster.]
'How about it, Fei'er?
Do you have a clone technique?' Ru Xue asked.
Zhang Fei immediately shared the Yin-Yang Avatar Technique with Ru Xue. 'Let's try to learn it first.'
Zhang Fei and Ru Xue immediately sat on the bed to study the Yin-Yang Avatar Technique first.
A few minutes later, they attempted to use the technique, but the sensation of their bodies splitting caused them discomfort.
Soon, two avatars appeared in front of the bed, so Zhang Fei and Ru Xue immediately got out of bed while observing them.
"These avatars are really good, and they are similar to your other clones, Fei'er."
"You're right." Zhang Fei nodded in agreement.
"This way, our cultivation can increase even faster if our avatars dual cultivate with each other, and we might be able to break through to the Seven Divine Realm much faster than we expected."
Ru Xue shook her head.
"We want to learn the clone technique not so that our clones dual cultivate with yours, but we want you to dual cultivate with them so you don't need to add more women."
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed while rubbing his nose.
"Since my cultivation still needs some time to stabilize, I will not dual cultivate with your avatar for now, so let your avatar cultivate by itself for the time being."
"Yeah." Ru Xue's avatar immediately sat down on the sofa and began cultivating there.
"Fei'er, you can go to the others and teach them the technique, and I will accompany Ling'er to sleep."
Zhang Fei immediately went to all his official wives and future wives.
He taught them the Yin-Yang Avatar Technique, which made them overjoyed.
Since all his clones were busy with other matters, he went to the portable mansion and taught the technique to all his clones' partners.
After that, Zhang Fei brought Zhang Chen and his main family into the Cloud Mansion and told them about the technique, but he forbade them from telling the others about it.
Even though those people were all his friends and family members, Zhang Fei still wanted to maintain some gap between them and his main family.
He didn't even teach the technique to his grandfather, Wang Zhetian, and his family.
Zhang Chen naturally knew Zhang Fei's character very well, so she did not refute his prohibition, and neither did Zhang Hanzhi and Qing Tan.
Thereafter, he asked them to quickly learn the technique so they could cultivate faster by utilizing their avatars.
Sometime later, Zhang Chen and the others had successfully created their avatars, and Zhang Fei took them to a special room inside the cloud mansion, where they focused solely on cultivating.
After that, Zhang Chen and the others immediately returned to the training space, and they did not discuss the technique with anyone as Zhang Fei had forbidden.

Zhang Fei also went to the training ground, where he focused on practicing using the suppression feature to hone his mental strength, especially since his enemies in the upper realms were too strong for the current him.
Meanwhile, in the Sky Jade Realm, a gate suddenly opened in the sky above the western region, and five people walked out from it.
They immediately checked the region, but their expressions looked upset because they couldn't find their target anywhere.
"Do you think Zhang Fei has already left this realm, Tian Jiyuan?"

chapters.title: Chapter 782: Foxes - Demons
paragraphs: "You should be careful in spreading your senses, Tian Jianxia. Have you forgotten that the Phoenix Princess lives in this realm? We came here to check whether that kid is still living in this realm or not, so we better not offend her, or we'll be in trouble." Tian Jiyuan then spread his senses towards the southern and eastern regions, but he still couldn't find Zhang Fei. "There are only a few weak people related to that kid in this realm, but I can't find any signs of his presence, so I think he has left this realm."

"Where do you think he went?" Tian Dan asked. "The last time we came here was nine months ago, and his cultivation was still at the soul realm at that time. Moreover, he was born in these lower realms, so he shouldn't be able to go too far, right?"
Tian Chen nodded in agreement. "He may have gone to other planets in these lower realms, but these lower realms are too vast, and we would waste a lot of time searching for him on all planets."

"Senior Jiyuan." Tian Jiyuan turned to Tian Gongzhu. "Could it be that Zhang Fei is hiding in the Netherworld Realm? Back then, he deliberately lured us into that realm, and Tian Wangzhi died there because of it."
"Let's check into that realm."
"Tch! A demon realm is always disgusting!" Tian Gongzhu grumbled as soon as they arrived at the Netherworld Realm. "We—"
*Swoosh*
"Move!" Tian Jiyuan shouted as a large fireball shot towards them, and the others immediately followed him to avoid the attack.

Yan Jiang, the lava lion demon beast, appeared before them with a ferocious look. However, he smelled a familiar scent from their bodies, and he was sure that it was the same as Zhang Fei's. 'Are they friends of that kid? I don't think they're his friends, especially since they look evil.' "Who are you guys? How dare you sneak into my realm?"
"Heh." The five of them snorted and suppressed Yan Jiang's bloodline directly, causing the demon beast to fall from the sky and slam into the ground with a loud bang.

'Damn it!' Yan Jiang cursed as he tried to break free from their pressure. Although his cultivation was at the 1-Moon Divine Manifestation Realm, the power of their bloodlines was too strong for ordinary demon beasts like him. Moreover, not only one of them was suppressing him but five at once, rendering him unable to move an inch.

"Do you think you are worthy to stand in front of heavenly foxes like us? Your cultivation has indeed reached the Seven Divine Realms, but your insignificant bloodline is trash in our eyes." Tian Jianxia then landed on Yan Jiang's head and pressed her foot against his head. "Since you don't know your place and are trying to block us, you can die now."

Just as Tian Jianxia was on the verge of killing Yan Jiang, hundreds of black crows unexpectedly materialized and launched a direct attack on her. She immediately abandoned her intention to kill the lion demon beast and flew away before attacking them, but her light element seemed useless against them.
Tian Jiyuan and three others moved to help Tian Jianxia get rid of the black crow, but a huge black wave pushed them back. Soon, Morgana and Oz the First appear before them, shocking them.

Tian Jiyuan and Tian Gongzhu had been to the Netherworld Realm when they were chasing Zhang Fei, so they knew that there should be no demon cultivators in that realm, yet two powerful demon cultivators suddenly appeared in front of them.
Shang Chongyun and the three others naturally felt the arrival of the five heavenly foxes, but they decided not to interfere in their affairs, and they only observed them from a great distance.

Tian Jiyuan and the others were apprehensive about the appearance of Morgana and Oz the First because they had no information about the two, and their cultivation was clearly in the Seven Divine Realm, especially since they couldn't detect it.
"Heavenly foxes, huh?" Morgana muttered as she looked at them one by one, and she could immediately guess that they had come to look for Zhang Fei.
Morgana turned to Oz the First, who immediately nodded and took out an interspatial communication device, causing Tian Jiyuan and the others to frown.
Oz the First disregarded their reactions and sent a long-distance message to Zhang Fei, informing him of the arrival of the five Heavenly Foxes.

"How is the result?" Oz the First informed his wife via voice transmission, and Morgana then spoke to the five. "What are you five doing in our realm? If you can't explain your reason for coming here and beating up our guardian beast, I will capture all of you and imprison you in this realm."
"Humph!" Tian Gongzhu snorted. "Do you two think you can capture us? You—"
*Slap*
"Ahh!" Tian Gongzhu screamed as Morgana suddenly slapped her cheeks so hard, causing both of them to swell. "You—"

"Stop it, Gongzhu." Tian Jiyuan then spoke to them. "I know you two are much stronger than us, but I'm sure you guys don't want to have trouble with us. If you capture us, our ancestors will send our elders to attack this realm, and all of you will be destroyed in their hands."

Instead, Morgana shrugged her shoulders. "Do you think we are afraid of Tian Baixing and Tian Baitian? This realm is not our home realm, and we took over this realm for a certain purpose. Thus, it doesn't matter to us if this realm is destroyed, and we can find another realm to replace it. On the contrary, the five of you will suffer if we imprison you all here, and you guys will turn into demon beasts as time goes by."

Tian Jianxia looked furious at Morgana's threats, but she was fully aware that the five of them would never be able to stand against her and Oz the First, with such a huge difference in their cultivation.

Tian Jiyuan let out a soft sigh and said to them. "We came here to look for someone, and your guardian beast attacked us first, so we have the right to defend ourselves, right? Since that person is not in this realm, we will leave now."

Morgana and Oz the First didn't say anything or stop them, and Tian Jiyuan directly opened the gate leading to the Sky Jade Realm. He then led the others to enter, but Tian Gongzhu hatefully glared at the witch demon for some time before following them, and the gate immediately disappeared.
Yan Jiang then flew next to Morgana and Oz the First. "Did they come here to look for Zhang Fei?"

"Zhang Fei is a heavenly fox, but he is not one of them. Instead, they are his enemies, and they hunted him to this realm several months ago." Morgana then warned him. "Your cultivation is indeed high, but they are mythical beasts, and not many cultivators dare to fight their elders or ancestors. Therefore, you must be careful if they come to this realm again, or you will die in their hands."

"I know." Yan Jiang answered with a nod, but he was furious because of how the five heavenly foxes treated him previously. 'Tch! I hope that kid will come here soon, and I will ask him to help me become stronger. When I am truly strong, I will tear apart and devour those five damn foxes.'

After that, Yan Jiang returned to the dead forest again. Morgana and Oz the First returned to the demon palace, and they ordered the demon kings and queens to be fully alert, especially since there was still a possibility that the heavenly foxes would return to their realm again.
"What should we do now? Do we really have to search for Zhang Fei on all the planets in these lower realms?" Tian Jianxia asked in an irritated tone.

Tian Jiyuan sighed softly. "We have no other choice, right? Our ancestors ordered us to search and find Zhang Fei's whereabouts as soon as possible, so we have to spread out and search for him on all the planets."
"I think we should ask for more people to help us, or else we will waste too much time just looking for him." Tian Dan spoke.

Tian Chen immediately opened the gate to their realm. "You guys wait here, and I will return to our realm to meet our ancestors to discuss this matter. I will also report the presence of the two demons to them so they can make a decision about them."
After Tian Chen left, Tian Gongzhu asked. "Do any of you recognize the identities of those two demons?"

"The male demon is a celestial demon, and the abilities of his demon race are quite terrifying. Even our ancestors had to think twice about confronting them, but their race also never looked for trouble with our race." Tian Jiyuan then thought about Morgana's identity. "The crows that the female demon summoned earlier were strong, and they had resistance to the light element. However, I don't know for sure what her demon race is, and I feel that she is not a pure demon."

"What do you think their purpose is to take over that realm?" This time Tian Dan asked. "Since they know the names of our two ancestors and their cultivation has reached the Seven Divine Realms, they should be demons from the upper realms. Meanwhile, the Netherworld Realm is a demon realm in the middle realm, and there are no demon cultivators there, so I feel strange about their existence there."

Tian Jiyuan answered him with a shake of his head. "Just like humans, the demons have complicated problems with their own races, such as the demons of the Blackthorn Abyss Realm. Their affairs are none of our business, so we don't need to bother with them, and we should focus on our task of finding Zhang Fei."

After they waited for some time, Tian Chen returned to the Sky Jade Realm again and informed them about their ancestors' decision. "The five of us must still look for Zhang Fei, and they will send some others to look for him in the middle realms."
"The middle realm?"
"Yeah." Tian Chen nodded at them. "Ancestor Baixing thought that Zhang Fei might have gone there, so they decided that."
"Let's go! We've wasted a lot of time." Tian Jianxia immediately flew out of the Sky Jade Realm, followed by Tian Chen and Tian Dan.

Tian Jiyuan turned to Tian Gongzhu. "You should forget about going to the Netherworld Realm again because you are not the opponent of those two demons, and you will be the one to suffer if you fall into their hands. Additionally, we will part ways here, and I cannot protect you, so you must be careful when traveling. Although this area is the lower realms, we do not know if there are powerful cultivators hiding on other planets, so you must not act rashly. If you encounter a critical situation, you must escape immediately and return to our realm using the gate. Do you understand?"

"Yes." Tian Jiyuan immediately shot out of the realm, but Tian Gongzhu did not right away follow him and the others. Instead, she tried to find Zhang Fei's whereabouts there by monitoring several other places, such as the Ye and Gu Clans' residences. Naturally, she could only find guards and maids in the two clans, causing her to sigh. "I have to find that bastard quickly to take revenge for my brother's death, or he will never rest in peace in the afterlife."
Tian Gongzhu wanted to leave the realm, but a cold air suddenly enveloped her. She immediately channeled her Qi to relieve the cold, but it quickly froze her body.

Even though Tian Gongzhu was frozen, her consciousness was still awake. Feng Jinqiu's sudden appearance shocked her, and the ice phoenix sealed her cultivation directly. 'Shit! Why is there an ice phoenix in this realm? Isn't Feng Yao the one protecting this realm?'

"Honestly, I have no problem with you or your heavenly fox race, but my princess asked me to help Zhang Fei, so I was forced to capture you." Feng Jinqiu's words frightened Tian Gongzhu, and her worries came true as a gate opened in front of them before Zhang Fei [5] walked out of it. "The other four searched for you in the lower realms, and their ancestors sent other foxes to the middle realms. Therefore, you must be careful, or you will be in big trouble if they manage to find you there, especially since the rules do not prevent high-level cultivators from causing trouble there."

"Thank you for your help." Zhang Fei [5] immediately restricted Tian Gongzhu's movements as soon as Feng Jinqiu melted her ice, and he also took her storage ring. "Hehe! You didn't expect to fall into my hands, right? You're lucky that I couldn't kill you, or your ancestors would have discovered my location. However, I can still make you suffer, and you will never be able to return to your race again."
Tian Gongzhu wanted to curse Zhang Fei [5], but he immediately took her away through the gate before closing it.
Feng Jinqiu shook her head after they disappeared. "That female fox will regret it for the rest of her life."

Tian Gongzhu was horrified as soon as they arrived at the Nine Hells Darkland and saw the wandering souls circling above them, and she finally realized Zhang Fei [5]'s purpose in bringing her to that realm. Moreover, her cultivation was sealed, leaving her vulnerable to their influence. "Please! Don't leave me in this realm! I don't want to become a demon!"

"There's no point in you begging me." Zhang Fei [5] directly pulled Tian Gongzhu's soul out of her body, replicated it, and returned it again afterwards. She was shocked to see her soul replica, but he immediately merged it with his soul. "You will become a demon fox soon, and you will never be able to commit suicide because your life is under my control. In addition, you will die if I die, but I will live if you die."

As soon as Zhang Fei [5] left her, several wandering souls immediately rushed towards Tian Gongzhu, forcing her to escape from them. Unfortunately, they were too fast for her with her cultivation still sealed, and they directly entered her body and spread their negative emotions to her.
"Argh!" Tian Gongzhu screamed as she rolled on the ground while holding her head. "No! Get out of my body! I don't want to become a demon!"
Tian Gongzhu's scream actually provoked the other wandering souls to come to her, and more and more of them entered her body, causing her mind to become increasingly filled with negative emotions.
Zhang Fei [5] watched Tian Gongzhu from a distance with an evil smile on his face. "I want to see her desperate expression after she becomes an evil demon."

[Wouldn't this be a loss for you, Master? If she becomes a demon fox, you won't be able to send her back to the Heavenly Moon Realm, especially since those foxes will immediately kill her once she returns there.]

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "Tian Gongzhu's cultivation has now reached the quasi-divine realm, but she certainly has no influence in her race. Therefore, I have no intention of sending her back there, and I will use her to lure the other foxes to come to me, especially that Tian Jiyuan. By the way, I have to think of something about those foxes looking for me in these middle realms, and I am certain that they are foxes cultivating in the Seven Divine Realms. If they manage to find my traces in the Nine Stars Realm, they will create chaos there, and those people will suffer because of me."
[Are you thinking about moving them to another realm, master?]

Zhang Fei [5] let out a heavy sigh. "They haven't appeared in the past nine months, but they suddenly appeared, so I haven't prepared anything to face them. I'll talk to my two fathers-in-law and the others first, and I'll decide on my plans afterward."

"Thank you for your help." Zhang Fei [5] immediately restricted Tian Gongzhu's movements as soon as Feng Jinqiu melted her ice, and he also took her storage ring.
"Hehe!
You didn't expect to fall into my hands, right?
You're lucky that I couldn't kill you, or your ancestors would have discovered my location.
However, I can still make you suffer, and you will never be able to return to your race again."
Tian Gongzhu wanted to curse Zhang Fei [5], but he immediately took her away through the gate before closing it.
Feng Jinqiu shook her head after they disappeared.
"That female fox will regret it for the rest of her life."

Tian Gongzhu was horrified as soon as they arrived at the Nine Hells Darkland and saw the wandering souls circling above them, and she finally realized Zhang Fei [5]'s purpose in bringing her to that realm.
Moreover, her cultivation was sealed, leaving her vulnerable to their influence.
"Please!
Don't leave me in this realm!
I don't want to become a demon!"
"There's no point in you begging me." Zhang Fei [5] directly pulled Tian Gongzhu's soul out of her body, replicated it, and returned it again afterwards.
She was shocked to see her soul replica, but he immediately merged it with his soul.
"You will become a demon fox soon, and you will never be able to commit suicide because your life is under my control.
In addition, you will die if I die, but I will live if you die."
As soon as Zhang Fei [5] left her, several wandering souls immediately rushed towards Tian Gongzhu, forcing her to escape from them.
Unfortunately, they were too fast for her with her cultivation still sealed, and they directly entered her body and spread their negative emotions to her.
"Argh!" Tian Gongzhu screamed as she rolled on the ground while holding her head.
"No!
Get out of my body!
I don't want to become a demon!"
Tian Gongzhu's scream actually provoked the other wandering souls to come to her, and more and more of them entered her body, causing her mind to become increasingly filled with negative emotions.
Zhang Fei [5] watched Tian Gongzhu from a distance with an evil smile on his face.
"I want to see her desperate expression after she becomes an evil demon."
[Wouldn't this be a loss for you, Master?

"Tian Gongzhu's cultivation has now reached the quasi-divine realm, but she certainly has no influence in her race.

By the way, I have to think of something about those foxes looking for me in these middle realms, and I am certain that they are foxes cultivating in the Seven Divine Realms.
If they manage to find my traces in the Nine Stars Realm, they will create chaos there, and those people will suffer because of me."
[Are you thinking about moving them to another realm, master?]
Zhang Fei [5] let out a heavy sigh.
"They haven't appeared in the past nine months, but they suddenly appeared, so I haven't prepared anything to face them.
I'll talk to my two fathers-in-law and the others first, and I'll decide on my plans afterward."

chapters.title: Chapter 783: Demon Tian Gongzhu
paragraphs: After he finished his training, Zhang Fei immediately left the training space. He then gathered Zhou Shenxin, Jiang Tingxi, and the people from the other five kingdoms.
Zhang Fei told them about the heavenly foxes sent by Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing to hunt him down in the middle realms, which shocked all of them.
"Can you deal with them, Zhang Fei? Long Huang seriously asked.

Zhang Fei nodded. "Even though all of our abilities as heavenly foxes are the same, I am confident in dealing with them as long as they do not gang up on me. However, you guys will have a challenging time dealing with them, especially if their cultivation is above the Divine Expansion Realm. Thus, I want you to tell everyone in your kingdoms not to discuss my name so they won't attack you."
Xian Feng and the others immediately agreed with that, and they ordered their trusted people to suppress the news of Zhang Fei's presence in their kingdoms.
Long Baiyun then asked. "Can Senior Feng Yao help you fight them?"

"Honestly, I don't know the exact depth of Feng Yao's strength yet, but I know that she is truly powerful." Zhang Fei then paused and thought about the phoenix princess, especially the presence of Huo Ling by her side. "She might be able to defeat the two ancestors of the heavenly fox race, but I'm sure she won't make a move right away, and she will only make a move if I can't handle their people."

"So what do you plan to do if some of them look for you in this realm?" Zhang Fei looked at Xian Lianghua with a weird smile, causing the latter to frown. "Are you really considering luring them to the Cyanwood Mountain?"

"Are you crazy?" Xue Jingling also asked him. "The lightning element at the top of Cyanwood Mountain is too powerful because it is reinforced by the lightning elemental law, and you will be instantly reduced to ashes if any of them strikes your body. Even Lei Ting, who is a lightning fairy and masters the lightning elemental law, doesn't dare to set foot there."

Zhang Fei naturally would not underestimate their words. "Empress Xue, we are cultivators, and danger is our middle name. I did think of luring them to Cyanwood Mountain, but I will use it as my last resort if my plans don't work. To prepare for that, I will meet Senior Lei Ting first, and I will ask her to teach me the method to learn the lightning elemental law."

"You don't need to see Lei Ting." Guo Xuehua immediately stood up and walked towards Zhang Fei before touching his forehead. "I am a lightning cultivator, and I have also mastered the lightning elemental law. Even though my mastery is still below hers, I can still teach it to you."

Zhang Fei closed his eyes as Guo Xuehua imparted the method of learning the lightning elemental law to him, and it was not difficult for him to understand it. "Do you think I can master the lightning elemental law by using my lightning tribulations, mother-in-law?"

"I have never met a non-lightning cultivator who can do it, but you are different from other cultivators, so you can give it a try." Guo Xuehua then returned to her seat. "If you can master the lightning elemental law through your lightning tribulations, it will be a huge breakthrough in the world of cultivation, and all your wives may be able to do it too."

Zhang Fei nodded in agreement. "I can't break through now because my cultivation and soul are still unstable, so I think I'll go to the lightning pond in the Guo Clan to give it a try. If I really succeed, I no longer need to be afraid of my lightning tribulations, and I might be able to go to Cyanwood Mountain ahead of schedule."
"I know Guo Jizhe hates you very much because of your marriage to my daughter, but I hope you won't kill him if you meet him in the lightning pond." Guo Xuehua said in a pleading tone.

Zhang Fei would not have remembered about the man if Guo Xuehua had not mentioned him, especially since he was just an insignificant person in his eyes. "Everything depends on him, mother-in-law. If you don't want him to die in my hands, you can tell his parents to control him. If he can't hold back his jealousy and attacks me first, then I will fight him back, and I will have no qualms about killing him."
"I understand." Guo Xuehua immediately contacted Guo Jizhe's parents and strictly ordered them to keep their son in check.
Thereafter, Zhang Fei sent them all back to their respective places, and he went straight to the Guo Clan.

When he arrived there, Zhang Fei immediately summoned Zhong Yan, Angela, and Ye Lian to cultivate in the lightning pond. After he taught them how to learn the elemental law, the three women immediately entered the pond and studied it.

Zhang Fei then summoned Lei Que out of the beast space before teaching him how to learn the elemental law, and the two immediately went to the source of the lightning. "Learn the method first and start trying to master it afterwards."
"Yes, Master."
Meanwhile, Bai Yaowei and Linghu Yincheng were already seated on their thrones, with their three children standing behind them.

On the left side, Bai Shushi and Bai Zizhen led the Bai Clan members under them. Linghu Xiaoting and Linghu Shiwei led the people from the Linghu Clan. On the right side stood the people from the five major clans, except for Han Yuanzhi, who was represented by her brother.

The ministers, generals, and nobles of the Bai Kingdom were also present. They were relieved that their emperor and empress had returned to normal, allowing them to once again lead their kingdom and reorganize everything.

However, Bai Yaowei's announcement shocked the ministers, generals, and nobles, especially since he decided to abdicate. After he discussed it with his wife, they agreed for Bai Chongxi to ascend the throne and become the next emperor.
Unlike them, the leaders of the five major clans were not surprised by that, and they already knew the purpose of Bai Yaowei and Linghu Yincheng's decision.

"All of you may think that our decision is too hasty, but we have thought things through carefully. Bai Chongxi may be young, but he is our first son and the crown prince, and he has learned a lot about imperial matters. Furthermore, you all know that Zhou Shenxin is the empress of the Zhou Kingdom now, and they are almost the same age." Even though Bai Yaowei said that, those people were still not sure about accepting their decision, and they were not sure that their crown prince was capable of carrying out the duties of the next emperor. "Even if we decide to abdicate, we will still assist him from behind, so you don't have to worry about anything. Our decision is final, and I want Bai Chongxi's coronation ceremony to be held in two weeks, so I want you to prepare everything from now on."

Linghu Yincheng then added. "For hundreds of years, the situation in all kingdoms has never been peaceful, and wars continue to claim many lives. Therefore, we also want to inform you that our kingdom will cooperate with the Yun, Zhou, and Xian kingdoms. This way, there is no need for any more wars, and all kingdoms will be able to coexist peacefully."
"What about the Huangfu Kingdom, Empress?" Kong Heng asked.

Linghu Yincheng smiled upon hearing that. "Zhang Fei has already informed us that the Huangfu Kingdom is already under his control, including Huangfu Shou. Unfortunately, he cannot act immediately because of the existence of the Huangfu Clan behind them, but he will make his move after he ensures that the clan will not be able to find out about his actions. Therefore, we no longer need to worry about them, and we will focus on reorganizing our kingdom under Bai Chongxi's leadership."

The ministers, generals, and nobles naturally already knew Zhang Fei's identity as the husband of the three princesses of the three other kingdoms. However, they were confused by Linghu Yincheng's decision to side with him, especially since their kingdom had no direct ties to him.

After Bai Yaowei and Linghu Yincheng told them a few other things, the people immediately left the throne room to carry out their orders, except for Bai Tian'er, Bai Shushi, Bai Zizhen, and the leaders of the five clans.

"Cousin, Zhang Fei contacted me earlier, and he wants you two to forbid everyone from mentioning his name in this kingdom." Bai Yaowei and Linghu Yincheng looked at Bai Shushi in confusion. "Currently, many powerful cultivators are hunting him in the lower and middle realms, and they might be able to find his presence in this realm. In order to prevent any unexpected incidents from happening in this kingdom, he wants us to cover all his traces and his ties with us so they won't attack us."
"Did Zhang Fei tell you the identities of his enemies?" Xiong Ningwu asked her.

"Zhang Fei's enemies are the heavenly fox race, and they come from the upper realms." Bai Shushi's answer shocked all of them. "Their strength is extremely high, and both of their ancestors have already reached the Ascension Divine Realm. If they know our relationship with him, they might attack us and use us to force him out. He previously met Xian Feng and the others, and they have already ordered their people to erase any traces of him from their kingdoms."
Bai Yaowei nodded in understanding. "In that case, I want all of you to send people from your clans to do that, and we must erase Zhang Fei's traces in our kingdom as neatly as possible."
"Yes." Xiong Ningwu and the others hurriedly left the Bai Royal Palace.
Bai Yaowei then asked his eldest son. "Are you ready to take on the new responsibility of leading our kingdom?"

"Ready or not, I still have to lead this kingdom, right?" Bai Chongxi responded with a bitter smile. "Even though I have learned about imperial affairs, I am not fully ready to become the emperor. However, the situation on this human island is much more conducive with all the kingdoms united under Zhang Fei, and the two of you will still help me to take care of everything, so I will try my best to be a good emperor."
"Haha." Bai Yaowei laughed as he nodded in satisfaction hearing that. "Being an emperor can be difficult or easy, and I'm sure you can adapt to your new responsibilities quickly."

Linghu Yincheng then told him. "Chongxi, the main key to being a good emperor is being willing to listen to advice and input from other people, especially your seniors. As long as you are willing to listen to them and treat your people fairly, they will fully support you."
"I know, Mother." Bai Chongxi then turned to his little brother and little sister. "Renfu and Shaoyi, you two should help me too, okay?"
Bai Renfu and Bai Shouyi nodded. "Don't worry, Big Brother. The two of us will definitely help you to take care of this kingdom."

"We haven't gathered together for a long time, so we'll go eat together at the Sky Jade Restaurant." Linghu Yincheng then stepped down from his throne. "Shushi and Tian'er, you two should also join us, and we'll eat while talking about other things."
"All right."

After a few hours, Zhang Fei [5] decided to check on Tian Gongzhu, who had stopped screaming. However, her eyes had already turned bloody red, and her white hair had become jet-black; even a baleful aura was emanating from her body.

Tian Gongzhu glared hatefully at Zhang Fei [5]. She had eventually become a demon fox due to the influence of the demon aura in that realm, and her mind was filled with the negative emotions of those wandering souls.

"How do you feel after becoming a demon fox?" Tian Gongzhu wanted to shout at Zhang Fei [5], but he suddenly changed to his half-fox form. He didn't use his white half-fox form but black, which shocked her. "You should have realized by now how I was able to escape to the Netherworld Realm back then, right? I am not an ordinary heavenly fox, but I am a demon heavenly fox, and you are the same as me now."
"You—mhmm."

Zhang Fei [5] immediately grabbed Tian Gongzhu's cheeks. "Even though I did not enslave you with my demon slave mark, you must remember that your life is in my hands now. Therefore, you must put away your arrogance when you are in front of me, or I will make you suffer much more than this. You better not doubt my words, especially since I am a cruel and merciless person, particularly toward my enemies."
'This bastard!' Tian Gongzhu inwardly cursed.
"Hehe." Zhang Fei [5] chuckled and pulled Tian Gongzhu into his arms before planting a kiss onto her lips, causing her eyes to widen in shock.

'Ugh!' Tian Gongzhu panicked when Zhang Fei [5]'s tongue invaded her mouth, and she struggled to escape from his embrace. He hugged her tightly with one hand while moving his other hand to her buttocks. 'Ugh! I really want to kill him!'

Under Zhang Fei [5]'s intense kiss, Tian Gongzhu's resistance gradually died down. She had already closed her eyes and began to enjoy their kiss, and her body writhed from his gentle squeeze on her buttocks.
A few minutes later, Zhang Fei [5] separated their lips, unsealed Tian Gongzhu's cultivation, and gave her a bottle containing six pills.
Tian Gongzhu immediately opened the lid of the bottle, but her expression changed to shock when she saw the six superior-grade pills inside. "Did you match these pills?"

"I am a grandmaster alchemist, okay?" Zhang Fei [5]'s answer surprised Tian Gongzhu. "Even though you are my enemy, you are mine now. Your cultivation is indeed quite high in the Quasi-Divine Realm; however, you are still too weak to be of much help to me. Therefore, you must swallow these pills immediately. If you are obedient to me, I will give you some better pills, and you will be stronger than Tian Jiyuan and the others. You can swallow these pills now, and you can help me deal with these wandering souls afterwards."

After he said that, Zhang Fei [5] immediately flew to another area to continue cleaning up those wandering souls. Tian Gongzhu stared at four different directions with a serious expression, especially looking at the four white circles in the sky that were continuously raining down light elements on the area below them. "What kind of ability is that? Why doesn't a single member of our race have that kind of ability? If we had that kind of ability, we would definitely be able to clear out all the demons attacking our realm much more easily."

Tian Gongzhu then sighed heavily because she had already become a demon heavenly fox, so she could no longer return to the Heavenly Moon Realm. If she forced her way back there, her race members would immediately regard her as a disgrace and kill her outright.

Tian Gongzhu immediately sat cross-legged on the ground and began to swallow the pills. After swallowing the first pill, she could immediately feel the changes in herself, and she hurried to swallow the rest. 'Does he really have better pills? If that's true, I think it wouldn't be bad to follow him, and I could become much stronger.'

'Ugh!' Tian Gongzhu panicked when Zhang Fei [5]'s tongue invaded her mouth, and she struggled to escape from his embrace.

I really want to kill him!'
Under Zhang Fei [5]'s intense kiss, Tian Gongzhu's resistance gradually died down.
She had already closed her eyes and began to enjoy their kiss, and her body writhed from his gentle squeeze on her buttocks.

"Did you match these pills?"
"I am a grandmaster alchemist, okay?" Zhang Fei [5]'s answer surprised Tian Gongzhu.
"Even though you are my enemy, you are mine now.
Your cultivation is indeed quite high in the Quasi-Divine Realm; however, you are still too weak to be of much help to me.

Tian Gongzhu stared at four different directions with a serious expression, especially looking at the four white circles in the sky that were continuously raining down light elements on the area below them.
"What kind of ability is that?

If we had that kind of ability, we would definitely be able to clear out all the demons attacking our realm much more easily."
Tian Gongzhu then sighed heavily because she had already become a demon heavenly fox, so she could no longer return to the Heavenly Moon Realm.
If she forced her way back there, her race members would immediately regard her as a disgrace and kill her outright.
Tian Gongzhu immediately sat cross-legged on the ground and began to swallow the pills.

chapters.title: Chapter 784: Two Emperors' Decision
paragraphs: After hearing about Bai Yaowei and Linghu Yincheng's decision, Yun Shang immediately discussed it with Guo Xuehua. "Are you sure about that, husband? Compared to Bai Chongxi and Zhou Shenxin, our son is indeed more prepared to carry out the duties of an emperor, but I'm still not sure about appointing him to be an emperor now."

"I understand your concerns, wife." Yun Shang then walked to the balcony and looked up at the sky. "Almost all the kingdoms have united now, making the situation in this realm much safer and more peaceful. Therefore, I think it is no problem if our son ascends the throne to replace me, and we will help him from behind while focusing on our cultivation."

Guo Xuehua walked to her husband's side. "Are you considering looking for our parents in the upper realms? It's been decades since they ascended, but they have never returned to this realm once. Senior Feng Yao said that they joined a sect there, but I truly miss them, and I want to see them again."

"I missed them, but I didn't think about them or the upper realms, especially since they were able to take care of themselves." Guo Xuehua turned to Yun Shang in confusion. "Have you forgotten Zhang Fei's story about the realms beyond the upper realms? The cultivators from there are trying to reach that place through the Sun Tower in the Blossom Heaven Realm right now, so I was thinking of challenging the Star Tower again. Back then, we only managed to reach the 5th floor because we were still weak, but our cultivation has improved a lot since then, so I'm confident we can reach the higher floors."
Guo Xuehua nodded in agreement. "What if we join Zhang Fei? He plans to bring all his wives and family, who have reached the earth realm, to challenge the tower."
"I think it's for the best." Yun Shang replied with a nod. "I will contact Brother Feng and discuss this matter with him, and you can persuade Sister Qingzhuang to join us."

"I'm sure Brother Feng and Sister Qingzhuang want to challenge the Star Tower again, but Xian Xianwu and Yao Yin are not ready to lead their kingdom." Guo Xuehua then thought of another possibility. "Do you think they will be willing to transfer their authority to Xian Luo?"

Yun Shang shook his head. "Xiao Luo once said that he is not interested in leading their kingdom, so he will refuse it. However, they still have Xian Qifeng and Luo Qinglin, and I believe they are worthy to lead the Xian Kingdom, but the decision is in their hands."

"In that case, you can go to our son to talk about this matter, and I will meet our daughter-in-law while contacting Sister Qingzhuang." Thereafter, they went to two different places. Yun Shang went to see Yun Aoxian, and Guo Xuehua went to see Li Yao, whose pregnancy was getting bigger.

Yun Aoxian and Li Yao were shocked by their parents' sudden decision, and they wanted to reject it because they felt they were not fully ready to lead the Yun Kingdom, but Yun Shang and Guo Xuehua continued to persuade and convince them.

Yun Shang and Guo Xuehua told Yun Aoxian and Li Yao that they would not completely retire, and they would continue to help them from behind. They also told them that Bai Chongxi would ascend the throne and become the emperor of the Bai Kingdom in two weeks, and he was clearly less experienced than them.

After a long and tough discussion, Yun Aoxian and Li Yao finally agreed with their parents' decision. Thereafter, Yun Shang immediately summoned his trusted people to discuss the matter with them, and Guo Xuehua returned to the room to contact Shi Qingzhuang.

Li Yao then went to her husband. "Why did they make such a sudden decision, husband? I know that we will replace them sooner or later, but I think their decision is too early. Moreover, I am still in the early stages of pregnancy now, and I have to focus on my pregnancy, so I won't be able to help you much in the kingdom's affairs after we ascend the throne."

"I think they decided this matter because of Bai Chongxi and Zhou Shenxin." Yun Aoxian responded by letting out a soft sigh. "Compared to them, we are more experienced in managing royal affairs, so our parents deliberately wanted to push us to the throne. If Xian Qifeng also ascends the throne and leads the Xian Kingdom and Zhang Fei pushes Huangfu Lian to replace Huangfu Shou as the emperor of the Huangfu Kingdom, then the five kingdoms will be led by young leaders."

"Well, that's true." Li Yao gave a light nod. "The Yu, Xian, Zhou, and Bai Kingdoms have good relations now, and Zhang Fei already controls the Huangfu Kingdom, so the situation on this island should be safe now. Moreover, he also became a bridge for us to establish good relations with the Beast and Natural Race Kingdoms, so only the two demon kingdoms are left."

"Zhang Fei has already made plans for the two demon kingdoms, but I don't know when he will make his move against them. Once the two demon kingdoms fall into his hands, then this realm will be truly safe. Fortunately, he is not crazy about power, and he is not interested in becoming the sole ruler, so we don't have to worry about anything." Yun Aoxian then touched his wife's belly. "After we ascend the throne, you don't need to think too much about the affairs of the kingdom, and you can focus on your pregnancy until our child is born."

Li Yao smiled at that. "Honestly, I'm still not ready to be a mother, but our parents have long desired a grandchild, so I have no other choice. By the way, you have to join our father, and you must convince his subordinates to accept you as their emperor."
"All right."
In the Xian Imperial Sect, Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang were sitting with three other people. They were Xian Luo, Xian Qifeng, and Luo Qinglin.

Xian Qifeng and Luo Qinglin fell into a daze after Xian Feng explained to them his purpose for calling them, especially since he suddenly wanted them to ascend the throne to replace him and Shi Qingzhuang.
"Why did you suddenly decide on something like this, Brother?" Xian Luo posed the question in a serious tone.

"I know you have never been interested in becoming an emperor, so I chose your son to replace you." Xian Feng then explained. "The Zhou Kingdom already has Zhou Shenxin as its empress, and Bai Yaowei will soon abdicate, with Bai Chongxi taking his place. In addition, Brother Yun just contacted me, and he has already decided for Yun Aoxian to ascend the throne in a month."
They were not surprised by Zhou Shenxin's status as the empress of the Zhou Kingdom, but they were surprised by Bai Yaowei and Yun Shang's decision to pass on their throne to their two sons.

Xian Feng then spoke again. "The Huangfu Kingdom is already under Zhang Fei's control, and Huangfu Lian will soon become the emperor of the Huangfu Kingdom. Therefore, Qingzhuang and I have decided to abdicate and focus on our cultivation. We want to pass the leadership to the younger generation. Unfortunately, Xianwu is too inexperienced, and he never had the ambition to become emperor."

"Back then, we thought to appoint our daughter to replace us, and she would become the first female ruler of our kingdom. Unfortunately, her situation changed, and she has already become Zhang Fei's wife." Xian Luo and the others actually didn't mind if Xian Xianqin ascended the throne, but her situation was different. "That kid is not interested in becoming an emperor because he doesn't like dealing with such matters, and he prefers to live unfettered. As his wife, it is impossible for our daughter to ascend the throne to replace us, so we want Xian Qifeng and Luo Qinglin to replace us."

"As I recall, Zhou Shenxin is also going to marry Zhang Fei, right?" Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang nodded to Xian Qifeng. "Since he allowed her to become the empress of the Zhou Kingdom, he should have no problem with my cousin becoming the empress of our kingdom, right?"

"You're not wrong with that." Shi Qingzhuang replied with a nod. "However, Zhenxin won't be the empress for long, especially since Zhang Fei has started preparing for their new life in the upper realms. Once everything is ready, he will take everyone by his side there, and she will hand over her throne to someone else at that time. If I'm not mistaken, Zhou Tong will be their first choice, but he will only be a puppet emperor because he is their slave."
Xian Qifeng nodded in understanding. "If that is the case, the Huangfu and Zhou Kingdoms are purely Zhang Fei's, and he will control both kingdoms from behind the scenes."
"That's right."

Xian Feng then spoke to him. "Qingfei, your experience and intelligence are not inferior to Yun Aoxian, and I believe you can lead this kingdom well. Moreover, Qinglin is a tactician with keen observation, and she always has many useful ideas. If the two of you lead our kingdom, I believe the future of our kingdom will be much better under your leadership. Therefore, I hope that the two of you will not reject our decision, and we will start preparing for the transfer of our authority to the two of you."
"Uncle and Aunt, can you tell us about your plans after abdicating? I'm sure you two won't live in isolation, right?" Luo Qinglin asked them.
"Haha." Xian Feng laughed before explaining. "Aside from focusing on our cultivation, we also want to challenge the Star Tower again, and we might spend many years there.
"As expected." Luo Qinglin said it with a light nod. "Does that mean you all will join Zhang Fei?"

Xiang Feng nodded at her. "Zhang Fei's cultivation will break through to the Heaven Realm in three to four months, and he will bring them all there, so we will join them. However, we can't rely on him, so we want to prepare ourselves for the next few months."
"Apart from that, we have the intention to go to the upper realms because your grandparents are still alive there, and we want to meet them to see their true situation." Shi Qingzhuang added.

Xian Luo, Xian Qifeng, and Luo Qinglin naturally also have dreams of going to the upper realms. However, they were different from Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang, and they did not have a close relationship with Zhang Fei, so they could only rely on their abilities to get there.

"I agree with your wishes." Xian Qifeng turned to Luo Qinglin in surprise. "Uncle Feng and Aunt Qingzhuang have led our kingdom for hundreds of years, and they have developed this kingdom into one of the best, so I think it's time for them to enjoy their private lives. Moreover, I'm confident in our abilities, and we will continue the results of their hard work over the years."
"All right." Xian Qifeng said to his aunt and uncle, "You can start preparing everything; Qingling and I will also prepare ourselves to shoulder our next responsibilities."
Their decision relieved Xian Feng and Shi Qingzhuang, and they left the Xian Imperial Sect afterward.

"Are you two sure you are ready to become the emperor and the empress of our kingdom?" Xian Qifeng and Luo Qinglin answered their father with firm nods. "Since you two have decided, you both must be ready to bear all the risks. Although the situation in this realm has become much calmer and more conducive, it might change again after Zhang Fei takes them to the upper realms. Therefore, as soon as you ascend the throne, you two must solidify your leadership to prepare for any sudden changes. I will support you from a distance."
"Thank you, Father."

After he tried for almost a whole day and failed to master the lightning elemental law, Zhang Fei decided to bring his fifth clone to the lightning pond to protect his three women who were cultivating in the pond, especially since the number of wandering souls in the Nine Hells Realm had decreased considerably.

Zhang Fei then returned to the Red Sun Realm and checked the situation in the Shang Clan. He discovered that the clan had deactivated the barrier, particularly with the return of Shang Huaqiang and Fei Qinyuan.

Zhang Fei found Shang Huaqiang holed up in his room, checking his lower body repeatedly and cursing nonstop. However, he did not expect that Fei Qinyuan would join Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian, and the three of them would engage in heated activities.
Zhang Fei decided to contact Xi Yinying, who immediately agreed to meet him a little away from the city.
In a few minutes, they were standing face-to-face, but Zhang Fei immediately noticed Xi Yinying's awkwardness and anxiety. "Did Xi Hongyan order you to seduce me?"
"Eh?" Xi Yinying looked at him with repeated blinks.

"I have dozens of women by my side, so I am well-experienced in women's matters. Moreover, you are too innocent, and you can't hide your awkwardness and anxiety." Xi Yinying let out a soft sigh and nodded at Zhang Fei. "Did Xi Hongyan threaten you to seduce me?"
Xi Yinying immediately told Zhang Fei the truth, especially Xi Hongyan's threats to her and her family. "Can you pretend to be in a relationship with me?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei pinched Xi Yinying's nose. "I don't like fake relationships, and you shouldn't force yourself to obey Xi Hongyan's orders either."
"But—"
"I will go to the Xi Clan to talk to Xi Hongyan, and I will make sure that she will never dare to threaten you again." Zhang Fei immediately disappeared from that place.
Xi Yinying was confused and frightened by Zhang Fei's departure; she was afraid that Xi Hongyan would really kill her and her family if she met her.

"What should I do now? If I abandon my duties, my matriarch will punish me severely." In the end, Xi Yinying decided to return to the Shang Clan, but her feelings were filled with anxiety, waiting for the outcome of Zhang Fei and Xi Hongyan's conversation. "I hope he can convince my matriarch not to force me to do that."

A while later, Zhang Fei had arrived at the Xi Clan and showed Hun Di's badge to the guard, who immediately led him to the main hall. Through the system's map, he found that Xi Hongyan was in her room, but her name was red on the map, indicating that she was hostile to him. 'Haha! She must have become hostile to me after hearing Xi Yinying's report about my actions at the Shang Clan yesterday, and she thinks that I did that because I wanted to help the Hong Clan.'
Before long, Xi Hongyan arrived at the main hall while still looking at him coldly, but Zhang Fei responded with a smile. "Why did you come here?"

"I want you to stop threatening Xi Yinying." Xi Hongyan frowned at Zhang Fei. "I'm much younger than you, but I'm much more experienced than you in matters of romance. I know you ordered that girl to seduce me, and I know you must have threatened her."
"Humph!" Xi Hongyan snorted in response. "Xi Yinying is my tool, and I can use her however I want. If she fails to do her task, I will kill her and replace her with another."

"Is that so?" Zhang Fei asked with narrowed eyes, causing Xi Hongyan to shiver at his killing intent. "I know I can't defeat you with my current strength, but I can still do something bad to you. However, I don't need to bother doing anything, especially since you will eventually die because of your arrogance."
*Boom*
Xi Hongyan's aura exploded as she rose from her seat. "Are you threatening me? Even if you are Hun Di's disciple, I will not hesitate to kill you because of your threat."

paragraphs: "Are you thinking about Zhang Fei, Xian'er?" Duan Zhao approached his female disciple, who was daydreaming on a large rock.
Xian Xian turned to him and nodded. "That kid always appears and disappears like a ghost, and I've been waiting for him to come back since morning, but he still hasn't shown up."
"Haha." Duan Zhao laughed at that. "The kiss you two had previously made an impression on your heart."

"Master! Don't tease me." Xian Xian complained with a pout. "I'm old, but I've never had a lover, and I've dedicated my entire life to blacksmithing. He was the first man to kiss me, so it's hard for me to forget that."

Duan Zhao gently patted her head, like a father to his daughter. "You know that Zhang Fei has dozens of women by his side, and he loves them dearly, so you should already understand the risks if you two end up becoming a couple. Thus, you must prepare yourself to accept the situation, or he will let you go."

"I know, Master." Xian Xian pulled her legs up, hugged them, and placed her chin between her knees. "Even though I have never had a lover, I am not an innocent woman either. The number of Zhang Fei's women is indeed numerous, but I don't think too much about that. However, I haven't thought about becoming his woman because I don't know him well yet, so our relationship is still too bland, and I still need time to solidify my feelings."

Duan Zhao nodded in response. "Zhang Fei is no ordinary cultivator, and he masters almost all fields, starting from blacksmithing, alchemy, and others. If he refrains from making hasty decisions, particularly when confronted with formidable adversaries, his future holds great promise. If his progress continues to increase as fast as it is now, he will become truly powerful in the future. Perhaps he will be able to stand at the top of the cultivation world one day, so he is the right man to be your husband."

"Master, you know that I didn't think that far, right?" Xian Xian looked up at the night sky. "Even if we become a couple in the future, Zhang Fei's success is not my success. The biggest dream in my life is to become the best blacksmith in the universe, and I've worked really hard for that. One day, I will prove to everyone that not only a man can succeed in that field, but a woman can also succeed in reaching the highest point in that field."

Duan Zhao smiled as he recalled this. "The first time you came to my workshop, I also had my doubts about you. You were only 19 years old at that time, and your body was too thin and fragile, so I didn't believe that you could become a blacksmith. However, I could see high determination in the look in your eyes, so I decided to accept you as my disciple. I made the right choice, and your hard work made you the best of the four."

"Haha." Xian Xian laughed with pride on her face. "Master, I might be the best among them now, but I can't stop working hard because Zhang Fei is chasing after us. If I relax now, he will definitely surpass me, and I don't want to lose to a newbie blacksmith like him. Therefore, I can't wait to go to the upper realms, and I will strive harder to improve my blacksmithing skills until I can achieve my dream of becoming the best blacksmith."

Duan Zhao nodded with a smile. "As long as you never lose your passion for improving yourself, I believe you will become the best blacksmith in the future. Go back to your room now and start cultivating, especially since you will accompany Zhang Fei to challenge the Star Tower in a few months."
"Don't you have any interest in challenging the tower again, Master?"

"Not for now." Duan Zhao replied with a shake of his head. "Like you, I have always harbored a dream of becoming the best blacksmith, and I have wasted too much of my time in this realm. As your master, I certainly do not wish to lose to you, and I will fully focus on my blacksmithing after we go to the upper realms."

Hearing that, Xian Xian jumped down from the rock and faced her master. "Master, you are far more skilled than me in blacksmithing now, but I will definitely defeat you in the future, and I will be the one to become the best blacksmith."

"Haha." Duan Zhao burst into laughter before pinching her nose. "All right, I will look forward to the day you surpass and defeat me in blacksmithing, and I will watch you chase your dream of becoming the best blacksmith after that."
Xian Xian nodded and ran away. "Good night, Master."

After Xian Xian left, Cheng Gaoji appeared by Duan Zhao's side. "You have raised a great disciple, Little Duan. Even though her skills in blacksmithing are still inferior to yours, she truly loves and focuses on that field, and both are the most important in achieving her dreams."

"You are right, Senior Cheng." Duan Zhao replied with a nod. "Xian'er loves blacksmithing more than anything else, and her dream of becoming the best blacksmith is ingrained in her soul. Compared to my other disciples, Xian'er has a great chance of becoming the best, and I will always support her to fulfill her dream."

Cheng Gaoji then looked into the house. "Gang Zhishou also has good talent in blacksmithing, but he lacks self-confidence, and he often doubts his abilities. If he can't change his mindset, he will face a dead end sooner or later."

"Shou'er's self-confidence used to be as high as Xian'er's, but his many failures caused his self-confidence to slowly fade, especially his failure in the tower. I have advised him many times, but he still finds it difficult to change his mindset." Duan Zhao let out a soft sigh as he looked into the distance, specifically towards the Star Tower. "The only way for him to regain his confidence is to pass the first floor of the tower, and Zhang Fei might be able to help him with that."

"That kid seems to like Gang Zhishou, and he obviously wants him in his group, so I'm sure he'll do whatever it takes to help him." Cheng Gaoji then looked at two different locations. "I still find it hard to believe that he has a good relationship with the Phoenix Princess, and he also has good relationships with many cultivators from the upper realms."

"Zhang Fei arrived in this realm about six and a half months ago, but his presence has already changed many things. The other four human kingdoms have united under his banner, and I'm sure he's already carrying out his plans for the Huangfu Kingdom. Eventually, that kingdom will fall into his hands, and he will become the sole ruler of this island despite his unwillingness." Duan Zhao then pointed to the location of the demon island. "He's already sent someone to monitor both demon kingdoms, but I don't understand why he still hasn't made a move against them."

Cheng Gaoji immediately spread his senses in that direction, and he found Xin Yanluo there. Additionally, he found three demons hiding in the Zheng Clan, and he guessed that Zhang Fei was holding back because of them. "There are three powerful demons in one of those kingdoms, but they are in hibernation right now. I have met many demons in the past, but I have never seen demons like them."

"Oh?" Duan Zhao immediately thought of that. "Zhang Fei got information about those three demons, and they were the ancestors of the Zheng Clan. He deliberately sent Xian Yanluo to monitor them, but the female demon still couldn't find them. Since you were able to find them, I will tell him about this matter so he can immediately take care of them."

Cheng Gaoji nodded at him. "Tell that kid that the three demons are hiding deep beneath that clan, and their location is covered by a powerful formation. If he wants to make a move against them, I can help him to destroy that formation."
"All right."

They might be able to summon a powerful demon with their combined technique, but it won't be stronger than Aunt Xinxin or Cheng Gaoji. We have artifacts to protect us from the demon aura on the island, so it won't affect us, and I'm sure we can handle them easily."

Zhang Fei immediately carried Shang Yumei out of bed and dressed her. "Let's go; we'll pick up Cheng Gaoji before going to the demon island, and we'll destroy the Zheng Clan tonight. After they disappear, I will take over the Dark Demon Kingdom, and Ximen Yan will be my puppet emperor."

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded at her. "Back then, I didn't have the strength to fight those three old demons, but the three of them are by my side now, and they can help me destroy them. Moreover, my business on the human island is almost finished, so I will start my plans for these demons."
Xin Yanluo was naturally aware of the strength of Hong Xinxin and Cheng Gaoji, and he was sure that they could eliminate the three old demons without any effort.
Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows while looking to the side, especially since Mai Xiaomeng suddenly appeared there. "Why don't you invite me to have fun?"
"Hehe." Hong Xinxin chuckled seeing Mai Xiaomeng pouting. "This was a sudden decision, so we didn't contact you."
"Humph." Mai Xiaomeng snorted softly. "Which kingdom are you targeting first?"

"That one." Zhang Fei pointed toward the Dark Demon Kingdom. "I have no intention of destroying that kingdom, and I want to take over it instead. However, I can't do it right away, and we have to destroy the three demons protecting that kingdom first."
"Oh." Mai Xiaomeng nodded in understanding. "Shall we start now?"
