If you want to absorb them, you must capture them first and absorb them after your cultivation is completely stable.]
Zhang Fei gave a light nod before telling them about his change in plans, causing all of them to frown. "Do you really want to absorb them?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei replied with a firm nod. "I can't wait to reach the Heaven Realm, and absorbing them is the quickest solution. I won't do it now, and I will wait for my cultivation to stabilize in a few days."

Hong Xinxin let out a soft sigh before speaking to him. "I understand your wishes to reach that stage as soon as possible, but you have taken too many shortcuts, and I am afraid that you will become addicted to taking shortcuts."

"You should listen to her, kid." Cheng Gaoji joined in persuading him. "I've been in your shoes, and I've taken many shortcuts to increase my strength. As a result, I became addicted to taking shortcuts, and it almost ruined my life. Fortunately, my good friends helped me realize my mistakes, saving me from ruin. The demon they summoned should have no cultivation, so it doesn't matter if you absorb it, but you should abandon your intention to absorb the three old demons."
"Things done hastily will never end well, so you should think it over carefully." Mai Xiaomeng also spoke.
Zhang Fei looked at them for a while before nodding. "All right, I won't absorb the three old demons, and I will only absorb the demon summoned by them."
Hearing that, Hong Xinxin and the others sighed with relief as they swiftly soared above the Zheng Clan.

Why did they suddenly appear in this realm and attack us?'
"Husband, this black demon has no cultivation, but it should be rich in demon essence, so you can absorb it now." Shang Yumei spoke.
Zhang Fei nodded and floated in front of the black demon. He touched its body before using his demon-absorbing and devouring abilities at the same time, quickly absorbing the demon's demon essence.
*Roar*

The black demon could only roar in pain because of Zhang Fei's action, and its body gradually faded, especially since he absorbed its demon essence too quickly. Witnessing that, the three ancestors of the Zheng Clan were horrified, thinking that he would do the same to them.

'Fuck!' Zhang Fei immediately cursed. 'Why have I never thought of doing that before?'

paragraphs: "Xinxin, cripple those old demons." Hong Xinxin and the others were confused by that, but Zhang Fei told them right away. "Their demon essence has nothing to do with their cultivation."
Hong Xinxin immediately crippled the cultivation of the Zheng Clan's three ancestors, plunging them into a deep state of despair. "Done."
"Thank you." Zhang Fei gave a faint smirk as he looked at the three.

[Master, the demons from the Dark Demon Kingdom are starting to move towards this location.] As soon as Mei warned him, Zhang Fei turned to the others, and they immediately moved to stop the demons, forcing them to retreat.

Zhang Fei suddenly sensed a gaze directed at him from a distance, and the map showed that its owner was Ximen Gui, the demon of the Ximen Kingdom who was assigned by Ximen Changtian to protect his kingdom.
An hour later, the black demon had disappeared after Zhang Fei absorbed all its demon essence.
[You gained 25,000,000 demon essences.]

Zhang Fei sighed in disappointment, especially since the amount of demon essence he obtained was too small compared to his previous estimation. 'How much more essence do I need to reach the archduke rank, Mei?'
[Less than one hundred million, Master.]
The three ancestors of the Zheng Clan trembled as soon as Zhang Fei looked at them with a vicious smile on his face, but their eyes widened as soon as he transformed into his lust demon lord form.

Cheng Gaoji was also shocked by Zhang Fei's demon identity; he then turned to Hong Xinxin and Shang Yumei. The two women simply nodded at him, assuring him that they already knew about his identity. 'This kid is truly abnormal! How could he have three different identities? No wonder Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing wanted to capture him, especially since the demon heavenly fox was a disgrace to their race.'

Unfortunately, Cheng Gaoji misunderstood that, and the two ancestors of the heavenly fox wanted to capture Zhang Fei not because of his demon identity but because he was the main candidate to become the successor of the ten-tailed fox, which would threaten their existence.
Zhang Fei immediately tied three of his six tails to the three ancestors of the Zheng Clan, and he wasted no time in absorbing their demon essences.

Unlike the black demon, the three ancestors of the Zheng Clan were much weaker, and Zhang Fei did not need too much time to drain their demon essences dry. Even so, their total amount of demon essence exceeded that of the demon they summoned.
[You gained 30,000,000 demon essences.]
[Master, another 66 million demon essence, and your demon rank will rise to the archduke rank.]
'66 million, huh?' Zhang Fei then opened the gate to the Netherworld Realm. "Yanluo, we can handle these demons ourselves, so you can return to Ju Yingzhi's side now."
Given that she had been apart from Ju Yingzhi for four months, Xin Yanluo simply nodded and went straight through the gate.
"Hey, kid. How can you be a demon?" Cheng Gaoji asked once Zhang Fei returned to his human form.

"Old Cheng, I have three identities because of a mysterious little girl." Zhang Fei told Cheng Gaoji the general outline. "At first, I thought she lived in the Xianjin Realm, but I thought my guess was wrong, and she should live in the Paradise Realm."
"The paradise realm?"
"Yeah." Zhang Fei pointed to the location of the Star Tower. "The Paradise Realm is beyond the upper realms, but we can only reach it by climbing the tower."

"The realm beyond the upper realms does exist, huh?" Cheng Gaoji murmured as he gazed in that direction. "Old Xia once told us about his theory regarding that realm, but we thought he was talking nonsense. We once tried to go to the edge of this universe, but we were blocked by an invisible wall. The nameless one once tried to bypass it by using his void element, but he didn't manage to do it, so we thought that realm didn't exist. Unlike us, he kept trying to prove his guess for thousands of years, but we never heard of him succeeding."

"The invisible wall blocking you all is the void wall that protects this universe, and only cultivators with a profound understanding of the void element can pass through it." Cheng Gaoji and Mai Xiaomeng were confused by Zhang Fei's answer. "You can imagine the wall as a bottle, and this universe is inside it. There is only void outside the bottle, and this universe will disappear if it is destroyed. The nameless one has the void element, but his understanding isn't deep enough to bypass it. Furthermore, ten mythical ancient beasts guard the place behind the wall."
"Ten mythical ancient beasts?"

"Yeah." Zhang Fei nodded at them. "I don't know anything about those beasts yet, but I got information about them from someone from the Paradise Realm, and I met him at the Star Tower. Anyways, let's talk about this matter later, and we will take over the Dark Demon Kingdom first."

When they arrived at the kingdom, Ximen Yan was already waiting for them in front of the royal palace along with two old demons. He immediately greeted Zhang Fei with great respect, especially since he was his slave.
Zhang Fei looked at the two old demons. "Who are they?"
"Master, they are my father's confidants, Ximen Qing and Ximen Hong. I have already given them the pills you gave me, and they are completely loyal to me now." Ximen Yan respectfully replied.
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding and led the others into the royal palace, followed by Ximen Yan and the two old demons.

On the way to the throne room, the demons of the kingdom kept watching Zhang Fei and the others with great fear, especially since the aura of some of them was more powerful than their emperor's and empress's.

Before long, they arrived at the throne room, and there were dozens of demons waiting for them inside. Zhang Fei casually stood in front of the throne and looked at them one by one, and he did not forget to check their strength. To his surprise, the demons were too weak compared to the Zheng Clan members, and only the two old demons had significant strength. 'Zheng Moyue deliberately limited their strength, huh? No wonder she and her clan held full control over this kingdom, and Ximen Gongfu was just their puppet.' "Ximen Yan, I want you to clear out the remaining demons from your mother's clan."
"Yes, Master." Ximen Yan turned to Ximen Qing and Ximen Hong, who immediately left the room to carry out Zhang Fei's orders. "What about the Ximen Kingdom, Master? Are you going to take over it?"
"Yeah." After he gave some other instructions to Ximen Yan, Zhang Fei led Cheng Gaoji and the two women to the Ximen Kingdom.
[Quest: Go to the eight kingdoms.]
[Quest rank: Easy]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Easy gift pack x 1 sent to the inventory.]

When they arrived, Ximen Gui was already waiting for them in front of the palace. Although his expression looked calm, he was tense in his heart because he had witnessed how Cheng Gaoji razed the Zheng Clan to the ground in just one attack.

Shang Yumei's lips curled upwards as she observed Ximen Gui's expression. 'This old demon was smart enough not to attack us, and he also stopped the other demons from this kingdom from approaching us.'

Hong Xinxin, Mai Xiaomeng, and Cheng Gaoji also thought the same as Shang Yumei. Moreover, Ximen Gui was no less powerful than the three ancestors of the Zheng Clan, so it would be a shame if he had to die at Zhang Fei's hands.

Zhang Fei walked to Ximen Gui's side and patted him on the shoulder. "I know you are a powerful demon, and I need someone like you by my side. Moreover, you have witnessed our actions before, so you should already know our strength, right?"
"What do you want from us?" Ximen Gui asked.

"This realm has been in chaos for hundreds of years, and I want to stop it all once and for all." Zhang Fei embraced Ximen Gui's shoulders and led him into the palace. "The five human kingdoms are under my banner now, and I also have favorable relations with the Beast and Natural Race Kingdoms. The Zheng Clan has been destroyed, and I use Ximen Yan to control the Dark Demon Kingdom, so only this kingdom is left."
Ximen Gui was inwardly shocked as he listened to Zhang Fei. "Are you also going to destroy this kingdom?"

"Everything depends on Ximen Changtian and Nu Huangjin." Ximen Gui raised his eyebrows as he turned to Zhang Fei. "If they are willing to submit to me and stop causing chaos in this realm, I will not take over this kingdom, and they can continue to lead this kingdom under my banner."
Ximen Gui felt a little relieved hearing that. "Unfortunately, the two of them are in the Star Tower right now, and I don't know when they will return."
"I know." Zhang Fei then looked at the two men walking towards them, but one of them frowned. "If you don't want to die, you better not think about doing anything stupid, Ximen Hongwu."
"You—"
"Stop it, Big Brother." Ximen Yueliang stopped her brother. "Even Grandpa Gui doesn't dare fight them, so you'll only die in vain if you fight them."
"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled. "How do you feel after swallowing my pills and Yang Qi for the last four months, Princess? Are you satisfied with the results?"
Ximen Hongwu turned to his little sister with a shocked look. He did not expect that Ximen Yueliang had such a relationship with Zhang Fei, and he was even willing to swallow his Yang Qi.

"Our relationship is not what you think, Big Brother." Ximen Yueliang then told Ximen Hongwu about Zhang Fei's actions toward her and Ximen Yan in the survival challenge. "I managed to survive our cousin because of him, and I immediately gave up the challenge after that. However, he planted something in my soul, so I couldn't fight him."

"Bastard!" Ximen Hongwu dashed toward Zhang Fei, but the demon extermination sword suddenly appeared and flew towards him. The sword instantly pierced through his right chest, forced him backward, and nailed him to the wall. "Argh!"
Ximen Gui wanted to move, but Hong Xinxin immediately restricted his movements, immobilizing him.
Zhang Fei quickly moved in front of Ximen Hongwu and sealed his cultivation. He then grabbed the hilt of his sword and pressed it deeper. "Argh!"
Ximen Yueliang panicked upon seeing that and immediately begged him. "Zhang Fei! Please! Don't kill my big brother!"
Zhang Fei paid no attention to Ximen Yueling and coldly stared at Ximen Hongwu, who looked in so much pain. "I told you not to do anything stupid, right?"
"Please! Spare my big brother, Zhang Fei." Ximen Yueliang tried to beg again. "You can do anything to him, but don't kill him."
Zhang Fei immediately pressed his palm against Ximen Hongwu's chest and implanted his demon slave mark into his soul, but he left his memories intact.
"Argh!" Ximen Hongwu screamed in pain as soon as Zhang Fei pulled the demon extermination sword out of his shoulder, causing black blood to flow from his right shoulder.
Ximen Yueliang was relieved that Zhang Fei didn't kill Ximen Hongwu, but she realized that her big brother's fate was not much different from Ximen Yan, and he had become his slave. "Thank you."

'Bastard! I'll—' "Argh!" Ximen Hongwu fell to the ground and rolled around in pain as he had evil intentions toward Zhang Fei, which was the result of his demon slave mark in his soul. "Argh! Bastard! I will kill you! Argh!"
"Haha." Zhang Fei simply laughed at that and led the others to go to the throne room. Ximen Gui could only follow them resignedly, especially since Hong Xinxin still restricted his movements.

Ximen Yueliang felt pain seeing Ximen Hongwu in such a condition. "Big brother! Throw that thought out of your mind, or you will continue to be tormented like this! He has implanted his mark into your soul, so you will never be able to do anything to him. Furthermore, the four people by his side were much more powerful than our parents and Grandpa Gui, capable of destroying our kingdom with ease.

Even though he was still furious with Zhang Fei, Ximen Hongwu realized that his little sister's words were true. He quickly calmed himself down and cleared his mind, causing the pain in his body to swiftly subside. "Hah... Hah...."
"Phew." Ximen Yueliang immediately lifted her big brother to his feet. "I don't know what he has planned for us, but we should follow them now."
Zhang Fei was already sitting in the throne room as he looked at Ximen Gui, Ximen Yueliang, and Ximen Hongwu. Shang Yumei then asked him. "What are your plans now?"
Instead, Zhang Fei turned to Mai Xiaomeng. "I want you to go to the Star Tower now, and my clone will meet you there."
"Eh? What do you want to do?" Mai Xiaomeng asked in confusion.
Zhang Fei pointed at Ximen Yueliang and Ximen Hongwu. "I will ask the old man to expel their parents from the tower, so I want you to bring them here afterward."
"Oh! All right, I'll go there straight away."
"Haha." Hong Xinxin laughed after Mai Xiaomeng disappeared. "Are you going to continue ignoring her? She really wants to get close to you, and she's willing to do anything for you to do so."

"I don't want to think about her for now, and we'll see how it goes in the future." Zhang Fei then observed the entire area of the realm through the map. 'Sigh! I hope those foxes won't find me here too soon.'
Sometime later, Mai Xiaomeng had returned to the Ximen Demon Kingdom. She brought Ximen Changtian and Nu Huangjin, who were still in shock.

They were still fighting with the beasts in the Star Tower, but they were suddenly expelled from there. Before they could react, Mao Xiaomeng suddenly appeared in front of them and sealed their cultivation, and they were now in their kingdom.
"Father! Mother!" Ximen Yueliang shouted as she approached them. "Are you two okay?"
"Yueliang, what happened here?" Ximen Yueling shook her head at Nu Huanjing and pointed at Zhang Fei, causing her to frown.
Ximen Changtian also looked at Zhang Fei, who was casually sitting on his throne. "What do you want from us?"

"Submit to me or be destroyed." Zhang Fei's answer made Ximen Changtian and Nu Huanjing frown, but they then looked at Mai Xiaomeng and the others. "Zheng Clan has been destroyed, and the Dark Demon Kingdom is mine now. Ximen Gongfu and Zheng Moyue are still alive, but they will die soon. If you two do not want to suffer the same fate as them, you must think carefully about your choices."

Ximen Gui immediately spoke to Ximen Changtian. "Emperor, if they wanted to destroy us, they could have done it so long ago. I witnessed them destroy the Zheng Clan in a single blow, proving that we were no match for them."

"Grandpa Gui is right, Father." Ximen Yueliang joined in. "Zhang Fei has enslaved Ximen Yan for a long time, and he is helping him to control the Dark Demon Kingdom. Moreover, all the kingdoms in this realm, including the Beast and Natural Race Kingdoms, were also on his side."

"I see." Ximen Changtian nodded in understanding before speaking to Zhang Fei. "Since the beginning of your appearance in this realm, I have guessed that you are not ordinary cultivators, and the four of them are cultivators from the upper realm, right?"

"That's right." Zhang Fei nodded to him. "So what is your decision? As long as you submit to me, you and all the demons under you can live freely in this realm, and the other kingdoms will never bother you again. If you guys prove your loyalty to me, I will make you all stronger, and I will take you to the upper realms. However, I hate traitors the most, and I will eliminate all of you if you dare to betray me."
Ximen Changtian turned to Nu Huangjin, who nodded at him. "All right, we will submit to you."

Although they did not want it, Ximen Changtian and the other two were relieved after Zhang Fei told them that it was not a slave mark. Moreover, they were not soul cultivators, and they could not possibly refuse him with Cheng Gaoji and the three women by his side.

"At first, I thought about keeping both kingdoms in existence, but it would be troublesome for me." Ximen Changtian could immediately guess the direction of Zhang Fei's conversation. "Both kingdoms have the same ancestors, right? You guys split into two because of the influence of the Zheng Clan on Ximen Gongfu, so I wanted to unite the two. "What if we give up this challenge?

paragraphs: "Cough... Cough..." Huangfu Fanbo immediately wiped the blood from his mouth and stood up. "Those goddamn sandworms! What do they want from me? They've been chasing me for two whole months, but they keep toying with me until my supply is almost gone."

Huangfu Fanbo then turned his head to Zheng Moyue and the others, causing them to become tense and alert. The old man immediately moved in front of them and stretched out his hand. "Give me some healing pills, or I won't hesitate to slaughter demons like you."

Zheng Moyue handed him three healing pills without a second thought, which Huangfu Fanbo immediately swallowed. The old man directly used his qi to dissolve and spread their effects throughout his body, gradually healing his injuries.
"S... senior, who are you? How did you get trapped in this place?" Zheng Moyue stuttered.
"Are you guys demons from the Nine Stars Realm?" They nodded to Huangfu Fanbo. "Do you know the way out of this place?"

Xian Hong immediately told him. "You know, Senior, I was trapped here before, and we had to find some items in random places to leave. Unfortunately, this place is vast, and many sand beasts live here, so it's quite difficult to find them. Back then, I almost died at the hands of those beasts, and it took me a month or so to find them."

"I've been trapped here for two months or so, and I've killed so many sand beasts, but they keep appearing and attacking me." They were shocked to hear that Huangfu Fanbo could survive for so long facing those beasts. "Since you guys are here, you should help me look for those items. Otherwise, I will feed you to those sand beasts, and they will enjoy eating you alive."
Xian Hong and the others shivered at Huangfu Fanbo's threat, and they all immediately scattered to search for the items needed to leave the place.

Still in the Star Tower, Huangfu Shong and five people from the Huangfu Clan looked frustrated as they cleaned the wounds on their bodies. The old man stared at the room in front of them— specifically at the chimera beast that stood tall in the middle of the room.

They wanted to escape from the place, but the path behind them was blocked by a huge rock. No matter how hard they tried to destroy it, the rock did not budge an inch, let alone shatter. After all, they were strong cultivators from the upper realms, and the Star Tower was located in the middle realms, which shocked and confused them.
They initially thought they could kill the chimera beast easily, but instead they were played by it, and they suffered quite heavy injuries from its attack.

Huangfu Shong walked to the door of the room and stared at the chimera beast with a serious expression. "Where did this beast come from? I have fought with hundreds or even thousands of types of beasts, but I have never seen anything like this. This beast's body is so big, but it has extremely agile speed, and its recovery speed is also unheard of."
"What should we do now, Ancestor?" A middle-aged man asked. "If we can't defeat this beast, we'll never be able to go to the next room."
Huangfu Shong let out a soft sigh. "I also want to defeat this strange beast as soon as possible, but all our attacks are useless against it. If we attack it, it will continue to recover itself."

"Ancestor." Huangsu Shong turned to another middle-aged man. "I don't think we can attack this beast with normal means because it will keep regenerating, so I think we should combine all our strength to kill it in one attack."
Huangfu Shong nodded in agreement. "You guys can focus on recovering from your injuries first, and once you all recover, we will use our combined strength to defeat this beast."
"Yes, Ancestor."

In the Netherworld Realm, a flying artifact slowly entered the realm, and two young men stood at its front end. However, none of the realm's inhabitants noticed their presence, especially since the flying artifact was invisible. "Do you think the people from the Shang Clan are really in this realm, Brother Chaozu?"

"Our matriarch wouldn't have sent us here if the news wasn't true, Brother Baoxing." Xi Chaozu then tried to spread his senses and search for the whereabouts of Shang Chongyun and the others. "The four of them live in the northwest area near a demon city."
"Shall we move to capture them?"

Xi Chaozu shook his head. "We don't need to meet or attack them because our matriarch only ordered us to monitor them, mainly to find information about Shang Huaqiang's plans in this realm. Anyways, use your transformation technique to disguise yourself as a demon, and we'll go to that demon city to find out what happened in this realm a few months ago."
"Hmm?" Xi Baoxing raised his eyebrows. "Why would we do that?"

Xi Chaozu immediately explained. "According to information from our matriarch, Shang Huaqiang once sent Shang Xishun and several others to this realm, but his plan failed miserably. Therefore, he sent Shang Chongyun and the three of them here to restart his plans, but she didn't know his plan at that time, so he asked us to find out about it."
"I see." Xi Baoxing nodded in understanding.

Sometime later, the two men had arrived at Lust City, and they had neatly hidden their auras as cultivators. They seemed surprised to see the demons' lives in the city, and many tried to seduce them, but they ignored them.
'Brother, this city is a city of prostitution.'
Xi Chaozu nodded to him. 'We must find the important demons in this city, and we will force them to tell us about those past events.'
'Let's go there, brother! That inn is the largest in this city, and we can definitely find a lot of information there!' Xi Baoxing said as he pointed to the Lust Inn.

The two men immediately rushed to the inn, and they saw many demons gathered there. However, Xenaya, the sexy succubus, drew their attention. 'She is much sexier than all the women in our clan, including our matriarch.'
"Hmm?" Xenaya turned to the two men before approaching them. "Are you two new to town? What can I do for you two?"
"Can we talk in a private place, miss?" Xenaya's brows furrowed, forcing Xi Chaozu to explain. "I just want to ask for some information, including what happened a few months ago."
Xenaya thought for a moment before leading the two men into the back room. "What do you two want to know?"
"Who is the leader of this town? Where can we meet that person? Do you know about what happened back then?" Xi Chaozu asked without beating around the bush.

"The leader of this town is Elion, and he usually lives with Lady Orith and Lady Ilsath in the succubi tower. Unfortunately, they are not here right now, so you two cannot meet him." Xenaya then asked. "Do you want to ask about the incident regarding the human invaders?"
"Yes." Both men nodded.

"The humans invaded this realm hundreds of years ago, and they used the demons of this realm to invade other realms using a teleportation portal." Xenaya's answer surprised Xi Chaozu and Xi Baoxing, as they did not expect that Shang Huaqiang had started his plan hundreds of years ago, but no one in their realm knew about it. "Their first invasion almost succeeded, but the humans in that realm thwarted their plan by sealing the portal. Nine months ago, they managed to break the seal and wanted to invade the realm again, but Elion and a fire phoenix thwarted their plan once again, and the two destroyed the portal. Since then, the situation in this realm has become safe, but four other humans came here four and a half months ago."

'A phoenix?' As cultivators from the upper realms, Xi Chaozu and Xi Baoxing naturally knew about the Phoenix race, but they were confused about the reason one of them helped the demons from the middle realms. "Who exactly is Elion? How can he stop those humans? Haven't those four humans done anything since they arrived here?"

Xenaya immediately explained. "Elion is no ordinary lust demon, and he is the lust demon lord. He is powerful, and his power exceeds all demon kings or queens; even Queen Zilvora submits to him. I heard that he beat one of the four newcomer humans, and they couldn't do anything to fight him."

"What do you mean by the lust demon lord?" Xenaya then told Xi Chaozu and Xi Baoxing that all demons can evolve, but each demon's evolution is different. "Does that mean the four of them are Elion's prisoners?"
Xenaya shook her head. "I don't know for sure about that because Elion is still busy with his own business, and he hasn't seen me again for the last few months."
"Thank you for your information, miss." Xi Chaozu immediately pulled Xi Baoxing out of the room.

On the other hand, Xenaya wonders about the identities of the two men because all the demons in the realm already knew about the incident nine months ago, and they should also know about the evolution of demons. 'Hmm? I should go see Ju Yingzhi right now, and she should be able to help me contact Elion.'

Xenaya then rushed to the succubi tower, but she didn't realize that Xi Chaozu and Xi Baoxing were monitoring her using their senses from a distance. The two men were surprised to find Ju Yingzhi and Xin Yanluo at the top of the tower because the two women were demon cultivators, and their cultivation was quite high.

Ju Yingzhi and Xin Yanluo immediately noticed Xi Chaozu and Xi Baoxing's senses eavesdropping on them, but they did nothing because the two men were stronger than them, and both spoke to Xenaya via voice transmission before contacting Zhang Fei.
"Who do you think those two women are, Brother? Why are such powerful demon cultivators hiding in a realm without Qi like this?"

Xi Chaozu shook his head at his brother. "I don't understand why those two female demons chose to hide in this realm, but I'm sure that they were demon cultivators from the upper realm, and one of them was terribly injured. Rather than them, I'm more curious about Elion's identity because he has ties to the phoenix race, and they worked together to stop Shang Huaqiang, which has never happened in the past."

"You're right." Xi Baoxing replied with a nod of approval. "As far as I remember, the phoenix race doesn't like demons, but one of them teamed up with a demon to help these demons, so I believe there's something fishy about Elion."

Xi Chaozu immediately took out an interspatial communication device and conveyed all the information they got to Xi Hongyan. Before long, she returned the message and gave them some instructions. "Our matriarch ordered us to investigate the identities of the two female demons and Elion, and she ordered us to infiltrate the succubi tower."
"The two female demons seem to have noticed our presence, so we should go first and change our disguises, and we will infiltrate there later." Xi Baoxing spoke.
Xi Chaozu and Xi Baoxing hurriedly left Lust City to avoid Ju Yingzhi's and Xin Yanluo's detection, but they did not immediately return to the city, and they chose to wait outside for some time.
After he heard the message from Ju Yingzhi and Xin Yanluo, Zhang Fei [5] immediately went to Tian Gongzhu's location. "Oh? You've been enjoying your time as a demon fox, huh?"
'Tch!' Tian Gongzhu gritted her teeth. "What do you want from me?"

"I don't care how you're going to do it, but I want you to lure Tian Jiyuan to come to you." Tian Gongzhu frowned at Zhang Fei [5], but he immediately opened the gate and took her away to the Netherworld Realm. "Quick! Contact that guy so I can make calculations with him."
Tian Gongzhu extended her hand to Zhang Fei [5]. "Give me back my storage ring."

Instead, Zhang Fei [5] gave Tian Gongzhu an interspatial communication device, which she used to contact Tian Jiyuan. However, she didn't send a clear message because her brother would suspect her, and she deliberately made her message sound forced. "I don't know if my message will be successful in luring him to come to this realm, so we can only wait for him to contact me back."

"That's good." Zhang Fei [5] then opened the map and searched for the whereabouts of the two men mentioned by Ju Yingzhi and Xin Yanluo in their messages. It didn't take him long to find them, but he frowned after learning their identities. 'Oh? Those two men must be Xi Hongyan's subordinates, but why did she send them to this realm? Did she deliberately send them to monitor Shang Chongyun and the others?'
"Hey! What are we going to do in this realm?"

Zhang Fei [5] did not answer Tian Gongzhu's question, and he immediately took the female demon heavenly fox to the succubi tower. He then took her to Ju Yingzhi and Xin Yanluo's room, causing her to become restless after she realized that the two female demons were powerful demon cultivators. 'Shit! These two are much stronger than Brother Jiyuan and the others.'
"Big problems never stop coming your way." Ju Yingzhi said to Zhang Fei [5].
Zhang Fei [5] smiled bitterly at that. "I never wanted to find trouble with anyone, but they always found trouble with me. How is your condition?"

"Thanks to your superior-grade healing pills, my injury has recovered thirty percent in the past four months, and I am confident that I can fully recover in the following months." Zhang Fei [5] then gave Ju Yingzhi a few batches of healing pills, which she gladly accepted. "What are your plans for those two demons?"

"They're not demons." Zhang Fei [5]'s answer confused Ju Yingzhi and Xin Yanluo. "They are human cultivators from the upper realms, and I think they came here specifically to monitor the other four, so I will meet them now."
Xin Yanluo immediately asked. "Are you sure you can face them by yourself? The cultivation of those two people is above my master's cultivation."

"Are you worried about me now?" Xin Yanluo snorted and turned his head away. "Their cultivation is at the Divine Fusion Realm, but I am confident in facing them. Furthermore, I know their leader, so I am sure there will be no major problems between us."
"Up to you, then."
"You wait here, and I will meet them."
"Wait—" Tian Gongzhu sighed heavily because Zhang Fei [5] disappeared so quickly; she then turned to the two female demons, who were staring at her sharply. "What do you two want from me?"
"You are a heavenly fox, right?" Ju Yingzhi asked.
Tian Gongzhu nodded. "I was a heavenly fox, but that bastard turned me into a demon fox."
"Hehe." Ju Yingzhi chuckled. "What would happen if the members of your race found out that you are a demon fox now?"
"Tch!" Tian Gongzhu gritted his teeth and hurriedly left their room.
"Master, that female fox will not be able to return to her realm again, or her ancestors will kill them."
"You're right." Ju Yingzhi then sat cross-legged on the bed. "Yanluo, I will swallow this healing pill now, but I need you to help me with your Qi."
Xin Yanluo immediately sat behind Ju Yingzhi, pressed her palms against her back, and channeled her Qi into her body. "You can swallow it now, Master."
"All right."

Xi Chaozu and Xi Baoxing, who were still waiting outside the city disguised as demons, were surprised by the appearance of Zhang Fei [5]. However, they relaxed after they detected his cultivation. "Let me guess; you must be Elion, right?"
"That's right." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at Xi Chaozu. "Did Xi Hongyan send you two to this realm to watch over Shang Chongyun and the others?"

"Up to you, then."
"You wait here, and I will meet them."
"Wait—" Tian Gongzhu sighed heavily because Zhang Fei [5] disappeared so quickly; she then turned to the two female demons, who were staring at her sharply.
"What do you two want from me?"
"You are a heavenly fox, right?" Ju Yingzhi asked.
Tian Gongzhu nodded.
"I was a heavenly fox, but that bastard turned me into a demon fox."
"Hehe." Ju Yingzhi chuckled.
"What would happen if the members of your race found out that you are a demon fox now?"
"Tch!" Tian Gongzhu gritted his teeth and hurriedly left their room.
"Master, that female fox will not be able to return to her realm again, or her ancestors will kill them."
"You're right." Ju Yingzhi then sat cross-legged on the bed.
"Yanluo, I will swallow this healing pill now, but I need you to help me with your Qi."
Xin Yanluo immediately sat behind Ju Yingzhi, pressed her palms against her back, and channeled her Qi into her body.
"You can swallow it now, Master."
"All right."
Xi Chaozu and Xi Baoxing, who were still waiting outside the city disguised as demons, were surprised by the appearance of Zhang Fei [5].
However, they relaxed after they detected his cultivation.
"Let me guess; you must be Elion, right?"
"That's right." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at Xi Chaozu.
"Did Xi Hongyan send you two to this realm to watch over Shang Chongyun and the others?"

chapters.title: Chapter 790: Let The Two Go
paragraphs: Both men became serious as soon as Zhang Fei [5] mentioned Xi Hongyan's name. "How do you know our matriarch?"

"Naturally, I know Xi Hongyan because we have met several times, and I saved her life yesterday." Xi Chaozu and Xi Baoxing naturally did not believe Zhang Fei [5] because their matriarch was much stronger and more experienced than a young cultivator like him. "Haha! If you two don't believe me, you can ask him directly about me, Lin Xiaolong."
'Lin surname? Is he really a member of that Lin Clan?' Both men inwardly wondered.

Xi Chaozu immediately sent a long-distance message to Xi Hongyan to confirm it. However, her reply confused him, as she was angry while confirming that she was acquainted with Zhang Fei [5] or Lin Xiaolong.
'How did it go, Brother? Does our matriarch really know this kid?' Xi Baoxing inquired, glancing briefly at Zhang Fei [5].

Xi Chaozu nodded. 'Our matriarch is acquainted with this kid, and he has saved her life. She forbade us from looking for trouble with him because he is a member of that Lin Clan, and he is also the Soul Emperor's newest disciple. Moreover, you have heard from the female demon before that she has relations with the phoenix race, and they are working together to stop Shang Huaqiang.'
'What?' Xi Baoxing screamed in shock. 'Is he really the Soul Emperor's newest disciple?'
"Hehe." Zhang Fei [5] chuckled at their expression. "Do you still doubt me?"

Both men took a deep breath before cupping their hands toward Zhang Fei [5]. "Please forgive us for doubting you, Young Master Lin. We truly did not know that you were a member of the Lin Clan and also the Soul Emperor's newest disciple."
"All right, you two don't need to think about it." Zhang Fei [5] casually answered. "Did Xi Hongyan send you two to monitor Shang Chongyun and the others?"

Xi Chaozu nodded. "Our matriarch received information about Shang Huaqiang's actions in this realm nine months ago, and she also learned that she sent those four people here to restart his plan. Therefore, she sent the two of us here to keep an eye on them, especially since she wanted to know his true plan. However, we did not expect that you stopped him at that time, and you also beat up one of those four people."

"Feng Yao and I thwarted Shang Huaqiang's plan nine months ago." Both men were once again shocked after hearing the name of the Phoenix Princess from Zhang Fei [5]. "This realm is under our protection now, so I will never allow anyone to mess around here. That guy sent the four of them to this realm, but I snatched their teleportation portal, so his new plan has already failed."
"Can you tell us about the realm targeted by Shang Huaqiang, Young Master Lin?"

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "Shang Huaqiang has already taken control of some of them, but I have no information about those realms or his purpose for controlling them, and I suspect that he wants to use them to do something bigger."
"Something bigger?"
"Cultivators from the lower and middle realms won't be able to win against cultivators from the upper realms, but they are at least as useful as cannon fodder, right?"

"You are right, Young Master Lin." Xi Chaozu replied with a nod. "Shang Huaqiang has always had the ambition to become the sole ruler of the Red Sun Realm, and that guy is truly evil. He will not hesitate to use his clansmen as scapegoats, let alone people who have nothing to do with him."

"Aren't all clans the same? They won't hesitate to sacrifice some people for their sake, and Xi Hongyan is among them." Xi Chaozu and Xi Baoxing could only smile in response to Zhang Fei [5]. "Your matriarch wanted to sacrifice Xi Yinying to get close to me, but I saw through her schemes, so I exchanged her life for hers."

Xi Chaozu and Xi Baoxing naturally knew Xi Yinying because they were in the same clan, and they also knew that she was one of Xi Hongyan's trusted confidants. However, they did not expect that their matriarch wanted to sacrifice her, but they thought that it was not wrong because Zhang Fei [5]'s status was too high.

"Do you two still want to stay in this realm?" Zhang Fei [5] asked them. "Shang Huaqiang's plan has failed once again, and his four subordinates are my prisoners now, so you don't need to waste your time monitoring them."

Xi Chaozu and Xi Baoxing exchanged glances for a moment. "Since there is nothing else we can do in this realm, we will return to ours now. Moreover, our matriarch already knows of your presence in this realm, so I don't think she will blame us."

Zhang Fei [5] then opened the gate to the Red Sun Realm. "You guys will arrive at the Hong Clan right away, and you can tell them that I sent you there so they won't stop you two from returning to the Xi Clan. If Xi Hongyan asks how you guys got back there so quickly, you can tell her that a woman helped me send you two back."
"We understand, Young Master Lin." Both men immediately entered the gate and returned to their clan using the returning jade.
[Why did you let them go, Master?]

Zhang Fei [5] closed the gate before answering the female AI. "Shouldn't you already know my character, Mei? Just like Xi Yinying, I can see their souls, and they are not bad people, so I decided to let them go."
[Master, your demon eyes are indeed one of your best advantages, especially since you can recognize other people's characters from their souls easily.]

Zhang Fei [5] gave a light nod. "However, my demon eyes are not yet perfect, and I cannot see that Huo Ling resides in Feng Yao's soul. I hope my demon eyes' ability will be upgraded when I evolve to a transcendent lust demon."

[Unfortunately, I can't confirm the changes to your demon abilities right now, so we have to wait for you to evolve to a transcendent lust demon first. Therefore, you must eat Ju Yingzhi and Xin Yanluo as soon as possible because their female essence is much stronger than all the female demons by your side, and you can also eat Tian Gongzhu, Qin Ying, and Ximen Yueliang.]

Zhang Fei [5] did not say anything in reply to Mei, and he went straight back to the succubi tower to meet Tian Gongzhu. The female demon heavenly fox told him that Tian Jiyuan had not replied to her message, so he took her back to the Nine Hells Darkland because the wandering souls had not completely disappeared.

At the Xi Clan, Xi Hongyan stared at Xi Chaozu and Xi Baoxing with an incredulous expression, especially after they told her about how Zhang Fei [5] sent them back to their realm. She then turned to Xi Qiuwei. "Who do you think the identity of that woman is, Auntie?"

"Lin Xiaolong is really not simple, Hongyan." Xi Hongyan agreed with Xi Qiuwei, especially after his action to immobilize her yesterday. "He is Hun Di's disciple, and these guys said that Princess Feng Yao helped him to thwart Shang Huaqiang's plan. As far as I remember, there is only one race that can open gates and travel to different realms easily, but I find it hard to believe that he also has a relationship with them."
"Which race?"

"The heavenly fox race." Xi Hongyan only realized it after Xi Qiuwei said it. "The Nameless One possesses the void element, but he can't move realms as quickly as the members of that fox race, so I'm sure that woman is one of them. However, they have always closed themselves off from outsiders, let alone humans, so I can't understand why that woman would help Lin Xiaolong."

"You guys go back to your places now." Once Xi Chaozu and Xi Baoxing had departed, Xi Hongyan inquired. "Do you think we can find out information about Lin Xiaolong's relationship with the heavenly fox race?"

"You need to abandon your idea." Xi Qiuwei replied with a soft sigh. "The heavenly fox race will not accept the presence of outsiders in their realm, and they will kill anyone who dares to trespass in it. The only solution is to approach Lin Moxian, and you can do that easily."

Xi Hongyan's face darkened because Xi Qiuwei kept mentioning Lin Moxian, even though she had told her too many times that she was not interested in him, let alone marry a man. She suddenly felt those invisible hands groping her body again, so she hurriedly left and returned to her room.
"What happened to her? Why do I feel like she often acts strange lately? Her face flushed red, as if she felt something unusual in her body." Xi Qiuwei shook her head and went elsewhere.

On the flying artifact, Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled in amusement as he watched Lin Moxian play with his puppet that he used to store Xi Hongyan's soul replica. "Senior brother, why don't you use a little force to subdue that woman? She is indeed cold and cruel, but she is actually too innocent when it comes to love. If you are a little forceful and aggressive with her, I am sure she will submit to you."

"Haha." Lin Moxian laughed awkwardly as he rubbed his head. "To tell you the truth, I myself am inexperienced with women, and Xi Hongyan is the first woman I have fallen in love with. Moreover, I am not familiar with her character, so I am at a loss as to where to start."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] sighed before telling him. "Xi Hongyan's self-esteem is very high, so you can't use a casual approach toward her. A woman like her prefers to be dominated, so you have to be more assertive and show your power to dominate her. She may not accept you right away, but I'm sure her heart will slowly melt if you do that, and she will eventually fall into your arms."
"Do you have a woman like her next to you?"

"I have several women similar to Xi Hongyan." Lin Moxian wore a curious look because she had never met Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s other woman, other than Hong Xinxin and Murong Qianying. He then summoned Boitata out of the beast space, surprising his senior brother. "She is a divine serpent dragon, and her pride is no less high than Xi Hongyan."

"Humph!" Boitata snorted at that. "Husband, if you called me out just for something like this, you can send me back now. I can't wait to break through to the 4-Star Sovereign Realm, so I would rather not waste my time here."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] glared at her. "I'll tie you up and smack your ass later!"
"Haha." Boitata giggled at his threat. "Do you think I'm afraid of your threats? You've done it to me too many times, remember?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] couldn't help but sigh at Boitata's shamelessness, and he sent him back to the beast space directly.
"Where did you meet her, Junior Brother?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately told Lin Moxian about his first meeting with Boitata. "So, you subdued her with your bloodline power?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at him. "Boitata was truly arrogant back then, and she looked down on me because I was much weaker than her. I used my bloodline power to subdue her, and she has become one of my best wives. Xi Hongyan is similar to her, so you can try using my idea to subdue her."
"Hey, have you ever been interested in Xi Hongyan?"

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] openly admitted it. "Xi Hongyan is an attractive woman, and her figure can make any man interested in her, including me. I do like women, but I am not greedy. You are my senior brother, and you like her, so I have no intention of approaching her. In fact, there are several attractive women by my side, but I never do anything to them, especially since my friends and family like them."

Lin Moxian nodded in understanding. "No wonder our master immediately accepted you as his disciple, even though he had only met you for the first time. The characters of the two of you are quite similar, and you two place great importance on those closest to you."

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed. "Senior brother, no matter how strong we are, we will need the help of many people one day. Outsiders won't necessarily help us, so we can only rely on those closest to us."
"You are right." Lin Moxian nodded in response. "Our master has always emphasized how important those closest to us are, and we must always treat them well."

"Our master is not wrong about that, but we cannot blindly trust them. Even though they are the closest people to us, we cannot know what's in their hearts." Zhang Xiaolong [3] released a soft sigh before continuing. "Before I became a cultivator, my biological brother betrayed me and stole my girlfriend at the time. They framed me and my big sister for something we never did, and my parents disowned me because of it. In the end, I killed them because they never changed, and they intended to kill me with the help of other people. I trust the people closest to me, but I still keep a little distance from them, including you, Senior Brother Liangren, and Senior Sister Yingyue."
Lin Moxian didn't think much about it and asked again. "What about your wives? Do you also keep a little distance from them?"

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s answer surprised Lin Moxian. "Among all my wives, only my little sister knows all my secrets because she loves me wholeheartedly, and I believe she will never betray me. The second person I trust the most is my grandmother because she always believes in me, and she always stands by me when I am at my lowest."
"Are you also interested in your grandmother?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately denied it. "I only have respect and familial love for my grandmother, so I don't have that kind of thought toward her. Anyways, how many more days until we arrive at the Xianjin Realm?"
"Around ten days." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then looked towards the front. "Are you impatient to arrive at that realm?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded. "I want Cheng Gaoji to create some other weapons for me, but I don't have their materials, especially the luminous Qi crystal."

"How did you know Cheng Gaoji?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately explained to Lin Moxian. "Hahahaha! That senile old man is idiotic! He already knows Shang Huaqiang's character, but he still took his bait, and he ended up becoming your subordinate. Although he isn't as good as Gong Ren, he is popular among cultivators, so you're lucky to get him."
"That's right."
Early in the morning, Zhang Fei took the two women into the training space, and he went straight to the Cloud Manxion.

Bai Tian'er was completely amazed to see so many people inside the place, even more so when she saw the two luxurious mansions. Bai Shushi immediately dragged her along and introduced her to Zhang Chen and the others before guiding her to begin her training.

Inside the Cloud Mansion, Zhang Fei discussed with all his women for quite some time, and they started to dual soul cultivate after that. Since Xu Ling'er had also reached the soul realm, he asked the little girl to join them.
However, Xu Ling'er brought Tasha with her, but Zhang Fei did not mind it, and he taught the two girls to dual soul cultivate with her directly.
On the demon island, Ximen Changtian, Nu Huangjin, and Ximen Yan have already announced the merger of the two demon kingdoms.

The demons of the Dark Demon Kingdoms objected to it because it was not the decision of Ximen Gongfu and Zheng Mohei, but none of them voiced their objections because their main backer, the Zheng Clan, had already been destroyed.
Naturally, both demon kingdoms merged under Zhang Fei's demon fox group, making his group truly large and controlling almost the entire Nine Stars Realm.

Since Xu Ling'er had also reached the soul realm, he asked the little girl to join them.
However, Xu Ling'er brought Tasha with her, but Zhang Fei did not mind it, and he taught the two girls to dual soul cultivate with her directly.
On the demon island, Ximen Changtian, Nu Huangjin, and Ximen Yan have already announced the merger of the two demon kingdoms.

The demons of the Dark Demon Kingdoms objected to it because it was not the decision of Ximen Gongfu and Zheng Mohei, but none of them voiced their objections because their main backer, the Zheng Clan, had already been destroyed.
Naturally, both demon kingdoms merged under Zhang Fei's demon fox group, making his group truly large and controlling almost the entire Nine Stars Realm.

[Ding]
[Quest: Clear the wandering souls.]
[Quest rank: Special]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Special gift pack x 1 sent to the inventory]
After four days of hard work, Zhang Fei's four clones finally managed to clear the wandering souls. His first, second, and fourth clones immediately moved to complete the three daily quests.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei's fifth clone was standing alone while thinking about something. "Open the reward, Mei."
[You obtained the Cursed Demon Heart.]

Zhang Fei [5]'s brows furrowed after reading the notification, but he immediately took it from the system inventory. The black heart emitted an ominous black-red aura, and it kept beating with endless demonic energy. In the next second, the black heart shot into his body, causing him to fall to the ground and groan in pain. "Argh!"
[Master, the cursed demon heart has begun to devour your human heart.]

"Argh!" Zhang Fei [5] was used to enduring the pain of his lightning tribulations, but the pain this time was truly unbearable, making him curl up and groan in pain. "Damn it! Does this mean I'll lose my humanity, Mei?"

[I don't think so, Master. Your humanity has nothing to do with your heart, and it is more influenced by your character. As long as you can maintain your sanity, I believe you will never lose your humanity. Since the cursed demon heart has begun to devour your human heart, it cannot be stopped anymore. Moreover, the cursed heart is not an ordinary demon heart, and it will grant you extraordinary powers and abilities, which are related to demons.]
"Tch! I hope you're right, Mei."

Gradually, black-red lines appeared all over Zhang Fei [5]'s body, and a black-red cocoon began to wrap around his body, causing his consciousness to disappear. Within it, he transformed into his lust demon lord without his control. His blood-red eyes became even redder, and two more demon horns appeared on top of his head, which looked more like goat horns.

Witnessing Zhang Fei [5]'s changes, Mei couldn't help but wonder. 'What exactly was the purpose of the system creator in giving my master the cursed demon heart? Did she want him to become a complete demon? Based on the description, the cursed heart once belonged to a powerful ancient demon who brought destruction to an unknown realm, and it was indestructible, even though powerful cultivators had repeatedly tried to destroy it.'
*Thud*

Tian Gongzhu landed not far from Zhang Fei [5], but his situation frightened him due to the ominous black-red aura emanating from the black-red cocoon. 'Where did this cocoon come from? Why did his demon aura suddenly become so terrifying? I have fought many times against demons who tried to invade our realm, but their auras were not as terrifying as his. If I approach him now, I might die at his hands, so I should wait for him to finish before telling him about Senior Brother Jiyuan.'
Quickly five hours passed, and the black-red cocoon had disappeared. Zhang Fei [5] stood at his previous spot with his eyes open, and two notifications appeared in his mind.
[Ding]
[The host's heart has been replaced by the demon cursed heart.]
[The host has learned the cursed demon codex.]

Tian Gongzhu, who was watching Zhang Fei [5] from afar, held her breath. His gaze and aura were calm, but she could feel death from both of them. 'What happened to him? Why is he just standing still like a statue?'
Zhang Fei [5] suddenly stretched his hand forward with his palm facing upward, and a sizable black ball appeared above it.

"Cursed Black Sun." Zhang Fei [5] threw the sizable black ball into the sky, and it immediately emitted an unusual aura, causing Tian Gongzhu and the demon beasts around him to be controlled by their madness and become berserk. "I can use it straight away without having to learn it, and the effect is excellent."
[Perhaps you were able to do that because of the demon cursed heart, Master. Anyways, cancel that technique, or Tian Gongzhu and the other demon beasts will be trapped in her madness.]
Tian Gongzhu fell into a daze after the cursed black sun disappeared, and she felt her mind was in disarray due to its effects. 'Tch! Being close to this guy is really unpleasant!'
Zhang Fei [5] moved to the front of a demon beast that was still in a daze and touched it. His action shocked Tian Gongzhu again, mainly because the demon beast's body quickly rotted.
"Decay Curse." Zhang Fei [5] muttered. "This ability is almost similar to my life-force absorption ability, but it causes my target's body to rot to death."
Zhang Fei [5] then dashed toward two fairly large demon beasts and used another of his new abilities against them. "Soulbinding Curse."
In an instant, two soul threads shot out from the bodies of the two beasts and attached themselves to Zhang Fei [5]'s body. "Hmm? These feelings are quite peculiar."
[What do you feel, Master?]

"Even though it was not significant, their soul power still increased my soul power, and I can absorb their souls whenever I want." Zhang Fei [5] moved toward several other demon beasts and used the ability. "The more I use this ability, the more my soul power increases. I don't know what the limits are or the risks, so I'll try it now."

Zhang Fei [5] tried to kill one of the beasts, but the result surprised him. Upon the beast's death, his soul absorbed its soul directly, transforming it into his power. "This ability is more sinister compared to the soul manipulation, but I like the effect. There are still some other abilities I got from the cursed demon heart, but I can't try them on these demon beasts."
Zhang Fei [5] then moved in front of Tian Gongzhu, causing him to subconsciously take a step back. "What... what do you want to do to me?"
"Nothing." Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "What about Tian Jiyuan? Has he contacted you?"
"Yes." Tian Gongzhu immediately told him. "Senior Brother Jiyuan has never been to this realm, so he can't possibly arrive so soon."

Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding and opened the portal to his training space, and all the female demons by his side immediately came out of it. "Those wandering souls have disappeared, and only demon beasts remain in this realm. Moreover, other cultivators do not dare to approach this realm, so you guys can cultivate and increase your demon power here."

Zilvora and the others were overjoyed after hearing that, and they immediately spread out to several areas, looking for opponents of equal strength. Moreover, Zhang Fei's three other clones were also in that realm, so they were not too worried about their safety.
"Are you going to send the others to this realm, Fei'er?" Ru Xue asked him.

Zhang Fei [5] nodded. "After they finish dual soul cultivating with me, I will send them here, and they can train while waiting for their cultivation to stabilize. Once your cultivation is stable, we will begin our seclusion again. I have to go to the Netherworld Realm now to settle one of those heavenly foxes, so you guys can start practicing now."
"Yeah." Ru Xue immediately changed into her demon form and flew to another area.

Zhang Fei [5] had already arrived at the Netherworld Realm, and Tian Gongzhu used a transformation technique to return to her original form, but she was unable to hide her demon aura. "Contact Tian Jiyuan now."
"All right." Tian Gongzhu immediately carried out his orders.
In a few minutes, Tian Jiyuan had arrived in that realm. However, he did not come alone, and the other three heavenly foxes also came with him.
"Is he really Zhang Fei?" Tian Jianxia asked as she looked at Zhang Fei [5] with a fierce gaze.
Tian Jiyuan gave a light nod. "He is indeed Zhang Fei, but I didn't expect that his cultivation had already reached 7-Star Earth Realm in just nine months."
"Hey, do you guys feel like there's something strange about Gongzhu?" Tian Dan asked them.
Tian Chen immediately replied. "Gongzhu has become a demon, and this brat deliberately used him to lure us into this realm."

Tian Gongzhu looked at them apologetically, but she didn't say anything to them, especially since she knew that it was useless. Since she had become a demon, they wouldn't care about her anymore, and they would have to think about killing her.
The four heavenly foxes wanted to attack Zhang Fei [5] and Tian Gongzhu, but Morgana and Oz the First suddenly appeared behind them, forcing them to increase their vigilance.
Zhang Fei [5] said nothing and disappeared from their sight. In a split second, the four heavenly foxes were sent flying in four different directions, and they felt immense pain in their stomachs.
"Cough... cough..." Tian Jiyuan immediately wiped the blood on his mouth, but Zhang Fei [5] had already appeared in front of him and punched his chin, propelling him in mid-air. "Guah!"
Tian Dan, Tian Jinxia, and Tian Chen teleported behind Zhang Fei [5] to attack him. However, he once again disappeared, reappeared behind them, and landed a heavy blow onto their backs.
"Argh!"
"Gah!"
"Guah!"

The three heavenly foxes screamed in pain because of Zhang Fei [5]'s attacks. They moved next to Tian Jiyuan, staring at him in complete shock. Their cultivation had already reached the Seven Divine Realms, while his was still in the ten mortal realms. Despite this, his speed outpaced theirs, rendering their teleportation abilities ineffective.

"Heh." Zhang Fei [5] once again disappeared from their sight, and his first target was Tian Dan, who was standing on the far left. He didn't beat the male heavenly fox anymore, but instead, he used his petrification ability.
"Help!" Tian Dan shouted and reached out to his three companions, but his body quickly turned to stone.
Zhang Fei [5] then moved behind Tian Chen, and he also used his petrification ability to turn him into stone.
"Shit!" Tian Jiyuan and Tian Jianxia immediately moved to attack Zhang Fei [5].

Zhang Fei [5] entered the invisible state and made a move against Tian Jianxia by using his newly acquired ability, the soulbinding curse, on her. He bound her soul to his, absorbing her soul power to increase his.

"Jiyuan! Help!" Tian Jianxia shouted as her soul rapidly weakened, which also weakened her body because the soul is an essential part of the body. Zhang Fei [5] then sealed her cultivation so that she could not contact the other heavenly foxes for help.
Tian Jiyuan wanted to help Tian Jianxia, but Zhang Fei [5] directly intercepted him and punched him in the face, sending him flying backwards.

Tian Jiyuan was completely shocked by Zhang Fei [5]'s actions. 'This bastard! How could his abilities improve so significantly in just nine months? Back then, we forced him to escape to this realm, but he was able to keep up with us and defeat three of us.'

"Are you surprised by my abilities?" Tian Jiyuan immediately turned around and punched directly, but Zhang Fei [5] casually caught his fist and squeezed it, causing him to grimace. "Soulbinding curse."
Tian Jiyuan used his other hand to punch his chest, but his attack lacked power after Zhang Fei [5] absorbed his soul power and weakened him. 'What the hell is this?'
Zhang Fei [5] gave a faint smirk and punched Tian Jiyuan's chest several times at high speed, causing his sternum to crack and blood to spew out of his mouth.
*Splurt*
"Cough... Cough..."

"The four of you are indeed stronger than me, but you guys won't be able to defeat me." After he said that, Zhang Fei [5] beat Tian Jiyuan black and blue, without him being able to avoid a single one of his attacks. Additionally, he used his demon-absorbing to weaken the male heavenly fox, causing him to scream in pain.
[You gained 3,000,000 Qi from Tian Jiyuan.]
Once the male heavenly fox was in a helpless state, Zhang Fei [5] directly enslaved Tian Jiyuan and used his new ability on him. "Karmic curse."
"I thought you were going to kill them."Morgana said this as she and Oz the First flew up to them.

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "If I kill them, Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing will find out right away, and they will definitely send stronger heavenly foxes to hunt me down. This guy is my slave now, and I will use him to monitor them."
'Shit! Why are we this unlucky?' Tian Jiyuan cursed in his heart with the little consciousness he had left.
"What are your plans for the other three heavenly foxes?" Oz the First asked him.
"I will leave two petrified foxes in this realm, and I will take the woman with me to the Nine Hells Darkland." Zhang Fei [5] suddenly remembered a person. "Do you know Wang Yin, Morgana?"

"Did you meet Wang Yin in the Nine Hells Darkland?" Zhang Fei [5] nodded at Morgana. "I met her a few times, and she is one of the good demons in the upper realms. If you can get her support, she can help you create corpse armies, and they will be useful to you because they will never die."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded in agreement. "I have thought about it, but I will not be going to the Demon Purgatory Realm anytime soon, and I will meet her when I am ready."

After he gave some orders to Tian Jiyuan, Zhang Fei [5] brought Tian Gongzhu and Tian Jianxia to the Nine Hells Darkland. On the other hand, Morgana and Oz the First bring the petrified Tian Chen and Tian Dan back to the demon castle.

Tian Jiyuan, who was lying limply on the ground, immediately swallowed a pill to recover himself. His expression was filled with regret because he was so stupid to take Zhang Fei [5]'s bait and go to the Netherworld Realm. Not only did he become his slave, but his three companions also fell into his hands. "Damn it! Even though he is also a heavenly fox like me, I am really unlucky to be his slave."

When they arrived at the Nine Hells Realm, Zhang Fei [5] immediately threw Tian Jianxia to the ground and said to Tian Gongzhu. "You should not unseal her cultivation and let her become a demon fox like you."
After he said that, Zhang Fei [5] immediately went to another area of the realm, where he let the demon extermination sword kill the demon beasts.
"You traitor! You trapped us and caused the four of us to suffer terrible luck!" Tian Jianxia shouted to Tian Gongzhu, but her tone was too weak.

Tian Gongzhu could only sigh upon hearing that. "Senior Sister Jianxia, I really don't want to betray you, but I can't go against his orders. I can't explain the details to you, and you will know for yourself when he comes back here."

Tian Jianxia said nothing more and lay on the ground with a weak body and soul. Her expression was filled with regret and despair, thinking about her future after she turned into a demon fox. Moreover, she was sure that Zhang Fei [5] still had other plans for her, and she was truly terrified, thinking of him enslaving her like he did to Tian Jiyuan.

A few hours later, Zhang Fei had finished dual soul cultivating with all his wives, and he sent them all off to the Nine Hells Darkland. Naturally, he also sent Elmyra there so she could protect them from the influence of the demon aura.

Thereafter, Zhang Fei went to the Hong Clan to meet people from that clan, Jin Ruyue, and Murong Qianying. He then explained his new plan for the Shang Clan. "Are you really going to make a move on them this soon? Isn't that a bit too hasty?"
