A few hours later, Zhang Fei had finished dual soul cultivating with all his wives, and he sent them all off to the Nine Hells Darkland.
Naturally, he also sent Elmyra there so she could protect them from the influence of the demon aura.
Thereafter, Zhang Fei went to the Hong Clan to meet people from that clan, Jin Ruyue, and Murong Qianying.
He then explained his new plan for the Shang Clan.
"Are you really going to make a move on them this soon?
Isn't that a bit too hasty?"

chapters.title: Chapter 792: Meet Fei Qinyuan
paragraphs: Zhang Fei answered Hong Quan by taking out the soul replicas of Fei Qinyuan and Shang Xishun. "Grandpa Quan, I have no intention of attacking them openly because it will be detrimental to us, especially with the presence of Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun. I have already done something to Shang Huaqiang, and his soul will continue to weaken without him knowing, so he will not be a threat to us. The solution I have in mind is that we should weaken those two old men, and I am thinking of controlling the two women through these two soul replicas."

"Fei Qinyuan may be strong, but she is still no match for those old folks. Shang Xishun is indeed one of the important elders in the Shang Clan, but she won't be able to do too much." Hong Quan paused for a while. "Compared to the two of them, Shang Ziyuan is much more useful. Can you do something to her?"

Zhang Fei nodded. "One of my abilities continues to torment Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian, and its effects will not abate unless I remove it. I've also gotten Xi Yinying from Xi Hongyan, and her shadow abilities are quite peculiar, so she can help me do something about those two women."
"Eh?" Zhang Fei's revelation about Xi Yinying stunned Hong Quan and the others. "Since when did you get that woman? How did you persuade Xi Hongyan to hand her over to you?"

"Grandma Yinzhi, Xi Hongyan's soul was injured due to a demon attack, and she will die if it is not healed." Zhang Fei explained to them how the woman got her injury. "She sent Xi Yinying to approach me, so I met her two days ago and exchanged their lives."
"Haha." Cai Yinzhi laughed at that. "Xi Hongyan must be angry with you because you treated her like that, but she would never dare attack you with your status as Hun Di's disciple."
"Are you going to start your plan now?" Hong Chong asked.

"I plan to infiltrate the Shang Clan now, and I will do something to Shang Ziyuan." Zhang Fei decided to merge the two soul replicas with his soul, especially since he could not use both of them for soul weapons. "Grandpa Quan, I want you to start suppressing the Wang and Dai clans, as well as the few clans who choose to be loyal to the Shang Clan. Once I succeed in doing something to that woman, I will use her to get rid of Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun as quickly as possible."
Hong Quan immediately pulled his son to his feet. "We will meet the other leaders of the clans on our side, and we will begin to suppress the Wang and Dai clans."
"I'll join you two, Old Quan." Jin Ruyue hurried after them.
Murong Qianying then spoke to Zhang Fei. "Long'er, you must be careful when you infiltrate the Shang Clan, okay?"
"That's for sure! I'll go to that clan right now." After Zhang Fei left, Murong Qianying said goodbye to Cai Yinzhi and Yan Yizhen.

Yan Yizhen let out a soft sigh and said to her mother-in-law. "I feel sorry for Qianying because she's the only one who doesn't know Zhang Fei's true identity, and she still thinks that he's a 10-year-old kid."

"Sooner or later, Zhang Fei will reveal his true identity to Qianying, so we don't need to interfere in their affairs." Cai Yinzhi then stood up from her seat. "Let's go; we will help our husbands to do other things."

Zhang Fei was standing on a tree not far from the Shang Clan. He first confirmed Shang Yanhan's position, and he found the old man was in his private room. After that, he looked for Fei Qinyuan and found her in her room with Shang Huaqiang.

Zhang Fei then looked for Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian, and the two women were quickly asleep in each other's arms due to exhaustion, especially after they had tried to quell their lust for four days. "Haha! This way, I don't need to do too much with them, and I just need to sneak there to replicate their souls."

Zhang Fei activated his invisibility and teleported to the front of Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian's room before sneaking in without the two of them realizing. Despite this, he waited until he was certain that both women were indeed asleep before making any moves.

Once he was sure that Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian were unaware of his presence, Zhang Fei directly pulled their souls out of their bodies. He directly replicated their souls before merging them with his own. After he returned their souls to their bodies, he also used the soulbinding curse on them to use their soul power to enhance his. 'This way, they are in my hands now, and I can start messing with this clan.'
After he left their room, Zhang Fei carefully infiltrated Shang Yanhan's private area, and he created several kinds of plants to mess with the old man's mind.
Zhang Fei then went to another area, but he found Fei Qinyuan leaving her room and going out of the Shang Clan, so he hurried to follow her.

A while later, Fei Qinyuan arrived at a simple residence, and Zhang Fei followed her inside, where he saw her meet an old woman. From the system scan, he learned that the old woman was Fei Shuya, and he guessed she was the ancestor of the Fei Clan, especially since her cultivation was one minor level below Shang Yanshan.
"Why did you come here again, Qinyuan?" Fei Shuya asked.
Fei Qinyuan let out a soft sigh and sat down beside Fei Shuya. "Grandmother, I'm still confused about my husband's condition; I don't understand how his thing could suddenly disappear."

"I've thought about that too, but I don't have an answer for you yet." Fei Shuya then turned to her. "Since your husband can no longer satisfy you, I think you can find another man to satisfy you, but you must be careful in doing so."
Fei Qinyuan was stunned for a moment. "Are you still thinking about me having a relationship with Huo Chunlai?"

"Yes." Fei Shuya blatantly admitted it. "You yourself know that your late grandfather wanted you to marry Huo Chunlai, but you chose Shang Huaqiang instead. The Shang Clan is indeed powerful, but the Huo Clan is much stronger than them, especially with the support of that Lin Clan. Furthermore, Chunlai has never stopped waiting for you, so I think you can start meeting him and building a relationship with him."
"Grandmother, I—"

"Are you still unaware of the Shang Clan's situation?" Fei Shuya asked with narrowed eyes. "The strength of the Hong and Xi clans has increased rapidly now, especially after the other clans joined them, which put the Shang clan in a tight position. I understand your feelings, but I don't want you to die along with them because you are the future of our Fei Clan. You must leave them before it's too late, and I think now is an appropriate time given your husband's condition."

Zhang Fei, who was eavesdropping on their conversation, smiled faintly. 'This old woman is smart enough to think of that, but I will not let Fei Qinyuan off so easily, and she must help me destroy the Shang Clan first.'
"I'll think about it first, Grandmother." Fei Qinyuan replied with a soft sigh.
Fei Shuya could only shake her head because Fei Qinyuan was too stubborn, but she then turned to Zhang Fei. "How long are you going to hide there, kid?"
"Huh?" Fei Qinyuan immediately turned to where her grandmother was looking and used her senses to check. "Who are you talking to, Grandmother?"
Instead, Fei Shuya spoke to Zhang Fei again. "You don't need to hide anymore; I have been aware of your presence since you set foot in my residence."
"Haha." Zhang Fei chuckled as he canceled his invisibility. Fei Qinyuan wanted to move to capture him, but her body didn't listen to her commands. "Are you surprised that you couldn't attack me?"
"You! What did you do to me?" Fei Qinyuan angrily asked.

Instead, Zhang Fei questioned Fei Shuya, particularly intrigued by the old woman's apparent awareness of his presence. "Why didn't you move to capture me or kill me if you were already aware of my presence?"

"Even if I wanted to capture or kill you, I still couldn't do it, right?" Zhang Fei responded to Fei Shuya with a smile. "I have been monitoring the Shang Clan using special methods, so I have long known about you, including your actions in causing chaos in the clan. I used the same method in this house, so it wasn't difficult for me to notice your presence. I know that you poisoned my daughter and her husband from your conversation with Du Yuanjia, and I know that you are Hun Di's disciple. You have done something to my granddaughter's soul, and I am certain that she will die if I kill you."

Fei Qinyuan's eyes widened in shock as she stared at Zhang Fei. She knew that Hun Di had already taken a new disciple, but she didn't expect that he was his disciple. She was even more shocked by her grandmother's last sentence. "Is that true, Grandma? Has this guy done something to my soul?"
"Haven't you experienced the effects yourself? You can't move your body to attack him, right?" Fei Qinyuan nodded to Fei Shyua. "What do you want from us, kid?"
*Clap... Clap...*

Zhang Fei clapped his hands before speaking. "You are indeed amazing, old woman. Ever since I gained my ability, not many people have been able to notice my presence, and you are the third person who has managed to do so. Honestly, I don't have a problem with you or your Fei Clan, but I have a problem with your granddaughter and the Shang Clan."
Fei Shuya frowned when she heard that, but Fei Qinyuan immediately shouted at Zhang Fei. "What's your problem with me? Why are you doing this to me? We've never even met before!"

"You're right that we've never met before, but that doesn't mean you can't have problems with me." Fei Qinyuan narrowed her eyes at Zhang Fei, but she was confused as to how she could have a problem with him. "You should still remember about the Sky Jade Realm and the broken portal, right?"
"You—"

"That's right." Zhang Fei nodded to Fei Qinyuan. "Because of you and your husband, several of my wives suffered from the deaths of their father and husband. Not only that, my brother-in-law and my sister-in-law turned into demons because of your actions. Since they are my family, I must avenge their suffering, right?"
Zhang Fei's revelation left Fei Qinyuan confused, shocked, and frightened. He was a cultivator from the lower realms, but he could go to the upper realms and do so much to her and the Shang Clan.

"You and your husband sent Shang Chongyun and the other three to the Netherworld Realm to start your second plan to invade the Sky Jade Realm, right? Do you think I will let you guys do that?" Zhang Fei then took out the teleportation portal. "Your second plan has failed because I have already captured them, and I seized this portal from their hands."
Fei Qinyuan's pupils constricted as soon as she saw the teleportation portal in Zhang Fei's hand. Fei Shuya exhaled heavily. "What must I do so that you will be willing to free my granddaughter?"

"I will never free my enemies, and your granddaughter must be held accountable for her actions." Fei Shuya immediately stood up and prepared to attack Zhang Fei, but he swiftly moved and captured Fei Qinyuan while pressing the hongxi dagger to her neck, causing her neck to bleed. "Old woman, your cultivation is indeed much higher than mine, but you will not be able to stop me from killing her, and you will also not be able to stop me from leaving. If you attack me, I will make sure that your Fei Clan disappears from this realm, so you must think carefully before acting against me."

Zhang Fei's threat made Fei Shuya furious, but the speed he displayed just now made her realize that she wouldn't be able to stop him from killing Fei Qinyuan, and her Fei Clan would suffer a setback if she died.
Fei Qinyuan, who was in Zhang Fei's hands, was also furious at his treatment of her. Unfortunately, she still couldn't move her body to fight against him. 'This bastard! I really want to kill him!'

Zhang Fei smiled at Fei Shuya's expression. "Even though I won't let go of your granddaughter, I won't kill her because I still need her. If you are wise, you should separate your Fei Clan from the Shang Clan, or your clan will be destroyed along with them."
"All right." Fei Shuya immediately agreed. "I will separate my Fei Clan from the Shang Clan, so I hope you keep your word not to attack us."
"I am a man of my word, so you don't have to worry about that." Zhang Fei immediately let go of Fei Qinyuan and disappeared from the residence.
Fei Shuya and Fei Qinyuan immediately spread their senses to search for Zhang Fei around the residence, but they couldn't find him anywhere.
"Grandmother, you must save me from that bastard." Fei Qinyuan persisted with a grim expression.

"If only you had heeded your late grandfather's advice not to marry Shang Huaqiang, none of these would have happened." Fei Qinyuan had a sour face hearing Fei Shuya's words. "I don't know what he plans to do next, but he won't kill you now because he still needs you, so I still have time to free you from him. For now, I will take care of our clan, and I will meet my old friend after. I don't know if she will be able to free you from him, but I will meet her first."
"Thank you, Grandmother." Fei Qinyuan then left her grandmother's residence.

Fei Shuya walked to the front of her room, crossed her hands behind her hips, and looked up at the sky. "Old man, what would you do in this situation if you were still alive? I'm more senior and stronger than him, but I feel powerless to face him. He's Hun Di's disciple, and his master will definitely make a move if I attack him, which will bring destruction to my Fei Clan."
Before long, Fei Qinyuan had returned to the Shang Clan, and she immediately returned to her room to think about her situation.
"What happened to you? Why are you so serious?" Shang Huaqiang asked her.

Fei Qinyuan wanted to tell her husband about Zhang Fei, but none of her words could come out of her mouth, making her even angrier in her heart. "I was just thinking about our situation, especially about the identity of the person who poisoned us. I asked my grandmother to help me find that person, but she still couldn't find the culprit, and she suspected that the person had something to do with the chaos in our clan four days ago."

"I thought so too." Shang Huaqiang replied with a nod. "However, I don't know where to start looking for that person, especially since we don't know where and when we started being affected by the poison. What about Ziyuan? Has her lust still not subsided?"
"Not yet." Fei Qinyuan shook her head in response. "If my guess is right, the culprit who made Ziyuan like that is the same person who poisoned us and caused chaos in our clan."
Shang Huaqiang immediately stood up and walked out of their room. "I will leave for a few days, and I will start looking for the culprit from the Northern Region."

Fei Qinyuan then lay on her bed and covered her face with one hand, thinking about Zhang Fei's next plan for her and her husband. 'What does he really want from me? Is he thinking of using me to kill my husband? He doesn't want to kill me, but he makes me unable to fight him.'

chapters.title: Chapter 793: Plans For Lower And Middle Realms
paragraphs: Tian Jiyuan, who had recovered, immediately went to the Sky Jade Realm based on Zhang Fei's orders. However, he repeatedly experienced unlucky events due to the influence of the karmic curse.

Tian Jiyuan then went to Zhang Fei's residence in the Western Region, especially since he ordered him to stay there while waiting for his next orders. "Tch! I've never been so unlucky in my life! What will he do to Tian Jianxia? Will he turn him into a demon fox like Tian Gongzhu? What will happen to Tian Chen and Tian Dan? Have they died into stone? What does he plan for me? I want to report his incidents to my ancestors, but he has already implanted his slave mark into my soul."

Tian Jiyuan released a heavy sigh before sitting cross-legged in the garden, and he began to cultivate there, but he was disappointed because the quality and quantity of Qi in the realm was simply minuscule for a cultivator at the Seven Divine Realm like him.

In the Shrouded Sky Realm, at the Alchemy Union Headquarters. Sun Jianming was sitting with Huoyun Zhiyan and Xiu Hanyu, discussing some matters. "Can we really not open a shop in the Wasteland Realm? Ever since we lost the Nine Stars Realm, our organization's income has been steadily decreasing, and it will be difficult for us to supply the other realms."

"Unfortunately, we can't open a shop in that realm, Zhiyan." Sun Jianming replied with a disappointed sigh. "The human cultivators in the Wasteland Realm are people who are punished to mine resources, and they are all members of clans from the upper realms, most of whom come from the Red Sun Realm. Apart from them, there are only beast races, demihuman races, and demons. I've tried to meet the demihumans, but they chased me away and threatened to kill me if I came to their island again."

"The beast race won't be able to give us anything, and there's no way we'll be able to set foot on the demon island." Xiu Hanyu then conveyed her idea. "Zhiyan, there are still several other realms that we can use to open our shops, and one of them is the Blossom Heaven Realm."

Huoyun Zhiyan thought for a moment. "As far as I remember, the Blossom Heaven Realm is mostly women, and they enslave the men in their realm. Jianming and I can't go to that realm, so I want you to go there to discuss with their leader about our plan. Meanwhile, we will go to some other realms, such as the Azure Sky Realm and the Divine Flame Realm."
"The Divine Flame Realm?"

"Yes." Huoyun Zhiyan nodded at them. "The people in that realm do focus on blacksmithing, but they still need pills and the like. Back then, I met with Jiang Shen to discuss it, but he still refused, so I focused on the other realms first. Therefore, I plan to meet him again, and I will use all means to get him to let us open our shop there."
"I will go to the Blossom Heaven Realm now." Xiu Hanyu immediately left the room.
Sun Jianming also stood up from his seat. "I will go to the Azure Sky Realm now."
After he gave orders to several elders of the Alchemy Union, Huoyun Zhiyan also left their headquarters for the Divine Flame Realm.

Zhang Fei stood in front of the glass tube and thought about absorbing the Qi inside so he could break through to the 8-Star Earth Realm directly. "Do you think I will be able to break through to the Heaven Realm directly if I absorb all this Qi, Mei?]

[Ever since you imprisoned Ruo Yanxi, Ma Mingxin, and Qu Qiuxue here, the amount of Qi in this glass tube has increased rapidly. If you absorb them all at once, I think you can break through to the Heaven Realm directly. However, it is too risky because your cultivation foundation will be fragile and unstable if you break through to that stage directly, and you will face considerable difficulty in stabilizing it. Not to mention, you will face four levels of lightning tribulations at once, so you must think carefully before doing so, Master.]

Zhang Fei did not immediately respond to Mei and thought about the risks first. "Since I have five clones, I think I can stabilize my cultivation foundation more easily with their help and the flow of time within the training space. If I have broken through to that stage, I can help Lin'er and the others to improve their cultivation, and I will start carrying out my plans for the lower and middle realms."
[Eh? Do you also want to master the lower realms, Master?]

"The lower realms may not mean much to the cultivators of the upper realms, but I think they can give me many things. Even the Sky Jade Realm gave me many jewels, so I plan to spread the demon fox group to all corners of the lower realms." Mei agreed with Zhang Fei, but the lower realms were quite vast, and there were so many realms in it, which would waste a lot of time. "Naturally, I won't do everything myself, and I will send some strong cultivators to help me."
[Who are the people you would choose to help you, Master?]
"There are no cultivators of the Seven Divine Realms in the lower realms, right?"
[The highest cultivation in the lower realms should be at 10-Star Saint Realm, Master.]

Zhang Fei gave a light nod. "I will ask the people from the Xian, Yun, Zhou, Bai, and Ximen Kingdoms to go to those realms. As long as I send cultivators in the Seven Divine Realms to all those planets, I believe the inhabitants of those planets will not dare to reject them."
[Well, you're right, Master. Then, what about the middle realms?]

"Ever since I became a cultivator, I have consistently acted cautiously and planned everything from behind, primarily because I believed my strength would not be sufficient to confront more experienced cultivators. However, I have become more confident since I went to the Red Sun Realm and dealt with the people in that realm, so I also plan to spread the demon fox group to all corners of the middle realms." Zhang Fei thought for a while before continuing. "Even so, I still can't do everything by myself because it will only waste my time, so I need many people to lead my group. To smooth my plans, I need the help of some influential people, so I am thinking of going to the Shrouded Sky Realm and the Divine Flame Realm."
[Are you thinking about taking over the Alchemy Union, Master?]

"Isn't that obvious, Mei?" Zhang Fei asked back. "The Alchemy Union controls most of the alchemy market in the middle realms, so their influence is significant. If I take over that organization, I can spread my group more easily by utilizing their influence. Senior Duan said that the influence of the Divine Flame Realm is also not inferior to theirs, especially in blacksmithing. Therefore, I plan to go to that realm to meet their leaders, and I will use all means to bring them into my group."

[Master, your main problem is to provide goods from Earth because their production is not comparable to the sum of all the planets in the lower and middle realms, which are too numerous. If you think of opening your modern shop on all those planets, you will not be able to meet their needs.]

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed at that. "Mei, of course I will not open modern shops on all the planets, and I will only open them on planets that are profitable. However, I will still open restaurants and alchemy shops on all those planets, but I need Cheng Gaoji's help to connect the Nine Stars Realm with all those planets so I don't have to waste so much time traveling."
[I think it will cost a lot of jewels, Master.]
"That's for sure." Zhang Fei replied with a nod. "Still, I don't need to think too much about that, especially since I won't do it all at once but gradually."
[So, when will you start your plan, Master? Are you really going to force yourself to break through to the Heaven Realm?]

"I will stabilize my cultivation first, and I will break through to the Heaven Realm after it is completely stable." Mei could only sigh because Zhang Fei was too hasty in making that decision. "I understand your concerns, but I am confident that I can get through everything well. Those lightning tribulations might be too strong, but I am not as weak as I used to be, and I have faced them many times, so I will do it soon."
[In that case, you should bring your four clones into the training space once the three daily quests are completed, and they should focus on stabilizing your cultivation first.]
"Yeah." Zhang Fei then exited the Yin-Yang Space.

Zhang Fei had already arrived at Duan Zhao's residence, but he could not find Gang Zhishou and the others. He immediately went to see Cheng Gaoji to discuss his plans, but the old man felt that he was too crazy and too ambitious with his plans to dominate the entire lower and middle realms. "How many jewels did it take to create one, Old Cheng?"

"Honestly, the price of one teleportation portal is not too expensive, but not everyone is able to create it. Only three people can create it, but it took us a month to create one, and the best one is Gong Ren." Cheng Gaoji then told Zhang Fei about the materials and costs needed to make one. "Do you have that many jewels?"

Zhang Fei scratched his head while shaking it, especially since the amount was still costly for him, making Cheng Gaoji sigh helplessly. The old man took out two teleportation devices and handed them over, which surprised him. "Is it okay if I use them?"

"Yeah." Cheng Gaoji nodded. "You should use them to connect with the two most important planets first, such as the Shrouded Sky Realm. I've never witnessed you concocting pills, so I don't know for sure about your alchemy abilities. Your pills are among the best, comparable to ones made by Tian Shuixiang and Lin Jingxia. If you sell them in many realms, especially the Xianjin Realm, I'm sure you'll be able to get many jewels, and I can help you create the teleportation portal."

"I do plan to sell my pills in the Xianjin Realm." Zhang Fei replied with a nod. "However, I will see the situation in that realm first because I would rather not clash with Tian Shuixiang and Lin Jingxia, which will only bring me new trouble."

"Haha!" Cheng Gaoji laughed and patted him on the shoulder. "Kid, Tian Shuixiang and Lin Jingxia never sell their pills in other realms, and they only sell them in the Void Heaven Realm, so you don't need to worry about clashing with them. Once your third clone arrives in the Xianjin Realm, you can take me back there directly, and I will take you to one of my empty buildings, which you can use to open your shop. However, you cannot sell items from your home realm there, especially since their quality is too low."

Zhang Fei himself had seen Shang Yaolin take out a blanket that she had bought in the Xianjin Realm, so he knew that the quality of the items from Earth could not be compared to those from that realm, but their prices were simply sky-high. "My third clone will arrive at the Xianjin Realm in about ten days, so I will take you there directly after he arrives."
"That's good."
Thereafter, Zhang Fei returned to the Red Sun Realm and entered the training space directly, where he stabilized his cultivation.

Several hours later, Zhang Fei's four clones had completed all three daily quests. His first, second, and fourth clones immediately entered the training space to stabilize his cultivation. Meanwhile, his fifth clone stabilized his cultivation in the Nine Hells Darkland while monitoring his wives and partners who were still training in the realm.
Furthermore, Zhang Fei was still waiting for Tian Jianxia to transform into a demon fox, so he left his fifth clone there.
Meanwhile, Hong Quan, Hong Chong, Jin Ruyue, and several other clan leaders had arrived at the Dai Clan. Dai Hubai greeted them with a frown. "Why are you all here?"

Hong Quan walked up to Dai Hubai before grabbing his shoulder. "Old Dai, you must have heard about the situation of the Shang Clan, right? We have come here to offer you a final choice: either join us or face the destruction of your Dai Clan alongside them."
Dai Hubai's face darkened when he heard that, but Hong Cong and the others immediately unleashed their strength and surrounded him. "Do you guys think you can fight Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun?"

"Do you think we would have made a move if we weren't sure we could beat them?" Jin Ruyue turned the question around. "You may not know it yet, but I can tell you that we have the support of the Soul Emperor even if it is indirect."
Dai Hubai naturally did not believe Jin Ruyue's words because Hun Di never interfered with other clans' matters, and he always remained neutral toward everyone.

"Old Dai, my granddaughter's fiancé is Hun Di's newest disciple, so you don't need to doubt Jin Ruyue's words." Dai Hubai turned his head to Hong Quan and looked at him in disbelief, but he himself had heard that the Soul Emperor had taken a new disciple. "You probably won't believe me, but he caused chaos in the Shang Clan a few days ago. He had far better abilities than senior cultivators like us; even Shang Yanhan did not manage to detect his presence in his clan. Not only that, but Fei Qinyuan and the others are already under his control, and he has also forced Fei Shuya to separate her Fei Clan from the Shang Clan. If you don't believe me, you can ask that old woman now."
Dai Hubai immediately contacted Fei Shuya, and the old woman right away confirmed this, especially since she already suspected that the Hong Clan would make a move soon.

Seeing Dai Hubai's expression, Hong Quan immediately spoke again. "I know you decided to join the Shang Clan because you were afraid of their ancestors, but we no longer need to be afraid of them, so you should reconsider your decision. By the way, you better not reveal our movements to them, or you and your Dai Clan will suffer."

'This old bastard!' Dai Hubai cursed in his heart, but Fei Shuya's confirmation of the Hong Clan's relationship with the Soul Emperor made his stance waver. "Sigh! You're right! I joined the Shang Clan because I was afraid of the threat of Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun, especially since they were too strong for me and my clan. Are you sure we can defeat them? Even if you have such a close relationship with Hun Di, I don't believe that he will interfere in this matter directly."

"In fact, we don't need Hun Di to intervene directly, and his newest disciple is enough to help us." Dai Hubai expressed disbelief because he didn't know Zhang Fei, so he wasn't sure they could win against the Shang Clan without the Soul Emperor's help. "Like I said before, Fei Qinyuan and the others are already under his control, and he can use them whenever he wants. Therefore, we don't have to face Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun directly, and he will use them to deal with those two, so you don't need to hesitate anymore and join us."

After weighing the pros and cons, Dai Hubai immediately made a decision. "All right! I will leave the Shang Clan and join you, but I hope your words are true because I don't want my Dai Clan to be destroyed in their hands."
"Don't worry, your Dai Clan will be safe as long as you join us."

chapters.title: Chapter 794: 10 Star Earth Realm
paragraphs: After they managed to convince the Dai Clan, Hong Quan and the others immediately moved to the Wang Clan. Unlike Dai Hubai, Wang Jinghsan was too cowardly and stubborn, making it difficult for them to convince him.
In the end, Hong Quan and the others decided to use violence and coercion to capture Wang Jinghsan, which caused great chaos in the Wang Clan and injured many of the clan's main members.
Since Wang Jingshan and the main members of the Wang Clan fell into enemy hands, the remaining members of their clan decided to surrender to Hong Quan and the others.

Hong Quan decided to take Wang Jingshan and the main members of the Wang Clan back to the Hong Clan, imprisoning them there. As for the remaining members of their clan, the other leaders from other clans divided them and took them to their respective clans.
Since the situation in the Northern Region was already quite safe, and the Shang Clan still couldn't make a move, Jin Ruyue decided to bring the members of her Jin Clan back to their residence.

Hong Quan asked Jin Ruyue, Dai Hubai, and Ren Dongcheng to monitor the changes in the situation in the Northern Region. In addition to that, he asked them to clean up the minor clans that were still loyal to the Shang Clan to weaken the clan even further.

Hong Quan and several others immediately moved to clean up the minor clans in the southern region who were loyal to the Shang Clan. Naturally, they did not move openly, especially since Shang Yanhan and Shang Yanjun would know their movements if they did.
Meanwhile, the leaders of the Tie, Miao, Lai, and Tao clans moved to purge the Shang clan loyalists in the eastern region.

The Huo Clan, as the strongest clan in the eastern region, was naturally aware of their movements. Huo Jiguang went to meet the leaders of the four clans to discuss the matter, but they did not explain it to him in detail, and they only told him the outline of Hong Quan's plan.
Even though he had long known about Hong Quan's movements, Huo Jiguang still did not expect that he would move so quickly against the Shang clan, which made him wonder about his reasons.

Despite this, Huo Jiguang was not too worried about their movements because their enemy was not his Huo Clan, but he was aware that the situation in their realm would change significantly, especially after they destroyed Shang Huaqiang and his clan.

Therefore, Huo Jiguang immediately made several plans to deal with this change, especially since there were three factions in their realm. These factions included his own group, Hong Quan's group, and Xi Hongyan's group.

After that day, the situation in the Red Sun Realm was relatively peaceful, and nothing major happened. Shang Huaqiang was too busy with his private matters to find the perpetrator who poisoned him and his wife; he believed that the perpetrator was the same person who infiltrated his clan and did despicable things to him.

Fei Qinyuan left the Shang Clan several times just to see Fei Shuya, and she heard from her grandmother about Hong Quan's actions against the Dai and Wang Clan. She believed that his actions were related to Zhang Fei, and she wanted to retaliate against them.
However, Fei Shuya repeatedly forbade Fei Qinyuan and reminded her that her life was in Zhang Fei's hands, so he could kill her whenever she wanted, forcing her to abandon her intention.

Due to Fei Shuya's relentless urging, Fei Qinyuan began to establish communication with Huo Chunlai, but she had not thought too far into a close relationship with him, mainly because her feelings for Shang Huaqiang were still too deep.
As for Shang Ziyuan and Shi Wuxian, both women are still tormented by the effects of Zhang Fei's hormone manipulation, and they never leave their room once.
Ten days later.
The atmosphere in the Zhou Kingdom was truly festive, and the entire city was decorated with wedding decorations, especially since today was Zhou Shenxin's wedding to Zhang Fei.

The royal families, sects, and clans from the three other human kingdoms were present at their wedding. Only the royal family of the Huangfu Kingdom was absent, even though they were already under Zhang Fei's control.

The residents of the Zhou Kingdom were shocked by the presence of the royal families of the Beast, Natural Race, and Demon kingdoms. They did not mind the presence of the people from the Beast and Natural Race kingdoms, but they could not accept the presence of the people from the Ximen kingdom.

Fortunately, Zhou Shenxin had already ordered her ministers and subordinates to take care of the matter, and they informed the residents of their kingdom that the Ximen Kingdom was subject to their empress's fiancé, which made them shocked and curious about Zhang Fei.

The residents of the Zhou Kingdom themselves already knew about Zhang Fei's status as the son-in-law of the Xian and Yun Kingdoms, and he would soon become the emperor of their kingdom after his marriage to Zhou Shenxin. At first, they did not know the reason behind the presence of people from the Beast and Natural Race kingdoms at their wedding, but they began to realize that those people were present because of their future emperor.
The wedding ceremony in the Zhou kingdom was not much different from that in the Xian or Yun kingdoms, and a few hours later, Zhang Fei had already solemnized his marriage to Zhou Shenxin.

After their wedding, Zhang Fei announced that he would not rule as the emperor, so Zhou Shenxin would handle all affairs in the Zhou Kingdom as their empress, assisted by Jiang Tingxi. He did not reveal to them that their former emperor and his sons were his slaves, and they would help his wife to take care of their kingdom.

Since he could not have a wedding night with Zhou Shenxin due to the vast difference in their cultivation, Zhang Fei decided to take her into the training space. He handed over all the affairs of the kingdom to Jiang Tingxi, Zhou Xiaochuan, and the other women, so the government continued to run normally.

Inside the cloud mansion, Zhang Fei gathered all his official and unofficial women. He explained to them his plan to directly break through to the Heaven Realm, which shocked all of them. After all, his cultivation had long been stable, but he had waited until his marriage with Zhou Shenxin, especially since he would face lightning tribulations that were much more intense than usual.

"Are you sure you want to do that?" Hong Xinxin asked in a serious tone. "I've heard of cultivators breaking through two to three stages at once, but they only broke through minor stages, and they experienced great difficulty in the process. As for you, you are about to break through three minor stages and one major stage, so I'm not sure you will be able to make it through. Your cultivation will be crippled if you fail, and at worst, you will die from your lightning tribulations."

Shang Yumei nodded in agreement with Hong Xinxin. "Husband, I understand your wishes, but I think it is too risky for you to break through to the Heaven Realm directly. After all, your bad karma is too thick, and Heaven will try to kill you by bringing down powerful lightning tribulations at once."

"I fully understand the risks, but I have already decided on it." Zhang Fei's response made them angry, but he hurriedly continued. "I will not break through to the Heaven Realm directly, and I will break through to the 10-Stars Earth Realm first. If I feel I am able to break through to the Heaven Realm, I will break through again immediately, but conversely, I will stop if I am unable to withstand my lightning tribulations."
"Why did you never discuss this matter with us, Feir? Why did you suddenly make this decision?" Zhang Yue inquired, her voice filled with worry.
Liu Qingyu also asked him. "Did you have any other plans for deciding to do that?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei then told them about his plans to dominate the lower and middle realms, which greatly shocked them. "Our family is large now, and we will need more cultivation resources as our cultivation continues to increase. Therefore, I decided on this matter, and the lower and middle realms will be our foundation before I bring you all to the upper realms."

They had long known that Zhang Fei wanted to dominate the lower and middle realms, but they felt that it was too hasty, and he should do everything gradually. However, their memories of Luo Yunxiao led them to believe that Zhang Fei made this decision in order to pursue her.
"Did you decide this for Luo Yunxiao?" Qing Yi asked.

Zhang Fei immediately admitted that. "Luo Yunxiao has always been on my mind, but I didn't make this decision entirely because of her. The heavenly fox race has started chasing me again, and sooner or later, they will arrive at our realm. So far, I have been able to defeat some cultivators in the Seven Divine Realms by relying on my speed, but I will not be able to continue relying on my speed, and I need a higher power to deal with them."

"Why are you guys so serious?" Qing Yi and the others turned to Zhang Chen, who had just entered the mansion. "Fei'er's decision does seem rash, but you guys should know his character, and he would never make such a decision if he was not confident in his chances. I believe he has considered everything carefully, and I believe he will get through everything, so I support him in doing so."

The women exchanged glances before finally agreeing with Zhang Fei's wishes. Hong Xinxin then spoke. "Where are you going to make your breakthrough? You will break through three minor stages and one major stage at once, and your lightning tribulations will be too strong because of it. I think you should not break through in the Nine Stars Realm, and you should do it in another realm."

"I will break through in the Nine Hells Darkland since there is not a single human there, but I will not bring all of you there, especially since it will be too dangerous." Zhang Fei immediately stood up. "I will prepare myself now."
After Zhang Fei left for the Nine Hells Darkland, Zhang Lin asked the others. "Do you think Big Brother will make it through?"

"Lin'er, you have to believe Fei'er." Zhang Chen answered her first. "He is not weak, and he has considered everything carefully. His current strength and abilities have indeed surpassed many cultivators, but those heavenly foxes, especially their two ancestors, are more powerful than him. If he can't fight them, he will die at their hands, and I don't want that to happen."
Qing Yi caressed her second daughter's head. "I'm worried about him too, but your grandmother is right, Lin'er. We have to believe in Fei'er, and I believe he won't let us down."
"Yeah."
Hong Xinxin then walked out. "Let's continue our training while waiting for Fei'er to complete his breakthrough, especially since he will need our help to deal with those heavenly foxes."

Meanwhile, Lin Moxian and Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already arrived not far from the Xianjin Realm. "Senior brother, I plan to break through today, so we should find an empty place so I can break through in peace."
"Huh?" Lin Moxian was surprised to hear that. "Do you really want to break through again? The last time you broke through was a month ago, right?"

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded at him. "I have five clones, and my cultivation has been stable for some time now. Moreover, I have many Qi reserves from my prisoners, so I will use them to break through today. However, I will not only break through to the 8-Star Earth Realm, but I will also directly break through to the Heaven Realm."

Lin Moxian's jaw dropped hearing that, but then he shouted at him. "Are you crazy? Breaking through three minor stages at once is already difficult to endure, yet you also want to directly break through to the Heaven Realm. If you fail to withstand your lightning tribulations, you will become a cripple, and your hard work all this time will end in vain. Moreover, you have numerous women by your side, and they will be in despair if you become a cripple or even die."

"Senior brother, I wouldn't dare do it if I wasn't sure that I could face my lightning tribulations." Zhang Xiaolong [3] replied with a soft sigh. "I know your worries, but I really need strength to face my enemies, and I think that is the best solution for me."
"Who are your enemies?"

"The heavenly fox race." Lin Moxian just remembered that. "Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing have sent their members to hunt me in the lower realms, and I have succeeded in defeating them. However, they also sent stronger foxes to hunt me in the middle realms, and I don't know their exact strength yet, so I have to prepare myself to fight them."

Lin Moxian let out a heavy sigh. "Since you want to break through several stages at once, we can't enter the Xianjin Realm now, especially since it will attract people there to come to us. I remember there is a small abandoned realm not far from here, so I will take you there, and no one will disturb your breakthrough there."
"All right, let's go to that realm now, Senior Brother."

Three hours later, they were already in the realm that Lin Moxian had mentioned before. The realm was too small compared to the Sky Jade Realm, but there were no living beings in it, so it was the perfect place for Zhang Xiaolong [3] to break through.

The two of them went straight to the highest mountain peak in the realm, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] sat in the middle alone. Meanwhile, Lin Moxian stood quite far away from him because he would rather not be affected by his lightning tribulations, which he believed would be extremely powerful. "Are you ready to break through?"
"Soon."
In the Nine Hells Darkland, Zhang Fei was already sitting on Lei Que's back. Tian Gongzhu and Tian Jianxia stood quite far from their location, wondering about his purpose in doing so.

Zhang Fei rubbed Lei Que's head and spoke to him. "This breakthrough will be dangerous because I intend to break through to the Heaven Realm, so you must prepare for the worst. If you are unable to withstand the power of my lightning tribulations, you must tell me immediately, and I will send you back to the beast space."

"Master, you don't have to worry about me. Your lightning tribulations will be extremely powerful, but I am the lightning bird. Furthermore, I am your beast contract, so I will accompany you to the end, and my cultivation will definitely break through several stages directly."

"Yeah." Zhang Fei looked up at the sky for a while before taking a deep breath. He then took out several superior-grade healing pills and placed them in his mouth so he could swallow them directly if he needed them to recover from his injuries later. "Get ready."
"I'm ready, Master."
After he felt completely ready, Zhang Fei's fifth clone in the Yin-Yang Space began to absorb the Qi inside the glass tube.
[You gained 2,450,000 Qi.]
[Congratulations! Your cultivation broke through to the 8 Star Earth Realm.]
[You gained 6,000,000 Qi.]
[Congratulations! Your cultivation broke through to the 9 Star Earth Realm.]
[You gained 6,500,000 Qi.]
[Congratulations! Your cultivation broke through to the 10 Star Earth Realm.]

After the third notification appeared, Zhang Fei's fifth clone stopped absorbing the Qi inside the glass tube. The sky in the Nine Hells Darkland that was already dark became even darker, and countless lightning bolts quickly flashed up there.

Soon, an extremely strong pressure descended from the sky, pressing down on Zhang Fei and Lei Que. Naturally, Tian Gongzhu and Tian Jianxia also felt that pressure, especially since it enveloped the entire realm. "What's with this pressure? What exactly did he do to provoke the wrath of the heavens?"

chapters.title: Chapter 795: 1 Star Heaven Realm
paragraphs: "Let's go there!"
"Yes, Master." Lei Que immediately took Zhang Fei flying into the sky and disappeared behind the dark clouds.

Upon their arrival in the clouds, Zhang Fei released his three souls before merging them into one. He did not forget to release his four cultivation cores so his lightning tribulations could temper and strengthen them.

Tian Gongzhu and Tian Jianxia, who watched their actions from a distance, were completely shocked to see the two of them disappear. No cultivators had ever dared to enter their lightning tribulations, especially since the attacks they received would be multiplied because those lightning bolts would directly hit their bodies.
Tian Jianxia's lips curled upwards. "If that bastard dies, we will be free from him, and we will be free people again."

"You are truly foolish, Senior Sister." Tian Jianxia turned to Tian Gongzhu with a frown. "Do you think someone as cruel as him will let us go free? Our souls have already merged with Zhang Fei's, and we will die if he dies, so you better hope he doesn't die."

"Tch!" Tian Jianxia just remembered that, making her furious. Moreover, she had become a demon fox now, preventing her from returning to the Heavenly Moon Realm. "What do you think his plans are for us? Ever since he brought us here, he hasn't come to see us again, and he's been busy with his own affairs."

"I don't know." Tian Gongzhu shook her head. "I'm sure he has prepared some evil plans for us, but there's nothing we can do. Even if he doesn't use his slave mark on us, we're no different from his slaves, so we can only wait for him to complete his lightning tribulations."
Zap... Zap... Zap...

Behind the black clouds, Zhang Fei and Lei Que had already started to face lightning attacks, and the attacks were much stronger than usual because it was the combination of three lightning tribulations.
Fortunately, Zhang Fei has his enhanced condition ability, and he also has his passive regenerative healing factors, but the case with Lei Que is different.
Even though Lei Que was a thunderbird, Zhang Fei's lightning tribulations were quite painful for him. "Master, these attacks are quite strong."

"Swallow these healing pills." Zhang Fei threw a few pills into Lei Que's mouth, which he swallowed immediately. "My lightning tribulations this time will last longer than usual, so you must endure their lightning attacks and absorb them to increase your cultivation."
"Yes, Master."
[Master, the attack just now was only the beginning. The system detects that the heavens are brewing stronger ones, so you have to be careful.]

Zhang Fei narrowed his eyes in the distance. 'What do you think will happen if I bring my four clones here, Mei? Will they be able to help me absorb this lightning? Or will their presence make the heavens even angrier?'

[I can't say for sure, Master. Your clones are different from the other clone techniques, and they are basically one unit with your original body. If you want to try it, you can bring one of them here, and you can bring the rest if there is no significant change from your lightning tribulations.]

In a few minutes, Zhang Fei's first clone had arrived beside them, but he did not detect any changes in his lightning tribulations, and neither did Mei and the system. In the end, he brought his second, fourth, and fifth clones there.
Zap... Zap... Zap...

Several lightning dragons suddenly struck towards them; Zhang Fei and his four clones immediately absorbed them. Lei Que also absorbed some of them, but he no longer felt the pain as before thanks to the presence of his four clones, which divided the attacks of those lightning.
[Your clones really benefit you, Master.]
'Yeah.' Zhang Fei responded with a sense of relief. 'If I had known this a long time ago, I would have never had trouble passing my previous lightning tribulations.'

[Are you going to break through to the Heaven Realm now, Master? Since your clones can help you deal with your lightning tribulation, I think it's fine if you break through to that stage now. However, the amount of Qi in the glass tube doesn't seem to be enough for that, so you'll have to use your Qi reserves in the Qi storage.]

Zhang Fei thought for a moment as he stared at the core of his lightning tribulations. 'Let's wait for these lightning tribulations to end first, Mei. If I break through to the Heaven Realm now, Lei Que won't be able to withstand it, and it will be detrimental to him.'
[Yes, Master.]
Zap... Zap... Zap...

The third group of lightning bolts quickly struck them, but Zhang Fei and his four clones did not experience any significant difficulties. However, Lei Que felt quite painful due to the increase in their attack power, but his master immediately gave him several healing pills.
Zhang Fei suddenly remembered something and used his lightning element technique, and the light winged race appeared behind them before enveloping them, which accelerated their recovery.
"Get ready to withstand stronger attacks, Lei Que."

Lei Que nodded. "Fortunately, you have powerful healing pills and your light element, Master. Otherwise, I wouldn't be able to withstand their powerful attacks for too long, and I would definitely die if I forced myself."

"This isn't over yet, and I will immediately break through to the Heaven Realm once these lightning tribulations are over." Lei Que took a deep breath as he imagined the power of Zhang Fei's lightning tribulation when he broke through to the Heaven Realm. "If you can't face it, I will send you into the beast space, and I will face my lightning tribulations myself."
"Yes, Master."

She really wanted to save herself and her three children, but she really didn't have the heart to kill Huangfu Shou.
Helian Yueyi then sat beside Huangfu Shou, who looked lost in thought. "What are you thinking, husband?"

"I will pass my throne to Lian'er." Huangfu Shou's answer took Helian Yueyi aback. "My memories are declining, and my body is also weakening. I can no longer lead our kingdom in this condition, so I will transfer my authority to our son."

Helian Yueyi herself didn't mind if Huangfu Lian ascended the throne to become an emperor, but Zhang Fei's threat still weighed heavily on her mind and heart. She was afraid that he would attack her son if he ascended the throne, which would complicate her situation.
"When will you transfer your authority to our son?"

"I have ordered Old Ling to prepare everything, and our son will become the emperor of this kingdom tomorrow morning." Helian Yueyi wrinkled her brows because Huangfu Shou had not discussed his decision with her before. "I want you to prepare for our son's coronation tomorrow."
Unfortunately, Helian Yueyi still did not know that Huangfu Shou was already under Li Tiannan's control through his soul marionette gu, and all his decisions were made based on his orders.
"Okay then, I'll prepare it." Helian Yueyi hurriedly left her husband's room to look for her son.

Helian Yueyi raised an eyebrow slightly when she arrived at her son's room, especially since Huangfu Lian was chatting with her husband's two concubines, Fei Yan and Guang Yi. "What are you two doing here?"
"We are talking to Lian'er about his coronation, Sister Yueyi." Fei Yan calmly replied.
Guang Yi also answered her. "I overheard Old Ling's conversation with Huangfu Ziyuan, and they were talking about Lian'er's coronation, so I came here to congratulate him."

"You guys knew about it before me, huh?" Helian Yueyi softly spoke, but they could hear the annoyance in her voice because she was the last to know about it. "Are you ready for tomorrow's coronation ceremony, Lian'er?"

Huangfu Lian shook his head at his mother. "Honestly, I am not ready to lead our kingdom, Mother. However, my father has already decided on this matter, and he does not seem to be going to change his mind, so I have to be ready whether I like it or not."

"I see." Helian Yueyi nodded in understanding. "I was shocked by your father's sudden decision, but his condition continued to decline, so he had no other choice but to hand over his authority to you. Therefore, you must be ready to carry out your new duties, and we will all help you to adapt to it, so your father's trusted people will be willing to accept you as their emperor."

"Tomorrow morning, and I will send people to help prepare at dawn." Thereafter, Helian Yueyi left her son's room and went to her two daughters' room.

"Sister Yan is right, Lian'er." Guang Yi also sat on Huangfu Lian's lap. At first, she was unwilling to have a relationship with him, but Fei Yan used dirty means to trap her into one. "We must wait for the situation to calm down before you can declare us your wife, or Sister Yueyi will be angry with us. Moreover, our children still don't know about our relationship with you, and they will be disappointed in us."
Huangfu Lian nodded to them. "Okay, I will follow both of your wishes. By the way, you two have to help my mother now, or she will be suspicious of you."
"Yes."

Helian Yueyi was sitting on the bedside of her two daughters, rubbing their foreheads and looking at them uncertainly. "What should I do? I won't be able to save you two if I don't kill your father, but I don't have the heart to do it. If I don't kill your father, that evil demon will kill you both. Unlike us, you two still have a long life ahead of you, so I don't want you both to die."

Helian Yueyi frowned. "Do you really have the heart to kill our husband, Sister Yanxi?"

"What do you think about that, Sister Yueyi?" The fake Ruo Yanxi asked.

"All right." The fake Ruo Yanxi replied with a nod.

"I think we don't need to rush with the matter, and it would be better if we allowed Lian'er to choose his empress himself, sister-in-law." Huangfu Ziyuan spoke.
Helian Yueyi softly sighed. "You're right. Lian'er has already grown up, and he will become emperor tomorrow, so he can choose the woman who will be his empress."

"Even though you have swallowed quite a few healing pills, and I have also used my light element to recover our injuries, I can see that your condition is not good. Inside the Cloud Mansion, Ru Xue and the others stood around Zhang Fei, but they did not disturb him from cultivating. They were glad he had passed three lightning tribulations at once, but they knew he would break through to the Heaven Realm after this.

chapters.title: Chapter 796: The Xianjin Realm
paragraphs: Lin Moxian stood alone, looking at Zhang Fei and his five clones seriously. As a cultivator who had reached the Seven Divine Realms, he naturally knew the difficulty of breaking through to the Heaven Realm.

The Heaven Realm could be said to be the first step of the three highest stages in the ten realms of mortal cultivation, followed by the Sovereign Realm and the Saint Realm. To break through to that stage and break free from mortal limitations, a cultivator must be able to understand and absorb Heavenly Qi, which was purer and stronger than ordinary Qi.

At this stage, a cultivator's body would undergo significant changes after being baptized by Heavenly Qi, which would increase their strength several times over compared to cultivators in the Earth Realm.

A single move from a Heaven Realm cultivator could change the weather, destroy hundreds of Earth Realm cultivators, or even reshape the landscape. One's body would become more resistant to poisons, diseases, and other negative effects.
When a cultivator broke through to the Heaven Realm, their lifespan would also increase quite a bit; one could live between 3000 to 5000 years depending on their level in that realm.

"Hmm?" Lin Moxian furrowed his brow, witnessing the sky above the realm swiftly transform into a pitch-black darkness. Unlike Zhang Fei's previous breakthroughs, the lightning bolts that appeared in the sky were no longer purple, yellow, or white but gold. "Junior brother, your hands are too bloody, leading to the accumulation of bad karma. As a result, the heavens wish to punish you. They even sent down the gold judgment lightning, even though you only broke through to the Heaven Realm. Even so, you will become much stronger if you manage to withstand and absorb them to temper your entire body, and your body will become unmatched even by a cultivator in the Seven Divine Realms. If you successfully pass this lightning tribulation, they might send down the black annihilation lightning in your next breakthroughs."
*Rumble... Rumble...*

Up in the sky, Zhang Fei, who had closed his eyes, could feel the power of his lightning tribulation, but his expression was extremely calm, and there was not the slightest fear on his face. His five clones sat cross-legged on both sides, waiting for the lightning tribulation to strike them. The white winged race enveloped them all to help them recover from their injuries if they were injured by the golden lightning bolt.

On the other hand, Lei Que, the thunderbird, felt worried and restless due to the power of Zhang Fei's lightning tribulation. His confidence in facing it dwindled significantly, but he would rather not back down because it would only bring setbacks for him.

Zhang Fei's eyebrows trembled slightly as he tried to understand the Heavenly Qi, but a faint smile appeared on his face because it was not difficult to understand thanks to his high comprehension in learning new things.

'The heavenly qi is indeed much different from ordinary qi; it is purer and stronger.' The divine Qi will be much stronger than this, making me impatient to reach the Seven Divine Realms.' Zhang Fei then calmed his mind and began to absorb the Heavenly Qi, gradually spreading it throughout his body, including his soul, cores, bones, and internal organs, to temper them.
[Master, these golden lightning bolts are much different from your previous lightning tribulations, so you must be extremely vigilant.]

Without Mei having to tell him, Zhang Fei had already realized the power of those golden lightning bolts. Even though he was confident in his body's capabilities after using his enhanced body condition ability to strengthen it, he still didn't dare to underestimate them. He and his clones had already prepared enough healing pills in their mouths just in case their bodies couldn't withstand them.
*Rumble... Rumble...*
The sound of lightning cracking became louder and louder; the pressure descending from the sky became more powerful, pressing down on Zhang Fei, his five clones, and Lei Que.

Three hours later, a golden dragon made of golden lightning appeared behind the dark clouds, and it immediately circled them. However, it did not attack them immediately, and it seemed to be waiting for the right time to strike.

Already immersed in their cultivation, Zhang Fei and the five clones experienced a faster flow of Heavenly Qi into their bodies. Gradually, his soul underwent significant changes, and it became thicker and clearer with each passing second, making it look like a separate individual. His four cultivation cores also became bigger after absorbing so much Heavenly Qi, making his Qi capacity increase significantly.

After waiting for a long time, the golden lightning dragon was floating in front of them with its mouth wide open. It instantly swallowed Zhang Fei, his five clones, and Lei Que, electrocuting them at the same time.
*Splurt*

As their bodies convulsed due to the powerful shock from the golden lightning, Zhang Fei and his five clones spurted blood from their mouths, and their entire bodies were charred black. paragraphs: "Hmm?" Yan Yinqing mischievously smiled. "Xi Hongyan? The cold and indifferent woman from the Red Sun Realm, right? Hasn't she rejected you dozens of times, Senior Brother?"
"Ugh!" Lin Moxian held his chest. "You hurt my feelings."
"Hehe." Yan Yinqing giggled. "So, what brings you here?"
"I brought our junior brother here for treatment, but Xiao Laoshu told me that you and Aunt Lingyan were here, so—" Yan Yinqing immediately pulled Lin Moxian's arm and led him away. "Hey, wait—"
"You can meet my mother later." Yan Yinqing accelerated her movements. "I've heard about our junior brother from my grandpa and uncle, and I can't wait to meet him, so we'll go see him right now."

A while later, they arrived at the healing chamber, where they found Zhang Xiaolong [3] unconscious in a healing capsule filled with a special liquid, with an oxygen mask and some medical equipment attached to his face and chest.1
Yan Yinqing immediately stood in front of the healing capsule, observing Zhang Xiaolong [3] with a curious look.
"How was your examination of my junior brother?" Lin Moxian approached Xiao Laoshu, who was checking Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s condition on a small monitor screen.

Xiao Laoshu pointed at the monitor and explained. "Young Master Lin, your junior brother's external injuries are indeed severe, and the burns on his body have reached ninety percent. His internal injuries are serious, but none of them are life-threatening. However, I find it strange because these devices detect the movement of some light elements inside his body, and he seems to have a passive healing ability, all of which makes all his injuries recover faster."

Lin Moxian was not surprised by that, and he was sure that some of Zhang Fei's women were nurturing his real body elsewhere using their light elements. "My junior brother is a little special, and I don't want people to know too much about him, so I hope you keep his medical records carefully."
"I understand, Young Master Lin."
Lin Moxian then approached his junior sister. "Why are you looking at our junior brother like this? Are you interested in him?"

"He is more handsome than you, Senior Brother." Lin Moxian's lips twitched hearing Yan Yinqing say that. "My grandfather told me that his cultivation only reached the 6-Star Earth Realm a little over two months ago, but he has now reached the 1-Star Heaven Realm, and his soul level has also reached the perfection stage of the earthly soul level."

"Zhang Fei is a dual cultivator, and his number of women is numerous, including your cousin, Hong Xinxin." Yan Yinqing herself had already heard that from Yan Leibao, so she was no longer surprised to hear it from Lin Moxian. 'I don't know how he managed to do it, but he had already broken through to the 7-Star Earth Realm when we set off for this realm a month ago, and he forced himself to break through to the Heaven Realm in two days.'
Yan Yinqing tilted her face to Lin Moxian. 'Did he really break through three minor stages and one major stage in two days?'
'Do I need to lie to you?' Lin Moxian immediately shared his memories of watching Zhang Fei break through with her junior sister. 'Watch them for yourself.'
Yan Yinqing watched everything before looking at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. 'So, this one is his clone?'

'Yes.' Lin Moxian nodded at her. 'Zhang Fei has five clones, and all of his clones are real, all of which are directly connected to his main body. According to him, all his clones have their partners except for the fifth clone, and his cultivation speed is extremely fast because of them.'
Yan Yinqing nodded in understanding. "I heard that he managed to defeat my grandfather in a speed race, so I can't wait for him to recover, and I will challenge him to a speed race with me."

"You are a speed maniac!" Yan Yinqing stuck out her tongue at Lin Moxian. "Trust me, you will never be able to win a speed race against him, and he will defeat you before you have time to blink. By the way, why did Aunt Lingyan check her health with Senior Yishen? Did something happen to her?"

Yan Yinqing released a heavy sigh. "My mother practiced incorrectly some time ago, and she suffered a backlash because of it, which caused her Qi to flow in reverse. My grandfather tried to help her recover, but he didn't succeed, so we came here to see Senior Yishen. Do you know where our master went, Senior Brother? Why hasn't he contacted me in the past five months? I also tried to contact him repeatedly, but I could never reach him."

"Our master is currently in the Star Tower in the Blossoming Heaven Realm. He brought Qiao Liangren and Shang Yingyue with him, especially since they were in the Wilderness Realm at the time." Lin Moxian then explained to his junior sister about the tower and some things from his conversation with Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Our junior brother wants to challenge another tower after he recovers, and I plan to join him, but we will go to my realm to see my aunt first. If you are interested in that, you can join us."
"I'm in!" Yan Yinqing decided without thinking. "Will our junior brother bring all his wives and partners with him?"
"That's for sure." Lin Moxian then turned to leave. "Let's go back upstairs. I haven't seen Aunt Lingyan for a long time, so I want to see her now."
Lin Moxian and Yan Yinqing had arrived at the room on the top floor, where Tantai Lingyan was discussing with Tian Yishen.

Tantai Lingyan's blue hair was worn in a high bun. She has a pair of gentle and pretty blue eyes. Although she didn't wear any cosmetics on her mature face, she was still a beautiful woman. Her simple, snow-white clothes couldn't conceal the fine curves of her slim and exquisite figure. Her shoulders were chiseled, and the curves in front of her chest were gorgeous. The aura emanating from her body was slightly cold, yet calming.
"Oh?" Tantai Lingyan turned to them directly. "When did you arrive in this realm, Little Moxian?"

"Not long ago, Aunt Lingyan." Lin Moxian sat down in front of them with Yan Yinqing. "I brought my junior brother here because his injuries were quite severe, but Senior Yishen was busy with you, so I handed him over to Xiao Laoshu, who is currently taking care of him."
Tantai Lingyan nodded in understanding. "I've heard many things from my father-in-law about Senior Hun Di's newest disciple, but how did he suffer such severe injuries? Did someone attack him?"
"Not at all." Lin Moxian then told Tantai Lingyan and Tian Yishen about Zhang Xiaolong [3], causing both of them to frown.

"That kid is too reckless." Tian Yishen commented by shaking his head. "Breaking through the three minor stages is already difficult even for senior cultivators like us, yet he forced himself to break through to the next major stage, and he was truly lucky not to become a cripple because of his recklessness."
"I agree with you, Senior Yishen." Tantai Lingyan then asked. "How is your junior brother's condition now? Has he passed his crisis period?"

Lin Moxian nodded at her. "Laoshu told me that his injuries are not life-threatening, and he is recovering quickly. However, his actions have made his cultivation foundation too fragile, so he must rest from cultivating for a while."
"Yeah, he must rest first." Tantai Lingyan then asked Tian Yishen. "Is there no other way to normalize my Qi flow?"

"No." Tian Yishen shook his head. "The only way to normalize your Qi flow is to unclog your veins, but the cold is too strong, so you need items with high Yang Qi intensity, such as the flame ginseng, the flaming sun essence, or other items."
Tantai Lingyan nodded in understanding. "In that case, I'll take my leave, and I'll go to the alchemy sector to look for those items. Would you like to join us, Little Moxian?"
"I'll catch up with you two after I talk to Senior Yishen, Aunt Lingyan."
Thereafter, Tantai Lingyan and Yan Yinqing left the room, but they did not leave the building immediately. Instead, the two women went to the healing chamber to see Zhang Xiaolong [3].
Lin Moxian immediately spoke to Tian Yishen. "Senior, I want you to keep all information about my junior brother under wraps, or the situation will become bad for him."
"Does he have any powerful enemies?"

"Yes." Lin Moxian then told Tian Yishen about Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s problems with the heavenly fox race, but he didn't tell him that his junior brother was a heavenly fox himself. "Those foxes are hunting him in the middle realms, and they will also hunt him in the upper realms if they find out about his presence here, so I hope for your help in hiding everything about him."

"You don't need to worry about that, and I will close all information about that kid." Lin Moxian hurried to catch up with Tantai Lingyan and Yan Yinqing, and Tian Yishen went to check on Zhang Xiaolong [3] himself.

Tian Yishen was already standing in front of the healing capsule, where Zhang Xiaolong [3] was unconscious. He was reading his health check data through a small screen in his hand. "Have you checked his body thoroughly, Laoshu? Have you located the source of the light elements in his body?"
Xiao Laoshu shook her head. "This kid has light elements, but the ones on his body are definitely not his own. They belong to some people, but I couldn't locate the source."

Tian Yishen nodded and returned his focus to Zhang Xiaolong's data [3]. 'If my guess is correct, this kid is a clone. However, I have never seen such a realistic clone, and the light elements on his body should belong to the people around his real body. This kid was truly fortunate that Lin Moxian brought him here, and he also had those people by his side. Otherwise, he wouldn't be able to recover so quickly, and he would probably become a cripple due to his severe injuries. However, I don't understand the heavenly fox race's reason for hunting him, especially since I couldn't find anything special inside his body, except for his four cores.'
"How long will it take for this kid to recover, Senior?" Xiao Laoshu asked.

"Hmm?" Tian Yishen first looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s data. "He should be able to fully recover in three to five hours, and you should immediately tell him not to cultivate for at least a month, or his cultivation foundation will collapse."
"I'll tell him after he wakes up."

Tian Yishen then left the place, his thoughts filled with wonder. 'No wonder Hun Di is willing to accept that kid as his disciple! He is only 20 years old, but his cultivation has already reached the 1-Star Heaven Realm, and most importantly, he has four cultivation cores, which is one more than the Nameless One. If he meets this kid, he might be interested in taking him as his disciple.'
A few hours later, Hu Yue and the others saw that Zhang Fei had opened his eyes. "How do you feel?"

"I was a little weak because of my previous injury, but I'm fine now thanks to all of you." Zhang Fei then took a healing pill and a qi recovery pill. "Additionally, my senior brother brought my third clone to the Xianjin Realm, and he is currently receiving treatment using super modern medical equipment there. However, I can't cultivate for a while, and I have to focus on stabilizing my cultivation foundation first."
Ru Xue's eyes lit up upon hearing that. "How advanced is their medical equipment compared to the medical equipment on Earth?"

"Are you interested in seeing them?" Ru Xue answered Zhang Fei with repeated nods. "Their equipment is no less advanced than my science capsule, so you should already know how sophisticated their medical equipment is, right? If you want to see their medical equipment, I will take you to that realm, but I want to rest for now."
"All right, you can rest first, and we will join the others to practice." Ru Xue and the others immediately left the room.

After they left, Zhang Fei's four clones began to focus on stabilizing his cultivation, especially since he wanted to challenge the second floor of the Star Tower as soon as possible. Moreover, he also wanted to explore the Xianjin Realm to find materials to produce more of his new weapons, and he couldn't do it in his weak state. 'How much Qi do I need to break through to the second stage, Mei?'
[Ten million, Master. You have used all the Qi in the glass tube, and there are only three hundred thousand remaining Qi in the Qi storage.]

Zhang Fei gave a light nod. 'The Qi in the glass tube will be filled quickly with the existence of Ruo Yanxi, Qu Qiuxue, Ma Mingxin, and Zhou Meiling in the Yin-Yang Space. Moreover, I still have a lot of Yin Qi stored in the bottle, so I don't need to think about that.'

[Your main task now is to stabilize your cultivation foundation, which is too fragile due to your previous breakthroughs. Fortunately, you have five clones, so it's not a big deal as long as they focus on doing it. By the way, the time you gave Helian Yueyi is up, so I think you should take care of that matter, and your affairs in the Nine Stars Realm will be over. That way, you can start your plans for the lower and middle realms, and you can take them away to the upper realms once everything is done.]
'I will go straight to Helian Yueyi once I am in good condition.' Zhang Fei then sat on the bed and started to stabilize his cultivation as well.

In the Xianjin Realm, Xiao Laoshu had already moved Zhang Xiaolong [3] to the ward, and he re-examined his body condition. "How did you recover from your injuries so quickly? Can you tell me about the other light elements that flowed through your body earlier?"

"Miss, I thank you for taking care of me, but we don't know each other, so I can't tell you anything." Xiao Laoshu put on a disappointed look, but he did not force Zhang Xiaolong [3] to say it. "Do you know where my senior brother is now?"
*Crack*
The ward door opened before Xiao Laoshu could reply to Zhang Xiaolong [3], and Lin Moxian walked in with the two women. "Are you okay now, Junior Brother?"
"Young Master Lin, I will take my leave now."

"Yes." Lin Moxian then introduced the two women to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Junior brother, this little girl is your senior sister and Hong Xinxin's cousin, Yan Yinqing. The other one is her mother, Tantai Lingyan."

"Hey! I'm not a little girl, Senior Brother!" Yan Yinqing immediately approached Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "How did you manage to defeat my grandfather in speed racing? I want to race with you, so you have to recover as soon as possible."

Tantai Lingyan shook her head helplessly as she listened to her daughter. "Qing'er, your junior brother has just recovered from his injuries, and his condition is not at its peak yet, so you should restrain yourself."
'Senior brother is right; this woman is truly proud of her speed.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] muttered in his heart. "Senior sister, I will compete with you after I have fully recovered, okay?"
"You must keep your word!"

"I will." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded before looking at Tantai Lingyan. "Senior, your veins are blocked by the cold in your body, and your Qi flow has been reversed because of it. To recover, you need some items with high Yang Qi intensity, but such items are scarce."

"Oh?" Both women were surprised to hear that, and Tantai Lingyan asked him. "Have you ever studied medical knowledge? Could you please explain how you were able to identify my injury without examining my condition?"
Naturally, Zhang Xiaolong [3] couldn't tell them that Mei told him about it. "One of my wives is a doctor, and I learned quite a lot of medical knowledge from her."
