chapters.title: Chapter 798: More Clues About Xereth
paragraphs: Tantai Lingyan nodded in understanding. "Can you cure me?"

"I'm not sure I can cure you, but I can try it first." Since she had nothing to lose, Tantai Lingyan stretched out her hand to Zhang Xiaolong [3], who immediately grabbed it. She raised her eyebrows slightly, especially when he rubbed the back of her palm. "Relax yourself, and I will try using my fire element."

After Tantai Lingyan calmed herself down, Zhang Xiaolong [3] channeled his fire qi into her body, but it surprised her. 'His fire qi is different from the ordinary one, and I feel that there are three different flames in his fire qi. One of them is his original flame, and the other is the phoenix flame, but I can't recognize the last one.'

Tantai Lingyan wasn't wrong about that because Zhang Xiaolong [3] got the phoenix flames from Feng Yao, and the other one was the soul flames, both of which had merged with his original flames thanks to the immortal Yin-Yang Fire Art that he got on the hidden floor of the Star Tower.
"Unfortunately, I can't dispel the cold with just my Fire Qi, Senior." Zhang Xiaolong [3] let go of Tantai Lingyan's hand.
"It's okay, I can look for items with high Yang Qi intensity later." Tantai Lingyan then asked him. "How did you get the phoenix flames?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] was momentarily taken aback. "Feng Yao is my friend, and she has helped me a lot since I was living in the lower realms."
"Huh? Are you really good friends with Princess Feng Yao, Junior Brother?" Yan Yinqing asked with a look of disbelief.
"Yeah." Zhang Xiaolong [3] told them how he came to know Feng Yao and their relationship in the past few months. "She is in isolation in my realm now."

"Wow! I didn't expect your relationship with Princess Feng Yao to be that close!" Yan Yinqing exclaimed. "Only a few people often meet her, and they are senior cultivators who know her parents. We, the younger generations, do know her. However, we rarely get to meet her, let alone have a good relationship with her."

Tantai Lingyan then spoke. "I have long heard that Princess Feng Yao went to the lower realms, but I don't know her purpose for going there. You are truly fortunate to be able to have a good relationship with her because not many people can do that, and it will be beneficial for you if you have a good relationship with the phoenix race; even Little Moxian's aunt has deep respect for them. Since you haven't fully recovered, my daughter and I won't bother you anymore, and you can rest in peace here."

"Wait a minute, Senior." Tantai Lingyan raised an eyebrow as Zhang Xiaolong [3] took out three bottles and handed them to her. "You can look at their contents later, and they can remove the cold from your veins."
Tantai Lingyan thought for a moment before receiving all three bottles. After she stored them, she took her daughter away, leaving Zhang Xiaolong [3] to rest.
Lin Moxian immediately sat down on the side chair. "Are you interested in Aunt Lingyan, Junior Brother? Otherwise, you won't give your Yang Qi to her, right?"
"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed awkwardly while rubbing his nose. "Senior Lingyan is a mature and pretty woman, and I prefer a MILF like her the most."

"What is a MILF?" Lin Moxian had never heard of such a term before, especially since it only existed on Earth. His jaw dropped after Zhang Xiaolong [3] explained the meaning of that term. "Does that mean you have a lot of MILFs by your side? You even gave Shang Chongyun a green hat by bedding Morung Qianying."

"Senior brother, my first woman is another man's wife, and she has an 11-year-old daughter." Zhang Xiaolong [3] told him about the accident between him and Ru Xue. "Back then, I purely considered her to be my big sister, but the accident changed the course of our relationship, and we ended up getting married after she divorced her husband. In fact, I still have four other wives who already have daughters, and their daughters are also my wives."

Lin Moxian raised both hands in surrender. "I am your senior in cultivation, but you are far more senior than me when it comes to women. You have many wives and partners, and I have pursued Xi Hongyan for decades, but I have always failed. Why are you more interested in mature women? Is it because they are more experienced?"

"Not really." Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head. "One of my wives is much younger than them, but she is much more experienced than them in such matters, and she taught them many things. It's hard for me to explain it to you, but mature women have their charm, and they always pique my interest. Once you have a relationship with a mature woman, you will definitely understand what I mean."

Lin Moxian sighed as he shook his head. "All members of my Li Clan are monogamous, and my grandparents will kill me if I have too many women. My aunt is the most terrible among them, and she will use me as a guinea pig if I have a polygamous relationship. By the way, Aunt Lingyan was already a widow before her daughter was born, so it's okay if you want to get her, but your senior sister might be hostile to you if you do that."
"How did her husband die?"

"A demon." Zhang Xiaolong [3] frowned at Lin Moxian's answer. "Back then, a powerful male demon attacked the Shandian Realm when Aunt Lingyan was pregnant with her daughter, and many cultivators from that realm died at his hands, including her husband. The Nameless One, the Phoenix Emperor and Empress, and several other powerful cultivators, including my aunt, immediately moved into that realm. Unfortunately, they arrived too late, and the demons had disappeared when they arrived. Since then, they have tried to hunt him down, but they never managed to find his trace. His attack also destroyed several clans in that realm, turning that day into the worst in the realm's history."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] thought deeply before asking. "Have you heard about the incident in the Starry Sky Realm, Senior Brother?"

"Yes." Lin Moxian immediately told him. "Unfortunately, the Starry Sky Realm was quite far from this realm, and it was already destroyed when the Nameless One and the others arrived there. The damage and destruction in that realm was the same as what happened in the Shandian Realm, so they thought the culprit was the same demon."
"Xereth."
"Hmm?" Lin Moxian raised an eyebrow.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] then summoned the demon extermination sword out. "This sword was forged by a blacksmith from the Starry Sky Realm, and he forged it specifically to kill Xereth because he slaughtered his family and the entire population of that realm. You said the destruction in that realm was the same as in the Shandian Realm, so I think he attacked it. He also destroyed many other realms, including some realms in the middle realms."
"How did you know about the demon's identity?"

"This sword is a soul weapon, and the blacksmith used the souls of his two dead daughters to forge it." Lin Moxian was shocked to hear that, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] told him about the Jian Clan. "Do you know about that clan?"

"In the past, the Jian Clan was one of the best blacksmith clans in the upper realms, and they were more skilled than the Tie clan or others; even Ji Changlan respected them very much. Unfortunately, the Jian clan disappeared along with the destruction of the Starry Sky Realm, and their disappearance was a huge loss for the upper realms." Lin Moxian nodded in understanding. "Since Xereth could destroy so many realms, and he could also evade the pursuit of a powerful cultivator like the Nameless One, his strength must be far beyond our reach. "Hmm?" Yan Yinqing took the bottle and opened the lid before sniffing it. "Huh? Mother, the contents of this bottle are Yang Qi, which is probably his Yang Qi."
Tantai Lingyan furrowed her brows and took the bottle back. "This Yang Qi indeed belongs to your junior brother, and it is much stronger than the items mentioned by Tian Yishen before."

"Haha." Yan Yinqing laughed at that. "Since you have recovered now, you can return to our realm today or tomorrow, but I won't come home with you. "Hmm?" Yan Yinqing then told Tantai Lingyan about the tower, which piqued her interest. "I will contact your grandparents now, and I will join you guys to challenge the tower."
Yan Yinqing was momentarily taken aback. "That's good then; our party will be even more lively."

Helian Yueyi did not join them and returned to her tent directly, but she felt very anxious because Zhang Fei could appear at any time. Just as Helian Yueyi was thinking about that, Zhang Fei [5] suddenly appeared in her room. He came together with Hong Xinxin and Shang Yumei, who restrained her two daughters, causing her to be thrown into a great panic.

Zhang Fei [5] intentionally brought Hong Xinxin and Shang Yumei with him because his condition had not fully recovered, and he was worried that he would not be able to fight Helian Yueyi if she tried to fight him back.
Helian Yueyi, who had reached a dead end, immediately ran to Zhang Fei [5] and threw herself in front of him. "Please! I beg you! Don't kill my daughters!"

"I've given you plenty of time to think about it, but you wasted the chance I gave you to save your daughters." Zhang Fei [5] lifted Helian Yueyi to her feet. "Since you chose your husband's life over your two daughters, you can watch them die with your own eyes."

Helian Yueyi shook her head vigorously as tears streamed down from her eyes. "No! No! Please! Zhang Fei! Don't kill my daughters! They are my everything, and I don't know what I should do if they die."
Hong Xinxin and Shang Yumei felt sorry watching Helian Yueyi's situation, but they said nothing and waited for Zhang Fei [5]'s next move.

"I will give you one last chance." Shang Yumei disappeared as soon as Zhang Fei [5] turned to her, and she returned with Huangfu Shou moments later. He then gave the Hongxi dagger to Helian Yueyi. "Kill him, and I will spare you and your children."

chapters.title: Chapter 799 799: Huangfu Shou's Death
paragraphs: Helian Yueyi held the hongxi dagger with trembling hands, pointing it at Huangfu Shou, who was standing in front of her with a flat gaze. "Husband, I—"
"I won't blame you, so you can kill me and save our children, wife." Huangfu Shou calmly spoke.
"But—"
"Do it!" Huangfu Shou shouted at his wife.
"Kill me!"
"Sorry... I'm... sorry..." Helian Yueyi said it with tears in her eyes, and she immediately thrust the dagger toward her husband.
Clang
Before the dagger pierced Huangfu Shou's chest, Zhang Fei [5] slapped Helian Yueyi's hand first, causing it to slip out of her hand and fall to the floor.

Helian Yueyi looked at Zhang Fei [5] with a puzzled look, but he turned to Shang Yumei, who immediately knocked her unconscious and supported her. "I thought you would really let her kill her husband."
"Do you two think I was too cruel to her?" Zhang Fei [5] asked as he pulled the Hongxi dagger back into his hand.
"Yes!" Both women answered simultaneously.

Hong Xinxin then spoke to him. "You were too cruel to her, especially since you forced her to choose between her husband's life and the lives of her children. In my opinion, you should kill them directly instead of doing something like this to her, and she wouldn't have to suffer like this."

"You still owe Yaolin an explanation, remember?" Zhang Fei [5] raised his eyebrows in response to Shang Yumei. "My sister did help Shang Huaqiang back then, but you know yourself that he had no choice but to follow his orders, just like my father and the others. Moreover, her feelings for you have already grown so deep after the two of you spent so much time together, and her feelings will be completely broken if she finds out that you were just toying with her. I know her character by heart, and she will commit suicide once she finds out about everything."
"Will you blame me if Shang Yaolin dies?" Zhang Fei [5] posed the question with a serious gaze.
Shang Yumei shook her head. "Yaolin is indeed my sister, but her life is in her hands. If she dies, then so be it."

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] chuckled. "You're truly a heartless sister, you know? Honestly, I've thought about some things about Shang Yaolin, but I would rather not focus on her for now, especially since she's still in the Sun Tower."
"What about Sister Qianying? When are you going to tell her the truth?" Hong Xinxin asked.
"Soon." Zhang Fei [5] then took Helian Yueyi from Shang Yumei before placing her on the bed. He then used his memory manipulation on her.
[Master, why are you acting too softly toward this woman? You even erased those bad memories from her memory.]

'Don't you already know what's on my mind?' Mei did not say anything to reply to Zhang Fei [5]. 'I would have killed them if she didn't dare to kill Huangfu Shou, but I changed my mind because of her actions just now. Since she is willing to sacrifice her husband and herself for the safety of their children, I will give her a chance. However, her husband must still die, but I will not do it with my hands.'

Zhang Fei [5] did not alter Helian Yueyi's original memories or add new memories, and he only erased those bad memories from her memory. Thereafter, he asked the two women to lay Huangfu Xiaomei and Huangfu Xiaoying by their mother's side before releasing their subconscious.

"Now that I've completed my business in this realm, I'll begin my next plan." Zhang Fei [5] turned to Hong Xinxin and Shang Yumei. "I want you two to accompany me to the Shrouded Sky Realm because it's time to take revenge against the Alchemy Union, and I will take over that organization for our sake. However, we need someone who understands the situation there, so we will pick up Luo Xuejia in the Zhou kingdom before leaving."
Both women nodded in agreement. "Let's go now."
When they arrived at the balcony, Hong Xinxin immediately took out her flying artifact, and they went to pick up Luo Xuejia before leaving the Nine Stars Realm.
Not long after they left, Li Tiannan entered Helian Yueyi's room and woke up the three women. He then walked behind Huangfu Shou, sealed his cultivation, and waited for them to open their eyes.

A few moments later, Helian Yueyi's eyelashes trembled, and she opened her eyes slowly, but she felt something was different about her. She then turned to her two daughters. "Eh? Why are Xiaomei and Xiaoying in my room?"
"Finally awake?"

Helian Yueyi immediately turned to Li Tiannan before jumping down from her bed in shock, especially since he pressed his dagger against Huangfu Shou's neck. "What do you mean by this, Senior Tiannan?"
"Superior orders." Li Tiannan directly slit Huangfu Shou's throat, causing blood to spurt from the wound, and his body convulsed repeatedly on the floor.
"No!" Helian Yueyi dashed toward Li Tiannan to attack him, but his pressure knocked her down. "Bastard! Why? Why did you kill my husband? We have always trusted you, but you killed him!"

"Hahaha." Li Tiannan walked over to Helian Yueyi before squatting down beside her and sealing her cultivation. "To tell you the truth, your husband and this kingdom are tools for the Huangfu Clan, and they no longer need you all, so they asked me to kill him. As for you and your two daughters, the three of you will be prisoners, and I will control this kingdom through your foolish first son."
"You—Mmhm!"
After he gagged Helian Yueyi's mouth, Li Tiannan immediately took her and her two sleeping daughters to the dungeon under the palace, and he imprisoned the three of them there.

After everything was settled, Li Tiannan went to see Huangfu Lian and ordered him to arrange Huangfu Shou's funeral before going elsewhere to help Gu Jinling create the Gu Heart that Zhang Fei wanted.

In prison, Helian Yueyi couldn't stop crying because of her husband's death, and her first son still didn't know anything about it. Li Tiannan had already sealed her cultivation, preventing her from telling Huangfu Lian about him.
Unfortunately, Helian Yueyi still didn't know that Huangfu Lian and the others were Zhang Fei's slaves, so it would still be useless if she told her son.
'Husband, I'm sorry; I can't avenge your death.' Helian Yueyi muttered as she continued to sob.
"Mhmm." Huangfu Xiaoying and Huangfu Xiaomei finally opened their eyes, but their minds were too muddled, especially since they had been unconscious for five whole months.

After a few minutes, Huangfu Xiaoying and Huangfu Xiaomei had fully regained consciousness, but they were shocked to find themselves in prison. They immediately sat on the bed before turning to their mother, and they hurried to remove the gag in Helian Yueyi's mouth. "What happened to us, Mother? Why are we in prison? Did our father put us in prison?"

"No! Your father didn't do this to us." Helian Yueyi wiped her tears and hugged her two daughters. "I'm glad you two finally woke up, Xiaoying and Xiaomei. You two have been sleeping for the past five months, and I've always been worried that you'll never wake up again."

"Eh?" Huangfu Xiaoying and Huangfu Xiaomei were stunned to hear that. They still remember the incident in the maze challenge when they were exposed to the black liquid, but they didn't expect that five months had passed since then. Moreover, they had a beautiful dream while they were still sleeping, and they thought it was real. "Did we two really sleep that long, Mother?"

"Yeah." Helian Yueyi released them from her embrace and rubbed their cheeks. "Xiaoying and Xiaomei, I don't want to talk about this since you two just woke up, but your father was just killed by the person we trusted so much, and he locked the three of us here."

Huangfu Xiaoying and Huangfu Xiaomei were stunned to hear that, but they did not feel any sorrow over Huangfu Shou's death, and they felt relieved to hear him die instead. "Who killed him, Mother? Why did that person kill our father?"

"His name is Li Tiannan, and he was sent by our ancestor." Helian Yueyi then explained to them about the Huangfu Clan in the Grand Royal Realm, which shocked them. "We couldn't tell you two or your brothers because he forbade us from telling you about them, and he has helped us so much to develop our kingdom, so it never crossed our minds that he would betray us and kill your father. Moreover, your big brother doesn't know about this matter yet, but I think he already has him under control."
"What should we do now, Mother? How can we escape from this prison if our cultivation is sealed like this?" Huangfu Xiaomei asked.
Huangfu Xiaoying hugged her knees. "I don't want to stay here too long, Mother."

Helian Yueyi shook her head and pulled her two daughters into her arms. "We can't do anything for now, but I'm sure Sister Yanxi and the others will notice that we are missing, and they will think of something to save us, so we can only wait for now."
"Um." Both women nodded and snuggled into Helian Yueyi's arms.

In contrast to the situation in the Huangfu Kingdom, the situation in the Bai Kingdom was much more peaceful and lively. The Bai royal family held a grand banquet for all the residents of their capital, especially after the coronation of Bai Congxi as their new emperor.

With all of Huangfu Shou's spies gone, the kingdom became much safer. Although the majority of the kingdom's population was still disappointed with Bai Yaowei and Linghu Yincheng's decision to abdicate, they still decided to support their new emperor.

In the Xian Kingdom, Xian Feng had already discussed plans for him and Shi Qingzhuang to abdicate. Their decision shocked the entire kingdom's population, but they knew that Xian Qifeng was a smart young man, and he also came from the main line of the Xian royal family, so they decided to support it.

Xian Feng ordered Old Feng and Old Wen to prepare for Xian Qifeng's coronation ceremony, and he wanted his nephew to ascend the throne in two weeks. This way, he and Shi Qingzhuang could focus on their isolation, especially since they were keen to join Zhang Fei to challenge the Star Tower once again.

In Yun Kingdom, Yun Shang and Guo Xuehua had also started preparing for Yun Aoxian's coronation ceremony. Since he was their crown prince and a direct descendant of the royal family, none of the nobles, clan leaders, or citizens of the kingdom opposed their emperor's decisions.
As for the generals of the Yun Kingdom, Yun Aoxian was already used to being involved with them, so they fully supported him to ascend the throne to become their next emperor.

Like Xian Feng, Yun Shang ordered her aides to prepare Yun Aoxian's coronation ceremony as soon as possible, and he wanted his eldest son to ascend the throne within two weeks. He also informed them that he and Guo Xuehua would enter seclusion after their eldest son ascended the throne, and they would only come out when Zhang Fei was ready to challenge the Star Tower.

After his condition improved enough, Zhang Fei sent his three clones to the Nine Hells Darkland to complete the three daily quests. He also sent the female demons to that realm, especially since all of them had reached their limits in training to use the gravity feature.
Zhang Fei's fifth clone, who was on his way to the Shrouded Sky Realm along with Hong Xinxin and Shang Yumei, also helped them complete one of them.

Since he couldn't cultivate for now, and all his women were busy with their training, Zhang Fei decided to relax in the training space by chatting with his family, the families of his wives, and friends.
Zhang Fei informed them that he might take them away to the upper realms much sooner than originally planned, which surprised all of them.
"Have you decided on our next destination, Fei'er?" Zhang Chen asked.

Zhang Fei took out the teleportation device. "If I activate this device, we can go directly to the Phoenix Realm from this realm. However, I haven't discussed this matter with Feng Yao, so I haven't activated it yet. She might be able to decide, but I think it would be wiser if I wait for her parents to return to their realms, especially since they are their current leaders."
"I think that is the best decision, Fei'er." Zhang Hanzhi then asked. "Do you have other realms to choose from besides the Phoenix Realm?"

Zhang Fei nodded at his aunt. "At first, I wanted to choose the Red Sun Realm, but I changed my mind. The Xianjin Realm is actually the most strategic, but it is already too crowded with people from other realms, and powerful cultivators go back and forth to that realm, so I think it is not suitable for us. Therefore, I thought of two other realms, which are the Starry Sky Realm and the Sovereign Heaven Realm."
"Why did you choose those two realms?" This time, Qing Tan asked.

Zhang Fei put away the device and summoned the demon extermination sword. "The Starry Sky Realm is the birthplace of this sword, and it has long been destroyed. Since its destruction, people have abandoned it, so no one will bother us if we stay there."
"What about the Sovereign Heaven Realm?"

Zhang Fei shook his head. "Old Ma told me that it is the strongest realm in the upper realms, so I believe the residents of that realm should be powerful. Moreover, I don't know the situation in that realm yet, so I want to go there first before deciding. However, I will put it off for now, and I will wait until my plans for the lower and middle realms are complete. By the way, I'm going out now to meet the others so I can put my plan into action."

After he left the training space, Zhang Fei immediately gathered the people from the Xian, Bai, Zhou, Yun, and Ximen Kingdoms in one place. He also invited Duan Zhao, his four disciples, and Cheng Gaoji to join them. "I want to tell you all that Huangfu Shou is dead, and I killed him indirectly through Li Tiannan. This way, the situation on this island is completely safe, and the war that has lasted for hundreds of years can be completely stopped."
"Kid, you didn't gather us all here to tell us that, right?" Cheng Gaoji spoke.

Zhang Fei immediately told them his true purpose. "I plan to spread the demon fox group to all the planets in the lower and middle realms, but I can't do it all by myself because the number of planets is too many. Since all the kingdoms are safe now, I need the help of your trusted people to carry out my plan."
"Why did you come up with such an ambitious plan, kid?" Xian Feng and the others nodded in agreement with Duan Zhao, and they felt that Zhang Fei's plans were too ambitious.

Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh. "Senior Duan, you already know about the Paradise Realm, right? That realm is entirely different from the three mortal realms, so I want to prepare everything as best as possible before going to that realm. I aim to expand the demon fox group, not to conquer all those realms, but to gather as many cultivation resources as possible. Currently, my fifth clone is on the way to the Alchemy Union headquarters with my two women, and I will attack them back to take over their organization."

"This kid's plan is ambitious, but he didn't plan it for himself, and he planned it for all of you too." They looked at Cheng Gaoji. All of you can't compete with upper realm cultivators, let alone the Paradise Realm. Thus, you should choose your best people to execute his plans, which will benefit everyone."
- To Be Continued -

chapters.title: Chapter 800: Ask For Help
paragraphs: After thinking things through carefully, those emperors and empresses finally agreed to Zhang Fei's plan, and they gave him some names. "I don't know their abilities, and you know them better, so I'll leave the decision to you. Once they are ready, they can gather at the Xian Capital, and I will send them to the Sky Jade Realm. This way, they don't need to spend much time traveling to the lower realms, and they can directly spread to other realms. As for the middle realms, I will ask my acquaintances from the upper realms for help, especially since their cultivation is higher."
Thereafter, Zhang Fei sent those emperors and empresses back to their respective kingdoms, and they immediately summoned the people they mentioned before to prepare to leave for the Sky Jade Realm.
Zhang Fei then spoke to Cheng Gaoji. "Old Cheng, my third clone has arrived at the Xianjin Realm, but he is currently being treated at Senior Tian Yishen's hospital."

"Hmm? Why is he receiving treatment there?" Cheng Gaoji and the others gasped as soon as Zhang Fei released his aura. "The Heaven Realm! When did you break through to this stage? Your cultivation should still be at the 7-Star Earth Realm, right?"

Zhang Fei smiled. "Strong enemies are starting to arrive, and I can't wait to challenge the Star Tower again, so I used up all my Qi reserves to break through to this stage yesterday. Unfortunately, my cultivation foundation is completely messed up now, so I have to rest from cultivating for now."

"You've gone mad, kid." Duan Zhao said this with a shake of his head. "You're lucky that your cultivation foundation wasn't destroyed, or else you'd already be a cripple by now. You do have many advantages over other cultivators, but you still have to be careful in making decisions, especially regarding your cultivation."

"You're right, I was indeed too careless, Senior Duan. Honestly, I wouldn't have taken this shortcut if it weren't for the appearance of the heavenly foxes, and I needed strength to fight them. Although my cultivation is still far below theirs, my strength has increased severalfold thanks to the heavenly Qi, and I am more confident in facing them now. If they dare set foot in this realm, I will immediately kill them." Zhang Fei then asked Cheng Gaoji. "Old Cheng, can you please check out the Starry Sky Realm for me?"
"What are your plans for that realm?"

Zhang Fei immediately replied. "I haven't confirmed my plans for that realm yet, and I want to confirm whether it is truly abandoned or if other cultivators have inhabited it. If that realm is completely abandoned, I might bring my close ones to live there, or I might use it as the headquarters of the demon fox group in the upper realms."

Cheng Gaoji nodded in understanding. "As far as I can remember, not a single cultivator has ever set foot in that realm after its destruction, especially since they considered it a cursed realm. It's fine if you want me to check that realm, but you have to take me back to the Xianjin Realm first, and I'll go there straight after."

"I'll go with you to that realm, Senior Cheng." Duan Zhao then sent a voice transmission to Zhang Fei. 'Kid, Xian'er has been thinking about you ever since you kissed her, and she keeps waiting for you to see her, so you have to do something about her.'
Zhang Fei was stunned for a moment before turning to Xian Xian, who lowered her face in embarrassment, amusing him. 'Haha! Behind her tomboyishness, she turns out to have such a shy side.'
After that, Zhang Fei sent the others back to Duan Zhao's residence so they could prepare to go to the Xianjin Realm, but he took Xian Xian away with him to the Cloud Mansion.

"Why did you bring me here?" Zhang Fei gave a faint smile before pulling Xian Xian into his embrace, and he gave her a gentle kiss on the lips, stunning her. 'Ugh! This brat always acts as he pleases!'

Despite her displeasure, Xian Xian put her arms around Zhang Fei's neck and returned his kiss with her eyes closed. She parted her lips when his tongue slipped into her mouth, and she instinctively sucked it.

Zhang Fei suddenly lifted her up and supported her buttocks, forcing Xian Xian to wrap her legs around his waist. She trembled when he massaged her round yet firm buttocks, making her body move involuntarily and rubbing her breasts against his chest.
A few minutes later, Xian Xian was having difficulty breathing, so she stopped their kisses and pressed their foreheads together. "Why are you doing this to me? Do you really have feelings for me?"

"Honestly, I was attracted to you from the start, but I didn't think much about it until I kissed you that day." Zhang Fei's answer made Xian Xian's heart pound. Although she was quite old, her feelings were no different from those of a teenage girl. "Do you want to be my lover, Xian'er?"

Xian Xian's face flushed; she was shyly nodding her head. Though I don't like you yet, you're the first man to do such things to me, so I want to be your lover. However, I would rather not do anything more than this before my feelings grow, so I hope you don't force me."

"If I wanted to force you, I would have done it already, and you wouldn't have been able to resist me." Xian Xian did not doubt Zhang Fei, especially since he was a man with numerous women by his side. "This place is my private place, and no one can enter here without me. Since you have never learned about the soul cultivation path, I will help you to become a soul cultivator, which will also be useful for your blacksmithing."
Xian Xian blinked her eyes repeatedly. "Can I really become a soul cultivator?"

"Do you need to doubt me?" Zhang Fei took Xian Xian to sit opposite each other on the bed. "All the people around me are soul cultivators, and I guide them to become ones. Release your soul first, and I will guide you to become one."
*Crack*
Before Xian Xian could release her soul, the bedroom door suddenly opened, and three little girls walked in. "Who are they?"
"Xu Ling'er is Ru Xue's daughter, Wu Lianzhi is my senior sister's daughter, and Tasha is a demon wolf." Zhang Fei then turned to them. "Why don't you three practice?"
Xu Ling'er climbed straight into bed. "Big brother, Tasha wanted to drink your Yang Qi, but we ran out of stock, so we came here to ask for it from you."
Zhang Fei looked at Tasha, whose face was red from embarrassment, and her wolf ears were closed. He then handed a few bottles of Yang Qi to Xu Ling'er, who accepted them with pleasure.
"Long'er, who is this big sister? Is she your new girlfriend?" Wu Lianzhi asked as he pulled Tasha over to them.
Zhang Fei wanted to answer, but Xian Xian preceded him. "Little sister, my name is Xian Xian, and I'm not in a relationship with him yet. By the way, why do you refer to him as Long'er?"

"I know his name is Zhang Fei, but I'm used to calling him Long'er, so I will call him by that nickname forever." Hearing Wu Lianzhi's answer, Xian Xian turned to Zhang Fei, who immediately told her about his third clone's previous situation. "Does this mean you will also be his wife in the future, Big Sis?"
Xian Xian patted Wu Lianzhi's head. "If he can make me fall in love with him, I will be his wife, but I will not be one if he fails to convince me."
Wu Lianzhi smirked in response to her, causing Xian Xian to raise her eyebrows. "Ling'er! Let's go back to our room! Tasha and I want to drink Long'er's Yang Qi."
After the three little girls left, Xian Xian asked Zhang Fei directly. "Are you going to take them as your wives in the future?"

"I promised Ling'er to take her as my wife in the future. Lianzhi likes me, but her feelings for me right now are more like siblings, and I still think of her as a little sister." "Old Cheng, my third clone has arrived at the Xianjin Realm, but he is currently being treated at Senior Tian Yishen's hospital."
"Hmm?

"The Heaven Realm!
When did you break through to this stage?
Your cultivation should still be at the 7-Star Earth Realm, right?"
Zhang Fei smiled.
"Strong enemies are starting to arrive, and I can't wait to challenge the Star Tower again, so I used up all my Qi reserves to break through to this stage yesterday.
Unfortunately, my cultivation foundation is completely messed up now, so I have to rest from cultivating for now."
"You've gone mad, kid." Duan Zhao said this with a shake of his head.
"You're lucky that your cultivation foundation wasn't destroyed, or else you'd already be a cripple by now.
You do have many advantages over other cultivators, but you still have to be careful in making decisions, especially regarding your cultivation."
"You're right, I was indeed too careless, Senior Duan.
Honestly, I wouldn't have taken this shortcut if it weren't for the appearance of the heavenly foxes, and I needed strength to fight them.
Although my cultivation is still far below theirs, my strength has increased severalfold thanks to the heavenly Qi, and I am more confident in facing them now.
If they dare set foot in this realm, I will immediately kill them." Zhang Fei then asked Cheng Gaoji.
"Old Cheng, can you please check out the Starry Sky Realm for me?"
"What are your plans for that realm?"
Zhang Fei immediately replied.
"I haven't confirmed my plans for that realm yet, and I want to confirm whether it is truly abandoned or if other cultivators have inhabited it.

Zhang Fei was stunned for a moment before turning to Xian Xian, who lowered her face in embarrassment, amusing him. 'Haha!

"Why did you bring me here?" Zhang Fei gave a faint smile before pulling Xian Xian into his embrace, and he gave her a gentle kiss on the lips, stunning her. 'Ugh!

Despite her displeasure, Xian Xian put her arms around Zhang Fei's neck and returned his kiss with her eyes closed.

Zhang Fei suddenly lifted her up and supported her buttocks, forcing Xian Xian to wrap her legs around his waist.

"If I wanted to force you, I would have done it already, and you wouldn't have been able to resist me." Xian Xian did not doubt Zhang Fei, especially since he was a man with numerous women by his side.
"This place is my private place, and no one can enter here without me.

Xian Xian blinked her eyes repeatedly.
"Can I really become a soul cultivator?"
"Do you need to doubt me?" Zhang Fei took Xian Xian to sit opposite each other on the bed.
"All the people around me are soul cultivators, and I guide them to become ones.
Release your soul first, and I will guide you to become one."
*Crack*
Before Xian Xian could release her soul, the bedroom door suddenly opened, and three little girls walked in.
"Who are they?"
"Xu Ling'er is Ru Xue's daughter, Wu Lianzhi is my senior sister's daughter, and Tasha is a demon wolf." Zhang Fei then turned to them.
"Why don't you three practice?"
Xu Ling'er climbed straight into bed.
